Lone Star Circle of Care (LSCC) Business Intelligence department (BI) seeks a highly qualified candidate to fill the position of Healthcare Data Analyst. BI is driven by its mission to deliver quality, cost-effective services to the neediest Texans. This position makes a significant contribution to LSCC's mission by assisting with data reporting and analytical activities.

The Healthcare Data Analyst performs complex data collection, reporting and analysis to monitor, evaluate and increase efficiencies for LSCC. Work involves conducting detailed analysis of and extensive research on data, used for financial estimates and operational deliverables. Includes providing results, and monitoring and implementing data quality. May provide guidance to others. Works under general supervision, with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment. The Healthcare Data Analyst works with various teams to explore different aspects of a system (people, policy, and processes) to determine why particular areas are performing well or have opportunities for improvement

The ideal candidate thrives in an environment that emphasizes teamwork to achieve goals, excellence through high professional standards and personal accountability, curiosity to continuously grow and learn, critical thinking for effective execution, and integrity to do things right even when what is right is not easy. This position will be required to travel to other LSCC facilities as needed. The Data Analyst collaborates with employees at all levels of the organization, fosters positive and professional working relationships, and delivers exceptional customer service.



A Day in the Life of a Data Analyst may look like this:

  • Attends work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with LSCC's leave policy and performs other duties as assigned.
  • Analyzes data using standard statistical tools, methods, and techniques. Consults with internal and external customers and LSCC staff to identify user needs. Compiles and queries data. Identifies data gaps, errors, anomalies, inconsistencies, and redundancies by analyzing the content, structure, and relationships within data. Interprets results to identify significant differences in data. Identifies and interprets data patterns and trends and assesses data quality. Cleans and prunes data to discard irrelevant information.
  • Prepares concise, comprehensive technical reports to present and interpret data, identify alternatives, and make and justify recommendations on data revisions. Assists in defining, developing, and implementing data standards. Assists in developing data quality measures, analyzing data quality results, and implementing necessary changes to ensure data quality improvement. Assists in developing statistical modeling and graphical analysis
  • Create comprehensive documentation for new developments, updates, and enhancements for both developers and end-users.
  • May develop and implement data collection systems, data analytics, and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality.
  • May perform quality assurance and serve as a subject matter expert on data integrity, extraction, and compilation. May guide the selection of data management tools, and the development of standards, usage guidelines, and procedures for those tools.
  • May provide guidance to others.
  • Performs related work as assigned.



We ask our Data Analysts to possess a minimum of:

  • Experience in data, reporting or business analytics
  • Experience in gathering requirements for reporting

The following experience/skills are preferred:

  • Experience and education may be substituted for one another with experience in healthcare, Medicaid, or other medical report data preferred.
  • Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with major coursework in data science, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, management information systems, accounting, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field is generally preferred.
  • Knowledge of SQL preferred.
  • Experience using Snowflake databases.
  • Experience building dashboards, reports, and applications using Streamlit.

Key Success Factors

Some key factors that will make an individual successful in this role:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
  • Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools.
  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Effective communication and collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Benefits

LSCC offers a competitive benefits package, including:

  • Competitive salary;
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance;
  • LSCC paid Life insurance;
  • LSCC paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability insurance;
  • Paid Time Off; and
  • 403b Employee Retirement Plan

Job Description

Apply now

Job Title: Data Analyst - ANA

Posting Start Date: 10/9/26

Posting Location: Ada (Grand Rapids), MI

Requisition ID: 43339

Job Title: Data Analyst

Department / Division: Data Analytics and Insights

Salary Range: $91,892 - $96,486

Location: Ada, MI (M-Th in Office, WFH Fri)

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who is equal parts curious problem-solver, data storyteller, and business partner. You’ll join the Amway North America (ANA) Data & Analytics team — the crew that turns messy questions, market movement, and performance signals into clear “aha!” moments. In this role, you’ll partner with Go-to-Market and ANA market leadership teams to understand what’s happening, why it matters, and where ANA can act next.

You’ll go beyond “here’s the report” and dig into the good stuff: what changed, what’s driving it, and what we should do about it. You’ll analyze standard and non-standard data, blend quantitative and qualitative insights, and create executive-ready stories that connect promotions, product launches, market activity, and Independent Business Owner (IBO) behavior to practical recommendations. If you love turning data into direction — and making complex business questions feel clear, useful, and maybe even a little fun — this could be your kind of role.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 - 5 years’ experience with data analytics or data operations
  • Experience with data analytics, database management, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing business performance, synthesizing insights, and presenting recommendations that influence decisions
  • BA/BS degree in Business, Statistics, Computer Science/Information Technology

Skills To Be Successful In The Role

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational data structures, data validation, and business intelligence tools, as well as Tableau or other data visualization software , with a willingness to deepen technical proficiency through practical experience.
  • Experience managing datasets, building queries to answer business questions, and generating clear data visualizations
  • Ability to craft audience-ready data stories that explain what is changing, why it matters, and which strategic or tactical actions should be considered
  • Strong business acumen with curiosity to connect promotions, product launches, field behavior, and market trends into a broader performance narrative
  • Consultative mindset to partner with internal clients, challenge assumptions, and translate analysis into recommendations for market leadership and Go-to-Market partners
  • Ability to collaborate with global partners and other analytics leaders to identify opportunities for analytics advancement, process improvement and automation that enhances reporting efficiency and scalability across markets

What’s Special About This Team

The ANA Data & Analytics team is a tight, hardworking crew of 7 who love turning big questions into smart, usable insights – and yes, we’re known to bond over the occasional team treat. We partner closely with Sales, Marketing and other cross‑functional friends to create reports and dashboards that help Independent Business Owners (IBOs) share, sell and shine with our products.

You’ll get hands‑on exposure to all kinds of complex business challenges and teams across the organization – the kind of variety that keeps things interesting and opens the door to real growth in the industry. It’s a team where you learn fast, collaborate often and enjoy the kind of camaraderie that makes the work feel meaningful.

This is a full-time W2 position. Amway does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Amway immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, STEM OPT, TN, etc.) now or in the future.

Apply now

descriptionHtml:
As a Data Analyst, you will be part of a small and dynamic technology team that is bringing cutting-edge technology solutions to a fast-growing company. You will collaborate closely with our business stakeholders and within the Technology team to create and maintain insights that are delivered either through PowerBI visualizations or via custom applications that the team builds. In this role you should be able to solve problems quickly, but you should also strive to understand the business reasons behind the ask, find root causes and prevent issues from recurring. You shouldn’t accept “that’s the way things are done”, but instead you should work to understand the reasons why things are done and identify ways to improve. You should value documenting your successes and solutions, helping to track challenges and build a knowledgebase to share with the team.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights.
  • Develop and maintain PowerBI dashboards and reports to support business decision-making.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and deliver solutions.
  • Perform data cleaning, validation, and transformation to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in data to drive business improvements.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in data analysis and visualization.
  • Provide training and support to team members on PowerBI and data analysis tools.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Curiosity and a passion for continuous learning.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and other data analysis tools.
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting using PowerBI.
  • Working knowledge of medallion architecture.
  • Skills in MS Fabric and Azure Data Factory a plus.
  • Experience with Snowflake a plus.
  • Knowledge of the mortgage lending industry is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Minimum 2 years of professional experience in data analysis and PowerBI development.

Physical and Mental Demands

  • Hearing: Ability to listen and communicate effectively in meetings, calls and daily interactions – Frequent (50-75%)
  • Seeing: Ability to read reports, documents, and data on screens or in print – Continuous (over 75%)
  • Sitting or Standing: Prolonged periods of sitting or standing (based on preference of the individual) at a desk. Physical participation in meetings, often working on a computer – Continuous (over 75%)
  • Standing/Walking: Moving around the office, attending meetings, and events – Occasional (15-45%)
  • Manual Dexterity: Regular use of hands for typing, writing, and handling documents – Frequent (50-75%)
  • Communication: Speaking with employees, executives, partners, and vendors – Frequent (50-75%)
  • Attention to Detail: Ensuring accuracy in operational processes – Continuous (over 75%)

Working Environment

This position operates in a fast-paced, dynamic office environment that fosters creativity and collaboration among team members in order to meet deadlines.

Employees are expected to work both independently and as part of diverse teams to meet the organization’s goals.

The in-office work setting is highly digital, requiring proficiency with various online tools and platforms to communicate and manage tasks effectively.

We emphasize a culture of respect and inclusion, where all employees are encouraged to share their ideas and contributions are valued.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an individual encounters while performing the essential functions of this position.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Data Analyst to support program management, data analytics, dashboard development and reporting activities at Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). This role will work with a team of both officers and contractors to interconnect reporting and analytics, tasking responses, and overall information to support the ICE mission. This role will directly support activities with the San Antonio Field Office on-site as they work to integrate processes to make law enforcement initiatives more efficient.

Responsibilities

  • Provide analysis of ICE specific mission data, processes, field operations, strategic planning, or nuanced mission systems.
  • Develop data analytics dashboards, tools and templates to support the efficient collection and analysis of field metrics.
  • Utilize tools such as Power BI, tableau, Excel, and Access to provide visualizations to overall data sets.
  • Support collaboration with multiple stakeholders, such as business, scrum teams, other project managers, to collect and compile information to ensure timely responses to requests and ad hoc assignments.
  • Facilitate the needs, issues, and challenges faced by the clients; perform gap analysis and recommend solutions.
  • Use source data to assess the effectiveness of projects and business processes.
  • Develop, gather and disseminate information and documentation among both business and technical customers.
  • Work with all team members to analyze changes in requirements and recommend the most expedient solutions in a timely manner.
  • Leverage advanced writing skills to translate complicated issues from multiple information sources into a clear point of view to create a compelling, concise, and well-written narrative.
  • Leverage excellent presentation development skills to prepare meeting agendas and synthesize complex information into succinct visualizations using tools such as PowerPoint.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's with 3 + years (or commensurate experience) in dynamic customer delivery environments

Clearance Required: Ability to attain and maintain DHS clearance (US citizenship required)

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Ability to translate ICE specific mission needs into tactical execution of reports, taskings and overall data analytics.
  • Excellent data analytic and oral communication skills.
  • Strong understanding in project management and data analysis.
  • Ability to lead data analytics development.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to work independently in an extremely fast-paced environment.
  • Be flexible to change direction on a moment’s notice while also tracking/executing tasks in progress.
  • Ability to think “outside of the box” while communicating or dealing with a variety of situations.
  • Possess clear understanding of the activities, roles, and responsibilities on large scale IT projects.

Posted Salary Range: USD $85,000.00 - USD $95,000.00 /Yr.

EnableComp provides Specialty Revenue Cycle Management solutions for healthcare organizations, leveraging over 24 years of industry-leading expertise and its unified E360 RCM™ intelligent automation platform to improve financial sustainability for hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) nationwide. POSITION SUMMARY

This role leverages quantitative analysis, reporting, and data modeling techniques to identify trends, measure performance, and drive process improvements. The Data Analyst collaborates with cross-functional partners to translate business needs into analytical solutions and delivers clear, data-driven recommendations to stakeholders.



THE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE

  • Analyze large, complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decisions

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize reports, dashboards, and analytical models to measure operational and financial performance

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, define requirements, and deliver data-driven solutions

  • Query and manipulate data using SQL and other tools to extract, transform, and prepare datasets for analysis

  • Build and maintain structured datasets, including joining tables and validating data integrity

  • Partner with Operations, Account Management, Product, IT, and Data management teams to align data solutions with business needs

  • Apply critical thinking to identify root causes of issues and recommend practical, data-backed solutions

  • Ensure accuracy and reliability of all analyses through thorough validation and quality checks

  • Document methodologies, assumptions, and processes to support transparency and repeatability

  • Manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences to drive understanding and alignment

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis and performance monitoring

  • Stay current on analytics tools, methodologies, and industry trends to enhance capabilities

  • Other duties as required

  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or working with relational databases required

  • Familiarity with healthcare terminology (e.g., CPT codes, DRG, claims, inpatient/outpatient)

  • Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik preferred

  • Experience with Databricks Data Intelligence Platform

  • 3 years of integrating Databricks, Power BI, and Claude Code

  • Experience in statistical analysis or predictive modeling techniques

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and experience writing SQL queries

  • Timely and regular attendance

  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.




SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS & PREREQUISITES

  • Strong ability to communicate complex data insights clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise

  • High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy, validation, and quality of work

  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities

  • Demonstrated problem-solving mindset with the ability to independently drive work to completion

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across teams while also working independently when needed

  • Ownership mindset with accountability for deliverables and outcomes

descriptionHtml:
Notice: This position does NOT work remotely.

Position Purpose

The Data Analyst will be responsible for the development, testing, implementation, and maintenance of Health Hub data and recurring reports as well as dashboards and other business intelligence applications that utilize the underlying data stores for internal and external use under the Health Hub Program. This includes tracking encounter and quality outcome data from electronic health records (NextGen), i2i, HMIS, Microsoft Office platforms, and health plan reports.

The Data Analyst will also support multidisciplinary teams, including medical providers, nursing, behavioral health, case management, and administrative staff with data reporting needs. Reporting includes Capitation and Fee-for-Service (FFS) Reconciliation reports, monthly dashboards, provider productivity reports, and more. The Data Analyst will thoroughly analyze and clarify report requirements, make recommendations, and provide education when necessary to meet business needs. They will also be responsible for creating and maintaining internal controls and reference materials to promote data quality.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot data systems and databases, including identifying and correcting coding errors, data discrepancies, and other data-related issues to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Collect, analyze, report, and monitor encounter data and quality outcome measures from NextGen, i2i, health plan reporting systems, and other applicable data sources to support Health Hub Program requirements.
  • Extract, organize, clean, and transform data from primary and secondary sources into meaningful formats that support organizational decision-making, program evaluation, and reporting requirements for county contractors and other stakeholders.
  • Apply statistical methods and analytical tools to interpret datasets, identify trends and patterns, and support diagnostic, predictive, and performance improvement analyses.
  • Evaluate and interpret data within the context of local, national, and industry-wide trends to identify potential impacts, opportunities, and challenges affecting the organization and its programs.
  • Prepare reports for program directors and executive leadership that clearly communicate trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data.
  • Collaborate with programmers, IT staff, and organizational leaders to identify opportunities for process improvement, recommend system modifications, and support the development of data governance policies.
  • Collaborate and coordinate with internal stakeholders and external consultants within the data network to extract, evaluate, and deliver data requested by county representatives on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Develop and maintain clear documentation of data collection, extraction, validation, and analysis methodologies to support transparency, reproducibility, and verification of reported information.
  • Develop, update, and maintain data reference materials, including data dictionaries, codebooks, reporting specifications, and standardized documentation to promote consistency and accuracy across reporting processes.
  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain business intelligence dashboards and data visualizations using a user-centered design approach to ensure information is clear, accessible, accurate, and meaningful to the intended audience.
  • Coordinate the ordering, inventory tracking, monitoring, and replenishment of medical supplies and other program-related materials requested by Program Directors, ensuring requests are processed and fulfilled in accordance with established organizational procedures.
  • Adhere to all organizational safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements to ensure a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors.
  • Participate in required safety and compliance training and apply learned practices in daily work activities.
  • Identify, report, and help mitigate unsafe conditions, incidents, or hazards in the workplace.
  • Use equipment, tools, and supplies safely and responsibly in accordance with organizational and regulatory standards.
  • Maintain awareness of infection control, occupational health, and emergency preparedness procedures appropriate to the role.
  • Participate in JWCH’s customer service training called AIDET on an annual basis.
    • Demonstrate an understanding of AIDET (Acknowledge, Introduce, Duration, Explanation, and Thank You) to apply in patient encounters or team discussions.
    • Utilize the AIDET communication framework to communicate with patients and team members in a manner that reduces patient anxiety, increases patient compliance, and improves clinical outcomes.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.
Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of two years of demonstrated experience working as a Data Analyst, Data Specialist, or in a data management and reporting support role, preferably in a healthcare, behavioral health, or nonprofit setting.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365 applications, with demonstrated experience using databases and analytical tools, including macros, Visual Basic for Applications (VBA), pivot tables, pivot charts, queries, and data filters.
  • Experience working with NextGen Electronic Health Records (EHR) or a comparable electronic medical records (EMR) system, including the ability to develop, execute, and maintain data queries and reports.
  • Experience using web-based data reporting portals, secure file transfer protocols (SFTP), and other platforms for data exchange, retrieval, and reporting.
  • Knowledge of healthcare data management, reporting requirements, and applicable federal, state, and local funding requirements related to healthcare services.

Knowledge, Skills And Ability

  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into meaningful insights.
  • Demonstrated ability to collect, organize, validate, analyze, and communicate large volumes of information with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, organizational leadership, external consultants, and community partners.
  • Experience working in a nonprofit, healthcare, or human services environment preferred.
  • All JWCH, Wesley Health Centers workforce members are recommended to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19.

Employee Benefits

At JWCH Institute, Inc., we believe in taking care of those who take care of others. If you work 30+ hours per week, you’ll enjoy competitive pay and a robust benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • Monthly employer-sponsored allowance for assistance with health premiums.
  • Funded Health Savings Account (up to deductible) to assist with carrier-approved medical expenses.
  • Paid time off (vacation, sick leave) and 13 paid holidays.
  • 401(k) Safe Harbor Profit Sharing plan.
  • Mileage reimbursement.
  • Short- and long-term disability plans (LTD/STD).
  • Life insurance policy & AD&D, and more!

Become part of a team where your work matters. Apply today and help us change lives, one patient at a time.

JWCH Institute, Inc + Wesley Health Centers is an Equal Opportunity and Fair Chance Employer.

This position is 100% on-site no remote.

Job Description:

Position Duties:

  • Prepare written summaries and presentations that reflect the results of data analysis and present findings to agency leadership.

  • Prototype data products and conduct analysis and feasibility based on program requirements.

  • Identify uniform data points for analysis.
  • Assist with projects that support the continual improvement of data analysis.
  • Compile, analyze, and visualize data using a data visualization platform such as Tableau.

Qualifications:

  • Requires BS/BA degree in Statistics or a related field as well as 8 years of related experience, or MS/MA degree with 6 years of experience.
  • Working knowledge of data visualization platforms (Tableau) and scripting languages (R/Python/SAS).
  • Working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with relational databases.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, strong attention to detail, and strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Previous experience working with children or in a health services realm preferred, but not required.

    • Statistical analysis and modeling.
    • Natural language processing.
    • Quantitative and qualitative data analysis
    • Data engineering, to include experience working with large datasets and performing tasks such as data cleaning and processing (ETL).
    • Fundamental working knowledge of SQL.
    • Python and/or R.
    • Tableau.
    • Palantir.
    • Data entry.

  • This position requires an existing  Public Trust or the ability to obtain one.

descriptionHtml:
About Nexon

Nexon America is a branch of Nexon Co., Ltd., a global video game publisher and leading developer of online virtual worlds for PCs, consoles, and mobile devices. Nexon proudly offers celebrated franchises like MapleStory and Mabinogi that have been enjoyed by millions of players for over two decades. When we founded our Nexon America branch in 2006, we made it our goal to bring those unique games to western players using a player-first approach. We achieve that goal by applying our team’s outstanding free-to-play expertise and live game support to every decision, every day.

But we’re committed to more than our games! Here at Nexon America, we’re all about open communication, diversity, mutual respect, and collaboration, so we can bring out the best in each other. Nexies find support, friendship, and career growth all in one place! And because we know a healthy work-life balance is the key to happiness, Nexies also enjoy flexible hours, a hybrid work model, and extra perks like food trucks, happy hours, and team events. It’s why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work certification for 6 years running!

We’re looking to expand our team with passionate individuals who want to learn, play, and grow with us. Ready for a new challenge?

Summary Of Position

Nexon America is looking for a Data Analyst to provide in-depth data mining and analyses to multiple departments, with a focus on understanding our players and identifying ways to improve the user experience within our games. In this role, you will empower our teams with actionable data derived from your own data exploration, experiments, and analyses.

We are currently working in the office 2-3x a week in a hybrid work model.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design and develop data analyses to create unique business insights; perform detailed data exploration and validation to understand players’ behavior and trends.
  • Identify key analytic metrics; build interactive data visualizations and present key insights to inform business decisions and drive growth; examine and analyze available information to determine patterns and gaps at a strategic level and recommend a course of action to support internal and external users.
  • Research and analyze web and game usage data and recommend solutions; analyze the user experience and business processes to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to translate business data needs into analysis specifications and validate requirements against strategic goals and project objectives.
  • Develop innovative projects and hone cutting-edge skills in Data Cloud technologies, Data Science models, Data storytelling, and AI.
  • Other duties as assigned

Work Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in data analytics, sales analysis, consulting, statistics, or a related field
  • Experience with data extraction and manipulation tools and Data Mining tools
  • Experience creating data visualization
  • Online gaming experience preferred

Education, Professional Training, Technical Training or Certification

  • Master's Degree preferred or Bachelor's degree with equivalent experience

Knowledge/Skills

  • Excellent knowledge of statistical analysis
  • Ability to extract data by writing your own SQL queries
  • Experience using Tableau or similar BI tools
  • Experience using Google Analytics preferred
  • Programming for data analysis (R or Python) preferred
  • Ability to translate complex data into stories for diverse stakeholders
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Able to manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Exceptional Excel and PowerPoint skills
  • Excellent time and project management skills

Management has the right to add or change duties and job requirements at any time.

Nexon’s Benefits And Perks

We offer medical, dental and vision plans for you, your spouse or domestic partner and your children. Employees who enroll in the high deductible health plan receive an annual employer contribution to a health savings account and company paid hospital indemnity benefits. We also provide company paid life, AD&D, short-term and long-term disability benefits as well as access to voluntary life and AD&D for yourself and your dependents, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) savings plan with a company match, and pet insurance. Nexies are encouraged to take advantage of our monthly wellness credit, participate in lunchtime yoga, and enroll in language classes. We host bi-monthly catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and maintain a well-stocked snack bar. To help you maintain a good work life balance, we offer paid time off, sick days, company holidays, and a year-end break.

Nexon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Compensation Description For Pay Transparency (annually)

The base salary range for this position in El Segundo, CA is $100,000 - $125,000 annually.

Our salary ranges are determined by market data based on position and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum salaries for that position. An individual’s pay is determined by factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s qualifications, skills, experiences, relevant education or training, and location.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work. This role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, however the salary range listed in this job posting reflects the base salary only.

Beware of Recruitment Scams

We have been made aware of fraudulent recruitment activities by individuals falsely claiming to represent Nexon America. Our recruiters will only contact you from official company email addresses ending in @nexon.com and will follow a formal interview process. We will never request for payment or personal financial information such as photos of government-issued identification during the recruitment process or offer a job without a formal interview process. If you receive suspicious email, we advise you to mark the email as junk or spam, so your email provider will block future messages from the sender.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

A Sr. Data Analyst on PepsiCo’s Data Analytics & AI team is responsible for turning data into actionable insights that support business decisions, process improvement, and data-driven strategy. The role typically sits in the BI & Reporting Automation or broader Data Analytics & AI space, depending on the team’s focus. PepsiCo describes this job family as one that leverages data and advanced analytics to drive insights, develop predictive models, improve business processes, and ensure strong data governance, data quality, and integrity.

Responsibilities

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data from large and small databases using SQL and related tools.
  • Build reports, dashboards, and visualizations to support business decisions.
  • Deliver ad hoc analysis and insights for cross-functional partners.
  • Work with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
  • Support data prep for advanced analytics and capability projects.
  • Translate business needs into analytical requirements and clear recommendations.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • The expected compensation range for this position is between $104,100 - $174,300.
  • Location, confirmed job-related skills, experience, and education will be considered in setting actual starting salary. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.
  • Bonus based on performance and eligibility target payout is 8% of annual salary paid out annually.
  • Paid time off subject to eligibility, including paid parental leave, vacation, sick, and bereavement.
  • In addition to salary, PepsiCo offers a comprehensive benefits package to support our employees and their families, subject to elections and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Health, and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Insurance (Accident, Group Legal, Life), Defined Contribution Retirement Plan.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • 3–4+ years of experience in data analytics.
  • Strong SQL and relational database skills.
  • Experience with Excel, PowerPoint, and possibly Tableau, R, or Python.
  • Ability to handle large datasets, do data cleansing, and explain technical findings clearly.
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

EEO Statement

Our Company will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Fair Credit Reporting Act, and all other applicable laws, including but not limited to, San Francisco Police Code Sections 4901-4919, commonly referred to as the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance; and Chapter XVII, Article 9 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code, commonly referred to as the Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

PepsiCo is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Female / Minority / Disability / Protected Veteran / Sexual Orientation / Gender Identity / Age

descriptionHtml:
Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

About The Position

Dexis is recruiting a Senior Data Analyst to support anticipated programming with the Department of State (DOS). This opportunity will provide policy direction and oversight in the areas of international security, security assistance, military operations, and defense strategy and plans, specifically focused on Foreign Military Financing (FMF) and International Military Education and Training (IMET) military grant assistance programs. Candidates must have an active Secret Clearance.  

This position is contingent upon contract award.

Responsibilities

  • Providing quantitative analytical support to produce country papers and perform data quality checks to ensure integrity of the data.
  • Coordinating with the client and with the core M&E team regarding additional data points to consider and explore for further analysis.
  • Designing and populating easy to read and digestible mockups of data visualization options to present to the client.
  • Documenting data calculation steps and methodologies applied to the analysis as needed.
  • Analyzing country trends for regional and global comparisons.
  • Producing approved final data visualizations of the countries to be included in reports.
  • Adapting to changing needs of the project and the team as needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in relevant field of study and at least six (6) years of data analytics experience.
  • Active Secret Clearance required.
  • Expertise aggregating, normalizing, and displaying data from multiple sources, and conveying nuanced distinctions and conclusions to end users while ensuring utmost accuracy.
  • Experience applying quantitative research methods, operating or managing databases, and applying statistical methods to conduct analysis.
  • Ability to perform advanced quantitative analyses of structured and unstructured data, especially working with, and manipulating large data sets in Excel.
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Experience designing data visualizations to demonstrate data trends.
  • Comfortable with the changing needs of the client and the team.
  • Strong attention to detail.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience creating data dashboards using tools such as Tableau or Flourish.
  • Experience building APIs.
  • Prior experience with DOS programming.

Below is the pay range aligned with this position. When developing a range, Dexis evaluates compensation holistically, triangulating between external market research, our budget for the position, and internal equity to arrive at a figure that is fair and competitive. Offers within this range will be based on an individual candidate's qualification, relevant education and experience, skills, performance, and organizational needs.

Dexis Pay Range For This Role

$105,000—$155,000 USD

Benefits

Dexis offers benefits to support employees’ health, financial security, and well-being. The benefits outlined below are for full-time, US-based positions only. These benefits include:

  • Medical and prescription drug coverage: A choice of three UnitedHealthcare medical plans, with coverage options for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Dental insurance: Dental coverage for employees and eligible dependents, including preventive, basic, major, and orthodontic services, subject to plan limits.
  • Company-paid vision insurance: Vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents, with premiums paid in full by Dexis.
  • Employer-funded health reimbursement arrangement (HRA): Employees who enroll in the Silver HRA medical plan receive an employer-funded HRA to help pay eligible in-network deductible expenses.
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance: Basic life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, plus short-term and long-term disability coverage.
  • Optional supplemental insurance: Voluntary supplemental life and AD&D insurance options, including life insurance options for eligible dependents.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Company-paid access to confidential counseling and legal and financial support resources for employees and their families.
  • Health and wellness resources: Virtual care, behavioral health resources, and wellness programs available through the medical plan.
  • Benefits assistance: Personalized support with benefit enrollment, coverage questions, claims, and finding providers through the Employee Care Center.

Participation, coverage, and employee contributions are subject to applicable benefit plan terms and eligibility requirements.

Dexis is on a mission to help solve today’s most pressing global political, social, and economic challenges and create a world where all people are safe and prosperous. As a Dexis employee, you will be challenged, empowered, and mentored. Our motto is “find a way or make a way” — that’s how Dexis goes “all in.” How will you?

If you are passionate about this opportunity, apply now!

Only those applicants who meet the above criteria will be contacted for interview.

For more than 180 years, the Medical Center has been leading the way in developing innovative and often life-saving treatments.

Rush salaries are determined by many factors including, but not limited to, education, job-related experience and skills, as well as internal equity and industry specific market data. The pay range for each role reflects Rush’s anticipated wage or salary reasonably expected to be offered for the position. Offers may vary depending on the circumstances of each case.


Summary

Join Rush University Medical Center and play a pivotal role in transforming data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making across the organization. As a Data Analyst, you will partner with clinical, operational, and administrative leaders to develop meaningful reports, dashboards, and analyses that help improve performance, support organizational goals, and enhance business operations.


In this highly visible role, you'll work with data from multiple sources, perform complex analyses, identify trends and opportunities, and present recommendations that influence leadership decisions. You'll also contribute to the successful implementation, deployment, and ongoing support of the Workday Student platform, helping to build the internal expertise needed to sustain this mission-critical system and support future enhancements.


We are seeking a collaborative and analytical professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex problems, and can translate data into clear, actionable insights. Experience with healthcare operations, reporting, system implementations, or enterprise platforms is highly valued.


Why Join Us?

  • Influence strategic and operational decisions through data-driven insights.
  • Partner with leaders across academic, clinical, and administrative functions.
  • Support a high-impact Workday Student implementation and long-term optimization strategy.
  • Work in a collaborative environment focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  • Grow your expertise while contributing to meaningful work that supports the future of healthcare and education.


Responsibilities

  • Organize data from multiple sources into one central report and/or dashboard for administrative and clinical leaders.
  • Conduct complex data analytics to produce key takeaways that can help inform decision-making.
  • Continuously monitor data to ensure that department objectives are being met.
  • Develop and routinely update performance packages that can be used by department leaders.
  • Complete ad-hoc reports for practice leaders to report on the outcome of recent schedule changes.
  • Prepare complex analyses utilizing benchmark data from a number of sources as appropriate.
  • May be requested to validate externally reported data with internal source data.
  • Establishes relationships with various departments across Rush to obtain and validate data.


Required Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, or a related field required.
  • Two years of health care experience in practice operations or decision support.
  • Understanding of concepts in methodology, data collection, and analyses.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data and communicate issues, findings and recommendations.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple assignments and projects of varying degrees of complexity.
  • Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment.


Preferred Job Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in business, healthcare administration or related field.
  • Current experience with the Workday Student platform.
  • Work experience in a large academic medical center system or similar environment.


Rush is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

descriptionHtml:
Description

Internet Brands is looking for an Associate Data Analyst to join our El Segundo based data analytics team.

The Ideal Candidate: You are an organized self-starter with a keen business sense who loves digging into data to understand trends and performance. You have a passion for manipulating large volumes of data, building dashboards, and have a consistent focus on efficiency. You easily understand requirements and communicate the progress and status of your work. You have a bias for action and know when to apply the 80/20 rule. You’re also a great teammate who likes a rapidly changing environment and wants to join a company that offers a ton of opportunities to build your skills.

The Associate Data Analyst’s primary role is to provide data and analysis support for tracking and reporting for the health vertical (WebMD/Medscape

This position requires an ability to understand the key metrics of a business and to develop reporting based on business requirements. The analyst will work in a project team-oriented and dynamic environment which will require working closely with other teams and adjusting to new developments as they arise. Various software packages and tools will be utilized in order to collect, mine, and report on this data. Strong analytical and communication skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines is critical for this

position.

In this role, you will:

  • Create insightful, easy to understand visualizations that provide performance, trending and benchmarking analysis to meet business needs.
  • Simplify and automate reporting, audits, and other data-driven activities; build solutions to have maximum scale and self-service ability by partners.
  • Support the business with time-critical data analyses.
  • Performing analysis of web traffic, email engagement, and app engagement data to understand and measure the success of programs, including click through analysis, retention, re-engagement and A/B testing.
  • Become a subject matter data (and business) expert related to appointed areas of responsibility.
  • Understand and recommend how AI can assist in improving the assigned task.

Required Qualifications:

  • Degree in Statistics or Business or equivalent work experience
  • Strong analytical, conceptual, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1-2 years of equivalent work experience
  • Experience accessing data from data bases.
  • Proficient with creating, maintaining, and optimizing data visualizations dashboards
  • Proficient in using SQL for data analysis and reporting.
  • Advanced Excel skill
  • Knowledge and experience with AI systems and capabilities.

At Internet Brands, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the compensation for this role to range at $65k-$70k and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

In addition to our awesome culture, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health and well-being of you and your family. Our benefits include health insurance options such as medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA) for medical and dependent care, short-term and long-term disability insurance, and life and AD&D insurance. We also provide a 401(k) retirement savings plan with a company match, paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, as well as access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and well-being coaching services. In addition, employees can take advantage of voluntary benefits such as home, auto and pet insurance, and discounted legal and financial services. For more details, feel free to inquire during the interview process.

Position Overview: This position supports the Defense Health Agency (DHA) Disability Evaluation System (DES) Program Support contract as a Senior Data Analyst. The Senior Data Analyst builds reports and supports the systems behind the Department of Defense (DoD) Disability Evaluation System (DES) at the Defense Health Agency (DHA). The role turns case data from the Veterans Tracking Application and related systems into the recurring and ad hoc reports leaders use to manage the program. KSA is hiring two Senior Data Analysts for this program.

This Position is Contingent Upon Award

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision (82% of employee’s premium paid by company, 25% towards dependents)
  • HSA / FSA Medical Plans
  • PTO
  • Flexible Work Environment and Encourage Work/Life Balance
  • 401K with Company Match
  • Observes all federal holidays
  • Professional Development/Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Annual Career Development Process


Job Type: Full-time/Exempt

Location: Hybrid remote. Candidates must live within commuting distance of Defense Health Headquarters in Falls Church, Virginia. Day-to-day work is remote, and all Government meetings are virtual.

Schedule: Full-time. Available 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, except Federal holidays.

Openings: 2

Anticipated Start Date: Late November 2026, contingent upon contract award.

Position Responsibilities

  • Pull, clean, and analyze case data from the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Tracking Application (VTA) and other sources for recurring and ad hoc reports.
  • Draft system change requests and support user acceptance testing for VTA and related systems.
  • Maintain VTA guidebooks within 10 days of any business process or technical change.
  • Maintain the shared Microsoft Access database of Special Compensation for Assistance with Activities of Daily Living (SCAADL) enrollment and analyze quarterly Military Department data.
  • Pull and validate survey cohort lists for the Integrated Disability Evaluation System (IDES) satisfaction survey.


Requirements

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or information technology field required.
  • 5 or more years of data analysis experience.
  • Advanced skill in SQL, Excel, and Microsoft Access, and working skill in R or Python.
  • Experience with Tableau or Power BI.
  • Must be able to pass a Tier 1 background investigation and qualify for a Common Access Card (CAC).
  • Within 30 days of start, complete DHA contractor annual training, DHA telework training and agreement, and privacy training for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Protected Health Information (PHI).
  • Handles Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and PHI only on a Government-furnished laptop.


Preferred Skills/Experience

  • Experience with VTA, military personnel data, or health data.

Job Title: Data Analyst

Location: Texas, USA

Experience: 2–4 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst with 2–4 years of experience in collecting, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting data to support business decisions. The ideal candidate will have strong SQL and Excel skills, experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau, and the ability to translate complex datasets into actionable business insights.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI or Tableau.
  • Analyze business trends, patterns, and performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports for business stakeholders and management.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to identify discrepancies.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
  • Identify key performance indicators (KPIs) and track business performance against established targets.
  • Document data processes, reporting procedures, and analytical findings.
  • Present insights and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and data manipulation.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and advanced formulas.
  • Experience with at least one data visualization tool: Power BI or Tableau.
  • Good understanding of data cleaning, data validation, data transformation, and reporting.
  • Knowledge of statistical concepts and analytical techniques.
  • Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and communicate actionable insights.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work independently as well as collaboratively.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python (Pandas, NumPy) for data analysis and automation.
  • Exposure to databases such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Snowflake.
  • Familiarity with ETL processes and data warehousing concepts.
  • Knowledge of cloud data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience working in Agile or cross-functional business environments.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • Master's degree or relevant certifications in Data Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, or SQL are a plus.

What We're Looking For

  • A data-driven professional with strong attention to detail.
  • Someone who can turn raw data into meaningful business insights.
  • A proactive problem-solver who can work with stakeholders and deliver accurate reports on time.
  • A clear communicator who can explain analytical findings and recommendations effectively.

*Job Summary and Responsibilities*

As our Data Analyst, you will transform complex data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decisions, improving patient outcomes, and enhancing operational efficiency.

Every day you will collect, analyze, and interpret large datasets from patient care, operations, and finance. You'll create reports, dashboards, and visualizations to present findings, identify trends, and inform initiatives for quality, cost reduction, and evidence-based practices.

To be successful, you will demonstrate strong analytical skills, proficiency in data tools (SQL, Tableau, Excel), and an understanding of healthcare data. Excellent communication for technical insights and a commitment to data integrity are essential.

  • Furnishes routine and ad hoc data analysis and reporting.
  • Coordinates and analyzes data inputs and outputs for accuracy/ quality. Consults with other employees and vendors/payers as needed.
  • Makes recommendations to leadership on opportunities for improvement of data quality. Implement change efforts related to data quality as directed by leadership by interacting with subject matter experts supporting the various data sources (EMRs, payers and vendors).
  • Researches best practices for data structure, reporting and analytics involving health and social care integration.
  • Collaborates with clinical and IT staff to design workflows integrating technology and maximizing efficiency in population health interventions.
  • Consults with leadership regarding project priorities, timelines and assignments.

***This is Not a Remote Role***

*Job Requirements**Required*

  • Bachelors in Computer Science, Information Systems and Management, Biomedical Science, Business or Healthcare Administration, or a related field and Two (2) years health care or data analytics experience
  • Other Formal education in programming languages (SQL, Python, etc.), upon hire
  • EPIC Certification, within 6 - months

*Preferred*

  • EPIC Clarity certification Strongly Preferred upon hire
  • Prior Clinical Research Experience
  • Masters in Computer Science, Information Systems and Management, Biomedical Science, Business or Healthcare Administration, or a related field.

Where You'll Work

CommonSpirit Health was formed by the alignment of Catholic Health Initiatives (CHI) and Dignity Health. With more than 700 care sites across the U.S., from clinics and hospitals to home-based care and virtual care services, CommonSpirit is accessible to nearly one out of every four U.S. residents. Our world needs compassion like never before. Our communities need caring and our families need protection. With our combined resources, CommonSpirit is committed to building healthy communities, advocating for those who are poor and vulnerable, and innovating how and where healing can happen, both inside our hospitals and out in the community.

$30.76 - $45.76 /hour

descriptionHtml:
Description

About Us

At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a best in class, seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

Position Overview

We are looking for a meticulous Senior Data Analyst with exceptional skills in data analytics and reporting to join our team. This role will serve as a vital link between our business intelligence team, commercial, and client success departments. The Senior Data Analyst will collaborate closely with both internal and client-facing teams to ensure seamless alignment across all analytics initiatives, performance measurement, and key insights. Reporting directly to the Executive Director of Data Strategy, this position is an integral part of the iBIDADS team.

Data Management & Analytics Support

  • Build, develop, and maintain datasets to support automated reporting solutions and program performance measurement, ensuring alignment with established SLAs.
  • Support commercial teams with data needs for performance reviews, business planning activities, and newly onboarded business.
  • Conduct ad hoc analysis to investigate and resolve program issues, providing critical support during QBR, Business Planning, and Launch Execution.
  • Manage third-party data integration and analysis, including shipping analytics and return-to-sender reconciliation processes.

Program Performance Analytics

  • Design and implement internal and client-facing program performance datasets, tracking and analyzing key SLA measurements and program KPIs.
  • Co-develop dashboards that visualize program performance trends, providing data-driven insights to client-facing teams and internal operational support.
  • Collaborate with both internal operations and client-facing BI teams to ensure consistent metrics and reporting.
  • Provide data-driven insights to the commercial and internal teams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with internal and customer-facing BI departments on healthcare analytics initiatives, supporting the internal operations excellence team and commercial team with key performance insights.
  • Ensure consistent data definitions and metrics across both BI functions, contributing to monetization opportunities through consulting and data products.
  • Work closely with Product Engineering to ensure product features, enhancements, and changes are reflected in the datasets

Data Quality & Governance

  • Ensure accuracy, reliability, and security of all performance data, implementing data validation processes and quality control measures.
  • Document data lineage and maintain data dictionaries, collaborating with stakeholders to define business rules and metrics.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to continuously improve data management and analytics processes.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in data analysis, with at least 3 years focused on healthcare reporting.
  • Advanced skills in SQL and Python, with experience in database management.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Domo, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare metrics and reporting requirements.
  • Experience supporting commercial and operations teams with program performance and identification of opportunities.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Deep passion for data, analytics, and a natural curiosity to explore and extract key insights.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the healthcare industry.
  • Proficiency in R for data manipulation.
  • Knowledge of data warehouse concepts and ETL processes.
  • Understanding of SLA management and performance metrics.
  • Experience working in dual-focused BI environments (internal and client-facing).
  • Familiarity with pharmacy management systems and logistics data.
  • Experience with data transfer agreements, data use agreements, and third-party data integration.
  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms.

Personal Attributes

  • Natural curiosity about data and its business implications.
  • Strong desire to track and improve program performance.
  • Can-do attitude with a passion for solving complex problems.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
  • Excellent communication skills to translate technical findings to business stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Team player willing to go the extra mile to support organizational goals.
  • Adaptable and responsive during high-pressure periods like launches, business planning, and quarterly reporting.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with industry trends.

What Success Looks Like

  • The commercial team consistently receives accurate, timely data for program management and performance.
  • Client-facing teams leverage insights to enhance customer relationships and drive business growth.
  • SLAs are consistently met for all reporting requirements, ensuring high standards of service.
  • New programs are seamlessly integrated into reporting and data systems.
  • Continuous improvement of data processes and reporting efficiency is achieved.
  • Seamless collaboration between internal and client-facing BI functions is maintained.
  • Operational metrics are effectively tracked and analyzed to drive commercial success and program performance.
  • Data sources are effectively integrated and governed, ensuring data quality and reliability.
  • Data security and privacy are maintained, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
  • Innovation and staying updated with industry trends are prioritized to maintain a competitive edge.
  • User satisfaction and feedback are actively sought and incorporated to continuously improve data solutions.

Employment Classification

Status: Full-time

FLSA: Exempt

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Gifthealth is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you do not meet every requirement but still feel you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply!

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required of personnel. Gifthealth reserves the right to modify job duties or descriptions at any time.

$122,000-$153,000

descriptionHtml:
About Clair

If you can send your friends money in seconds, why does it still take your employer two weeks to send your paycheck?

At Clair, we are on a mission to create financial freedom for America's workers by giving them a digital banking platform that allows them to get paid as soon as they clock out of work. But we're not just another digital bank or on-demand pay provider. We meet Americans at their place of work by embedding our products within the scheduling, workforce management, and payroll apps they already use every day.

Learn more about us at getclair.com/about

About The Role

We’re looking for a top-tier analytics professional to deliver insights that drive growth. As a Senior Data Analyst at Clair, you’ll join a growing team of data practitioners who are passionate about bringing financial security to underserved communities by giving workers access to their earnings right when they need them. As a trusted thought partner to product and business teams, you’ll surface impactful insights supporting their goals. Through experimentation, analysis, modeling, and dashboard development, you’ll surface recommendations to enable Clair to reach millions of hourly workers and help them get paid on demand.

The ideal candidate will consider themselves a “full stack” data analyst with experience across the entire data pipeline, including data ingestion, processing, modeling, and visualization. This person will be comfortable with the analytics engineering workflow, mixing technical proficiency with the ability to engage stakeholders across the organization.

What You'll Do

  • Leverage data to drive user growth, identify trends, and influence product and business decisions
  • Collaborate with cross-functional business partners to address key analytical questions and evaluate hypotheses, leveraging data to drive innovation and novel solutions.
  • Define and manage key metrics that inform strategic product, growth, and operational decisions, ensuring alignment with business goals
  • Put data at the fingertips of stakeholders and enable them to independently explore and utilize data
  • Build efficient data ingestion and transformation pipelines using tools like dbt
  • Develop intuitive dashboards, memos, slides, and other visualizations that tell stories and inspire action
  • Collaborate to brainstorm ideas, verify analyses, and review the work of your peers to ensure accuracy and quality

What We're Looking For

  • 4–5 years of professional experience in the data analytics field
  • Fluent in SQL (translating business questions to queries, understanding joins and functions, and building data pipelines)
  • Experience with experimentation and statistical analysis to guide decision-making
  • Passionate about building the best version of whatever you’re working on

Nice to Have

  • Experience with the modern data stack, including Snowflake, dbt, Tableau
  • Experience with a scripting language like Python or R
  • Interest in financial systems and consumer behavior
  • Experience with machine learning or statistical modeling
  • Experience in a high-growth start-up environment

Additional Details

Location: This is a hybrid position based out of New York City, you will be expected to come into the office at least three days a week (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, & Thursdays) with additional days on occasion for client meetings.

Compensation: The annual base salary for this role is $160,000-$165,000. The base pay for this role is determined using many factors, such as education, skills and experience and is reflective of Clair Series stage and size. Base pay is only one part of Clair’s competitive total compensation package which includes equity, benefits and additional perks. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Clair will only contact candidates from @getclair.com email addresses. We will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you happen to receive anything suspicious, please ignore it.

Need more convincing?

Benefits

Apart from getting to work with our incredible team, here are some of the benefits you can expect when you join Clair:

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage, with option to extend to your family
  • Fully-paid parental leave
  • Company-sponsored 401k, HSA, and FSA
  • Unlimited vacation for salaried roles, generous PTO for hourly roles
  • Work from home setup allowance
  • Access to your earnings every day on Clair
  • Company-sponsored short-term and long-term disability insurance

Equal Opportunity Employer Information

Clair is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

NREIG is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team in the Oklahoma City or Kansas City metropolitan areas.   • Collect, clean, and validate data from internal and external sources.

  • Proficiency in Power BI for data visualization and reporting.
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL for querying and data manipulation.
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks.
  • Strong communication skills to present findings clearly and effectively.
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Experience with Salesforce, Snowflake, and/or Python
  • Understanding of data modeling and ETL processes.
  • Exposure to business intelligence or analytics projects.


Please note that candidates outside of the Oklahoma City or Kansas City metropolitan areas will not be considered at this time. We will only consider candidates who are eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship at this time.

We believe NREIG is for everyone - we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer

Job Summary

  • We are seeking a highly analytical, business-oriented Data Analyst to support the Print Supplies business. In this role, you will translate consumer and enterprise print telemetry into trusted metrics, dashboards, and actionable insights, with a primary focus on laser printer data. You will partner closely with data engineers and data scientists to improve data reliability, define KPI and metric semantics, and influence cross-functional decisions through clear data storytelling.

Responsibilities

  • Own laser print telemetry business insights for the Print Supplies organization, from problem framing and metric definition through analysis, visualization, and executive-ready recommendations.
  • Partner with stakeholders to clarify goals, translate business questions into analytical requirements, define critical KPIs, and deliver insights that drive decisions.
  • Provide consultative support and ad hoc analyses with clear hypotheses, methods, and assumptions; produce reusable queries, datasets, and shareable outputs with documented limitations.
  • Collaborate with internal and external partners to align on telemetry instrumentation, data collection methodology, and platform differences to ensure consistent interpretation across printer platforms.
  • Investigate data quality issues (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), perform root-cause analysis across pipelines and sources, and communicate impacts and remediation paths with appropriate caveats.
  • Enable self-service analytics by documenting dashboards and KPI definitions, and coach users on correct interpretation and common pitfalls.
  • Design and maintain measurement frameworks (e.g., adoption, usage, retention, share, funnel/driver analyses); when applicable, support experiment or pre/post evaluation and interpret results for stakeholders.
  • Create clear narratives through written summaries, presentations, and recurring reporting that highlight trends, drivers, risks, and recommended actions for leadership and partner teams.
  • Provide guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members.
  • Solve difficult and complex problems with a fresh perspective, demonstrating good judgment in selecting creative solutions and managing projects independently.
  • Lead moderate to high complexity projects, delivering professionally written reports, and supports the realization of operational and strategic plans.

Education & Experience Recommended

  • Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
  • Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, database management, statistical analysis, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.

Preferred Certifications

  • Programming Language/s Certification (SQL, Python, or similar)

Knowledge & Skills

  • Analytics: exploratory analysis, root-cause analysis, and KPI design
  • SQL: complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query performance optimization
  • Python (and/or PySpark) for analysis, data validation, and automation. Familiar with VSCode and Databricks Ideally
  • Ability to interpret telemetry and pipeline outputs in business context, including communicating uncertainty and known limitations
  • Comfort working across multiple data sources/layers and explaining differences in source-of-truth, grain, and transformations
  • Comfort with modern analytics tooling (including AI-assisted development) while maintaining reproducibility and reviewable outputs
  • Dashboarding & data visualization: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, advanced excel / PowerPoint or similar; ability to build stakeholder-ready reporting
  • Data quality and governance: profiling, anomaly detection, metric validation, and documentation
  • Strong documentation habits for metric definitions, data lineage, and stakeholder guidance; familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) a plus. Familiar with Jira and Confluence.
  • Applied statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, and basic experiment/pre-post evaluation

Cross-Org Skills

  • Effective Communication
  • Results Orientation
  • Learning Agility
  • Digital Fluency
  • Customer Centricity
  • Collaboration across technical and non-technical teams

Impact & Scope

  • Impacts function by providing analytics and data quality validation that supports business-critical reporting and stakeholder decision-making for laser telemetry KPIs
  • Serves as a key point of contact for laser telemetry interpretation and investigation requests, partnering across teams to drive consistent definitions and reliable use of outputs

Complexity

  • Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.

The pay range for this role is $83,000 to $127,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

  • Health insurance

  • Employee assistance program
  • Flexible spending account
  • Life insurance
  • Generous time off policies, including;
  • 4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure
  • 11 paid holidays
  • Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave (US benefits overview)
