Website: Specialty Dental Brands

What You'll Do

As a Data Analyst at Specialty Dental Brands, you will transform complex data into meaningful insights that support better decisions across our growing organization. You will partner with leaders across Operations, Finance, Human Resources, and Clinical Support to develop reporting and analytical solutions focused on provider productivity, employee retention, operational efficiency, and financial performance.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Analyze data from the enterprise data warehouse (EDW) and other business systems to identify trends, opportunities, and areas of risk.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and data models that provide leaders with clear, actionable insights.
  • Evaluate key performance indicators related to provider productivity, practice performance, employee retention, operational efficiency, and financial results.
  • Partner with business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
  • Validate data for accuracy, consistency, and completeness across multiple systems.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, data quality, and access to information.
  • Present findings and recommendations in a clear, concise manner to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Support recurring reporting needs as well as ad hoc analysis for strategic initiatives.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to strengthen the organization’s data infrastructure and reporting capabilities.
  • Maintain documentation for reports, dashboards, data definitions, and analytical processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Experience working with enterprise data warehouses and large, complex datasets.
  • Proficiency in SQL and business intelligence or data visualization tools, such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, and analytical models for business leaders.
  • Strong understanding of data validation, reporting accuracy, and data integrity.
  • Experience analyzing operational, financial, workforce, or healthcare-related data.
  • Dental, healthcare, or multisite business experience is preferred.
  • Ability to work effectively in a hybrid, collaborative environment.

What Makes You Successful:

  • You are naturally curious and enjoy uncovering the story behind the data.
  • You can translate complex findings into clear insights and practical recommendations.
  • You are highly detail-oriented and committed to producing accurate, reliable work.
  • You take ownership of projects and follow through from initial discovery to final delivery.
  • You are comfortable working through ambiguity and helping build structure as the organization grows.
  • You balance technical expertise with strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • You understand the needs of your business partners and develop solutions that are useful, accessible, and actionable.
  • You manage competing priorities effectively while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
  • You look for opportunities to improve processes, strengthen reporting, and make data easier for leaders to use.

Why Join Specialty Dental Brands?



At Specialty Dental Brands, you'll be part of a collaborative team that values people first. We celebrate teamwork, continuous learning, and creating positive experiences for both our candidates and employees. When you join us, you'll enjoy:

  • Hybrid work environment
  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid Time Off and paid holidays
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • A supportive, collaborative culture where your work truly makes a difference

Title: Data Analyst

Location: Houston, TX (Hybrid)

Salary Range: $90,000-130,000

Type: Full-Time

No C2C or 3rd Party Vendors at this time.

Reporting To: Director of Business Intelligence / Analytics Manager

Position Overview

A growing organization is seeking a Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across multiple business units. This individual will work closely with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements, analyze operational and financial data, identify trends, develop dashboards, and provide actionable insights that improve business performance. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, experience working with large datasets, and the ability to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze business, operational, and financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.
  • Gather reporting requirements from stakeholders and translate business needs into meaningful analytics solutions.
  • Perform data validation, cleansing, and quality assurance activities to ensure reporting accuracy.
  • Create recurring and ad hoc reports for various business departments.
  • Support KPI development, performance tracking, and executive reporting initiatives.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and provide recommendations to improve business processes.
  • Collaborate with IT, business teams, and leadership to improve data accessibility and reporting capabilities.
  • Document reporting processes, business rules, calculations, and data definitions.
  • Assist with data warehouse, ERP, CRM, and business application reporting initiatives.

Project & Data Environment

  • Enterprise business systems including ERP, CRM, HRIS, and operational applications.
  • Reporting and analytics environment supporting multiple business units and executive leadership.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Finance, Operations, Sales, Human Resources, and Information Technology teams.
  • Focus on reporting automation, dashboard development, data governance, and business intelligence.

Required Qualifications & Competencies

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Data Analytics Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or analytics roles.
  • Experience working with large datasets and transforming raw data into actionable insights.

Technical Skills:

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Power Query).
  • SQL querying and data analysis.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
  • Experience building dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting.

Analytical Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis abilities.
  • Experience identifying trends, anomalies, and process improvement opportunities.

Communication Skills:

  • Ability to clearly present findings and recommendations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
  • Strong documentation, organizational, and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or NetSuite.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL processes.
  • Experience with Python, R, or advanced analytics tools.
  • Exposure to financial, operational, or supply chain analytics.
  • Experience working in manufacturing, logistics, energy, construction, or industrial environments.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, or military or veteran status. We consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with state and local laws, including the California Fair Chance Act, City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

The Senior Data Analyst independently develops data solutions to support business goals. Develops clear and well-structured analytical plans and analyzes large data sets. Oversees and conducts the conversion of data into insights that will lead to informed business decisions. Develops a mastery of all available databases to effectively serve as an organizational subject matter expert on data sourcing. Ensures data integrity and compliance with data security standards. Supports the manager in guiding and directing the activities of data analysts, where applicable, to ensure the efficient execution of their duties.

Minimum Education

Bachelor's Degree in mathematics, statistics, economics, finance, computer science or a related field. Relevant experience beyond the minimum required work experience may substitute the educational requirement on a 1-to-1 ratio.” (i.e., one year of relevant work experience equals one year of required education). (Required)

Minimum Work Experience

5 years related experience (Required)

Required Skills/Knowledge

Demonstrates a deep interest in research and data analysis, drawing actionable insights form raw data and information to help further the business’s cause.

Skilled in statistical and econometric modeling, performing quantitative analysis, and technological data mining and analysis techniques.

Possesses a clear understanding of key IT business systems, reporting and analytics, general ledger management, and data warehousing.

Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.

Must demonstrate a willingness to be accountable for the business’s performance.

Exceptional attention to detail, have an ability to handle multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines, have creative and innovative problem-solving skills, be self-motivated and proactive, and demonstrate calmness during time of uncertainty and stress.

Most possess a natural ability to get along with people and establish strong and meaningful relationships with others.

Proficiency with standard statistical packages (e.g. SAS, R, etc.)

Proficiency with writing SQL code using multiple tools such as SQL Server Management Studio or GUI programs that assist with developing queries and reports preferred.

Functional Accountabilities

Data Management to Support Business Goals

  • Demonstrates a curiosity and drive for identifying the most efficient and accurate reporting solutions.
  • Thinks strategically to connect data flows into big picture business outcomes.
  • Works closely with management to prioritize business needs and stay up to date with the goals of the organization as they evolve.
  • Works with the business’s departmental heads, management, and key stakeholders, in developing detailed business requirements, conducting gap analyses, creating functional designs, and guiding the business’s leadership through analytical data processing when needed.
  • Establishes KPIs to identify predictive trends that assist with business decisions and validate the effectiveness of solutions over time.

Data Reporting and Modeling

  • Gathers and extracts data from the database using a variety of common commercially available tools (such as MS Excel, MS SQL and Tableau) to assist clients in identifying potential solutions to business needs.
  • Collaborates with a team of analysts and other associates to collect and process information. Creates graphs and charts for presentations to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Works under the Data Manager to develop clear and well-structured analytical plans, and to identify opportunities for improving operational processes and outcomes.
  • Analyzes large data sets to find usable information and to forecast and interpret potential trends. Enhances data sets to support performance improvement opportunities.
  • Builds statistical models, diagnoses, validates, and improves the performance of these models over time, in addition to creating efficient and reusable SQL code meant for the improvement, manipulation, and analysis of data.

Manage and Maintain Databases

  • Develops a mastery of all available databases to effectively serve as an organizational subject matter expert on data sourcing.
  • Maintains various existing reporting databases including those that are more complex.

Data Integrity and Compliance

  • Build and operationalize processes that ensure timely data-loading and maintain accuracy and relevance of data.
  • Documents the methodologies used to develop reporting outputs, including demonstrating the flow of data to stakeholders for review purposes.
  • Develops and maintains quality control standards and data reconciliation techniques for internal and external reporting.
  • Performs routine data audits to ensure compliance with deliverable reporting requirements.
  • Creates, troubleshoots, and enhances the business’ data loadings.
  • Completes data validation for applicable databases.
  • Works with Data Manager in ensuring constant compliance with data security standards and to effect change where merited.

Training and Technical Support

  • Creates and maintains documentation relating to data management including training guides, report specifications, and data dictionaries.
  • Maintains the flow of accurate data sets to various tools that allow stakeholder access to information in a self-service manner and trains senior leaders and management on the effective use of such tools.
  • Attends meetings where reporting and analytics expertise is needed and represents the department in both internal and external settings.
  • May control and grant access to database and/or standard reports.

It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the maximum of the pay range. The exact pay rate for this position will be based on a variety of factors in alignment with the Children’s National compensation philosophy. These factors are legitimate and non-discriminatory including, but not limited to, the current market conditions; organizational needs; the individual’s combination of prior work experience, level of education, knowledge, skills, and other qualifications. descriptionHtml:
CHAMP Titles modernizes the technology Motor Vehicle Agencies rely on. Our cloud-native platforms replace legacy processes for titling, registration, and licensing, and the data behind them supports decisions for agencies and the people they serve.


Location: Cleveland, OH (Hybrid, 4 days onsite)

Department: Data Product and Analytics

Reports To: Manager, Data Product and Analytics

Travel: Less than 5%

Visa Sponsorship: Not available

Relocation: Not available

Your Impact


CHAMP Titles is hiring a Data Analyst to join the Data Product and Analytics team. You'll write the reports and build the dashboards that internal teams and Motor Vehicle Agency clients rely on, working from our Operational Data Store, Data Warehouse, and Data Marts. The right candidate writes strong SQL, uses Python to automate reporting, and understands how warehouse data is modeled well enough to query it correctly and spot when something's off.


What You'll Do


  • Define report requirements with the Product team, internal teams, and Motor Vehicle Agency clients. Explain results to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Develop SQL to build reports from agreed specs. Keep queries accurate, performant, and consistent with team standards.
  • Data Validation: Make sure each report answers the question the requestor actually asked and that the results make sense. Check output against source data and raise data quality issues with the Data Engineering group.
  • Use Python to automate recurring reports and produce clear charts and summaries.
  • Document report logic, metric definitions, and data sources so reports are repeatable and easy to support.
  • Build and maintain dashboards in our business intelligence tool.
  • Take part in sprint planning and help improve how report requests are taken in and delivered.


We welcome candidates from all backgrounds. If you meet most of the qualifications below, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every single one.


Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years writing SQL for reporting or analytics.
  • Strong SQL, including joins, aggregations, window functions, and query tuning against relational databases.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants, with the judgment to verify their output.
  • Experience using Python for data manipulation and visualization (e.g., Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn).
  • Experience building dashboards in a business intelligence tool.
  • Working knowledge of data warehouse concepts such as fact and dimension tables.
  • Ability to find trends, patterns, and anomalies in complex data sets.
  • Clear verbal and written communication, including explaining technical results to non-technical audiences.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with government, motor vehicle, or other regulated-industry data
  • Experience with AWS data services
  • Familiarity with Git


Perks + Benefits

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus Potential
  • Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Unlimited PTO Policy
  • Matching 401K with immediate vesting
  • Subsidized Lunches at our Cleveland Headquarters
  • Fast Paced work environment in a growth company
  • Newly Renovated Office Space


Salary Range

The expected salary range for this position is $65,000 - $90,000 annually. This is a good faith estimate, and final compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and geographic location.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, including veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We're here to help.


By joining CHAMP, you will be an integral member of our team with many opportunities for personal growth and upward mobility in a growing organization. We have a great culture that is flexible, collaborative and welcoming.

descriptionHtml:
The Senior Data Analyst turns complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive business outcomes. In this role, you will develop scalable analytics assets, and promote the advancement of analytics across our organization. You will independently partner with executive stakeholders on challenging data problems, support BI infrastructure, develop scalable data assets, and conduct exploratory analyses that create new value.

Do you enjoy building systems you can take pride in, discovering insights that create measurable value, and working in a role that is both business-facing and technical? If you want to grow your data career with mentorship, resources, and meaningful ownership, this could be a great role for you.

The primary tools used in this role are Databricks, SQL, R, Power BI, and related Microsoft Fabric capabilities.

At this time, we are NOT considering applicants that require immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States. This includes, but IS NOT LIMITED TO: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, etc.

Salary range: $101,700-113,000 plus 10% bonus

Benefits

Our employees enjoy a generous package of benefits that we are thrilled to provide, and feel is part of what makes us different as an employer. We value our team members, and this is one way we can show it.

Benefits Include

  • PTO, holiday pay and holiday of choice
  • 401(k) match
  • Life insurance
  • Short-term disability
  • Health, dental and vision insurance
  • Maternity/paternity leave
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA) – health and dependent

Position Responsibilities May Include, But Not Limited To

  • Support high-impact analytics initiatives from problem framing through delivery; quantify value, design robust analyses, and communicate recommendations to business partners and executives
  • Develop analytics products and solutions using Databricks, dbt, custom scripting, and BI tools
  • Implement advanced analytics where applicable, using scalable scripts and Databricks workflows to support modeling, automation, and repeatable analysis
  • Build performant Databricks workflows (notebooks, jobs, SQL Warehouses) to wrangle large datasets, engineer features, and automate recurring analyses
  • Partner with Data Engineering to design scalable data solutions, clarify upstream data requirements, and ensure analytics assets are built on reliable data foundations
  • Own analysis quality through data validation, experiment and study design, sensitivity checks, reproducibility, versioning, and documentation
  • Define and monitor KPIs tying operational reporting directly to business objectives
  • Adopt and champion BI development standards across the organization, including naming conventions, documentation expectations, quality checks, and release practices
  • Stay current with emerging analytics methodologies, technologies, and capabilities

Required Skills And Experience

  • 4 -8 years in analytics roles, including 2 + years leading projects with cross-functional business stakeholders
  • 2+ years writing data directly to a data warehouse
  • Proven impact delivering analytics in complex environments ( messy data, ambiguous scope) with measurable business outcomes
  • Statistical and financial analytics expertise, including analysis design, interpretation of results, and business case development
  • Expert proficiency in writing production-level SQL with query optimization over large, partitioned tables
  • Knowledge of AI-assisted analytics development , and AI-assisted analytics tools
  • Versioning and Reproducibility: Git ‑ based workflows; disciplined documentation , and peer review
  • Comfort in at least one BI platform like Power BI, Hex, Tableau, etc.
  • Proficiency in R to create reproducible workflows, conduct statistical testing, and develop basic models
  • Executive storytelling: translate complex analyses into clear narratives, recommended actions, and solutions that support decision-making
  • Stakeholder partnership: influence cross-functional partners, set expectations, drive alignment, and maintain trust through clear communication
  • Product mindset: understand and define problem statements, success metrics, and iterate with feedback – drives adoption of analytics products and solutions

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Certifications in Databricks, dbt, Power BI, or cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
  • Familiarity with data governance tools and compliance standards
  • Product management training or analytics product delivery experience

Physical Requirements

  • Repetitive motions that include the wrists, hands and/or fingers
  • Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting, remaining in a stationary position for prolonged periods
  • Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

Company Overview

Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.

EEO

Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.

descriptionHtml:
Job Number: R0252346

Data Analyst

The Opportunity:

As data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. As a data analyst at Booz Allen, you can use your skills and experience to support a mission and use data for good.

As a client-facing data analyst on our National Security team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you provide a deep understanding of their data, you’ll also advise your client on what the information means and how it can be used to make an impact on their mission.

What You'll Work On:

As a data analyst on our team, you’ll:

  • Use your data analytics expertise to support client and stakeholder relationships.
  • Research, develop, and test data methodologies, and generate cross-functional solutions through collection, interpretation, evaluation, analysis, etc. of large data sets.
  • Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across multiple organizations.
  • Apply communication skills and data analytics expertise by simplifying technical requirements and trends, based on audience.
  • Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, scripting languages such as SQL, Python, R, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive technical outcomes.
  • Apply data visualization through different formats such as graphs, tables, and PowerPoint slides.
  • Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions across National Security.


Work with us to drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 2+ years of experience developing data visualizations and dashboards with Tableau or PowerBI to communicate key insights
  • Experience identifying and collecting data using specific tools or techniques
  • Experience analyzing and extracting key data and information
  • Experience in data validation and cleaning to ensure the quality and integrity of data
  • Ability to synthesize and communicate organizational performance clearly based upon information from disparate sources through oral and written communication formats 
  • Ability to translate complex, technical findings into an easily-understood narrative, in graphical, verbal, or written forms
  • TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
  • Bachelor’s degree


Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with SQL
  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with Tableau Prep and Tableau Server
  • Ability to adjust quickly to changing priorities and make progress in areas where high ambiguity and uncertainty exists
  • Ability to think critically, using logic and reasoning to help identify alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems  
  • Ability to execute projects and tasks with minimal guidance and supervision 
  • Possession of excellent oral and written communication skills 
  • Possession of excellent data gathering, analytical, and problem-solving skills 


Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $77,600.00 to $176,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

  • Remote: If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
  • Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
  • Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.


Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

Brief Job Description

Would you thrive in an environment where you learn and grow personally and professionally all while helping make a positive impact on people’s lives? Do you appreciate being around others like yourself who are dependable, trustworthy, hard workers who believe in the value of teamwork? HSCS is dedicated to building an atmosphere where employees feel valued and supported while providing specialized care for Texans in need. HSCS is comprised of ten psychiatric hospitals, two youth residential treatment facilities, and thirteen state supported living centers. Psychiatric hospitals are a hub of excellence for forensic mental health and complex psychiatric care, with all facilities accredited by The Joint Commission. They provide state-of-the-art treatment that is recovery-oriented and science-based. If providing hope and healing through compassionate, innovative, and individualized care interests you, we welcome your application for the position below.

The Data Analyst II performs routine (journey-level) data analysis work. Work involves creating and running queries to generate data sets, analyzing the data, and producing reports and graphics based on that data. Activities include a mix of running routine reports, responding to ad hoc report requests, and developing new reports to address identified needs. Responsibilities include ongoing development and technical support of local databases plus training and support of the individuals throughout the hospital using them. Works under moderate supervision, with limited latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgment.

Performs other duties as assigned. Other duties as assigned include but are not limited to actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role to meet the agency’s obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation. Such participation may require an alternate shift pattern assignment and/or location.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

Attends work on a regular basis and may be required to work a specific shift schedule or, at times, even a rotating schedule, extended shift and/or overtime in accordance with agency leave policy and performs other duties as assigned.

Creates and supports databases and related data collection systems that are used by customers throughout the hospital. Assures that these systems function smoothly and return accurate and reliable results that can be used for data analysis. Monitors use of these data systems to promote accuracy of data input by various users. Creates or adjusts queries to meet ongoing changes in customers’ data needs. Provides relevant analysis of results as needed and discards unnecessary information.

Consults with internal and external customers to clarify their specific data needs and how those needs can best be met. Identifies existing reports that address ongoing data needs and ensures that customers can readily access those reports. Adjusts existing reports to better address existing needs. Creates new reports in response to newly identified needs.

Conducts ad hoc data analysis in response to specific requests from Hospital Management, State Hospitals Central Administration, and department heads throughout the hospital.

Runs production reports that involve some compilation of results on a daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis. Interprets the results to identify outliers in the data from ongoing measures and places results into optimal format for presentation.

Uses queries and reports to conduct audits or monitor for possible irregularities in how the electronic medical record and other databases are implemented. Assists in using the results of such analysis to provide training, modify procedures, or take other responsive action.

Performs other duties as assigned. Other duties as assigned include but are not limited to actively participating and/or serving in a supporting role to meet the agency’s obligations for disaster response and/or recovery or Continuity of Operations (COOP) activation. Such participation may require an alternate shift pattern assignment and/or location.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities (KSAs)

Knowledge of common statistical measures and their relevance to data analysis.

Knowledge of the operation of electronic medical records and the specific types of information contained within them.

Skills in managing data in relational database management systems, including the creation of queries, linking of tables, extraction of relevant data, and assessment of the accuracy and validity of data within such systems.

Skills in the use of computers and common software programs used in data collection and analysis.

Ability to compile, review, and analyze data from existing data systems and to create reports and presentation graphics based on the results.

Ability to communicate with clinicians and department heads regarding their data needs.

Ability to maintain accuracy and attention to detail.

Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.

Registrations, Licensure Requirements Or Certifications

None

Initial Screening Criteria

Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university with major coursework in data science, business analytics, computer science, computer information systems, management information systems, accounting, finance, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field.

OR

Four (4) years’ equivalent experience in one or more of the above fields.

One year of experience in data analysis, research, and report design.

One year of experience with database software programs.

One year of experience creating queries and reports.

Experience can be overlapping.

Additional Information

Applicants must pass a fingerprint criminal background check, pre-employment drug screen, and registry checks including the Client Abuse/Neglect Reporting System (CANRS), Nurse Aid, Medication Aide and Employee Misconduct, List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE). Males between the ages of 18-25 must be registered with the Selective Service.

All applicants must be at least 18 years of age to be considered for employment at a state-operated facility. Waco and Terrell Center for Youth applicants must be 21 years of age.

Flexibility in work hours may be required for this position. The position may be required to work overtime and/or extended hours.

Compliance with HHSC immunization policy and state hospital operating procedures related to immunizations is required. According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, healthcare workers are considered to be at significant risk for acquiring or transmitting hepatitis B, measles, mumps, rubella, varicella (chicken pox), tetanus, diphtheria, pertussis (whooping cough), and influenza. All these diseases are vaccine preventable. As a result, state hospital policy requires employees be vaccinated according to their level of contact with individuals. In the event you choose to not be immunized for the influenza virus, you may be required to wear a mask and take other protective measures.

Military occupation(s) that relate to the initial selection criteria and registration or licensure requirements for this position may include, but not limited to those listed in this posting. All active-duty military, reservists, guardsmen, and veterans are encouraged to apply if qualified to fill this position. For more information please see the Texas State Auditor’s Job Descriptions, Military Crosswalk and Military Crosswalk Guide at Texas State Auditor's Office - Job Descriptions.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), HHSC and DSHS agencies will provide reasonable accommodation during the hiring and selection process for qualified individuals with a disability. If you need assistance completing the on-line application, contact the HHS Employee Service Center at 1-888-894-4747. If you are contacted for an interview and need accommodation to participate in the interview process, please notify the person scheduling the interview.

Pre-Employment Checks And Work Eligibility

Depending on the program area and position requirements, applicants selected for hire may be required to pass background and other due diligence checks.

HHSC uses E-Verify. You must bring your I-9 documentation with you on your first day of work. Download the I-9 Form

Job Description

Position Summary

The Data Analyst will be a key member of the Revenue Management team, responsible for transforming raw data into actionable insights that support strategic pricing decisions. The Analyst will use their analytical skills to gather, validate, and implement pricing strategies based on performance data. In addition will provide managerial reporting and trends for revenue performance. The position works closely with our team of internal analysts, external business partners, and our information technology group. The primary goal is to help us improve the revenue generating effectiveness of our consumer by translating complex and massive data sets into actionable insights and recommendations for senior management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct in-depth analysis of large datasets to uncover patterns, trends, and variances
  • Apply data mining techniques to extract meaningful insights
  • Build and maintain data models that reflect complex business processes and relationships
  • Create clear, comprehensive reports and presentations for stakeholders
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs and deliver customized insights
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and security by following governance standards and best practices
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation abilities.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure, accurately meet deadlines, present a professional demeanor and work well independently is essential

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience in a data analyst or similar role or graduate in above fields from top universities.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Highly proficient in Excel and comfortable with using formulas, vlookups and pivot table and graph
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI is helpful but not required
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal abilities
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively

Preferred Skills:

  • Master’s degree in a relevant field

Additional Information

Compensation

Base Pay Range: $95,000 - $110,000

Workplace

  • One of our values pillars is to work as One Team and we believe that there is no replacement for in-person collaboration but understand the value of some flexibility. Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days each week with the option to take up to three flexible remote days per month.

Public Storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

Grow With Us

Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. Stay Awesome

Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A Day In The Life

The Data Analyst II supports data-driven decision making by transforming complex data into actionable insights, reports, and analytical solutions. This role partners with stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs, integrate and prepare data from multiple sources, and deliver analyses that improve operational effectiveness and business outcomes. This position combines business analytics, data wrangling, and technical development skills using SQL, Python, and modern analytics platforms.

Data Analyst II's Are Also Responsible For

  • Uses SQL, Python, and analytics platforms to prepare, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Ensures data quality through validation, investigation, and documentation of data sources and methodologies.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders across Tandem’s business units to define user needs and develop proof-of-concept analyses, datasets, and visualizations that inform solution design.
  • Analyzes data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business insights.
  • Develops reports, dashboards, visualizations, and analytical datasets that support business decision-making.
  • Presents findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Identifies opportunities to automate and improve reporting and analytical processes.
  • Ensures compliance with company policies, including Privacy/HIPAA, and other legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Job Description

JOB SUMMARY:

The Portfolio Data Analyst prepares reports and data extracts from various sources to provide to internal customers and approved vendors to support business functions and processes while maintaining data security.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop new reports and update existing reports to support business lines by utilizing Business Intelligence tools. Validate reports to assure accuracy.
  • Summarize key findings from reports and analysis for presentation to internal customers.
  • Support Data Governance by identifying and researching potential data quality issues.
  • Responsible to interact with all levels of staff across the organization and regulators in a prompt and professional manner.
  • Work closely with Director of MIS & Credit Analytics on other projects and responsibilities as business needs arise.

Essential Functions:

  • Sitting for extended periods of time.
  • Sufficient dexterity of hands and fingers to efficiently operate a computer keyboard, mouse, power tools, and other computer components.
  • Ability to converse and exchange information with all levels of staff within organization.
  • Ability to observe, perceive, identify, and translate data

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in quantitative field, such as data analytics, mathematics, statistics, MIS or related field, or a minimum of (3) three years of data analysis work in a professional setting environment required
  • Ability to present deliverables in a concise, complete and professional format-demonstrating research, analysis and conclusion.
  • Proficiency in MS Microsoft Office products is required
  • Experience working with relational databases and performing complex queries.
  • Advanced analytical ability to perform simple/complex mathematical calculations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to demonstrate prior working experience creating reports from large amounts of data is highly desired, preferably in Business Objects.
  • Excellent interpersonal, professional, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, multi-task, results-oriented and lead projects as needed.
  • Interact with all levels of staff across the organization and bank examiners in a prompt and professional manner.

descriptionHtml:
Since opening our first self-storage facility in 1972, Public Storage has grown to become the world’s largest owner and operator of self-storage facilities. With thousands of locations across the United States and Europe and more than 170 million net rentable square feet, we are also among the largest landlords globally.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work by the Great Place to Work Institute, Public Storage is a member of the S&P 500 and FT Global 500. Our common and preferred stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

As the nation’s leading self-storage provider, we are known for our iconic orange doors and our commitment to delivering simple, reliable storage solutions to millions of customers.



Job Description

Public Storage runs at a scale that makes the work interesting. More than 4,500 locations and growing, a national customer base, prices that move every day, and a footprint expanding across the U.S. and into Canada. Our Data and Analytics team sits with the business partners who own those decisions and works with them on the critical problems: pricing, promotions, marketing, operations, real estate acquisitions, and forecasting supply and demand.

Our platform runs on Google Cloud, including BigQuery, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run, GKE, and Terraform, along with dbt Cloud, Airflow/Cloud Composer, Looker, and modern CI/CD. We're a small, senior team that operates like a startup inside an S&P 500 company. Short paths from idea to production, real ownership, and work that shows up in the business instead of in a slide deck.

Analysts here aren't a report factory. In this role you'll support our customer teams, working with customer data to answer the questions that change what we do the following week. You'll write real SQL against a modern warehouse, build dashboards people actually use, and learn the difference between a number that's interesting and a number that's decision-grade. You'll work closely with a senior data scientist who reviews your work and helps you grow, and you'll learn to work alongside AI analysis tools, which means your value is in framing the question and validating the answer.



What You'll Do

Analysis

  • Write clean, efficient SQL against BigQuery to answer business questions from our customer teams and other business partners
  • Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting in Looker, and support customer team partners in using them
  • Investigate anomalies and trends in customer and business data: find the driver, not just the delta
  • Support experiment readouts and performance measurement for customer initiatives, such as campaigns and promotions, with correct methodology

Data Craft

  • Contribute dbt models and tests for the metrics you own, with documentation others can read
  • Validate data before you publish it, with reconciliation, sanity checks, and known caveats stated up front
  • Handle customer data responsibly, following our privacy and access standards
  • Use AI assistants to accelerate query drafting and exploration, and critically review everything they produce

Communication

  • Turn analysis into a short, clear recommendation with the assumptions visible
  • Present to business partners in their language, not in yours
  • Document metric definitions so the same question gets the same answer next quarter

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field, such as statistics, economics, finance, business analytics, mathematics, engineering or computer science, with a minimum of 3 years of analytics, reporting or business intelligence experience; or Master's degree in one of these fields with 1 year of analytics, reporting or business intelligence experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job
  • Solid SQL skills, including joins, window functions, and aggregation logic
  • Experience building dashboards in Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets modeling skills
  • Clear written and verbal communication; comfort presenting to business stakeholders

Preferred

  • 3+ years of analytics experience, including customer, marketing, digital, retail, or consumer analytics
  • Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks
  • Exposure to dbt, Git, or version-controlled analytics workflows
  • Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis
  • Exposure to A/B testing, statistical significance, and experiment interpretation
  • Experience with web and digital analytics such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or clickstream data
  • Interest in using LLMs and AI tools to accelerate analytical work

Skills & Technologies

  • Core: SQL, Looker, Excel/Sheets, data storytelling
  • Cloud & data: BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, dbt (exposure)
  • Analytics: cohort and funnel analysis, segmentation, trend and variance analysis, KPI design
  • AI: prompt engineering, AI-assisted analysis with human validation

Additional Information

Workplace Environment:

One of our core values is working as OneTeam. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while recognizing the importance of flexibility. Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days per week, with the option to use up to three flexible remote-work days each month.

**Sponsorship for Work Authorization is not available for this posting. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. We do not provide training plans or support for F-1 OPT, STEM OPT extensions, or future visa sponsorship.**

Description

Leidos is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to support operations and maintenance of a large-scale, mission-critical enterprise environment. The successful candidate will work closely with government stakeholders, program management, systems engineering, and enterprise architecture teams to analyze complex information, develop actionable insights, and support operational and technical decision-making.

This position requires an experienced individual contributor capable of independently analyzing information across multiple enterprise systems, identifying data quality and integration challenges, and developing reporting solutions that improve operational visibility and decision-making.

The Senior Data Analyst will also support enterprise data standardization, digital engineering, and model-based systems engineering (MBSE) initiatives.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Independently collect, analyze, interpret, and validate complex data from multiple enterprise systems, databases, documents, and repositories to support program operations and government requirements.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve analytical reports, dashboards, data models, and visualizations that communicate operational performance, trends, and findings.
  • Respond to complex government and internal stakeholder data requests by researching, reconciling, and synthesizing information from multiple sources.
  • Identify data inconsistencies, gaps, and quality issues; develop and recommend solutions to improve data accuracy, standardization, and reliability.
  • Apply analytical techniques to identify trends, relationships, anomalies, and opportunities for operational or process improvement.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

We are looking for a customer-centric and detail-oriented Data Analyst II to join the Customer Reporting team. Reporting to the Manager, Customer Reporting, you will be responsible for delivering custom and standard reporting that demonstrates the impact of Spring Health to its customers. You will collaborate closely with Customer Success and Subject Matter Experts to refine Spring’s storytelling strategy and data artifacts. This role is expected to support a combination of ad hoc requests and dashboard development.

Please note that this is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week at our 44 Montgomery Street location. Candidates must be based in the San Francisco metro area or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Occasional travel will be required for team on-sites. Periodic travel of up to 25% is expected for team collaboration and company events.   • Delivering analyses and dashboards to customers and internal stakeholders they need to tell compelling stories about Spring Health’s impact
  • Diving into different data sources, quickly building expertise on what is possible, and developing creative solutions based on your stakeholder’s needs
  • Developing a deep understanding of our products and how we tell the story of their impact to customers
  • Collaborate with Product to inform how we evolve our customer data story and expand our standard suite of reporting
  • Surface opportunities to automate and scale commonly requested reports and data sets
  • Become an expert working with our data stack including Snowflake, Looker, dbt, and Hex

  • Customers and internal stakeholders trust the data provided to them; reports and data sets are reviewed for data consistency and data quality

  • Bring ideas forward that can reduce the amount of time spent manually pulling data to inform decisions
  • Dashboards and analyses deliver ongoing value to stakeholders

descriptionHtml:
Our Health Data Analysts play a meaningful role at Blue Cross of Idaho by supporting provider contracting and reimbursement strategies through advanced analytics, forecasting, and process automation. This role is responsible for answering ad hoc business questions related to modeled reimbursement rates, developing and maintaining models that forecast contracted rates for provider contracts, and leveraging SQL and Python to automate existing analytical and reporting processes. Health Data Analysts perform research, analysis, and modeling of complex healthcare data, evaluate utilization and cost trends, and present actionable insights and recommendations that support contract strategy.

This role will report to the Manager Provider Analytics and interacts with various departments across Blue Cross of Idaho.

We're Looking For a Health Data Analyst With

Experience (Level I): 2 years’ data analysis

Experience (Level II): 4 years' data analysis

Education (Level I & Level II): Bachelor’s Degree Finance, Information Systems, Economics, Math or related field; or equivalent work experience (Two years’ relevant work experience is equivalent to one-year college)

What Your Day May Look Like

  • Answer ad hoc questions on modeled rates, provider reimbursement, and contract performance.
  • Develop forecasting models for Contracted Rates.
  • Analyze claims, utilization, and financial data to support contracting decisions.
  • Partner with contracting teams to provide insights and recommendations.
  • Automate reporting, modeling, and data workflows using SQL, Excel and Python.
  • Build custom datasets, tools, and reports to support business needs.
  • Identify reimbursement trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain and enhance analytical methodologies and reporting standards.
  • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Demonstrate strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Utilize SQL, Python, and Microsoft Office to support data-driven decision-making.

We'd love it if our Health Data Analyst also has:

  • Modeling experience
  • Health Insurance/Healthcare knowledge
  • STEM degree

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay range for a level I is: $66,353 - $92,894 and a level II is: $78,064 - $117,095. The position is eligible for an annual incentive bonus (variable depending on company and employee performance).

The pay range for this position takes into account a wide range of factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, relevant experience, skills, seniority, performance, travel requirements, internal equity, business or organizational needs, and alignment with market data. At Blue Cross of Idaho, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top range for the position. Compensation decisions are dependent on factors and circumstances at the time of offer.

We offer a robust package of benefits including paid time off, paid holidays, community service and self-care days, medical/dental/vision/pharmacy insurance, 401(k) matching and non-contributory plan, life insurance, short and long term disability, education reimbursement, employee assistance plan (EAP), adoption assistance program and paid family leave program.

We will adhere to all relevant state and local laws concerning employee leave benefits, in line with our plans and policies.

The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. descriptionHtml:
ABOUT LOGIC

Logic is a practitioner-led program management firm that helps utilities, public agencies, and infrastructure owners deliver complex capital programs. Our teams provide program and project controls, PMO and governance, and organizational change and business transformation, working inside our clients’ programs as part of their teams, not advising from the sidelines. We hire experienced people, give them real ownership of their work, and build an inclusive environment where they want to stay. Join us to do work that keeps critical infrastructure moving.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

Logic is seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Data Analyst II to support a utility wildfire program for a major utility client in the San Diego area. This role supports reporting and analytics work for wildfire mitigation programs and regulatory deliverables. That work includes gathering, transforming, validating, reconciling, analyzing, and visualizing data, and turning technical findings into clear, defensible information. It’s a strong fit for a data professional with 2–5 years of experience who enjoys owning analytics work from start to finish and wants work with real-world public safety impact. You’ll work closely with project managers, subject matter experts, data owners, and regulatory stakeholders.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting & Analytics

  • Execute processes to assess client datasets and prepare reliable, traceable data for analysis, reporting, and visualization.
  • Lead assigned reporting and analytics projects independently, including planning, stakeholder coordination, testing, documentation, and delivery.
  • Build and maintain interactive Power BI or Tableau dashboards that communicate key performance indicators and wildfire mitigation performance in an actionable format.
  • Apply statistical methods and diagnostic or predictive modeling, as appropriate, to identify trends, patterns, relationships, and anomalies.
  • Develop thorough test plans and perform QA/QC to confirm the proper functioning of reports, calculations, dashboards, and data automation tools.

Wildfire Mitigation Regulatory Support

  • Support quarterly data and spatial reporting, annual information reports, Wildfire Mitigation Plan (WMP) filings and tables, and regulatory data requests.
  • Gather, analyze, validate, and reconcile data that supports quarterly data reports, WMP tables, effectiveness studies, narratives, and regulatory responses.
  • Investigate reporting changes, anomalies, conflicting values, missing information, and source-system discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with data owners and program SMEs.
  • Validate data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, traceability, and alignment across regulatory deliverables.

Documentation, Communication & Continuous Improvement

  • Document data sources, metric definitions, calculation methodologies, assumptions, business rules, validation procedures, and data lineage.
  • Translate technical analyses into plain-language findings and recommendations for project managers, executives, business leaders, and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, standardize methodologies, automate recurring processes, and reduce manual effort.
  • Perform all work in accordance with client procedures, security and confidentiality requirements, and established data governance practices.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, or a related field — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong proficiency with Power BI and advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including reconciliation, data shaping, and quality review.
  • 2–5 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, data management, business intelligence, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading reporting or analytics assignments.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for database querying and analysis.
  • Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis, automation, or modeling.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams).
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to explain technical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to attend in-person meetings in the San Diego area as needed.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in utility, wildfire mitigation, regulatory reporting, compliance, risk, asset management, or infrastructure programs preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data tools, including Amazon S3 and Amazon Redshift, preferred.
  • Experience with Tableau or other visualization platforms a plus.
  • Working knowledge of statistics, hypothesis testing, and data modeling preferred.
  • Power BI Data Analyst certification or a comparable analytics certification preferred.


PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Hybrid — Enhanced work-life balance with our hybrid model combining both remote and in-office work.
  • Climbing PTO — Enjoy freedom and flexibility with our annual increasing paid time off.
  • Paid Holidays — We observe 9 federal holidays.
  • Health & Wellness — We prioritize your physical and mental well-being with health and wellness initiatives and programs.
  • Medical & Retirement Benefits — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, and retirement with company match ensures you and your family’s health and future are well-protected.
  • Career Growth — Track your career with our robust learning and development opportunities.
  • Culture Focused — Thrive in our inclusive, vibrant culture that values diversity, teamwork, and mutual respect.

At the State of Minnesota, employees play a critical role in developing policies, providing essential services, and working to improve the well-being and quality of life for all Minnesotans. The State of Minnesota is committed to equity and inclusion, and invests in employees by providing benefits, support resources, and training and development opportunities.

Join PERA and turn data into insights that support critical decisions and strengthen retirement services for Minnesota's public employees!

As a Data Analyst at PERA, you will collect, validate, analyze, and report on data used across the organization to support business operations, strategic planning, and decision-making. This role works closely with staff, management, and business partners to develop reports and dashboards, research complex data issues, ensure data quality and integrity, and provide meaningful analysis and recommendations.

You'll play a key role in maintaining accurate information, identifying trends and opportunities, supporting actuarial reporting, and helping PERA leverage data to better serve more than 435,000 members and 2,100 participating public employers.

This position is telework eligible and offers a hybrid work schedule, based on agency and department needs. Scheduled in-office workdays will be at the PERA office, 60 Empire Drive, Suite 200, St. Paul, Minnesota.

  • Candidates residing in Minnesota within 50 miles of our St Paul office may be eligible to telework up to 50%.
  • Candidates residing in Minnesota and more than 50 miles from our office may be eligible to telework more than 50%.
  • Candidates residing in a bordering state within 50 miles of our office may be eligible to telework up to 50%.
  • Candidates who do not reside in Minnesota or within 50 miles of the office in a state bordering Minnesota are not eligible to be hired, unless planning to relocate within 50 miles of the office or report to the office full time.

Minimum Qualifications

To facilitate proper crediting, please ensure your resume clearly describes your experience in the areas listed below and indicates the beginning and ending day, month, and year for each job held. Only applicants whose resumes clearly demonstrate fulfillment of each of the minimum qualifications will be considered for this position.

Two (2) years experience writing SQL queries and developing reports and dashboards using Microsoft Power BI, including:

  • Experience developing, maintaining, or supporting reports, data extracts, dashboards, or other business intelligence tools.
  • Experience collecting, validating, analyzing, and interpreting data to identify trends, resolve data discrepancies, and support business operations and decision-making.
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel and other reporting or data analysis tools to organize, reconcile, maintain, and present data for business users and management.

Minimum qualifications that will be assessed during the interview process:

  • Experience collaborating with business users, technical staff, and external stakeholders to develop reporting solutions, improve data quality, and support business objectives.
  • Experience using analytical and problem-solving skills sufficient to research data issues, evaluate impacts, identify root causes, and recommend effective solutions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with individuals with a wide range of backgrounds, who do not share your same culture, ethnicity, language, or other common experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a closely related field.
  • Two (2) or more years of experience in data analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or data management.
  • Experience using SQL, Power BI, Python, or similar tools to analyze data, develop reports and dashboards, validate data quality, and support business decision-making.
  • Experience working with large relational databases, data warehouses, and data visualization tools.
  • Knowledge of pension administration, governmental operations, or experience supporting financial, actuarial, audit, or regulatory reporting.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Data Analyst to support program management, data analytics, dashboard development and reporting activities at Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). This role will work with a team of both officers and contractors to interconnect reporting and analytics, tasking responses, and overall information to support the ICE mission. This role will directly support activities with the Miami Field Office on-site as they work to integrate processes to make law enforcement initiatives more efficient.

Responsibilities

  • Provide analysis of ICE specific mission data, processes, field operations, strategic planning, or nuanced mission systems.
  • Develop data analytics dashboards, tools and templates to support the efficient collection and analysis of field metrics.
  • Utilize tools such as Power BI, tableau, Excel, and Access to provide visualizations to overall data sets.
  • Support collaboration with multiple stakeholders, such as business, scrum teams, other project managers, to collect and compile information to ensure timely responses to requests and ad hoc assignments.
  • Facilitate the needs, issues, and challenges faced by the clients; perform gap analysis and recommend solutions.
  • Use source data to assess the effectiveness of projects and business processes.
  • Develop, gather and disseminate information and documentation among both business and technical customers.
  • Work with all team members to analyze changes in requirements and recommend the most expedient solutions in a timely manner.
  • Leverage advanced writing skills to translate complicated issues from multiple information sources into a clear point of view to create a compelling, concise, and well-written narrative.
  • Leverage excellent presentation development skills to prepare meeting agendas and synthesize complex information into succinct visualizations using tools such as PowerPoint.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's with 3 + years (or commensurate experience) in dynamic customer delivery environments
  • Clearance Required: Ability to attain and maintain DHS clearance (US citizenship required)

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Ability to translate ICE specific mission needs into tactical execution of reports, taskings and overall data analytics.
  • Excellent data analytic and oral communication skills.
  • Strong understanding in project management and data analysis.
  • Ability to lead data analytics development.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to work independently in an extremely fast-paced environment.
  • Be flexible to change direction on a moment’s notice while also tracking/executing tasks in progress.
  • Ability to think “outside of the box” while communicating or dealing with a variety of situations.
  • Possess clear understanding of the activities, roles, and responsibilities on large scale IT projects.

Posted Salary Range: USD $85,000.00 - USD $95,000.00 /Yr.

About the Role:

The Business Intelligence Analyst will play a pivotal role in supporting McKesson Pharmaceutical Solutions and Services (PSaS) Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) and Practice Advisory Services through advanced analytics. The Business Intelligence Analyst will be responsible for generating actionable insights and analysis to meet the evolving needs of GPO customers and stakeholders and facilitate the organization's growth. Key areas of focus include GPO contract performance and trends, pharmaceutical manufacturer segmentation and contracting strategies, as well as physician reimbursement and clinical trends.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop and implement analytics, reporting, and visualization tools to effectively address inquiries from stakeholders and customers.
  • Perform ad hoc requests from stakeholders and manage large, complex, or cross-functional projects.
  • Conduct and support data-driven analyses to define and measure operational, financial trends, and strategic insights related to McKesson’s GPO and Provider Solutions Organization.
  • Design, maintain, and distribute customer-facing and internal dashboards that track GPO and membership key performance indicators.
  • Support GPO operational functions by managing internal/external reporting and tracking key performance indicators.
  • Perform data analytics to support strategic planning initiatives and present findings to customers.
  • Collaborate with solution architects and cross-functional teams to enhance automation and visibility of data workflows


Basic Requirements:

  • Degree or equivalent and typically requires 4+ years of relevant experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field.
  • Proven proficiency in analyzing and manipulating large data sets, with exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate data insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong proficiency in MS Office Suite; expertise in data analytics platforms such as Tableau/Power BI/Databricks; familiarity with back-end data architecture.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.


Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master’s degree in Data Analytics or MBA preferred.


Additional Skills/Experience:

  • Experience working in a virtual team-based environment.
  • Flexible and positive attitude.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent tasks efficiently.
  • High attention to detail, delivering high-quality and accurate outputs.
  • Results-driven, thriving in a fast-paced environment.
  • Pharma/Oncology knowledge and experience preferred.


Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to travel nationwide up to 5%.
  • Commutability to The Woodlands, TX is highly preferred.


This position offers the possibility of a hybrid work arrangement based on recent updates to our in-office/work‑from‑home model. Specific in‑office days may be designated according to team needs and business priorities.
