descriptionHtml:
The Data Analyst within the Office of Institutional Analytics uses statistical methods, existing reports, and ad hoc reporting developed using university report writing assets to call up, refine, and report data to inform institutional analytics processes and solve business problems. The Data Analyst also consults on data collection / processes and engages in projects of institutional analytics need, particularly those focused on enrollment, retention, productivity, efficiency and contact center routing strategies.

Work Location: Virginia Beach, VA (Qualified candidates may be considered for remote work depending on location.)

Salary: $45,000-$50,000 annually

Essential Duties

  • Determine data needs from various constituencies and lead or contribute to the design, testing, validation, and delivery of reports which provide the desired data outputs.
  • Collect, maintain, and expand upon the regularly requested reports in support of the various needs of the institution, including weekly, quarterly, annual, and ad hoc reporting needs for the university.
  • Maintain applicable websites and/or project inventories.
  • Master in-house and popular reporting/analysis tools (Pyramid, Discoverer, Microsoft BI, Tableau) and provide expert training to other data constituents.
  • Develop data documentation manuals or other learning materials, as needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to the work described above (e.g.: math or computer science); Master’s degree preferred, though significant experience related to the job requirements can substitute for a relevant master’s degree
  • Prior experience with analytical software is a must

Candidates Must Have

  • Must be comfortable with the detailed work of data validation and preparation
  • The successful candidate must demonstrate the ability to translate data into presentable formats, via PowerBI or other visualization tools for organizational executives; careful attention to detail and professional business acumen are a foremost consideration
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both oral and written, which demonstrate the ability to convey complex and technical data and concepts in ways suited to the recipient’s needs
  • Excellent customer service and project management skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Commitment to Regent’s core values of Excellence, Innovation, and Integrity

descriptionHtml:
Scientific Games

Scientific Games is the global leader in lottery games, sports betting and technology, and the partner of choice for government lotteries. From cutting-edge backend systems to exciting entertainment experiences and trailblazing retail and digital solutions, we elevate play every day. We push game designs to the next level and are pioneers in data analytics and iLottery. Built on a foundation of trusted partnerships, Scientific Games combines relentless innovation, legendary performance, and unwavering security to responsibly propel the global lottery industry ever forward.

Position Summary

The Data Analyst turns data into reliable, reusable analysis that helps internal teams and lottery customers understand performance, identify opportunities, and make better operating decisions. This role supports reporting, dashboarding, exploratory analysis, and recurring analytical workflows with an emphasis on clarity, accuracy, and repeatability.

The analyst works with business partners, technical teams, and customer stakeholders to define questions, prepare and validate data, build cloud native analysis in environments such as Databricks, and communicate findings in clear business language. The role requires solid SQL, growing comfort with Python and SQL, familiarity with version control, and an interest in automating routine work so useful analysis can scale without adding unnecessary manual effort.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain analysis, reports, dashboards, notebooks, and visualizations that support revenue growth, cost reduction, operational performance, and customer success.
  • Use cloud native data platforms, with emphasis on Databricks, SQL, notebooks, governed datasets, and reusable workflows.
  • Help translate business questions into clear analytical approaches, data requirements, success measures, and decision ready recommendations for internal stakeholders and external lottery customers.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reporting assets, and self service data products using the right visualization tool for the need. Tableau experience is helpful, but the role is tool agnostic and values strong visualization judgment over a specific platform version.
  • Use GitHub or similar version control practices to manage analytical code, notebooks, documentation, peer review feedback, and reproducible project history.
  • Automate recurring analysis, quality checks, data preparation, and distribution steps where practical so the team can deliver more value without adding proportional manual effort.
  • Partner with data engineering and business teams to improve data collection, transformation logic, metric definitions, and the usability of shared datasets.
  • Review data quality, reconcile source differences, document assumptions, and clearly communicate limitations, confidence levels, and recommended next steps.
  • Create and maintain studies, research reports, executive dashboards, sales enablement tools, and exploratory visualizations that surface useful insights and practical growth opportunities.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and contribute to durable solutions that reduce rework, improve trust in the data, and make future analysis easier to repeat.
  • Manage multiple analytics tasks and projects, balancing stakeholder requests with clear documentation and reliable analytical practices.
  • Work effectively in a remote environment, using collaboration tools, written updates, and shared documentation to keep stakeholders aligned.
  • Travel to lottery and corporate locations on an occasional as needed basis.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in mathematics, economics, statistics, applied statistics, data science, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field. A master's degree in data science, applied statistics, analytics, or a related field is a plus.
  • At least three years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, reporting, analytics engineering, data science, or a closely related role.
  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, filtering, validation, and the ability to work with data from multiple sources.
  • Hands on experience, coursework, certification, or practical exposure with Databricks or comparable cloud analytics platforms, including notebook based analysis, lakehouse concepts, Spark SQL, or PySpark.
  • Familiarity with cloud native analysis patterns in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, including shared workspaces, governed datasets, and scalable compute environments.
  • Experience with Python or similar language for analysis, data preparation, automation, or reproducible analytical workflows.
  • Familiarity with GitHub or similar version control tools, including commits, branches, pull requests or review workflows, and readable project documentation.
  • Ability to design effective dashboards and visualizations in Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Sigma, or comparable BI tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to collect, organize, analyze, interpret, and communicate significant amounts of information accurately.
  • Ability to explain analytical findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations in plain language for business, executive, and customer audiences.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience contributing to reusable data models, metric layers, feature datasets, or certified analytical tables that support multiple downstream use cases.
  • Experience automating recurring reporting or analytics workflows with scheduled jobs, orchestration tools, notebooks, scripts, or CI style validation.
  • Working knowledge of data quality practices, testing approaches, lineage, documentation, and governance in modern analytics environments.
  • Experience with Alteryx, dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or similar transformation and orchestration tools.
  • Familiarity with forecasting, segmentation, regression, classification, or other statistical methods used in practical business analysis.
  • Experience supporting sales, operations, gaming, lottery, retail, or other transaction rich business domains.

Skills And Abilities

  • Thinks beyond one time deliverables and looks for ways to make each analysis easier to reuse, maintain, audit, and scale.
  • Balances speed with reliability by documenting assumptions, validating outputs, and building repeatable workflows.
  • Communicates clearly in writing and conversation with technical teams, business partners, executives, and customer stakeholders.
  • Works effectively in a team environment, seeks feedback, and contributes to shared analytical standards.
  • Prioritizes effectively, manages multiple deadlines, and adapts as business needs or data realities change.
  • Learns new tools, languages, platforms, and analytical methods as needed.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, bend, use hands, operate a computer, and have specific vision abilities to include close and distance vision, and ability to adjust focus working with computer and business equipment.

Work Conditions

Scientific Games, LLC and its affiliates (collectively, “SG”) are engaged in highly regulated gaming and lottery businesses. As a result, certain SG employees may, among other things, be required to obtain a gaming or other license(s), undergo background investigations or security checks, or meet certain standards dictated by law, regulation or contracts. In order to ensure SG complies with its regulatory and contractual commitments, as a condition to hiring and continuing to employ its employees, SG requires all of its employees to meet those requirements that are necessary to fulfill their individual roles. As a prerequisite to employment with SG (to the extent permitted by law), you shall be asked to consent to SG conducting a due diligence/background investigation on you.

This job description should not be interpreted as all-inclusive; it is intended to identify major responsibilities and requirements of the job. The employee in this position may be requested to perform other job-related tasks and responsibilities than those stated above.

companyDescription: Strive Health is the nation’s leader in value-based kidney care and partner of choice for innovative healthcare payors and providers. Using a unique combination of technology — including AI — care interventions and seamless integration with local providers, Strive forms an integrated care delivery system that supports the entire patient journey from chronic kidney disease (CKD) to end-stage kidney disease (ESKD). To help patients, Strive partners with commercial and Medicare Advantage payors, Medicare, health systems and physicians through flexible value-based payment arrangements, including risk-based programs. Strive serves over 165,000 people with CKD and ESKD across 50 states and partners with over 6,500 providers. Strive’s case management and population health programs are accredited by the National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), and its technology platform, CareMultiplier™, is certified by HITRUST. To learn more, visit StriveHealth.com.
companySlogan: We partner with providers and payors to provide complete care for kidney patients in a value-based setting.
descriptionHtml:
How You’ll Make An Impact

At Strive Health, patients come first. We’re on a mission to transform chronic conditions by identifying risk earlier, coordinating thoughtful care, and supporting people through every stage of their health journey.

Our work reduces emergency visits, improves outcomes, and helps patients live fuller lives. You’ll work alongside passionate Strivers who care deeply about making an impact, show up for one another as One Team, and find ways to elevate the everyday.

If you’re looking for meaningful work where your contributions truly matter, you’ll feel right at home at Strive! 

Benefits & Perks 

  • Hybrid-Remote Flexibility – Work from home while fulfilling in-person needs at the office, clinic, or patient home visits.
  • Comprehensive Benefits – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance programs, employer-paid and voluntary life and disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts.
  • Financial & Retirement Support – Competitive compensation with a performance-based bonus program, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources.
  • Time Off & Leave – Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid birthgiving, bonding, sabbatical, and living donor leaves.
  • Wellness & Growth – Family forming services through Maven Maternity at no cost and physical wellness perks, mental health support, and an annual professional development stipend.

To learn more about our offerings, click here. 

What You'll Do

The Senior Data Analyst (Partner Analytics) will work across the organization to support new and ongoing initiatives. This person will be an early member of a highly experienced and passionate team and will play a key role in defining the future of the organization. The associate’s primary focus will be supporting and advancing initiatives across analytics and operational performance in collaboration with both the new market & business development team, as well as the organization overall. 

Essential Functions 

  • Research, hypothesize and develop analytical approaches for identifying, analyzing, and interpreting trends or patterns in complex data sets, particularly in healthcare claims & lab data. 
  • Ability to conceptualize and design innovative models to assess viability of new and ongoing initiatives and clinical programs. 
  • Collaborate with team members from strategy, clinical and new market functions to identify data driven opportunities to add value to existing and potential partners. 
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis for internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Design and build self-service dashboards to measure performance and assist in directing team’s efforts towards initiatives with the largest impact. 
  • Identify, communicate, and lead the resolution of data gaps that impede the fulfilment of operational reporting and oversight. 

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree with strong academic achievement. 
  • Located in Denver, or willing to relocate. 
  • 2+ years’ experience in healthcare data analysis. 
  • Internet Connectivity - Min Speeds: 3.8Mbps/3.0Mbps (up/down): Latency <60 ms.   
  • Ability to travel and be onsite to meet business needs. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Working knowledge of analyzing medical claim, lab data, EMR data and clinical data. 
  • High degree of proficiency in Microsoft SQL, Excel & PowerPoint. 
  • Entrepreneurial spirit and comfort in ambiguity; desire to be a self-starter. 
  • Must be comfortable speaking and leading analytical discussions with partners.  

*Must be located in Denver Metro*

Annual Salary Range: $85,500 - $104,000. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 10%

Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications. 

Strive Health is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. At this time Strive Health is unable to provide work visa sponsorship. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please apply even if you feel you do not meet all qualifications. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to talentacquisition@strivehealth.com.

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from outside recruiters/placement agencies. Strive Health will not pay fees associated with resumes presented through unsolicited means.

Under limited supervision, this position is responsible for gathering, extracting, compiling, and analyzing data to create comprehensive reports that will be used to support decision making. Specifically, this position will conduct analysis using data from internal and external sources, prepare reports and research briefs, present findings through oral presentations at meetings and conferences. Further, will assist in data validation and play a vital role in building and maintaining data dictionaries and glossaries, and documenting data related processes. Performs related duties as assigned.

Associate’s degree. Bachelor’s degree in an analytical field, such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, economics, engineering, or social sciences strongly preferred.

Four years of experience in data extraction and validation, statistical analysis, reporting writing, and making presentations in related field, preferably in a higher education setting in which conducting data analysis and reporting findings is/was the primary function; the experience includes software, i.e. Power BI, Power Query, DAX formulas, or SQL database management platforms like SSMS or pgAdmin and/or other statistical software (not including spreadsheet packages); and, experience with database software, i.e. SAS, Access, SQL, Paradox, dBase and/or other database software.

Position Details:

Position Emphasis: The position supports the NEA’s strategic objective to focus the energy and resources of its nearly 3 million members toward the promotion of public education by providing professional expertise in data coordination and analysis for the Center for Innovation & Technology’s Reporting, Analytics, & Data (RAD) team.

Position Summary: The essential functions of this position include conceptualizing and conducting a broad range of data coordination and analysis projects for the Reporting, Analytics, & Data (RAD) team. Key responsibilities include: Carrying out queries and analysis of data; developing data-driven reports, publications, graphics, talking points, and presentations accessible to diverse audiences, including NEA and affiliate staff, education professionals, and policymakers; and developing data dashboards and data visualizations. Additional responsibilities include writing and maintaining technical documentation. To carry out responsibilities, the incumbent uses a computer and/or laptop, associated software, and other office technology, and travels occasionally.

Minimum Education Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in social sciences, applied statistics, data science, or related discipline, including advanced graduate studies in quantitative data analysis, or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and skills may be acquired. Minimum Qualifications: Five years of progressively responsible experience in data analysis involving the transformation, combination, and analysis of complex datasets to support data-driven decision making; experience in heading major data coordination and analysis projects; and strong writing and public speaking skills, with proven ability to communicate complex ideas to professional and lay audiences. Other Requirements: Some travel required (approximately 15-20 overnights per year). Samples of recent work products (e.g. writing, presentation, and research materials) may be required at interview.

Selection Criteria: Tier 1 (Essential): Proven training and experience in data analysis/science. Experience building, transforming, querying, and analyzing large databases. Experience using coding languages such as R, Python, and/or SQL. Proven project management skills and ability to effectively allocate time and resources toward the completion of multiple projects with overlapping timelines. Demonstrated ability to synthesize and interpret data analysis findings for technical and non-technical audiences. Proven oral and written communication skills. Experience using data to create data visualizations. Successful references. Tier 2 (Significant): Knowledge of business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, AWS Quick Suite). Experience with national datasets, particularly those maintained by NCES, Census Bureau, and other federal agencies (e.g., SASS, CCD, ACS, CPS). Substantive background in education, social policy, and/or labor issues. Experience using Civis Platform. Significant experience collaborating with others for purposes of identifying, defining and solving problems. Tier 3 (Desirable): Capacity to work effectively within the context of the NEA, an advocacy organization. Knowledge of the mission and strategic focus of NEA Center for Innovation & Technology.

Additional Information

Please submit a cover letter with your application, and in your cover letter answer the following two questions:

  • Use your past experience to suggest a problem you could solve at NEA.
  • Give one example where a peer, superior, or an AI chatbot gave you an answer you knew was wrong. How did you know it was wrong, and how did you resolve the issue?

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), the following is provided: The position involves skill in using a computer and/or laptop; oral and written communication skills; skills in proofreading and editing; use of clear and articulate speech; interpersonal relations skills; reasoning and problem-solving skills; ability to work in a fast-paced environment; ability to sit for long periods, stoop, bend, reach and carry light materials (up to 10 lbs.); and ability to travel by various methods of transportation, e.g., airplane, car.

NEA is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and encourages applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, or disability. Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal. To apply for this position or to search for other openings, please go to our jobs page at Careers at NEA (myworkdayjobs.com)

Who’s driving the success of one of the fastest-growing retailers in the nation? ALDI National Real Estate! Our Real Estate Analytics team uses data, statistical modeling, and advanced analytics to help shape the future of our store network. We are looking for someone who is passionate about numbers and problem solving, using data to understand the past and help predict the future.

Who’s driving the success of one of the fastest-growing retailers in the nation?

ALDI National Real Estate! Our Real Estate Analytics team uses data, statistical modeling, and advanced analytics to help shape the future of our store network. We are

looking for someone who is passionate about numbers and problem solving, using data to understand the past and help predict the future.

As a Data Analytics Associate II, you will develop analyses, build and improve data workflows, and create reporting and visualizations that support strategic real estate

decisions across the country. You will also support non-technical users of a technical system by answering questions and helping them understand analytical outputs and

insights. The ideal candidate has a strong analytical background, solid math and statistics skills, and at least one year of relevant experience. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with Tableau, Power BI, and other workflow and visualization tools are strong pluses

Position Type: Full-Time

Starting Wage: $31.75 per hour

Wage Increases: Year 2 - $32.75 | Year 3 - $34.50 | Year 4 - $36.00

Work Location: Dublin, OH

This role is eligible to participate in ALDI’s Hybrid Work Program, which allows remote work up to 3 days per week (i.e., work remotely up to 3 days per week; work in-office at least 2 days per week)

Duties And Responsibilities

Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Designs, manages, and delivers analyses for all real estate-related departments via workflows and statistical modeling.
  • Aggregates data from various sources to construct streamlined data pipelines and integrate data from multiple databases for centralized analysis.
  • Develops and executes statistical models to support various internal client goals and derive statistically significant insights.
  • Develops and implements databases, data collection systems, data analytics and other tools that optimize statistical quality and efficiency. }
  • Maintains and validates data regularly to enhance the quality of the analysis and resultant output.
  • Seeks out process, data sourcing improvements and programs scheduled refreshes continually.
  • Maintains various computer applications, databases, and report generation and tracking spreadsheets.
  • Makes data visually appealing and simple to both navigate and comprehend for end-users.
  • Collaborates with team members and communicates relevant information to direct leader.
  • Complies with ALDI privacy and security requirements and policies if job responsibilities include possible access to confidential and/or sensitive information.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

Job-specific Competencies:

  • Consistently demonstrates the Mindsets, ALDI Acts Competencies and Professional Skills (M.A.P.) as outlined for the role.
  • Gives attention to detail and follows instruction.
  • Ability to stay organized and multi-task efficiently.
  • Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
  • Establishes goals and works toward achievement.
  • Effective time management; maximizes productivity.
  • Excellent understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle large data sets and crunch numbers.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Computer Science, Math, Statistics or a related field required.
  • A minimum of 1 year of relevant experience required.
  • Or, a combination of education and experience providing equivalent knowledge.
  • Experience with Power BI preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Work may be performed in an office, remote office or a combination of both where a computer and office equipment may be used as needed to perform duties.
  • Regularly required to sit, reach, grasp, stand and move from one area to another.
  • Constantly and repeatedly use keyboard/mouse.
  • Occasionally required to push, pull, bend, lift and move up to 25 lbs.

Travel

  • Minimal travel required as needed for job related duties such as training, project work and administrative tasks.

ALDI offers competitive wages and benefits, to all employees including:

  • 401(k) Plan
  • Company 401(k) Matching Contributions
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • PerkSpot National Discount Program

In Addition, Full-time Employees Are Offered

  • Medical, Prescription, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Generous Vacation Time & 7 Paid Holidays
  • Up to 6 Weeks Paid Parental Leave at 100% of pay
  • Up to 2 Weeks Paid Caregiver Leave at 100% of pay
  • Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Life, Dependent Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Voluntary Term Life Insurance
  • Full-time employees average 30 or more hours per week within an annual lookback period
  • Benefits offered to full-time and part-time employees may vary by state Click here to learn more about the benefits ALDI has to offer

descriptionHtml:
Overview

We are building a cloud-native data platform that ingests, governs, and serves data to teams across the company. We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who can turn that data into clear, trustworthy answers — and document it well enough that others can reuse the work. You will sit close to the platform and its consumers, analyzing data to drive decisions while writing the queries, definitions, and guides that make the platform easier for everyone to use.

This role blends deep analytical work with strong technical writing. You will not only produce analysis, you will document data sources, metrics, and how-to guidance so that self-service actually works. We move fast and use AI as a normal part of the job, so we want someone who reaches for those tools to raise the quality and speed of their work.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

  • Deliver analysis that drives decisions — scope questions with stakeholders, pull and model data from the platform, and turn it into clear findings and recommendations.
  • Be the go-to expert on the platform's data — develop deep knowledge of the data model, the data it holds, and the platform's capabilities, and answer questions from consumers about what data exists, what it means, and how to use it.
  • Own metrics and definitions — define, validate, and maintain the key metrics teams rely on, and keep them consistent across the platform.
  • Write technical documentation — document data sources, schemas, metric definitions, and query patterns so consumers can find and trust the data without a meeting.
  • Enable self-service — build reusable queries, dashboards, and how-to guides that let other teams answer their own questions.
  • Safeguard data quality — profile new and existing sources, flag anomalies, and partner with data engineering to resolve issues at the source.
  • Be a bridge to the platform — translate consumer needs into feedback for the platform team, and help onboard teams onto new data as it lands.
  • Work AI-forward — use AI tools as a default part of how you analyze, draft SQL, summarize findings, and produce documentation — and share what works with the team.

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a similar role delivering analysis that shaped real decisions.
  • Strong SQL — you can independently query, join, and model data in a cloud warehouse; comfort with a scripting language such as Python is a plus.
  • Data platform fluency — hands-on understanding of modern cloud data architectures, data pipelines, and schemas; able to trace data from source to consumption, identify data issues, and partner effectively on technical solutions.
  • Technical writing skills — you write clear, well-organized documentation — data dictionaries, metric definitions, runbooks, and how-to guides — that non-experts can follow.
  • Rigor and clarity — you validate your numbers, explain your assumptions, and communicate findings simply to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • AI-forward mindset — you actively use AI tools to do your best work and raise your leverage, and you stay current as the tooling evolves.
  • US-based — authorized to work in the United States; this role is open to US-based candidates.

Nice to Have

  • Real estate / proptech experience — familiarity with property, leasing, or real estate data is desired but not required.
  • Experience standing up or maintaining a data catalog, data dictionary, or metrics layer.
  • Experience supporting internal consumers of a shared data platform.
  • Familiarity with dbt, version control, or documentation-as-code workflows.

How We'll Measure Success

  • Analysis that stakeholders act on, delivered accurately and on time.
  • A well-documented, trusted set of metrics and data sources that others reuse.
  • Growth in self-service — teams answering their own questions from your guides and queries.
  • Faster, higher-quality output through effective use of AI tools.

Salary And Benefits

RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement savings plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Performance-based bonus based on position.

Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance.

Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Pay Range

USD $85,200.00 - USD $145,200.00 /Yr.

Description

Come Smile with Us!

Turn data into insights that make a difference! As a Data Analyst with Delta Dental of Iowa, you will transform data from multiple sources into meaningful dashboards, reports, and recommendations that help teams make informed decisions. Primarily supporting our Professional Relations team, you will also partner with Sales and other areas of the organization to provide insights that support operational, quality, contractual, and business objectives.

Learn why Karmin enjoys working for Delta Dental of Iowa.

Why Delta Dental of Iowa?

For your smile. For your health. For your community.

At Delta Dental of Iowa, we’re more than just a dental and vision insurance company. Improving health and wellness is at the center of everything we do. As a not-for-profit, we aim to build stronger communities by investing in actions that promote and improve health. Delta Dental of Iowa invests 40% of our dollars directly back into the communities we serve.

Come see why we are passionate about "Bringing Smiles" to our customers. Our team enjoys competitive pay and benefits, an awesome "One Team" approach, and a company culture that fosters "Exceptional Quality Service" and "Leadership at All Levels." Together, we can make a difference – not only in Iowa but across the country.

Essential Functions And Principal Accountabilities

  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of business areas supported by role.
  • Collaboratively work with internal stakeholders to identify informatics, reporting requirements, and desired outcomes measurement.
  • Develop, analyze and distribute, and manage reporting and analysis related to requested deliverables, including ad hoc data requests.
  • Generate and analyze reports to identify statistical aberrant treatment profiles; evaluate targeted claims for utilization review, appropriateness, and adherence to national processing policies; work with appropriate staff to educate dentists and dental office staff to appropriate treatment reporting and compliance to Delta Dental of Iowa processing policy.
  • Perform annual fee schedule analysis and update fee schedule documentation for all lines of business.
  • Lead quality assurance and management checks to confirm compliance and accuracy with data and department operations
  • Perform deep dive analysis to effectively translate broad data sets into performance insight; present findings and recommendations to multiple levels of management.
  • Report, analyze and summarize data for cost containment reports, dental consultant activity and other required department reporting.
  • Utilize SQL, Power BI, Network360, geoaccess mapping, and other tools to mine database(s) for analytic data.
  • Advise on data policies and data process best practice standards.
  • Be the go-to person for data definitions, data flows, and troubleshooting data issues, and support data dictionary enhancement.
  • Work with internal and external audit and project teams to provide complete and accurate audit documentation for initial requests and any required follow-up activities including corrective action plans.
  • Effectively and clearly communicate results to stakeholders.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Required

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Data Analytics, Business, Finance, Mathematics, or related field.
  • Three to five years of relevant work experience.
  • Must possess superior math and impact analysis skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Ability to work as an analytical, problem solver who can make high-quality judgments and decisions quickly with excellent organization skills to work across functions, with internal leadership, and external customers.
  • Ability to interpret and develop data reporting and monitoring requirements.
  • Experience using critical thinking skills working with results, metrics and data management and desire to create and build new processes.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively on project teams, as well as independently.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and communication skills working with all levels of employees, including Leadership.
  • High level of proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong working knowledge of database environments.
  • Strong understanding of analytical SQL scripting.
  • Understanding of Power BI with applicable experience.
  • Strong ability to organize, analyze and solve complex problems with attention to detail and accuracy.

Preferred

  • Experience in health, financial, or operational data analysis.
  • Experience in Insurance or dental.

descriptionHtml:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

  • MS or MA plus 2 years, or BS or BA plus 3 years, of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
  • Proficiency in SQL
  • Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
  • Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
  • Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
  • Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
  • Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
  • Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
  • Strong statistical knowledge
  • Working knowledge of Python
  • Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs and MBRs
  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding


Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $121,800 - $182,800. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

 JOB DESCRIPTION

The Data Analytics Senior Analyst is responsible for analyzing, preparing, and presenting data to support executive decision-making, project reporting, and operational performance tracking. This role focuses on developing structured reporting, dashboards, and data solutions while continuously improving data collection, quality, and efficiency. The position collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality insights and scalable reporting capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyse, prepare data, and create reports for executive and project-level stakeholders
  • Prepare data, KPIs, and metrics for executive reports and presentations
  • Create various reports and dashboards for project management and executive reporting
  • Design report layouts with clear, high-level summaries, KPIs, and graphical presentations
  • Review existing data collection methods and identify continuous improvement opportunities
  • Develop and maintain tables, templates, trackers, and structured data models
  • Implement automation in data collection and reporting processes
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and readiness for reporting
  • Identify trends, patterns, and insights from structured and unstructured data
  • Support cross-functional teams with reporting and analytical needs
  • Develop and enhance business intelligence solutions and dashboards
  • Apply data transformation, cleansing, and standardization techniques
  • Continuously improve reporting processes for speed, quality, and efficiency

Qualifications

  • Minimum 8–10+ years of experience in data management and analysis
  • Strong experience with databases; relational databases preferred
  • Strong ability to summarize and interpret data and recognize trends and patterns
  • Experience with project reporting and executive-level reporting
  • Advanced user of Excel and Office tools
  • Experience with PowerQuery, Power BI, and similar reporting tools
  • Experience designing reports with strong visualization and presentation capabilities
  • Proficiency in SQL; knowledge of M and DAX is a plus
  • Programming experience (e.g., VBA or other languages) is a plus
  • Experience working with data structures, templates, and tracking tools
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills and ability to present complex data to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a dynamic environment

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

  • Own it
  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute
  • Lead by example
  • Drive continuous improvement
  • Learn and seek out development
  • Promote transparent & open communication

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Work Authorization

No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Vertiv is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability. Cambia Health Solutions is a family of companies headquartered in Portland, Oregon, working to make healthcare simpler, more affordable and more person-focused. Through our regional health insurance plans, innovative technologies and strategic investments, we are delivering consumer-centric solutions that:
 
•	Help people achieve better health and well-being
•	Make healthcare more available, affordable and personalized
•	Are easily understood by everyone 

We put people at the heart of everything we do. Our company reaches more than 70 million Americans nationwide, including more than four million people enrolled in our regional health plans.

descriptionHtml:
Hybrid role (3 days/week in office) at our Portland, Vancouver, Renton, Salt Lake City, Boise, Little Rock, Springdale, Fargo, Medford, Burlington, and Lewiston offices. Candidates must reside within commutable distance of that location or be willing to relocate.

Build a career with purpose. Join our Cause to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.

Who We Are Looking For

Every day, Cambia’s dedicated team of FEP Business Intelligence Analysts is living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the FEP Data Analytics team, our FEP Business Intelligence Analysts build FEP analytics, ad-hoc reports, and Sigma or Tableau dashboards using Python for scripting; analysis of claims, customer service, and clinical data; manage projects, communicate with stakeholders, and collaborate cross-departmentally to meet varied deadlines– all in service of creating an economically sustainable health care system.

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where collaboration and flexibility are key? Are you energized by turning data into insights that help shape better health plan operations? Then this role may be the perfect fit.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Cambia:

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Economics, or a related field
  • 3+ years of related work experience
  • An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

Skills And Attributes

  • SQL proficiency (complex queries for standard and ad hoc data mining); candidates without SQL experience must demonstrate strength in other listed areas
  • Microsoft Excel skills
  • Scripting and statistical tools experience, such as Python, R/RStudio, SSIS, Alteryx, and Talend
  • Data visualization and reporting tools experience, such as Tableau, MicroStrategy, SPSS, and Power BI
  • Interactive dashboard development for data exploration, self-service analytics, and visual storytelling
  • Broad data analysis experience across datasets such as demographics, workflow, financial, and healthcare data
  • Large-scale data analysis, including interpreting qualitative data (research, feedback) and incorporating it into analyses
  • Research and methodology skills, with the ability to develop data mining approaches and innovative statistical or mathematical methods
  • Experience with AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity and decision-making (highly desired)
  • Whole-brain thinking: creative and analytical problem-solving, both independently and on teams, with the ability to learn quickly and synthesize solutions, options, and action plans
  • Collaboration skills to partner with team members and business stakeholders to define, develop, and deliver analytics that support routine operations, tactical decisions, and strategic direction
  • Clear communication of complex data, analyses, and findings in ways that support business decisions and program efforts
  • Independent work with strong management of deliverable timelines and clients
  • Accuracy and quality focus, producing error-free deliverables and supporting a peer review culture

What You Will Do At Cambia

  • Partner cross-functionally to understand business objectives and deliver routine and ad hoc analyses that are clear and relevant to stakeholders, including reporting that meets stakeholder agreements
  • Design and execute analytics projects from start to finish, including conceptualization, methodology, data sourcing, analysis structure, and reporting or data visualization
  • Ensure timely delivery of accurate project reporting and analyses, and provide insights to internal partners on tracking deliverables and ad hoc projects drawing on multiple sources across Healthplan Operations
  • Turn data into action by moving beyond "what happened" to "why it happened" and "what should be done," converting observations into insights, insights into recommendations, and recommendations into strategy and site optimization
  • Define and measure KPIs with team members, identifying the best ways to track metrics across Healthplan Operations to assess the success of new and existing initiatives and shape strategy
  • Collaborate with internal and external teams to prioritize recommendations based on data insights and support corporate initiatives through analyses and KPI measurement
  • Develop standardized, automated processes with team members, including analytical and statistical methods, best practices, and self-service reporting, to deliver sustainable, impactful data while building strong business partnerships that drive efficiency and strategic goals

Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure / certifications; and performance history.

  • National pay structure — applies to the Boise, Portland, Salem, Seattle/Renton/Tacoma, Burlington, Vancouver, Lewiston, and Salt Lake City metro areas: The expected salary range is $70,600 - $95,500, the full salary range is $66,000 - $108,000, and the bonus target is 8%.
  • Regional pay structure — applies to North Dakota, and to Idaho, Oregon, Washington, and Utah locations outside the metro areas listed above: The expected salary range is $63,500 - $85,900, the full salary range is $59,000 - $98,000 and the bonus target is 8%.

About Cambia

Working at Cambia means being part of a purpose-driven, award-winning culture built on trust and innovation anchored in our 100+ year history. Our caring and supportive colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry, innovating together toward sustainable, person-focused health care. Whether we're helping members, lending a hand to a colleague or volunteering in our communities, our compassion, empathy and team spirit always shine through.

Why Join the Cambia Team?

At Cambia, You Can

  • Work alongside diverse teams building cutting-edge solutions to transform health care.
  • Earn a competitive salary and enjoy generous benefits while doing work that changes lives.
  • Grow your career with a company committed to helping you succeed.
  • Give back to your community by participating in Cambia-supported outreach programs.
  • Connect with colleagues who share similar interests and backgrounds through our employee resource groups.

We believe a career at Cambia is more than just a paycheck – and your compensation should be too. Our compensation package includes competitive base pay as well as a market-leading 401(k) with a significant company match, bonus opportunities and more.

Benefits

In exchange for helping members live healthy lives, we offer benefits that empower you to do the same. Just a few highlights include:

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members, including mental health benefits.
  • Annual employer contribution to a health savings account.
  • Generous paid time off varying by role and tenure in addition to 10 company-paid holidays.
  • Market-leading retirement plan including a company match on employee 401(k) contributions, with a potential discretionary contribution based on company performance (no vesting period).
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid parental time off (eligibility requires 12 months of continuous service with Cambia immediately preceding leave).
  • Award-winning wellness programs that reward you for participation.
  • Employee Assistance Fund for those in need.
  • Commute and parking benefits.

Learn More About Our Benefits.

We are happy to offer work from home options for most of our roles. To take advantage of this flexible option, we require employees to have a wired internet connection that is not satellite or cellular and internet service with a minimum upload speed of 5Mb and a minimum download speed of 10 Mb.

As part of our security requirements, new hires will need access to a personal mobile device to set up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) upon joining the company. MFA is an important layer of protection for accessing Cambia systems and is required for all employees.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer dedicated to a drug and tobacco-free workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by law. A background check is required.

If you need accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please email CambiaCareers@cambiahealth.com. Information about how Cambia Health Solutions collects, uses, and discloses information is available in our Privacy Policy.

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where collaboration and flexibility are key? Are you energized by turning data into insights that help shape better health plan operations? Then this role may be the perfect fit.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Cambia:



- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Economics, or a related field
- 3+ years of related work experience
- An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered 

Skills And Attributes



- SQL proficiency (complex queries for standard and ad hoc data mining); candidates without SQL experience must demonstrate strength in other listed areas
- Microsoft Excel skills
- Scripting and statistical tools experience, such as Python, R/RStudio, SSIS, Alteryx, and Talend
- Data visualization and reporting tools experience, such as Tableau, MicroStrategy, SPSS, and Power BI
- Interactive dashboard development for data exploration, self-service analytics, and visual storytelling
- Broad data analysis experience across datasets such as demographics, workflow, financial, and healthcare data
- Large-scale data analysis, including interpreting qualitative data (research, feedback) and incorporating it into analyses
- Research and methodology skills, with the ability to develop data mining approaches and innovative statistical or mathematical methods
- Experience with AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity and decision-making (highly desired)
- Whole-brain thinking: creative and analytical problem-solving, both independently and on teams, with the ability to learn quickly and synthesize solutions, options, and action plans
- Collaboration skills to partner with team members and business stakeholders to define, develop, and deliver analytics that support routine operations, tactical decisions, and strategic direction
- Clear communication of complex data, analyses, and findings in ways that support business decisions and program efforts
- Independent work with strong management of deliverable timelines and clients
- Accuracy and quality focus, producing error-free deliverables and supporting a peer review culture

- Collaborate with internal and external teams to prioritize recommendations based on data insights and support corporate initiatives through analyses and KPI measurement

Description

About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will turn a federal program's operational data into figures its people can rely on. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your First Project Will Likely Have You Building The Reporting a Federal Program Runs On. Depending On The Assignment, You May

  • Work with the people who own each process to define its measures, and document the business rules behind every figure.
  • Write the Structured Query Language (SQL) that turns platform data on Amazon Aurora and related Amazon Web Services (AWS) data stores into clean, reconciled analytical datasets.
  • Build the recurring reports, dashboards, and data visualizations the program actually uses, with documented measures, refresh schedules, and access controls, designed to answer the question, load fast, and never mislead with a scale or a label.
  • Trace each discrepancy to its source, whether a definition, timing, a filter, or a source system, until the figure is explained.
  • Produce the quality evidence behind the reporting: validation checks, reconciliation reports, and issue logs that hold up in an audit.
  • Replace manual reporting with repeatable, tested workflows.
  • Make AI-assisted analysis standard practice, using coding assistants and language models across the work with your own judgment on top.

You help deliver figures a federal program can run on, each with the provenance to show where it came from, and clean datasets that give every later analysis solid ground.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of data analysis experience using SQL
  • Bachelor's degree
  • A strong working command of SQL
  • Experience building reports and dashboards in a business intelligence tool, such as Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable tool
  • Familiarity with Python or R for analysis scripting
  • The ability to own an analysis from the first question to a delivered, documented answer
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • Master's degree in a relevant field
  • Experience with cloud data platforms on AWS
  • Experience with federal program, financial, or performance data
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development and analysis tools

Who You Are

You are exact with numbers and wary of any you cannot explain: an anomaly is something to run down, not a footnote. You move easily between a stakeholder's question and the data that answers it, and you would rather hand a program one figure it can trust than ten it cannot. You adapt, and you pick up new concepts, systems, and tools fast enough to stay ahead of what the program needs as projects finish and priorities shift. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

  • A practical command of SQL and spreadsheets, with Python or R scripting where it makes the work faster or safer.
  • The discipline of defined measures: rules written down, sources reconciled, and reports that refresh without surprises.
  • The judgment to pick the chart that serves the reader, and the restraint to leave out the one that does not.
  • The care to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $67,000 to $123,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

MP Materials (NYSE: MP) is rebuilding the American rare earth supply chain.

From our operations in California and Texas, we produce the materials and magnets that power technologies critical to modern life, economic competitiveness, and national security.

At Mountain Pass, California, we operate one of the world's richest rare earth deposits and the second-largest rare earth mine globally. There, we mine, process, separate, and refine rare earth materials. In Texas, we manufacture high-performance rare earth magnets at our Independence facility, bringing a critical industrial capability back to the United States.

We are expanding those capabilities through investments in additional refining capacity, recycling circuits, and larger-scale magnet manufacturing. Construction is underway on 10X, our second U.S. magnetics facility, which will further scale domestic production and help meet growing demand from industry.

MP Materials serves leading customers across technology, automotive, and defense, including Apple, General Motors, and the U.S. Department of War.

Our mission is straightforward: restore the full rare earth supply chain to the United States and strengthen the industrial foundation on which the next generation of American manufacturing will be built.

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview:

MP Materials (NYSE: MP) is rebuilding American industrial capability for a new era of autonomy, robotics, and electrification.

We are the only U.S. company with a fully integrated rare earth supply chain—from mining and refining to advanced metal and magnet manufacturing. Our products include both the critical materials used to make permanent magnets and the finished magnets themselves—enabling next-generation technologies in robotics, automation, aerospace, transportation, defense, and energy systems. These materials are the foundation of physical AI—the convergence of computation, movement, and control.

We hire ambitious, mission-driven people who want to tackle complex challenges and shape the future of strategic industries. Our culture is rooted in teamwork, resiliency, and integrity, with a deep commitment to operational excellence and national purpose. MP is rapidly evolving from a materials producer into a leading U.S. manufacturer—and our people are driving that transformation.

Position Overview:

The Enterprise Data Analyst will be empowered to develop and maintain the Company’s reporting and analytics portfolio in collaboration with the broader analytics team. This position will possess a unique view of the business and support finance, manufacturing, and other functional teams in developing and analyzing key performance indicators, resource allocation, and future planning. The Enterprise Data Analyst will be a key member of MP Materials’ corporate financial planning and analysis team.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Prioritizing fully automated solutions, collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand analytical needs, define requirements, and translate business questions into actionable insights
  • Analyze and interpret multi-faceted datasets to identify key drivers, risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
  • Present conclusions and recommendations with clear distinction between fact and opinion
  • Support in the development of other enterprise-level analytics and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, workflows and/or other weekly reports for recurring analysis
  • Integrate and analyze large, disparate data sources to uncover new insights and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Establish and maintain data quality standards, validation processes, and reporting controls to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of manufacturing and financial reporting
  • Manage aspects of the analytical architecture and collection of manufacturing data
  • Proficient in acquiring and working with disparate data sources
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Finance, Computer Science, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment or in manufacturing data analytics; experience in a publicly traded company is a plus
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, operational KPIs, and cost structures; experience with SAP is a plus
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques. Advanced SQL (CTEs, window functions, complex relationship handling), proficiency in DAX, or proficiency in KNIME/another recognized analytical workflow automation tool is required
  • Experience with OneStream or Palantir is a plus
  • Ability to work with large, complex datasets from multiple sources and deliver clear, actionable insights

Desired Qualities:

  • Must be highly analytical, intellectually curious and a fast learner
  • Ability to identify objectives, collect and process data, analyze and interpret results, and present conclusion and recommendations
  • Must be self-directed, highly collaborative, and able to handle a variety of responsibilities
  • Ability to work with and for all levels in the organization, including senior management
  • Ability to work with internal customers and external agencies for compliance and controls
  • Strong verbal and written presentation skills
  • Familiarity with, or keen interest in learning about, mining, manufacturing, and industrial processes

MP Materials is Proud to be an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Underrepresented groups/Women/Disabled/Veterans are encouraged to apply. Candidates whose disabilities make them unable to meet the position’s requirements will still be considered qualified if they can perform the essential functions of the job with reasonable accommodation.

Job Summary

Responsible for developing, preparing, interpreting, and monitoring moderate–to–complex health process and outcomes data analyses, projections, data modeling, and reports used by system management in decision-making. POSITION TITLE: Senior Clinical Data Analyst

REPORTS TO: Chief Medical Information Officer

SALARY RANGE: $85,000 - $115,000

Job Summary: The Senior Clinical Data Analyst supports the mission of Santa Rosa Community Health (SRCH), A Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC), by transforming clinical, operational, and population health data into actionable information that improves equitable access, quality, patient outcomes, and care delivery.

This role partners clinical, quality, behavioral health, dental, enabling-services, operations, finance, and leadership teams to develop reliable reports and dashboards; monitor performance; identify care gaps and disparities; and support data-informed improvement work. The Senior Clinical Data Analyst works with a strong commitment to patient-centered, culturally responsive care for medically underserved communities.

The Senior Clinical Data Analyst works closely with the Population Health and Electronic Health Record teams as well as SRCH clinical and operational leaders to ensure high-quality usable reports that incorporate data standards and validation processes. The Senior Clinical Data Analyst will also collaborate with other community health centers to ensure consistency in data governance related activities. The Senior Clinical Data Analyst has expert knowledge of SQL, experience working with an electronic health record, and a working knowledge of health care practices, workflows, and documentation. In addition, this position requires excellent written and verbal communication skills to facilitate ongoing collaboration and ensure that reports align with agreed upon specifications from clinical and administrative report requests.

Specific Tasks/Duties Include:

Data Analysis, Reporting, and Visualization

  • Extract, validate, analyze, interpret, and integrate data from electronic health records, claims systems, scheduling platforms, referral systems, registries, health information exchanges, and other internal and external data sources.
  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, scorecards, patient registries, data visualizations, and recurring reporting tools to support clinical, operational, financial, and population health initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain SQL queries, reporting logic, algorithms, and analytic processes to support organizational reporting needs.
  • Present findings and recommendations through reports, dashboards, presentations, and written summaries tailored to various audiences.
  • Maintain documentation including report specifications, data definitions, business rules, data dictionaries, workflows, and query methodology.

Quality, Population Health, and Performance Improvement

  • Monitor and report performance on clinical quality, population health, access, utilization, patient experience, financial, and operational measures.
  • Identify care gaps, variations in performance, and opportunities for improvement through data analysis.
  • Support patient outreach activities and population health initiatives related to preventive care, chronic disease management, referrals, and care coordination.
  • Analyze outcomes by demographic, geographic, language, insurance, disability, and social determinant factors to identify disparities and advance health equity initiatives.
  • Support quality improvement activities through baseline measurement, intervention monitoring, performance tracking, and evaluation of outcomes.
  • Partner with clinical and operational leaders to translate data findings into actionable workflow and process improvements.

Regulatory, Compliance, and External Reporting

  • Support reporting requirements for UDS, HRSA, DHCS, CDPH, Partnership HealthPlan, SAMHSA, Title X, grants, incentive programs, accreditation activities, and other regulatory or contractual obligations.
  • Maintain current knowledge of reporting specifications, quality metrics, value-based care programs, and external reporting requirements.
  • Prepare accurate and timely reports for internal leadership, regulatory agencies, grant programs, and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies, HIPAA requirements, data governance standards, and applicable federal and state regulations.

Data Quality, Governance, and System Optimization

  • Perform routine data quality audits and validation activities to ensure reporting accuracy and data integrity.
  • Identify and address workflow, documentation, data entry, and system issues that impact reporting outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Information Technology, EHR Optimization, Population Health, and operational teams to improve data collection, system configuration, reporting processes, and workflow alignment.
  • Support EHR optimization initiatives by providing data analysis, validation, and performance monitoring.
  • Participate in organizational data governance efforts, including standardization of definitions, measures, and reporting methodologies.
  • Collaborate with external partners and community health center organizations as needed to promote consistency in reporting and data governance practices.

Project Planning and Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Collaborate with clinical, operational, and executive leaders to define business requirements, project scope, reporting specifications, deliverables, and timelines for analytical projects.
  • Facilitate meetings related to reporting, analytics, quality improvement, and strategic initiatives.
  • Assist leadership in prioritizing data requests and managing analytic work plans.
  • Provide project management, process design, implementation support, and ongoing monitoring for data-driven initiatives.
  • Support strategic planning, workforce planning, grant applications, operational planning, and community health assessment activities through data analysis and reporting.
  • Support reporting and analytics needs of residency, fellowship, and training programs.

Empanelment and Panel Management Analytics
