    Littler is the largest globalemployment and labor law practice in the world exclusively devoted torepresenting management. With more than 1,900 attorneys in over 100 officesworldwide, Littler serves as the single source solution provider to the globalemployer community. Consistently recognized in the industry as a leading andinnovative law practice, Littler has been litigating, mediating and negotiatingsome of the most influential employment law cases and labor contracts on recordfor over 75 years.

    Littler’s unparalleledcommitment to labor and employment law helps clients navigate a complexbusiness world with nuanced legal issues—building better solutions for clients’toughest challenges. With deep experience and resources that are local, everywhere,Littler is fully focused on its clients. With a diverse team of the brightestminds, Littler fosters a culture that celebrates original thinking. And withpowerful proprietary technology, Littler disrupts the status quo—deliveringbold, groundbreaking innovation that prepares employers not just for what’shappening today, but for what’s likely to happen tomorrow.

    Benefits

    We offer a generous benefits package to full-time and part-time employees working at least a 50% schedule. Benefits include comprehensive health, dental and vision plan for you, your spouse/domestic partner and children. In addition, we provide a superior 401(k) plan, ample time off programs, mental health programs, family building and caregiving, generous paid parental leave, life insurance, disability insurance, a wellness program, flexible spending accounts, and an employee referral bonus program.

    For moreinformation about our benefits visit: www.littler.com/benefits/state-details.

    For moreinformation about our firm visit: www.littler.com.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

A leader in cutting-edge research and technology in the cyber arena, CPMG focuses on using business drivers to guide cybersecurity activities and manage risk. CPMG offers flexible, integrative solutions for Department of Defense (DoD) contractors, among others, and specializes in cybersecurity, information and operational technology, electronic security surveillance, and support services.

Summary:

The Data Analyst - Journeyman (JNY) is responsible for analyzing structured and unstructured data to support decision-making across USSOCOM. This role involves working with data sets from various sources to develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations that help leadership and operational teams gain actionable insights. The analyst will collaborate with database administrators, system engineers, and mission stakeholders to deliver high-quality, data-driven visualization solutions in support of SOCOM’s mission.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and experience working with data tools and visualization platforms. This position requires familiarity with databases, data modeling, business intelligence.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Collecting, cleaning, transforming, and analyzing large data sets from multiple sources to identify trends and support decision-making.
  • Developing and maintaining dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or other data integration platforms.
  • Working closely with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and design user-friendly reports and data visualizations.
  • Writing queries and scripts to extract, manipulate, and analyze data from enterprise databases.
  • Supporting the generation of recurring and ad hoc reports for operational and leadership teams.
  • Contributing to the design and implementation of data models and workflows that enhance reporting efficiency.
  • Conducting data quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency of reporting outputs.
  • Documenting data sources, processes, and report specifications for continuity and audit readiness.
  • Collaborating with IT teams and database administrators to troubleshoot data access and integration issues.
  • Providing analytical support for strategic initiatives, operational planning, and mission readiness assessments.
  • Ensuring compliance with USSOCOM data governance, classification, and cybersecurity standards.
  • Presenting findings and recommendations in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Mentor junior team members by reviewing analytical outputs, ensuring adherence to USSOCOM data governance standards, and fostering technical skill development.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

  • Experience in data modeling, transformation, and visualization.
  • Familiarity with SQL and experience writing queries for data extraction and analysis.
  • Knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, or .NET).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and Access.
  • Ability to develop data visualizations that inform leadership decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma with a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience, 4 years’ experience with Associate's, OR 2 years’ experience with Bachelor's.
  • Must be DoW 8140 compliant under the Work Role Code 422 - Data Analyst- Intermediate level or higher.
  • Security Clearance: Active DoD TS/SCI clearance or higher is required.
  • Ability to successfully pass a background check

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Microsoft SharePoint integration for data visualization or workflow automation.
  • Experience with MAVEN platforms
  • 2+ years designing Palantir Foundry workflows: engineering data pipelines, modeling ontologies, and deploying BI applications to support mission-critical decisions

Referred Qualifications And Skills

Pay and Benefits

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

The Medpace Insights & Analytics within Clinical Operations is growing rapidly and is focused on building a data driven culture across the enterprise. The Insights & Analytics team uses data and insights to drive increased strategic and operational efficiencies across the organization. As a Clinical Data Analyst, you will hold a highly visible analytical role that requires interaction and partnership with leadership across the Medpace organization.

What’s in this for you?

  • Work in a collaborative, fast paced, entrepreneurial, and innovative workplace;
  • Gain experience and exposure to advanced BI concepts from visualization to data warehousing;
  • Grow clinical research management knowledge by working with clinical operations leadership across Medpace.

Responsibilities

What’s involved?

We are looking for a Junior Clinical Data Analyst to add additional depth to our growing Analytical team to support clinical operations and study management – from Visualization and Storytelling to SQL, Data Modeling, and Data Warehousing. This role will work in close partnership with operations management to help run studies more efficiently.

An ideal candidate in this role will apply great analytical skills, communication skills, and problem-solving skills to continue developing our analytics & BI capabilities. We are looking for team members who thrive in working with complex data sets, conducting deep data analysis, are intensely curious, and enjoy designing and developing long-term solutions.

What you bring to the table – and why we need you!

  • Data Visualization skills - Designing and developing key metrics, reports, and dashboards to drive insights and study management to improve performance and reduce costs;
  • Technical Skills – either experience in, or strong desire to learn fundamental technical skills needed to drive BI initiatives (SQL, DAX, Data Modeling, etc.);
  • Communication Skills - Partner with operations leadership to understand key risks and problems in a clinical trial;
  • Analytical Skills - Conduct complex analysis and proactively identify key clinical insights to assist study management decision making.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Life Science, Computer Science, or Related Degree;
  • 0-3 years of experience in business intelligence or analytics within a clinical setting or healthcare– Power BI and advanced SQL preferred;
  • Strong analytical and communication skills;
  • Excellent organization skills and the ability to multitask while efficiently completing high quality work.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

Purpose-Driven Work

Collaborative Culture

    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable
Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Company-sponsored social events and intramural sports

    • Multiple on-site dining options in the heart of Madison Square
    • Free on-site parking
    • Convenient access to on-site 24-7 fitness and wellness facilities

What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

companyDescription: Founded in 2011, Compass Health Center is the largest provider of non-hospital-based, specialized mental health services in Illinois, Maryland, Virginia, Washington D.C., and Wisconsin. We have a long history of partnering with providers, clinicians, schools, employers, health plans, and community members to provide the highest quality in-person and virtual Partial Hospitalization (PHP) and Intensive Outpatient (IOP) programs for people who need more than traditional outpatient therapy but are not acute enough for inpatient hospitalization. descriptionHtml:
Weekly outpatient therapy isn't always enough, and a trip to the ER isn't the only answer. Patients and their families rely on Compass Health Center when in crisis – every day, we help people overcome depression, anxiety, suicidality, obsessions/compulsions, trauma, chronic pain, and other obstacles in order for our patients to live freely.

About This Role 

The Senior Healthcare Data Analyst is a senior individual contributor responsible for clinical, outcomes, and program analytics across the organization. This role partners with clinical, operational, and executive leaders to turn complex questions into clear, meaningful insights. A strong understanding of behavioral health care delivery is important, including the patient journey from referral and intake through admission, treatment, utilization, outcomes, and discharge. The role also helps advance AI-enabled analysis within the Data Analysis function, using AI to improve the speed, depth, and efficiency of analytical work while establishing repeatable methods, validating outputs, and ensuring appropriate human and clinical oversight. 

What You'll Do 

Healthcare Analytics & Insights 

  • Analyze access, conversion, census, capacity, utilization, length of stay, patient engagement, clinical outcomes, and program performance.
  • Develop a strong understanding of behavioral health care delivery, including intake, treatment planning, group, individual and family therapy, psychiatry, documentation, authorization, outcomes, and discharge.
  • Partner with clinical leaders to understand operational and clinical questions and translate them into meaningful analysis.
  • Ensure findings reflect how care is actually delivered and are interpreted in the right clinical and operational context.
  • Identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities that can improve care delivery, patient experience, or program performance.
  • Turn complex findings into clear insights, recommendations, and actions for clinical and executive audiences.
  • Work independently on complex analytical questions and bring forward recommendations, not just findings. 

Clinical Outcomes Research, Program Evaluation & Publications 

  • Partner with clinical and research leaders to define research questions, outcomes measures, analytical approaches, and data requirements for clinical studies and program evaluations.
  • Build accurate, well-documented, and reproducible datasets and analyses for outcomes research, program evaluation, presentations, and publications.
  • Conduct and interpret analyses that evaluate patient outcomes, treatment effectiveness, program effectiveness, and differences across populations, programs, or levels of care.
  • Work with clinical subject matter experts to ensure findings are interpreted appropriately and limitations are clearly understood.
  • Translate findings into publication-ready tables, visualizations, summaries, and supporting materials for presentations, abstracts, manuscripts, and publications.
  • Support analytical review through final presentation or publication, including refining analyses, responding to questions, and reproducing results as needed.
  • Ensure research and publication-related data and analysis follow organizational privacy, compliance, governance, and data-use standards. 

Analytics Partnership & Standards 

  • Serve as a trusted analytics partner to clinical, operational, and executive leaders.
  • Help stakeholders clarify questions, define meaningful measures, and translate needs into analytical approaches.
  • Establish and maintain trusted metric definitions, documentation, analytical standards, and best practices.
  • Partner with other analysts and Data Engineering to support consistent definitions, reliable data, and scalable solutions.
  • Move recurring analytical needs into standardized dashboards, reports, or repeatable workflows.
  • Help stakeholders understand what the data shows, what it does not show, and how it should be interpreted.
  • Identify opportunities to improve analytical methods, tools, workflows, and how the organization uses data.
  • Provide subject matter expertise and mentor other analysts as appropriate. 

AI-Enabled Analysis & Validation 

  • Apply and help advance AI-enabled analytical methods within the Data Analysis function.
  • Identify analytical workflows where AI can improve the speed, depth, quality, or efficiency of analysis.
  • Use AI to accelerate data exploration, analytical development, quality review, synthesis, and interpretation while independently validating final outputs.
  • Develop repeatable AI-assisted analytical workflows, methods, prompts, standards, and validation practices.
  • Validate AI-generated findings for accuracy, relevance, bias, and appropriate clinical or business context.
  • Ensure human judgment remains accountable for final analytical conclusions.
  • Partner with clinical subject matter experts when findings require additional clinical interpretation.
  • Partner with Technology and Data Engineering to evaluate AI capabilities and determine how they can be incorporated into governed analytical workflows. 

What You'll Do 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, Health Informatics, Public Health, or a relevant clinical discipline such as Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, Nursing, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, healthcare analytics, business intelligence, or related analytical work. Candidates with a clinical background should also have demonstrated experience using data to evaluate care delivery, patient outcomes, program performance, or other complex healthcare questions.
  • Experience working with healthcare clinical operations and translating clinical workflows and business questions into meaningful analysis.

Job Summary

The Justice Services Division of the Community Resources Department is on the hunt for our next "Data Dominator" — a new Data Analyst role!

This isn't a "request comes in, report goes out" job — it's a chance to build something from the ground up. We're bringing data work in-house to strengthen our infrastructure, close longstanding reporting gaps, and turn metrics into real tools for decision-making.

You'll have a hand in it all: building division-wide dashboards from scratch, shaping reporting standards that don't fully exist yet, contributing to a new database management system, and supporting high-stakes work like CJC extended-custody reviews and EPSO quarterly reporting. It's a foundational, division-wide scope that'll only grow as the role matures.

We're looking for 3+ years of experience in data collection, synthesis, or analysis — hands-on with databases, queries, and visualization tools (SQL, BI tools, and beyond). Just as important: the ability to tell a story with data, translate numbers for courts, boards, and the public, and stay steady across stakeholders who each see the data differently.

 If you're curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and as driven by mission as by mechanics — this role was built for you. Apply today!

Hiring Range: $70,000.00 - $79,140.00 Annually

This position has an anticipated work schedule of Monday – Friday 8:00AM – 4:30PM; Hybrid schedule available upon successful completion of the probationary period

 Please be advised this position may close without advance notice, should we receive a sufficient number of qualified applications.

This position analyzes, evaluates, and documents data requirements. Develops a comprehensive data collection and analysis strategy based on functional assignment to evaluate the quality of services, performance, or other business indicators. Identifies and utilizes data solutions to implement data collection; performs data extraction and analysis and presents data. Employment is subject to the terms, conditions, and policies detailed in the Personnel Policies Manual (PPM). This position requires regular in-person presence as an essential job function. This position may be subject to grant funding.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

  • Performs a variety of complex activities involved in the collection, analysis, documentation, and interpretation of data and information related to applicable requirements, initiatives, services, and other activities. Independently draws reasonable and sound conclusions consistent with findings and provides presentations.
  • Develops data solutions, tools, and capabilities to improve data-driven efforts, frameworks, data delivery, or dashboards.
  • Conducts research, compiles data, and uses statistical tools to identify, analyze, and interpret patterns and trends. Isolates potential root causes, projects consequences, draws conclusions from analyzed data, organizes and explains data and assumptions, and provides solutions or recommendations.
  • Designs, validates, and assesses methods of data collection and analysis; develops and implements protocols for data extraction and analysis. Monitors data collection methods and audits data to ensure data collection methodologies and protocols are followed.
  • Works collaboratively with cross-functional teams to produce qualitative and quantitative data analysis that supports organizational objectives and processes, aligning with the strategic plan and associated efforts.
  • Conducts comprehensive and special purpose data analysis, audits, and/or examinations; reviews, evaluates, and measures compliance of programs and processes for quality, effectiveness, and outcomes; assesses adherence to internal policies, regulatory requirements, and other legal mandates. Recommends and implements practices/processes to support data analytics and program
  • Identifies, recommends, and helps to implement process improvement opportunities. Proposes system modifications and devises data management strategies for the organization to improve the quality and usability of data.
  • Serves as the organization’s subject matter expert for function/assignment-specific systems, databases, and data integrity. Develops and oversees training and development of staff on the use of data collection systems and quality assurance, ensuring alignment with policies, procedures, and best practices. Provides technical assistance, troubleshooting, and user support for databases and systems.
  • Leads or participates in data-driven work groups or committees; collaborates with internal and external partners to improve the efficiency of databases and systems; provides recommendations.
  • Utilizes function/assignment knowledge to provide guidance and recommendations to leadership, staff, and external sources regarding department data, policies, procedures, and best practices.
  • Maintains a highly technical working knowledge of industry standards and best practices, as well as relevant regulations, policies, standards, and procedures to improve the organization's operations.
  • Contributes to unified efforts to measure organizational and departmental performance; participates in supporting initiatives, services, and other activities.
  • Gathers, organizes, and prepares data and presentations; provides data-driven presentations at leadership meetings, conferences, or other forums as needed.
  • Performs other duties as required.


Supervision Exercised: This classification does not have supervisory authority; however, may be required to provide expertise or limited guidance or direction to employees, such as overseeing work quality, training, and guidance. Typically serves as a subject matter expert on the scope of functional area.

Supervision Received: Receives general supervision. This classification typically performs job duties by following established standard operating procedures and/or policies. Regular direction, guidance, and coaching from supervisor may be expected. There is a choice of the appropriate procedure or policy to apply to duties. Performance reviewed periodically.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Extensive knowledge and proficiency in the use of automated data systems to perform a variety of complex tasks. Must be receptive to the adoption and application of new and innovative technologies and technological platforms.
  • Working knowledge of office and data analytic software, databases, and business applications.
  • Working knowledge of research methodology, principles, and procedures.
  • Proficiency in Toad, Crystal Reports, Microsoft Power BI, SPSS, and SQL preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to quickly and accurately wrangle, analyze, and interpret data, as well as identify and define data integrity issues and make recommendations for resolution. Ability to collect, synthesize, and analyze data. Ability to develop sound and valid recommendations.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Must possess exceptional interpersonal communication skills. Ability to communicate and work effectively with co-workers, clients, other agencies, and the public. Ability to provide excellent customer service.
  • Must possess a high level of professionalism and integrity to handle sensitive and confidential situations and information.
  • Ability to build strong working relationships, internal and external to the organization. Ability to work cross-functionally with teams and key stakeholders, utilizing analytical skills in understanding data flows, dissecting problems, and delivering clear recommendations and guidance.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of proficiency related to research and analysis of a variety of data and systems used by the organization and in conjunction with applicable laws, regulations, and policies.
  • Ability to articulate data findings using both technical and non-technical language.
  • Ability to prepare reports and proposals to meet leadership objectives. Ability to write clearly and concisely and with proper respect to spelling, grammar, and punctuation.
  • Ability to assess situations and make prudent and appropriate decisions; ability to apply conflict resolution and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to respond in a flexible manner and reprioritize work as situations change.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance.


Required Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent education.
  • Three years of data collection, synthesis, or analysis experience, including working with databases or statistical software.
    • Associate’s degree in a related field may substitute for one year of the required experience.
    • Bachelor’s degree in a related field may substitute for two years of the required experience.
    • Education substitutions are not cumulative; only the highest qualifying degree will be considered.


Preferred Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, information systems, or related field.
  • Experience with writing SQL and other data queries and with managing databases.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, such as Power BI.


Licenses/Certificates

  • Must obtain and maintain necessary certifications/licenses as applicable to the position.
  • If assigned to the Digital, Strategy, & Technology Department:
    • Must obtain and maintain Criminal Justice Information System (CJIS) Compliance within six months of employment based on regular access to the Sheriff's Office buildings, systems, and/or networks.


Pre-Employment Requirements

  • Must pass conditional post-offer background investigation and drug screen.


Work Conditions

Duties are primarily performed in an office and remote work environment dependent upon Department discretion and business needs. May be required to work evening and weekend hours.

The classification specification above is intended to describe the general nature of work, key responsibilities, and minimum qualifications. Minimum qualifications reflect the baseline experience required for the classification. Departments may establish additional or preferred qualifications to address operational needs, assignment complexity, and specialized functions, provided such qualifications are job-related, consistent with the intent of the classification, and as approved by the Human Resources department. Specific job assignments, duties, education, experience, licenses/certifications, and working conditions may vary based on the department or office's needs and the requirements of the assigned position. Changes to this classification specification may only be made by the Human Resources Department.

El Paso County is an E-Verify and Equal Opportunity Employer.

El Paso County adheres to Federal drug screening guidelines and requires a pre-employment drug screen.

descriptionHtml:
At Amentum, we believe that data tells a story — and we're looking for a Data Analyst Sr. who can help us read between the lines. If you're passionate about using analytics to solve complex challenges, improve performance, and support mission-critical decisions, we want to hear from you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you won’t just crunch numbers — you’ll lead high-level functional and systems analysis efforts that shape how our organization and our clients operate. You’ll play a vital role in identifying trends, uncovering inefficiencies, and recommending actionable solutions grounded in data, experience, and hands-on insight.

This is more than just a technical role — it’s a leadership opportunity. You’ll act as a trusted advisor across multiple teams, applying your deep expertise to guide decision-makers through the full analysis cycle: from initial planning and data gathering to interpretation and implementation. Your contributions will directly impact organizational effectiveness and the mission success of those we support.

If you're ready to use your skills to influence change, drive innovation, and be recognized as an authority in your field — join us at Amentum and transform data into meaningful action.

Work Schedule: 8 hours 5 days a week within the hours of 6:00am – 6:00pm

Essential Responsibilities:

As a Data Analyst Sr. at Amentum, your days will be dynamic, intellectually engaging, and mission-focused. You’ll be a key player in turning complex data into strategic insights that drive organizational success. On a typical day, you can expect to:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across business, technical, and leadership teams to gather data requirements and understand business challenges.
  • Extract, clean, and validate large data sets from various sources to ensure accuracy and consistency for analysis.
  • Develop advanced data models, dashboards, and visualizations to identify trends, forecast performance, and support decision-making.
  • Perform root cause analyses to uncover underlying issues and identify areas for process or performance improvement.

descriptionHtml:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta’s Integrated Operations Planning team aligns strategic plans across operations, develops key operational inputs to the airline schedule, and designs cross-divisional solutions to achieve operational goals. The Data Analyst, Airport Planning Integration, role supports this work by organizing and analyzing planning data to enable rapid decision-making. This role partners closely with leaders and business partners to understand operational processes, address emerging challenges, and develop data-driven solutions that improve operational performance.

  • Be intellectually curious, ask questions, and speak up when they have an idea
  • Sustain a culture of independence and curiosity, driving cross-divisional decision making with little direction and supporting team members to look for problems to solve and then come up with innovative ideas
  • Develop new schedule KPIs and create automated reporting in support of executive-level future planning reviews
  • Be the central owner of schedule data for operations teams, partnering with Network Planning to maintain consistent and accurate data flows, as well as developing new data sources and structures
  • Partner with Network planning teams to create schedule feedback loops that resolve conflicts and provide feasible solutions in future schedules
  • Directly create and work with team members on written materials that distill findings and insights for a variety of audiences
  • Enjoy working in a high-profile environment with fluid priorities, ambiguity and extremely aggressive timelines
  • Present findings to Operations Analytics leaders
  • Produce robust documentation and training materials to assist other teams in interpreting and analyzing future schedules
  • Distill information and synthesize complex problems and processes to form a cohesive story for leaders across the organization
  • Identify and resolve or escalate, as appropriate, potential roadblocks within projects
  • Have a team first attitude, with the success of our team and business partners as their top priority
  • Develop an understanding of the schedule development process, including timelines and various schedule constraints

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Must be comfortable working in group and individual settings
  • Experience with analytical tools, such as SQL, Python, and Tableau or Power BI required
  • Strong business acumen, statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, and able to manage complex processes with cross-functional teams
  • Be a strong team player, detail oriented, and perform well under pressure
  • Previous experience in analysis, information science, data visualization, or other relevant quantitative field preferred
  • Experience communicating with stakeholders, delivering projects, and working collaboratively to drive improvement in the overall analytical support of Delta operations worldwide
  • Excellent written, presentation, and verbal skills, with the ability to produce concise, relevant, strategically driven documents and presentations for leaders

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

Bachelor's degree and previous work experience in Data Analytics, Decision Science, Engineering, Business, Finance or related analytical field

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

The Henry M. Jackson Foundation for the Advancement of Military Medicine is a global nonprofit organization created by Congress in 1983 to assist in accelerating the progress of military medicine. Our unmatched experience in military medical research makes us uniquely qualified to assist investigators and clinicians in managing scientific research. By providing exceptional program management services, we relieve the administrative burden associated with medical research, empowering researchers to make the medical discoveries our warfighters need.  

Our mission is to advance Military Medicine and our objectives are clear: to carry out medical research and education projects that provide answers and drive change while removing barriers to success; to serve as a trusted and responsive link between the military medical community, its private partners and American service members, veterans and civilians; to encourage engagement of the medical community for the mutual benefit of military and civilians, who benefit from this work. 

HJF is committed to supporting Military Medicine serving as the connective tissue between its industry partners and the research environment. 

We are driven to solve the biggest puzzles and hardest problems by using the resources necessary to support the mission. We anticipate needs, responding at the pace of change to focus on continually adding value to military medical research.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Join the HJF Team!

HJF is seeking a Data Analyst I to provide analytic support to CETCE’s informatics team, researchers, and scientists and ensure data quality and data integrity. This is the first of three levels in the Data Analyst hierarchy.

This position will be in support of the War Related Illness and Injury Study Center (WRIISC) and the Complex Exposure Threats Center of Excellence (CETCE), located at the Washington DC VA Medical Center. The Data Analyst will contribute to a variety of WRIISC and CETCE research, clinical-support, surveillance, and quality-improvement activities related to Veterans’ health and military occupational and environmental exposures. Work assignments will be based on evolving program needs including data preparation and management, preparation of research materials and reports, and support for tools and initiatives essential to the CETCE mission.

The Henry M. Jackson Foundation for the Advancement of Military Medicine (HJF) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing military medicine. We serve military, medical, academic and government clients by administering, managing and supporting preeminent scientific programs that benefit members of the armed forces and civilians alike. Since its founding in 1983, HJF has served as a vital link between the military medical community and its federal and private partners. HJF's support and administrative capabilities allow military medical researchers and clinicians to maintain their scientific focus and accomplish their research goals.

Responsibilities

  • Imports, cleans, transforms, validates and/or models data with the purpose of understanding or making conclusions for decision making and public health purposes.
  • Assists in making data accessible to epidemiologists, scientists, physicians, and other end users.
  • Tests data to identify data integrity issues, makes recommendations, and coordinates with the research supervisor to plan solutions..
  • Recommends methods to improve data collection, processing, and analyses.
  • Actively participates in data-related projects, including but not limited to data aggregation, normalization, standardization, statistical analyses, manuscript preparation, and presentation of findings.
  • May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned or directed by the supervisor. This may include attendance of and participation in required training for role.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in bioinformatics, data science, statistics, computer science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 0-2 years experience required.
  • At least 1 year of relevant experience preferred.

Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Must have strong python or R skills. General knowledge of SQL is a plus. Ability to investigate data issues and participate in remediation activities.
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis skills are a must.
  • Experience analyzing complex, high-dimension data from real-world datasets such as healthcare records, environmental data, etc.
  • Well organized, detail-oriented, and able to multitask independently.
  • Knowledge and application of constructing reproducible workflows, version control, and methods documentation.
  • Demonstrated analytical skills, and experience with various modelling approaches.
  • Ability to review published methods and develop similar analytical pipelines is desired.
  • Familiarity with electronic health records and public health data is beneficial.
  • Direct experience working on topics related to veterans health preferred.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a T1/Public Trust background check.

Work Environment

  • This position will take primarily in an office environment.

Compensation

  • The annual salary range for this position is $52,800-$67,500. Actual salary will be determined based on experience, education, etc.

Benefits

  • HJF offers a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on your health and well-being, from medical, dental, and vision coverage to health savings and retirement plans, and more.

Employment with HJF is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, which may include, but is not limited to, contacting your professional references, verification of previous employment, education and credentials, a criminal background check, and a department of motor vehicle (DMV) check if applicable. descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Research Data Analyst who will provide data analysis and related activities for various types of research projects and studies. The Research Data Analyst will contribute to ongoing development, maintenance, and use of a research data pipeline that collects and analyzes data. We are seeking an experienced Research Data Analyst to support health economics and health services research projects led by faculty in the Department of Health Policy and Management. The Research Data Analyst will contribute to a range of policy-relevant projects examining the health of older adults, mental health and substance use, value in the Medicare and Medicaid programs, health care affordability, and improving the value and quality of health care delivery. This is an ideal role for those interested in applying for a PhD in health economics or health services research, or those with significant experience and interest in applied academic research.

The Research Data Analyst will primarily be responsible for constructing analytic datasets from large administrative databases including health insurance claims, electronic health records (EHRs), employment records, and population survey data. The position would involve developing analytic datasets, conducting data management and quality assessment, and applying statistical and econometric methods to support faculty-led research. In addition, the analyst may also work with more unstructured data sources such as clinical notes or business ownership records. Candidates with experience implementing econometric research designs—including instrumental variables and difference-in-differences—as well as regression modeling are especially encouraged to apply. The position provides opportunities to contribute intellectually to research projects and, when contributions warrant, to serve as a coauthor on resulting manuscripts.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

  • Collect data and generate reports and models.
  • Run models, analyze model results, and prepare reports on the analysis.
  • Conduct analyses in support of the assigned research project or study.
  • Conduct statistical analyses using standard and statistical software packages.
  • Design and prepare tables to illustrate analytic findings.
  • Manage or contribute to entry of data in the assigned database.
  • May engage in other research related responsibilities.
  • Other duties as assigned.

In addition to the duties described above

  • Develop and maintain analytic datasets from large administrative data sources such as health insurance claims data or electronic health record (EHR) data.
  • Perform advanced data management and data linkage, including cleaning and integrating disparate datasets, fuzzy matching of individuals or organizations, geocoding of addresses.
  • Conduct data quality assessments and exploratory analyses using descriptive statistics, visualizations, and other diagnostic methods.
  • Implement statistical and econometric analyses under faculty guidance, including regression and quasi-experimental research designs such as instrumental variables and difference-in-differences.
  • Contribute to research products and dissemination, including preparing analytic results, tables, figures, documentation for presentations and manuscripts; analysts who make substantial intellectual contributions may have opportunities for co-authorship.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in a related field.
  • Three years of related experience.
  • Additional education may substitute for required experience to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAS/SQL.
  • Stata or R.

Technical Skills & Expected Level Of Proficiency

  • Data Management and Analysis - Developing
  • Data Pipeline Architecture & ETL/ELT Development - Developing
  • Data Visualization - Developing
  • Programming Languages - Developing
  • Reproducible Research Practices - Developing
  • Research Methodology - Developing
  • Statistical Modeling - Developing
  • Statistical Programming - Developing

The core technical skills listed are most essential; additional technical skills may be required based on specific division or department needs.

Hybrid - Utah

Who is Comagine Health?

Comagine Health is a national, mission-driven nonprofit organization dedicated to improving health and creating a better health care system. For more than 50 years, we have partnered with health care providers, government agencies, health plans, and communities to improve care delivery and health outcomes.

Our work spans quality improvement, care management, research and evaluation, and data solutions. At Comagine Health, our employees have the opportunity to do meaningful work that helps people and communities flourish.

About The Role

Comagine Health is seeking a Healthcare Data Analyst I to join a multidisciplinary team of professionals working to improve health care in our communities.

In this role, you will support the collection, analysis, display, and interpretation of data to help inform team decisions and advance project goals. Your work will help project teams use data effectively as they develop and implement initiatives designed to improve health care and health outcomes.

This is an opportunity to apply and develop your analytical skills in a collaborative, mission-driven environment where data and insights help support meaningful improvements in health care.

What You’ll DoData Analysis & Interpretation

  • Analyze information obtained from a variety of sources.
  • Conduct thoughtful and methodologically sound analyses and evaluations of data.
  • Interpret data and provide meaningful insights to internal and external clients and stakeholders.

  • Help translate data into useful information that supports project goals and health care improvement initiatives.

Project & Team Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with project teams to ensure analytic products meet the needs of internal and external customers.

  • Prior work experience in health care.

descriptionHtml:
Description

About Us

At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst II to own recurring reporting and ad hoc analysis for an assigned manufacturer program or internal domain, becoming the person who knows that program's enrollment funnel, payer quirks, fulfillment path, and data sources deeply. This position plays a key role in supporting the Data & Analytics department and reports to the Manager, Analytics & Reporting, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards.

Depth in one program or domain beats a thin layer across many, especially in the first year. This role has no direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own one manufacturer program or internal domain deeply: its enrollment funnel, payer quirks, fulfillment path, and where its data comes from and lives.
  • Own recurring reporting that goes out on a schedule: weekly and monthly program reporting plus support for daily feeds, reviewing numbers before they leave and raising unexplained changes rather than shipping them.
  • Answer questions with a deadline attached by tracing them through claim adjudication, prior authorization status, prescription state changes, and fulfillment records, returning an answer plus your confidence in it.
  • Write down metric definitions when you settle a disagreement for your program, keep reporting consistent with them, and document them where the next person will find them.
  • Build dashboards in Looker, our primary BI platform (Metabase also in use, migrating off Domo), including client-facing Looker work that is still being stood up, and raise a dbt model request when logic belongs in the warehouse rather than in a dashboard tile.
  • Handle PHI carefully as a daily practice: know what your access covers, use the minimum you need, and ask before moving patient-level data anywhere new.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree preferred; not required. We evaluate demonstrated capability rather than credentials.
  • Licensure/Certification: Not applicable.
  • Experience: Typically 2 to 4 years of experience in data analysis. This band is guidance rather than a gate.
  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
    • Can take a vague question, sharpen it into something answerable, and come back with the answer and its caveats without needing to be checked on daily.
    • Validates work: counts rows, compares against a second source, and asks why a total does not tie before anyone else has to ask.
    • Writes and speaks plainly about what you found, so someone in an account or operations role can read your summary and act on it.
    • Comfortable being told a number is wrong: finds out why and says so rather than quietly patching it, and is curious about how the healthcare and pharmacy operation actually works.
    • A couple of years of analysis work where SQL was the main tool: you can write more than a simple join, including window functions and careful aggregation, and you take the time to figure out grain before writing anything.
    • Demonstrated application of the above Qualification
    • Nice to have: pharmacy, claims, or payer data experience (prior authorizations, adjudication, benefit verification, NDCs, dispensing workflows); dbt experience contributing transformation logic rather than only reading from it; Looker or LookML exposure; Snowflake (we are mid-migration from PostgreSQL); Python for analysis that does not fit in SQL; or experience producing work that went to an external client.
Work Environment

  • Location: Columbus, OH or Remote (US).
  • Schedule: Full-time; standard business hours.
  • May require flexibility around reporting deadlines tied to weekly, monthly, and daily program feeds.
  • Regular collaboration with account and operations teams and manufacturer program contacts, plus time on the distribution center floor and with the call center to understand the operation firsthand.

Key Essential Functions

  • Must be able to work at a computer for extended periods
  • Must be able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, with account and operations stakeholders
  • Must be able to handle and access data in compliance with HIPAA and PHI handling requirements
  • Must be able to periodically visit the distribution center and call center to observe operations firsthand

Employment Classification

Status: Full-time

FLSA: Exempt

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you do not meet every requirement but still feel you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply!

Position Summary

We are seeking a Data Analyst II to own recurring reporting and ad hoc analysis for an assigned manufacturer program or internal domain, becoming the person who knows that program's enrollment funnel, payer quirks, fulfillment path, and data sources deeply. This position plays a key role in supporting the Data & Analytics department and reports to the Manager, Analytics & Reporting, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards.

Depth in one program or domain beats a thin layer across many, especially in the first year. This role has no direct reports.

Key Responsibilities



- Own one manufacturer program or internal domain deeply: its enrollment funnel, payer quirks, fulfillment path, and where its data comes from and lives.
- Own recurring reporting that goes out on a schedule: weekly and monthly program reporting plus support for daily feeds, reviewing numbers before they leave and raising unexplained changes rather than shipping them.
- Answer questions with a deadline attached by tracing them through claim adjudication, prior authorization status, prescription state changes, and fulfillment records, returning an answer plus your confidence in it.
- Write down metric definitions when you settle a disagreement for your program, keep reporting consistent with them, and document them where the next person will find them.
- Build dashboards in Looker, our primary BI platform (Metabase also in use, migrating off Domo), including client-facing Looker work that is still being stood up, and raise a dbt model request when logic belongs in the warehouse rather than in a dashboard tile.
- Handle PHI carefully as a daily practice: know what your access covers, use the minimum you need, and ask before moving patient-level data anywhere new.

Qualifications



- Education: Bachelor's degree preferred; not required. We evaluate demonstrated capability rather than credentials.
- Licensure/Certification: Not applicable.
- Experience: Typically 2 to 4 years of experience in data analysis. This band is guidance rather than a gate.
- Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

- Can take a vague question, sharpen it into something answerable, and come back with the answer and its caveats without needing to be checked on daily.
- Validates work: counts rows, compares against a second source, and asks why a total does not tie before anyone else has to ask.
- Writes and speaks plainly about what you found, so someone in an account or operations role can read your summary and act on it.
- Comfortable being told a number is wrong: finds out why and says so rather than quietly patching it, and is curious about how the healthcare and pharmacy operation actually works.
- A couple of years of analysis work where SQL was the main tool: you can write more than a simple join, including window functions and careful aggregation, and you take the time to figure out grain before writing anything.
- Demonstrated application of the above Qualification
- Nice to have: pharmacy, claims, or payer data experience (prior authorizations, adjudication, benefit verification, NDCs, dispensing workflows); dbt experience contributing transformation logic rather than only reading from it; Looker or LookML exposure; Snowflake (we are mid-migration from PostgreSQL); Python for analysis that does not fit in SQL; or experience producing work that went to an external client.
Work Environment



- Location: Columbus, OH or Remote (US).
- Schedule: Full-time; standard business hours.
- May require flexibility around reporting deadlines tied to weekly, monthly, and daily program feeds.
- Regular collaboration with account and operations teams and manufacturer program contacts, plus time on the distribution center floor and with the call center to understand the operation firsthand.

Key Essential Functions



- Must be able to work at a computer for extended periods
- Must be able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, with account and operations stakeholders

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

Connecting People. Uniting the World. There’s never been a more exciting time to join United Airlines! As a global company that operates in hundreds of locations around the world — with millions of customers and tens of thousands of employees — we have a unique responsibility to uplift and provide opportunities in the places where we work, live and fly.

We’re on a path to becoming the best airline in aviation history. Join our Cybersecurity and Digital Risk (CDR) team to help lead the industry in cyber safety, security and resilience. United's CDR team plays a critical role in protecting our operations by enabling secure and resilient systems, managing threats and vulnerabilities, and ensuring swift response and recovery. Our mission is to seamlessly embed cybersecurity and digital risk management into every aspect of our business. We help drive progress and growth through trusted digital solutions, safeguarding assets and empowering our team, all while promoting a cyber-safe and secure environment that supports resilient airline operations.

United offers a competitive benefits package aimed at keeping you happy, healthy, and well-traveled. From employee-run "Business Resource Group" communities to world-class benefits like parental leave, 401(k), and privileges like space-available travel, United is truly a one-of-a-kind place to work. Are you ready to travel the world and help us keep our airline cyber safe? Apply today!

Job Overview And Responsibilities

The Analyst – Fraud Data provides fraud business intelligence, analysis and storytelling that explains how fraud affects customers, operations, revenue and enterprise risk. This role integrates operational data on fraud detected, prevented and realized to quantify exposure, control outcomes, customer friction and financial impact. The Analyst uses approved artificial intelligence and automation tools to accelerate analysis, identify patterns, summarize findings, develop reporting content and improve the productivity and consistency of recurring workflows, with appropriate human validation and data-governance controls. The individual in this position develops clear narratives, dashboards and executive insights that connect fraud trends to business priorities and support informed decisions across the enterprise.

Fraud Business Impact Intelligence

  • Integrate fraud detected, prevented and realized-loss data to explain the scale, drivers and business implications of fraud across products, channels and customer journeys

Executive Storytelling & Insights

  • Translate complex operational and analytical findings into clear narratives, presentations and recommendations tailored to senior leaders and business stakeholders; use approved AI tools to accelerate synthesis, drafting and audience-specific communication with human review

Operational Performance Reporting

  • Develop and maintain dashboards and scorecards covering fraud volumes, prevented loss, realized loss, recovery, customer friction, operational workload and control outcomes; automate recurring data preparation, quality checks and reporting workflows where appropriate

Trend & Root-Cause Analysis

  • Analyze shifts in fraud activity and operational results to identify material trends, root causes, emerging risks and changes in business exposure; use approved AI-assisted methods to accelerate exploration, pattern identification and summarization

Financial & Customer Impact Measurement

  • Quantify the revenue, loss, cost, customer and operational effects of fraud and fraud controls, including tradeoffs between risk reduction and customer experience

Data Quality, Reporting Governance & Responsible AI

  • Establish consistent definitions, validation checks, documentation and reconciliation practices for fraud performance metrics, reporting datasets and AI-assisted outputs; protect sensitive data and validate accuracy, bias and business context

Cross-Functional Business Partnership

  • Partner with Fraud Strategy, Operations, Loyalty,
  • Digital Technology, Customer Insights, Sales and other teams to align metrics, interpret results and turn insights into action

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree. with preference for Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Information Systems or a related quantitative or business field; equivalent experience accepted
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in fraud analytics, business intelligence, operational analytics, financial analysis, risk analytics, ECDLP or a related discipline
  • Demonstrated ability to quantify business impact, create clear data visualizations and translate analytical findings into concise recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to use approved generative AI and automation tools to improve analytical, reporting and documentation productivity while validating outputs
  • SQL proficiency and experience reconciling, analyzing and interpreting large operational datasets
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Master's degree
  • Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Finance, Economics or a related discipline
  • Developing executive-ready reporting, presentations and narratives for senior business stakeholders
  • Experience with fraud, retail, e-commerce, airline, financial services or another high-volume customer environment
  • Knowledge of fraud operations, loss prevention, customer experience metrics, financial measurement or operational performance management; experience with enterprise AI assistants, natural-language analytics or workflow automation
  • Tableau, Power BI, Looker or comparable visualization and reporting platform experience

Post Expiration 11/18/2026

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

descriptionHtml:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

Candidate Verification Step: As part of our application process, candidates are asked to complete a brief verification exercise. This will involves In place of a cover letter, please complete a short data task. Download donors.csv and gifts.csv from https://github.com/neilcuz/recruitment and use any tool you like (SQL, Python, R or similar) to answer the three multiple-choice questions there. It should take less time than writing a traditional cover letter. Upload a Word document (.docx) in the cover letter field containing only your answers, one per line, in this format:

  • Q1: A
  • Q2: B
  • Q3: C

Why we’re asking: This step helps us confirm that every applicant is a real person and keeps the selection process fair for all candidates. It is not part of your skills assessment, and it will take only a few minutes.

The Purpose of the Role

The External Relations (ER) department was created in February 2020 and is comprised of 3 main but complementary functional areas: Private fundraising, Communications and Advocacy. The ER department is at the beginning stages of creating a radical and ambitious global strategy that will enhance IRC’s ability to ‘punch above its weight’ in private income, advocacy, and brand awareness. The main objective of the department is to enable this organization of more than 12,000 staff to have the resources needed to continue serving 18 million people worldwide in places affected by war and disaster, shape the humanitarian sector by influencing key policies and reforms, and build and grow IRC’s reputation.

We are looking for an experienced and highly analytical Senior Data Analyst to join our team, with a primary focus on supporting our Philanthropy and High Value fundraising teams. As a Senior Analyst within our Global Analytics team, you will play a pivotal role in supporting and driving data-driven insights for our fundraising efforts across the globe.

You will leverage your expertise in data analysis, statistical modeling, and reporting to guide the strategic decisions of our fundraising initiatives, ensuring that we continue to meet and exceed our goals. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams, including fundraising, marketing, and finance, to deliver actionable insights that enhance donor engagement and maximize fundraising outcomes.

Major Responsibilities

  • Data Analysis & Reporting:Analyze and interpret large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that inform global fundraising strategies.Create and maintain dashboards, visualizations, and reports to track fundraising performance and donor engagement metrics.Develop and deliver regular performance reports to key stakeholders, highlighting actionable insights and areas of opportunity for growth.Develop comprehensive data models and reports for external benchmarking to assess performance against peers and identify opportunities for new investments.
  • Strategic Insights & Recommendations:Collaborate with senior leadership to translate analytical findings into strategic recommendations for improving fundraising effectiveness.Provide insights that influence global fundraising campaigns, donor retention strategies, and personalized donor experiences.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration:Act as the main analytics partner to the Philanthropy and High Value teams, building trusted relationships, understanding their priorities and building strong business knowledge of how these teams operate.Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., fundraising, marketing, and finance) to ensure data-driven decisions are integrated into the global strategy.Present findings to senior management, explaining complex data insights in a clear and actionable manner.
  • Process Improvement & Innovation:Identify opportunities to enhance the data collection and reporting processes, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and alignment with global goals.Keep abreast of industry trends and emerging analytics tools, and bring innovative ideas for improving the team’s capabilities.Acting as a technical leader, collaborate with fellow Analytics colleagues to ensure best practices in coding, statistics, and general analysis.
  • Work with integrity and accountability to the “IRC Way” – IRC Global Standards for Professional Conduct.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Experience

Demonstrated Skills and Competencies:

  • 3+ years working in the field of data analytics.
  • Proven experience with advanced data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI) and data visualization platforms.
  • Demonstrable experience planning and executing complex analytics projects across multiple stakeholders.

Skills & Competencies

  • More than two years of professional experience with SQL and relational databases.
  • Knowledge of dimensional modeling and experience with workflow orchestration tools.
  • Familiarity with PowerBI, Tableau, Looker, or other business intelligence tools.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actionable insights.

Soft Skills

  • Curiosity and willingness to explore complex and ambiguous problems and deliver actionable insights through both quantitative and qualitative data analysis.
  • Desire to work in a multi-cultural environment and collaborate with people from different backgrounds and experiences, with a partner-first approach to interacting with stakeholders.
  • Strong data visualization and communication skills: ability to “tell a story” with numbers in a variety of formats: PowerPoints, dashboards, memos, and presentations.
  • Strong attention to detail & commitment to a high standard of work product.

Nice-to-Haves / Areas You Will Grow

  • Knowledge of philanthropy, major gifts, or nonprofit fundraising analytics.
  • Experience with Databricks and dbt.
  • Experience with web analytics and behavioral data, and relevant tooling like Heap or Amplitude.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce or similar CRM technology.

Working Environment

  • Standard office working environment.
  • Some international travel.
  • This role may require working remotely full or part time and part time remote employees may be required to share workspace.

This is a remote position open to internal and external candidates located in the United Kingdom or the United States. Successful candidates must have the right to work in these counties, be of residence and will be employed on a local employment contract in accordance with local salary scales and employment regulations.

Compensation: (US Pay Rate: $85,000 - $100,000/yr; UK Pay Rate £65,000/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Standard Responsibilities

Foster ongoing learning, honest dialogue and reflection to strengthen safeguarding and to promote IRC values and adherence to IRC policies

Standard Job Requirements

The IRC and IRC workers must adhere to the values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. These are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Beneficiary Protection from Exploitation and Abuse, Child Safeguarding, Anti Workplace Harassment, Fiscal Integrity, and Anti-Retaliation.

Related Standard Content

IRC strives to build a diverse and inclusive team at all levels who as individuals, and as a group, embody our culture statement creating a working environment characterized by critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity for us to achieve our aspirations as a team and deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Recruitment Process

The process for this role will be as follows

  • Screening call online
  • First round panel interview online – including assessment / test
  • Second round panel interview – online – including presentation task
  • Final role and expectations alignment call with Senior Director, online

Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Cookies: https://careers.rescue.org/us/en/cookiesettings

Equal Opportunity Employer: IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Title: Data Analyst II, Medicaid Fraud Control Unit

State Role Title: Data Analyst

Hiring Range: $79,920 - $88,800

Pay Band: UG

Agency: Attorney General & Dept of Law

Location: Office of the Attorney General

Agency Website: https://www.oag.state.va.us/

Recruitment Type: General Public - G

Job Duties

: The position primarily accesses, analyzes, and presents data extracted from the Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS) focusing on providing critical support for criminal and civil investigations related to Medicaid Fraud using available software including SQL, SAS, visualization software and Microsoft Office programs. This position is in our Richmond, Virginia office. Some overnight travel is required.

Minimum Qualifications

Working knowledge of SQL, SQL/SAS, Tableau and Teradata.

Applicants must have the ability to extract and analyze datasets and have working knowledge of database applications and database structures.

Applicants must be able to write ad-hoc queries for data extraction and analysis.

The candidate must be able to validate and interpret data and communicate results.

Candidates should have a demonstrated ability to work on several projects simultaneously within a multi-team environment.

Candidates must have excellent analytical and planning skills.

Candidates must be detail-oriented with a high sense of accountability and integrity. Candidate must be skilled in Microsoft Office Suite products.

Any suitable combination of education, training, or experience is acceptable.

A criminal background check will be completed on successful candidate.

Additional Considerations

Demonstrated programming or analysis experience with health claims data is preferred.

BS/BA in data analytics, economics, statistics, engineering, mathematical sciences, accounting, computer science and two years analysis experience or MS/MA and one year analysis experience.

Special Instructions

You will be provided a confirmation of receipt when your application and/or résumé is submitted successfully. Please refer to “Your Application” in your account to check the status of your application for this position.

Kindly utilize the Virginia Jobs website (https://www.jobs.virginia.gov) to submit your application. Applications sent to the Recruitment email address will not be reviewed for the hiring process. We do not entertain phone calls or emails inquiring about application status; instead, please login to the PageUp/RMS system for updates on your application's status.

Contact Information

Name: OAG Recruitment

Phone: 804-786-2071

Email: recruitment@oag.state.va.us

In support of the Commonwealth’s commitment to inclusion, we are encouraging individuals with disabilities to apply through the Commonwealth Alternative Hiring Process. To be considered for this opportunity, applicants will need to provide their AHP Letter (formerly COD) provided by the Department for Aging & Rehabilitative Services (DARS), or the Department for the Blind & Vision Impaired (DBVI). Requesting an AHP Letter can be found at AHP Letter or by calling DARS at 800-552-5019.

Note: Applicants who received a Certificate of Disability from DARS or DBVI dated between April 1, 2022- February 29, 2024, can still use that COD as applicable documentation for the Alternative Hiring Process.
