descriptionHtml:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Senior Data Analyst

About Your Role

Fiserv is uniquely positioned at the center of global commerce and financial services, powering the movement of money and information across an unmatched network of financial institutions, merchants, and consumers. With billions of transactions processed annually and deep integration across payment rails, banking systems, and merchant ecosystems, Fiserv has built a proprietary data advantage that no competitor can replicate—enabling insights across the full lifecycle of every transaction.

Within Data Commerce Solutions, we are building a new class of data intelligence products—spanning issuing, banking and acquiring domains—that translate Fiserv’s scale and connectivity into tangible client outcomes.

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst within our Data Architecture team — turning Fiserv’s unmatched data into scalable, privacy-safe, and commercially differentiated data products that deliver measurable value to clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze payment and banking transactions across multiple data sources, identify patterns and build insights for data commercialization.
  • Analyze 3 to 5 years historic transaction data on banking, digital banking, check data, external data, payments to create macro and micro level stats.
  • Support end-to-end analytics projects including requirements development, exploratory data analysis, data wrangling and data quality checks on final delivery to the client.
  • Assist in the communication of insights and the implementation of solutions across the
  • undefined

Experience You’ll Need To Have

  • 7+ years of experience in payments industry with strong knowledge of Core banking, ACH, Wire, Check or Card processing.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Computing language such as Python, preferably PySpark.
  • Strong working knowledge of data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake & Azure  or NoSQL Databases
  • Experience with reference data management tools and building data dictionaries
  • Business requirements analysis and Ability to work in a highly collaborative team environment with multiple stakeholders including business, product development, architecture, and engineering teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.

Experience That Would Be Great To Have

  • Knowledge of Banking transactions, Digital Payments, BillPay transaction data, ACH Payments, Wire payments, Card payment and/or Check Payment transactions.
  • Proficiency with statistical data analysis and pattern recognition techniques (e.g., SVM, regression, classification, clustering, time series).
  • Experience with entity resolution involving business or consumer.

How You’ll Work

  • This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

Travel

  • Approximately 10% travel off-site or to other office locations is expected.

Sponsorship

  • You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered.

Salary Range

$100,000.00 - $165,600.00

These pay ranges apply to employees in New Jersey and New York. Pay ranges for employees in other states may differ.

It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran.

For incentive eligible associates, the successful candidate is eligible for an annual incentive opportunity which may be delivered as a mix of cash bonus and equity awards in the Company’s sole discretion.

  • Apply using your legal name
  • Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
Position Summary...Hello there! Are you someone who thrives on solving complex problems and loves to dive deep into data? If so, we've got an exciting opportunity for you at Walmart, the world's largest retailer. We're on the hunt for a Senior Data Analyst who's ready to take on meaningful challenges and make a real impact.

What you'll do...This role is a part of the Decision Sciences, Delivery Data & Analytics. We are a BI team that will support the ecommerce transportation’s daily operations. You will help our users navigate through billions of data so they can take the best decision in a timely manner. You will be working with operations and finance and provide them with the insights they need. You will learn a lot about the business and upgrade your tech skills in this role.

You’ll make an impact from the first day if you have:

  • Excellent SQL Skills. Capability to manipulate data from multiple tables while keeping the data integrity (4-6 years)
  • Creativity with a User Experience foundation to develop impactful Tableau Dashboards (2-3 years)
  • Business Operations Fluency. Capability to understand and root cause a business problem. A Supply Chain background, preferably with Last Mile Delivery or Parcel Deliveries experience.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally

Responsibilities:

  • Work with large, messy, disparate datasets and conduct ad-hoc analyses to quickly inform critical business decisions. Create ETLs or processes that pull data from multiple places and centralize it in one table.
  • Develop data visualization to monitor and quantify the impact of changes and unique business challenges.
  • Engage with team members and cross-functional teams on a periodic basis and establish credibility. Analyze stakeholder needs and partner with them to share relevant information. This includes partnering with Operations, Finance and Product teams on data accuracy, completeness and latency across multiple operations and systems
  • Leverage scripting languages (Python preferred) to automate activities made for reporting (Screenshots, metrics prioritization and outlier recognition)
  • Document your processes and share your knowledge with your peers. Mentor your peers as you become a Subject Matter Expert.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Analytics, Mathematics, Arts, Finance or related field and 2 years' experience in data analysis, data science, statistics, or related field. Option 2: Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Technology or related field. Option 3: 4 years' experience in data analysis, data science, statistics, or related field.
  • Advanced SQL and Tableau user

Preferred

  • Advanced experience with SQL and Tableau
  • Experience with ecommerce operations or parcel carrier operations
  • Experience with Python or other scripting language.
  • Experience with data manipulation tools such as Knime, Alteryx, R, Tableau Prep etc.

At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see https://one.walmart.com/notices. Position Summary

The Data Analyst - Safety will manage, organize, analyze, and report on operational and safety data received from Waymo and other TAS accounts. This position will help ensure that client data is accurate, secure, accessible, and converted into useful insights for the TAS Safety team.

The Data Analyst will collaborate with Safety, Operations, Account Management, and other stakeholders to identify trends, monitor performance, support investigations, and improve safety outcomes. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, comfortable working with large and complex datasets, and able to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Transdev Is Proud To Offer

  • Competitive compensation package of minimum $60,320 – maximum $70,720

Benefits Include

  • Vacation: minimum of two (2) weeks
  • Sick days: 5 days
  • Holidays: 12 days; 8 standard and 4 floating
  • Other standard benefits: 401(k) retirement plan, medical, dental and vision, life insurance, short-term disability, voluntary long-term disability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage safety and operational data received from Waymo and other TAS accounts.
  • Collect, clean, validate, standardize, and maintain data from multiple client systems and sources.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, reports, and recurring performance summaries.
  • Monitor safety trends, incidents, leading indicators, and key performance metrics.
  • Identify data inconsistencies, missing information, unusual patterns, and emerging areas of risk.
  • Support incident investigations and root-cause analyses by providing accurate and timely data.
  • Produce account-specific reporting while maintaining consistent definitions and standards across the TAS organization.
  • Partner with Safety and Operations leaders to define reporting requirements and performance measures.
  • Translate complex data into clear findings, visualizations, and recommendations.
  • Automate recurring reports and improve data-management processes where practical.
  • Maintain documentation for data sources, definitions, calculations, reporting procedures, and quality-control practices.
  • Protect confidential client, employee, operational, and safety information in accordance with company policies and contractual requirements.
  • Respond to approved requests for data and analysis within established timelines.
  • Assist with client reviews, internal audits, compliance reporting, and leadership presentations.
  • Perform additional data analysis and safety-support responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, business, safety, or a related field - or equivalent professional experience.

  • Experience using data-visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.

  • Ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and reporting requirements.
  • Sound judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience analyzing vehicle, fleet, autonomous-vehicle, transportation, or workplace-safety data.

  • Experience automating dashboards, reports, or data-quality checks.
  • Familiarity with data governance, privacy, access controls, and client-specific reporting requirements.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.

Core Competencies

  • Data accuracy and quality control
  • Analytical and critical thinking
  • Safety and risk awareness
  • Confidentiality and professional judgment
  • Clear written and verbal communication
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Process improvement
  • Client service
  • Accountability and reliability

Measures of Success

Success In This Role May Be Measured By

  • Accuracy and completeness of safety and account data.
  • Timeliness of dashboards and recurring reports.
  • Reduction in manual reporting work and data errors.
  • Quality and usefulness of insights provided to Safety and Operations leaders.
  • Consistency of definitions and reporting standards across TAS accounts.
  • Responsiveness to investigations, audits, and approved client requests.
  • Compliance with data-security and confidentiality requirements.
  • Demonstrated contribution to improved safety performance and risk reduction.

Working Conditions

  • Primarily office-based or remote work involving extended periods at a computer.

Position Summary

As a member of our Analytics team, you will play a crucial role in driving the development of creative solutions and analytic insights for a variety of stakeholders. While in this role, you will have the opportunity to learn from others within the Data Intelligence organization, help others on their analytical journey, expand your technical skillset, and will be a key resource creating innovative solutions needed for end users throughout the organization.

This role is located on-site in Green Bay, working in office Monday - Thursday and optional remote day on Fridays as business needs allow.

Job Responsibilities

Analytical Ability:

  • Experienced analytics resource providing support and direction to others on the analytics team on varying tasks and projects:
    • Data acquisition & cleansing
    • Conducting thorough analysis, exploring nuances, and considering inputs and outputs from various perspectives
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define analytical requirements, identify key metrics, and develop analytical solutions to address business challenges.
    • Ticket management & completion
    • Understanding of business processes, data structures, and how to leverage these things to create meaningful data-driven insights
    • Development of analytical processes to meet business needs while ensuring accuracy & maintenance of company data standards and expectations
  • Develops and maintains dashboards, reports, and data visualizations to communicate analytical findings and insights to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Completing business asks for analytical deep-dives and exploratory analytics.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools, data

Resource Development:

  • Serves as a contributor and innovator for the Data Analytics organization
    • Brings innovative concepts and approaches to work to the team.
    • Brings business acumen and technical expertise to the team to understand the needs of the stakeholders and help form solutions for end users
    • Works to develop personal skills, both technical and interpersonal, to foster a collaborative environment.
    • Stays current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data analysis space to provide recommendations to continuously improve and introduce capabilities to drive scale and innovation.
Collaboration:

  • Must possess the ability to communicate and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization to build rapport and establish credibility
    • Will work with more senior team members to develop personal skillset and help improve how tasks are completed in various areas of the organization.
    • Will help mentor and train new team members on business processes, tooling, and company standards for coding & solution creation
Execution:

  • The responsibilities this individual will have include:
    • Completing and iterating on analytics for stakeholders within the product lines in a manner that meet the needs of the end user while ensuring accuracy & data standards
    • Continual learning on various data analysis methods, data visualization development, & other skills to apply to various software platforms
    • Take direction from more senior team members to help advance analytical projects
    • Guiding new members of the team through documentation and helping guide the tasks they perform
    • Presenting the results of analyses to internal and external stakeholders at varying levels of organizations
  • Proficient analytical abilities in SQL, data visualization tools, & data storytelling

Provides expertise in data management, quality assurance, analysis and reporting. Establishes data accuracy and validity derived from a variety of systems.   • functional documentation
  • iterative & incremental development
  • organizational skills
  • planning

  • workflow development & documentation

The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) appreciates your interest in employment at our growing institution. We want your application process to go smoothly and quickly. Final applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment.

If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775) 784-1495 or jobs@unr.edu. For UNR Med professional job postings, please contact the Office of Professional Recruitment at (775) 784-6778.

Job Description

The University of Nevada, School of Medicine is recruiting for a Patient Safety Data Analyst. This position is is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data collection, reporting, analytics, and visualization solutions for the Rural Patient Safety Organization. The position works with PSO leadership, participating healthcare organizations, data stewards, and technology partners to convert patient safety data into accurate, understandable, and actionable information. The Analyst supports secure patient safety reporting, data quality, data modeling, metric development, dashboard creation, regulatory submissions, and documentation of data processes. The position develops analytical products that support organizational learning, patient safety improvement, rural healthcare benchmarking, and strategic decision-making.

The Analyst also supports the evaluation, configuration, testing, and ongoing operation of the PSO’s reporting and analytics environment. The position exercises independent judgment while handling confidential and

sensitive healthcare information and must consistently follow applicable data-governance, security, and Patient Safety Work Product requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Designs and develops reports, dashboards, scorecards, data visualizations, and other business intelligence solutions that support patient safety, organizational learning, and healthcare quality improvement.
  • Translates organizational and participating-provider information needs into reporting requirements, analytical products, and performance measures.
  • Evaluates patient safety reports, dashboards, datasets, and analytical products to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and appropriate interpretation.
  • Develops and performs data validation, reconciliation, quality-control, and user-acceptance testing.
  • Supports implementation, configuration, testing, maintenance, and improvement of the PSO’s patient safety data collection and reporting environment.
  • Creates user guides, data dictionaries, metric specifications, workflow documentation, report instructions, and other technical resources.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in statistics, business administration, business analytics, Information Systems or related field and two years of related work experience; OR
  • Master’s Degree in statistics, business administration, business analytics, Information Systems or related field and one year of related work experience.

Related Experience

  • Experience creating business intelligence reports, dashboards, scorecards, or comparable analytical products and/or reports.
  • Experience with AHRQ Common Formats or similar standardized healthcare reporting specifications.
  • Experience communicating analytical findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Certification or licensures

Nevada driver’s license

Schedule and Travel

Will be required to travel extensively across the state to meet rural hospital leaders and stakeholders. Occasional out of state travel for conferences

Compensation Grade

Administrative Faculty – B

To view the salary schedule for this position, please visit: Salary Schedules and select Administrative Faculty by Grade. Salary is competitive and commensurate with related education and experience.

Remarkable Retirement

Our retirement plan is beyond compare. Your 19.25% contribution is generously matched by the University. With the faculty retirement plan, you are 100% vested your first day. Sit back and watch your retirement dollars grow! All permanent employees on an annual “A” or “B” contract who are employed at least 50% full-time are eligible to participate in the NSHE retirement program.

Perks of working at UNR

  • Health insurance options including dental and vision – Health Insurance
  • Generous annual, sick leave, life insurance, and long-term disability – Faculty Benefits
  • E. L. Wiegand Fitness Center offers annual or semester memberships and spouse/domestic partner membership options. E.L. Wiegand Fitness Center
  • Reno is proud to be a University town! Many local businesses offer discounts to WolfCard holders
  • Mountain EAP supports employees (and eligible dependents) through life’s difficult moments. Mountain EAP is located in Reno and specializes in counseling and advising services for personal or interpersonal issues.
  • Faculty Senate is the principal representing body for faculty. Its membership includes representatives from each academic and administrative major unit of the University. Faculty Senate
  • No state income tax!

Grants-in-aid for Faculty Employees

The University is proud to provide a reduced-rate tuition benefit to faculty and qualified dependents. Faculty can take up to six credits per semester at a reduced rate. Dependents of faculty have unlimited credits, but in order to be eligible children must be unmarried and under the age of 24 and must receive at least 50% of their financial support from the employee and/or employee’s spouse or domestic partner. Faculty Grant-in-Aid.

Faculty Dual Career Assistance Program

The University of Nevada, Reno recognizes the importance of addressing dual-career couples’ professional needs. We offer a dual career assistance program to newly hired faculty spouses/partners that provides resources and assists them to identify career opportunities in Northern Nevada. Dual Career Assistance Program

University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine (UNR Med)

For over 50 years the University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine (UNR Med) has trained physicians who are leading the way to 'A Healthy Nevada', nation, and world. Community-based and research-intensive, UNR Med is committed to our four-part mission of education, research, clinical service, and diversity. We show this commitment through our demonstrated core values: people are our strength, we innovate and improve, we serve with integrity, and we success with trust and respect.

The University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine is an inclusive and engaged community. We recognize that diverse faculty and leaders add value to the educational experience and promote excellence in our teaching, patient care, and research missions. We seek applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences who will contribute to our mission and uphold our core values.

Our mission has guided our growth in graduating the next generation of primary and specialty care physicians and medical researchers while maintaining personalized instruction. The School of Medicine has statewide outreach with a local touch providing patient care, health services, and training physicians in Reno, Nevada and in the state’s rural communities. We are expanding provider education to train medical specialists as Medical Doctors as well as Speech Pathologists and Physician Assistants. We are actively expanding technologically-advanced infrastructure to keep pace with our world-class research to meet the needs of students, patients, and researchers. We seek to create an environment that serves all who enter our doors, from the physicians who teach our learners to our employees, patients, and students.

Exempt

Yes

Full-Time Equivalent

100.0%

Required Attachment(s)

Please note, once you submit your application the only attachment/s viewable to you will be the attachment/s to the resume/CV section of the application. Any additional required attachment/s to the cover letter, references, additional documents sections of the application, will not be viewable to you after you submit your application. All uploaded attachment/s will be on the application for the committee to review. To request updates to attachments, prior to the committee review of applications, please contact the candidate helpdesk at jobs@unr.edu.

Please attach the following attachments to your application

  • Cover letter
  • Resume
  • Contact information for three professional references

This posting is open until filled

Qualified individuals are encouraged to apply immediately. This search will close without notice when a sufficient number of applications are received or a hiring decision has been made.

Posting Close Date

Note to Applicant

A background check will be conducted on the candidate(s) selected for hire.

HR will attempt to verify academic credentials upon receipt of hiring documents. If the academic credentials cannot be verified, HR will notify the faculty member that an official transcript of their highest degree must be submitted within thirty days of the faculty member’s first day of employment.

References will be contacted at the appropriate phase of the recruitment process.

Applicants hired on a federal contract may be subject to E-Verify.

As part of the hiring process, applicants for positions in the Nevada System of Higher Education may be required to demonstrate the ability to perform job-related tasks.

For positions that require driving, evidence of a valid driver's license will be required at the time of employment and as a condition of continued employment.

Schedules are subject to change based on organizational needs.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

These are functions a qualified incumbent or applicant must be able to perform with or without reasonable accommodation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute ETL processes to assess client datasets and prepare reliable, traceable data for analysis, reporting, and visualization.
  • Perform data analysis and compile technical reports and findings that explain trends, anomalies, assumptions, limitations, and recommended actions.
  • Lead assigned reporting and analytics projects independently, including planning, stakeholder coordination, testing, documentation, and delivery.
  • Develop thorough test plans and perform QA/QC to confirm the proper functioning of reports, calculations, dashboards, and data automation tools.
  • Create dashboards and visual reports that communicate key performance indicators and other business or regulatory information in an actionable format.
  • Collaborate with project managers, SMEs, data owners, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, resolve data issues, and communicate findings and status.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data quality, standardize methodologies, strengthen data lineage, automate recurring processes, and reduce manual effort.
  • Perform work in accordance with Campos EPC standards, client procedures, applicable security and confidentiality requirements, and established data governance practices.

Wildfire Mitigation Assignment Responsibilities

  • Support quarterly data and spatial reporting, AIR, WMP filings and tables, regulatory data requests, and other wildfire mitigation reporting requirements.
  • Gather, analyze, validate, and reconcile data supporting QDRs, AIR, WMP tables, effectiveness studies, narratives, and regulatory responses.
  • Investigate reporting changes, anomalies, conflicting values, missing information, and source-system discrepancies; coordinate resolution with data owners and program SMEs.
  • Apply statistical methods and diagnostic or predictive modeling, as appropriate, to identify trends, patterns, relationships, and anomalies.
  • Build and maintain interactive Power BI or Tableau dashboards and visual reports for wildfire mitigation performance and regulatory reporting.
  • Identify appropriate data sources and develop clear, defensible analyses and supporting information for wildfire mitigation data requests.
  • Validate data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, traceability, and alignment across regulatory deliverables.
  • Document data sources, metric definitions, calculation methodologies, assumptions, business rules, regulatory requirements, validation procedures, and data lineage.
  • Translate technical analyses into plain-language findings and recommendations for project managers, executives, business leaders, and regulatory stakeholders.

EDUCATION And/or EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Communications, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 2 to 5 years of relevant data analysis, reporting, data management, business intelligence, or comparable experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with data management and visualization and with independently leading reporting or analytics assignments.
  • Utility, wildfire mitigation, regulatory reporting, compliance, risk, asset management, or infrastructure program experience preferred.
  • Power BI Data Analyst or comparable analytics certification preferred

Skills & Abilities

  • SQL - Strong proficiency in database querying and analysis.
  • Python or R - Proficiency using at least one language for deeper data analysis, automation, or modeling.
  • Business Intelligence - Strong proficiency with Power BI; Tableau or comparable visualization experience may also be beneficial.
  • Cloud Data Tools - Hands-on experience with AWS data storage and analysis tools, including Amazon S3 and Amazon Redshift.
  • Excel - Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including analysis, reconciliation, data shaping, and quality review.
  • Statistics & Modeling - Working knowledge of statistics, hypothesis testing, data modeling, and diagnostic or predictive analytical methods.
  • Data Quality & Governance - Able to validate accuracy, completeness, consistency, and traceability and document methodologies, business rules, controls, and lineage.
  • Communication - Able to explain technical findings, assumptions, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • In-Person Collaboration - Able to attend in-person meetings in the San Diego area as needed.

SALARY: 90-110k/yr depending on experience

WHY CAMPOS EPC?

Campos EPC offers industry leading pay, a great team environment, and a rewards system that aligns your compensation with your success. Our continued growth provides career development opportunities and the ability to create your own future. Campos EPC rewards innovative thinking, hard work, and determination. Come grow with us!

companyDescription:
Rewards Network® is a Chicago-based fintech company founded in 1984 that helps restaurants thrive through data-driven marketing, loyalty programs, and flexible funding solutions. For over 40 years, Rewards Network has worked with restaurants nationwide to help drive measurable revenue and long-term customer loyalty. 

Rewards Network connects more than 20,000 restaurants to a network of 25 million dining members through partnerships with leading loyalty brands across travel, fintech, and consumer platforms. These include major programs that diners already use, allowing Rewards Network to position restaurants directly within customers’ everyday spending habits. 

At the core of Rewards Network is its pay-for-performance model, which ensures restaurants only pay when diners spend. This approach eliminates wasted marketing spend and ties every dollar directly to real customer visits and revenue generation. 

Rewards Network also equips restaurant operators with advanced analytics, actionable insights, and detailed reporting tools. These tools allow restaurants to better understand customer behavior, track repeat visits, evaluate performance, and make smarter operational and marketing decisions. 

In addition, Rewards Network provides flexible funding solutions tied to future revenue, enabling restaurants to access capital without traditional loan structures. This helps operators manage cash flow, invest in growth, and adapt to seasonal business needs. 

With over 400 employees, Rewards Network continues to innovate while staying true to its mission: when local restaurants thrive, communities thrive. Rewards Network has earned industry recognition, including being named one of Chicago’s Best Places to Work in 2026.

descriptionHtml:
About Rewards Network®

Rewards Network is a fast-paced, restaurant-focused fintech company that connects restaurants with the world’s most powerful consumer loyalty programs to reward diners through card-linked offers. We are the leading capital provider for restaurants, and our partners—companies like United, Delta, Bilt, Fetch, and Rakuten—are the leaders in their industries. With a strong foundation built over four decades, Rewards Network has delivered enduring value to more than 100,000 restaurants.

Our Culture

At Rewards Network, you'll be part of a driven and diverse team that excels in collaboration, issue resolution, and taking ownership of both personal growth and the company's success. We take pride in partnering with the world's most powerful loyalty programs to drive full-price paying customers to local restaurants through marketing services and flexible funding options. Our engaging and rewarding environment is designed to help you gain your full potential.

Job Overview

The Data Analyst, Marketing, will play a critical role in delivering actionable insights to our Restaurants team. This position supports effective decision making and strategic planning through clear reporting, in depth ad-hoc analysis, and strong communication skills.

The Data Analyst will sit at the crossroads of Marketing, FP&A, Data Science, and Data Architecture, helping translate complex business and customer data into insights that drive transformational business value.

The ideal candidate combines a strong sense of curiosity with strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills. This role is well suited for an analytical problem-solver who can move beyond reporting to uncover insights, challenge assumptions, and help shape strategies that improve customer value and business performance.

This is a hybrid position and requires in-office presence Tuesday through Thursday each week in Chicago.

What you’ll bring to the table: (Responsibilities)

  • Discover new customer insights and trends related to our restaurant customer base
  • Translate complex data into actionable customer insights that afford the improvement and creation of go-to-market materials, processes, and presentations for our distribution teams
  • Partner with cross-functional and customer-focused teams to gather customer insights, understand their needs, identify risks, opportunities, and emerging trends to better serve customers
  • Create, prepare, report, and communicate monthly and quarterly reports for senior management that translate analytical findings into business actions
  • Collaborate with data science, data, marketing, products, to create meaningful value for our restaurant customers`

Do you have the right mix of ingredients: (Requirements)

  • Strong skill and interest in modeling and analysis, with a demonstrated history of success in both
  • Advanced in SQL, Python, PowerBI and Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel and Power Query)
  • Ability to manage large datasets (data integration, data preprocessing, and exploratory data analysis)
  • Familiarity with building models and statistical analysis
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally and align financial plans with business objectives
  • Continuous improvement mindset and innate curiosity
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, or related field
  • 2-5 years of experience in corporate finance, data analytics or financial analysis.
  • Master of Science in Computer Science or Business Analytics-Preferred

What You’ll Love About Us

Comprehensive benefits package, which includes:

  • This is a full-time, exempt position and the base compensation for this opening in Chicago is expected to be $80,000-$95,000 annualized, depending on level, candidate experience, skills, and other factors. This position will be eligible for an annual bonus program with a 7.5% bonus target for total at target of $86,000-$102,125.
  • Competitive Paid Time Off and company holidays
  • Generous dining reimbursement when you dine with our restaurant clients
  • 401(k) plan with a company match
  • Two medical plan options- Standard PPO or High Deductible Health Plan (HSA with company match for HDHP participants)
  • Partnership with Rx n Go, offering certain prescriptions for free
  • Two dental plan options and a vision plan
  • Flexible Spending Accounts and a pre-tax commuter benefit program
  • Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance Plans
  • Short Term and Long Term disability
  • Company-paid life insurance and AD&D insurance, supplemental employee, spouse, and child life insurance
  • Employee Life Assistance Program
  • Hybrid working space in our state of the art office downtown located by the Metra and Ogilvie train stations
  • Catered lunches provided on Tuesday's in our Chicago office

Rewards Network is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). We encourage and strongly support workplace diversity.

Expected Pay Range : $80,000 USD - $95,000 USD

Description

Position Summary

Credit One Bank is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to support the overall growth of the organization. The individual in this position will primarily be responsible for improving and maintaining operational business measurements through the analysis of diverse systems and processes at Credit One Bank. This Senior Analyst will support junior analysts within the Operations Analytics team and work with key stakeholders to identify improvements, define success metrics, and report key performance indicators that support achievement of business strategy from an Operations perspective.

Summary Of Essential Job Functions

  • Provide insight into business performance, trends, improvement opportunities, and root cause analysis in a clear and creative way using a variety of reporting tools and techniques.
  • Evaluate, analyze, and report the impact and performance of operational strategies.
  • Present findings to management and make recommendations for improvements.
  • Manage project requirements, analytic plans, SOWs, project timelines, and other related materials for the management of deliverables.
  • Lead others in the utilization and optimization of data analysis tools.
  • Implement solutions for best-in-class data management practices to ensure accurate, reliable, and well documented data and reports.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, or other STEM related field
  • 3-5 years of experience with Python or a similar programming language is required.
  • 3-5 years of relevant experience with advanced understanding of advanced data analytics, tracking, and reporting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining and segmentation techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to convey technical information to non-technical and technical professionals.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and project management skills

The Business Data Analyst I role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home. The position also requires 10-15% local travel to other sites.

The Business Data Analyst I role has a national salary range of $70,000 - $115,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase, and a generous PTO policy.

Are you ready to turn data into decisions that drive real impact in the supply chain world? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Business Data Analyst I who thrives on solving complex problems, creating powerful visualizations, and delivering actionable insights. This is your chance to be at the heart of operations, influencing strategy and performance in a dynamic warehouse environment. If you're passionate about analytics, innovation, and making a difference, this role is for you. If you're a curious, self-driven problem solver with a passion for analytics, innovation, and impact—this role is for you!

Job Description

As a Business Data Analyst I, you will play a key role in transforming operational data into strategic insights that identify opportunities, improve performance, and reduce costs. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build reports, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. This role is ideal for someone with foundational analytics experience who is ready to take ownership of projects and grow into a trusted resource for data solutions.


  • Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
  • Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
  • Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
  • Collaborate with site and sector leadership to identify opportunities for efficiency and cost reduction
  • Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights through presentations and reports for internal and customer use
  • Ability to leverage data from various systems that support our operations (Warehouse Management System, Timekeeping systems, etc.)
  • Manage analytics projects independently, from concept to delivery
  • Serve as a point of contact for Power BI-related questions and support


Required Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience, required
  • 1+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, required
  • Hands-on experience using SQL or other scripting languages (such as Python or R) to query, clean, and transform data, required
  • Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards and reports from scratch, required
  • Experience writing DAX expressions to automate and enhance Power BI reports, required
  • Strong understanding of statistical concepts and data modeling techniques, preferred
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, preferred
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines, required
  • Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required


Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

  • Present findings and recommendations in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Mentor junior team members by reviewing analytical outputs, ensuring adherence to USSOCOM data governance standards, and fostering technical skill development.

You MUST Have

  • Education & Experience: High school diploma with a minimum of 12 years of relevant experience, 10 years experience with Associate's, OR 6 years experience with Bachelor's.
  • Security Clearance: Active DoD TS/SCI clearance
  • Technical Experience
    • Experience in data modeling, transformation, and visualization.
    • Familiarity with SQL and experience writing queries for data extraction and analysis.
    • Knowledge of at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, or .NET).
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel and Access.
    • Ability to develop data visualizations that inform leadership decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must be DoW 8140 compliant under the Work Role Code 422 – Data Analyst- Intermediate level or higher
    • Have or obtain a GSEC or SSCP certification
It’s GREAT If You Also Have

  • Experience with Microsoft SharePoint integration for data visualization or workflow automation.
  • Experience with MAVEN platforms
  • 2+ years designing Palantir Foundry workflows: engineering data pipelines, modeling ontologies, and deploying BI applications to support mission-critical decisions

Education

  • High School Diploma with 12 years of experience OR AA + 10 yrs of experience OR BS + 6 years of experience

descriptionHtml:
The Senior Data Analyst turns complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive financial and operational outcomes. In this role, you will develop scalable analytics assets for finance and revenue cycle management, connect operational activity to financial performance, and partner independently with executive stakeholders on high-impact data problems. You will build reliable data products, conduct exploratory analysis, and translate findings into recommendations that create measurable business value.

D o you enjoy building systems you can take pride in, discovering insights that create measurable value, and working in a role that is both business-facing and technical? If you want to grow your data career with mentorship, resources, and meaningful ownership, this could be a great role for you.

The primary tools used in this role are Databricks, SQL, R, Power BI, and related Microsoft Fabric capabilities.

Remote hires will be required to travel to our headquarters in Ankeny, IA (company paid) their first few days for new hire orientation, training, and onboarding.

At this time, we are NOT considering applicants that require immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States. This includes, but IS NOT LIMITED TO: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, etc.

Salary range: $101,700-113,000 plus 10% bonus

Benefits

Our employees enjoy a generous package of benefits that we are thrilled to provide, and feel is part of what makes us different as an employer. We value our team members, and this is one way we can show it.

Benefits Include

  • PTO, holiday pay and holiday of choice
  • 401(k) match
  • Life insurance
  • Short-term disability
  • Health, dental and vision insurance
  • Maternity/paternity leave
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA) – health and dependent

Position Responsibilities May Include, But Not Limited To

  • Support high-impact analytics initiatives from problem framing through delivery; quantify value, design robust analyses, and communicate recommendations to business partners and executives
  • Partner with finance and revenue cycle management stakeholders to develop new self-service reporting tools and capacities
  • Develop core organizational KPIs and directly present on the success and health of our business to senior stakeholders
  • Develop analytics products and solutions using Databricks, dbt, custom scripting, and BI tools
  • Implement advanced analytics where applicable, using scalable scripts and Databricks workflows to support modeling, automation, and repeatable analysis
  • Build performant Databricks workflows (notebooks, jobs, SQL Warehouses) to wrangle large datasets, engineer features, and automate recurring analyses
  • Partner with Data Engineering to design scalable data solutions, clarify upstream data requirements, and ensure analytics assets are built on reliable data foundations
  • Own analysis quality through data validation, experiment and study design, sensitivity checks, reproducibility, versioning, and documentation
  • Define and monitor KPIs tying operational reporting directly to business objectives
  • Adopt and champion BI development standards across the organization, including naming conventions, documentation expectations, quality checks, and release practices
  • Stay current with emerging analytics methodologies, technologies, and capabilities

Required Skills And Experience

  • 4-8 years in analytics roles, including 2+ years leading projects with cross-functional business stakeholders
  • 2+ years writing data directly to a data warehouse
  • 2+ years partnering directly with finance, strategy and ops, FP&A, or revenue cycle management leaders
  • Proven impact delivering analytics in complex environments (messy data, ambiguous scope) with measurable business outcomes
  • Statistical and financial analytics expertise, including analysis design, interpretation of results, and business case development
  • Expert proficiency in writing production-level SQL with query optimization over large, partitioned tables
  • Knowledge of AI-assisted analytics development, and AI-assisted analytics tools
  • Versioning and Reproducibility: Git‑based workflows; disciplined documentation, and peer review
  • Comfort in at least one BI platform like Power BI, Hex, Tableau, etc.
  • Proficiency in R to create reproducible workflows, conduct statistical testing, and develop basic models
  • Executive storytelling: translate complex analyses into clear narratives, recommended actions, and solutions that support decision-making
  • Stakeholder partnership: influence cross-functional partners, set expectations, drive alignment, and maintain trust through clear communication
  • Product mindset: understand and define problem statements, success metrics, and iterate with feedback – drives adoption of analytics products and solutions

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Certifications in Databricks, dbt, Power BI, or cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
  • Familiarity with data governance tools and compliance standards
  • Product management training or analytics product delivery experience

Physical Requirements

  • Repetitive motions that include the wrists, hands and/or fingers
  • Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting, remaining in a stationary position for prolonged periods
  • Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

Company Overview

Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.

EEO

Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.

descriptionHtml:
Senior Data Analyst

HYBRID (No Visa Transfers or Sponsorships Available)

About Tillster

Headquartered in the USA, Tillster is the global leader in digital ordering and customer engagement solutions. For over a decade we have developed revolutionary self-service, ordering and payments solutions – for mobile, tablet, online, kiosk, call center, and more – creating personalized interactions based on consumer preferences, language, and currency. Our platform is compatible with 15+ unique POS systems, representing over 90% coverage in multi-unit restaurants. We offer one platform: one scalable, enterprise class solution – to create world-class digital engagement solutions. Our mission and passion are one in the same: Empower restaurants and consumers to engage and transact anywhere, anytime, and from any device - one consumer at a time, one order at a time, billions of times over. In doing so, together we are transforming e-commerce in restaurants and making the till grow for Tillster and our customers.

Are you a passionate data analytics with a knack for data?

Job Duties

Analytics & Insight Delivery

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of complex analytical initiatives — from framing the business question and scoping the analysis through execution, presentation, and follow-through on stakeholder action. Do not wait to be asked; proactively surface KPI trends, anomalies, opportunities, and risks before stakeholders encounter them.
  • Support ad-hoc analysis for Tillster customers, executives, and internal stakeholders — going beyond data retrieval to provide interpretive framing and actionable recommendations with a clear point of view.
  • Operate as a trusted analytics advisor to Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, Account Management, and Support/Operations. Challenge assumptions in business requests where data tells a different story. Translate complex findings into decision-relevant narratives.
  • Design and support A/B test experiments with statistically valid methodology — including hypothesis definition, sample sizing, success and guardrail metric selection, and results analysis. Communicate findings clearly to Product and Marketing stakeholders.

Google Analytics & Data Collection

  • Act as the team's primary Google Analytics subject matter expert. Own GA4 reporting, custom dimensions and metrics design, tracking plan validation, and GA-to-warehouse integration. Advise on tagging strategy for new product features and platform launches in partnership with the Lead MarTech Solutions Architect.
  • BI Development & Semantic Layer
  • Design, build, and maintain high-performing Explores and dashboards in Looker for business stakeholders including Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering, Account Management, and Support/Operations — owning deliverables end-to-end with minimal re-work.
  • Develop LookML for owned domains to a high quality standard — including complex dimensions, measures, derived tables, and Explore configurations. Ensure all LookML is documented, tested, and consistent with organisation-wide semantic layer standards.
  • Ensure metric definitions in owned domains are canonical, unambiguous, and consistent with the definitions governed by the Analytics Engineering team. Flag and resolve discrepancies between business intent and semantic layer implementation.
  • Expand self-service analytics capabilities — enabling non-technical users across Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to answer their own questions independently, reducing ad-hoc request volume to the team. Target coverage across ≥2 new business units per half-year.
  • Proactively maintain the accuracy and consistency of production Explores and dashboards as underlying data warehouse structures change. Identify discrepancies before stakeholders encounter them.

Data Quality & Platform Collaboration

  • Own the accuracy and freshness of all data products in scope. Proactively identify and investigate data quality issues — with root-cause evidence — and partner with Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers to resolve upstream problems promptly.
  • Write high-quality, performant SQL — including complex window functions and CTEs — and collaborate with Data Engineers on query optimisation, compute cost efficiency, and derived table design for owned analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate with Analytics Engineers on LookML architecture and semantic layer design for owned domains — providing analytical requirements that inform model design and validating that data models correctly reflect business logic.
  • Partner with the Senior BI & AI Analyst on customer analytics definitions for segmentation, LTV, and churn use cases. Consume ML model outputs from the Data Science team and surface them accurately in dashboards and analytical narratives.
  • Understand the structure of data pipelines feeding owned dashboards sufficiently to diagnose data freshness and quality issues, escalate to the correct team, and communicate resolution timelines to stakeholders.

Standards, Mentorship & Team Development

  • Own coding standards and analytical best practices for the team — including SQL style guides, LookML conventions, documentation requirements, and PR review processes. Conduct structured code reviews that are substantive, consistent, and designed to build capability in Junior Analysts.
  • Mentor Junior Data Analysts through paired analysis, direct feedback, and structured review. Track improvement over time. Escalate development needs or blockers to the Manager.
  • Build and contribute reusable assets to shared team libraries — including SQL query patterns, LookML components, analysis frameworks, and documentation templates — reducing time-to-delivery for the entire team, not just own work.
  • Contribute to at least one standards update, governance policy, or best-practice guide per year.

AI-Augmented Analytics & Self-Serve Agent Development

  • Apply LLM and AI tools (Gemini, GPT-4, Cortex Analyst, or equivalent) hands-on to accelerate analytics workflows — including automated insight narration, anomaly detection and explanation, and AI-assisted dashboard annotation. Practical delivered experience required; theoretical familiarity is not sufficient.
  • Design and build self-serve analytics agents that enable non-technical stakeholders in Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Account Management to query data and surface insights in natural language — without raising tickets or requiring analyst intervention. Own the full lifecycle from prompt design through output validation and iteration.
  • Configure Cortex Analyst or equivalent AI-assisted BI platforms to extend self-service beyond traditional dashboard interaction — including semantic model templates and YAML definitions that produce accurate, governed responses to unstructured business questions.
  • Define quality standards for AI-generated analytical outputs — including accuracy validation, hallucination detection, and a review process before AI-generated insights are shared externally or with executives.
  • Prototype and propose AI tooling that reduces repetitive analytical work for the team. Present prototypes to the Manager with a clear build-vs-buy recommendation and documented lessons learned that contribute to the team's shared AI analytics playbook.

Skills Required With Years Of Experience

Core Technical Skills (5-7 years total experience)

SQL & Data Analysis - 4-5 years

  • Advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization)
  • Complex analytical queries and performance tuning

Business Intelligence Tools - 3-4 years

  • Looker expert (LookML development, Explores, dashboards)
  • Data visualization and self-service analytics design

Google Analytics - 2-3 years

  • GA4 implementation, configuration, and reporting
  • Tracking strategy and warehouse integration

Python/Programming - 1-2 years (preferred)

  • Data manipulation and automation
  • Version control (Git) and code review

Statistical & Analytical Skills (3-5 Years)

A/B Testing & Experimentation - 2-3 years

  • Experimental design and statistical testing
  • Hypothesis formulation and results interpretation

Statistical Analysis - 3-4 years

  • Descriptive and inferential statistics
  • Trend analysis and anomaly detection

AI & Emerging Technologies (1-2 years)

AI-Augmented Analytics - 1-2 years

  • Hands-on LLM usage (GPT-4, Gemini, Cortex Analyst)
  • AI agent development and prompt engineering
  • AI output validation and quality standards

Business & Communication Skills (4-6 Years)

Stakeholder Management - 4-5 years

  • Cross-functional collaboration (Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering)
  • Executive communication and presentation
  • Trusted advisor relationships

Business Analytics - 3-4 years

  • Customer analytics (segmentation, LTV, churn)
  • KPI development and metric definition
  • Translating business questions to analytical frameworks

Leadership & Mentorship (2-3 years)

Team Leadership - 2-3 years

  • Mentoring junior analysts
  • Code review and standards enforcement
  • Building team best practices and documentation

Project Management - 3-4 years

  • End-to-end analytical project ownership
  • Managing multiple concurrent initiatives
  • Proactive insight delivery

Thriving at Tillster

As a member of Tillster, you will embody our core values:

  • Put Customers First: Prioritize the needs and satisfaction of our customers in all decisions and actions appropriate to Tillster’s stage of development, resources, and stated goals.
  • Collaborate: Work together effectively, leveraging diverse perspectives to achieve common goals.
  • Innovate: Embrace creativity and pursue new ideas to drive progress and improvement.
  • Operate from Data: Use strong critical thinking skills to make informed decisions based on accurate and relevant data.
  • Drive Results: Focus on achieving tangible outcomes and delivering high performance.
  • Own It: Take responsibility for your actions and the success of your work.
  • Be Passionate and Have Fun: Bring enthusiasm to your work and enjoy the journey.

The Interview Process

  • Recruiter interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist
  • Interview with Data Analytics Team
  • Final interview with our Data Analytics Leader

Pay And Benefits (USA)

  • Salary yearly rate is $115,000k - $145,000k DOE
  • Health Benefits: All full-time, regular employees and their dependents are eligible for medical, dental, vision and FSA benefits. Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Circle has made its reputation on being compliant and transparent. As a Senior Data Analyst working on financial reporting at Circle, you’ll work closely with our product, treasury, finance, and accounting teams to ensure that we meet our reporting and regulatory requirements and continue to be a trusted, compliant actor in the crypto ecosystem. You will also work to make sure that the most important financial information we track is well organized and understandable. You’ll also have the opportunity to draw insights from our rich data and help make sure that our teams are looking at these important problems in the right ways. The right candidate will join a group of colleagues who are a passionate team with a deeply analytical approach and your work will support our mission to be a world-class company driven by data. If you have a lot of attention to detail, get bothered when the numbers don’t tie together, are excited to learn from our expert accounting and treasury teams, and want to help people better understand how our financial systems are working, we would love to talk to you.

What You'll Work On

  • Partner with teams across the company to understand how their products will affect our reporting duties and partner with these teams, accounting, treasury, finance, and data engineering to design data requirements, data models, business logic, and a reporting layer that helps us track and verify that we are meeting our regulatory requirements.
  • Develop a strong understanding of how we think about our finances and accounting and partner with teams to make the inner workings transparent.
  • Build the frameworks and systems that help us see when something might be going wrong and help lead the charge to fix these immediate problems and design solutions that keep these problems from happening again.
  • Build scalable automated solutions utilizing SQL, Superset, other reporting tools, scripting languages, and AI.
  • Occasionally share your results with larger audiences to educate them on the inner workings of our engineering and financial systems.
  • Partner with accounting and treasury to solve important data problems that arise as new opportunities and regulations arise.

You Will Aspire To Our Four Core Values

  • Multistakeholder - you have dedication and commitment to our customers, shareholders, employees and families and local communities.
  • Mindful - you seek to be respectful, an active listener and to pay attention to detail.
  • Driven by Excellence - you are driven by our mission and our passion for customer success which means you relentlessly pursue excellence, that you do not tolerate mediocrity and you work intensely to achieve your goals.
  • High Integrity - you seek open and honest communication, and you hold yourself to very high moral and ethical standards. You reject manipulation, dishonesty and intolerance.

What You’ll Bring To Circle

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a quantitative major (Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering)
  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics.
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language, such as R or Python, for data manipulation, analysis, and modeling.
  • Experience with bank reporting, business banking, financial services, or other similar industries.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain to non-technical audiences and potentially regulators about how the systems you own and design work.
  • Strong collaboration skills that allow you to make sure that product, product engineering, data engineering, finance, accounting, and treasury are all on the same page regarding reporting and requirements.
  • A strong sense of ownership and accountability: when a number looks wrong or a report breaks, you take the lead in triaging it, investigating the root cause, and driving it to resolution, and you keep cross functional partners informed until it is fixed.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

Base Pay Range: $132,500 - $157,500

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to accommodations@circle.com for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

Description

Journeyman Data Analyst

At B&A, we foster and embrace a distinct set of values that we live by and instill in all aspects of our organization: dedication, commitment, partnership, trust, and recognition. We have incorporated these values into successful delivery for our customers since 1988. B&A believes in ensuring its employees feel deeply connected to B&A, recognizing successes and hard work, and providing continuous opportunities to learn and grow. Our people are entrepreneurial thinkers that combine mindset, vision, and experience to drive value – not only to us as an organization, but to the clients we support. We promote a collaborative culture with our clients, and with each other, as one team working towards a common vision. We’d love for you to join our team!

Job Summary

B&A is looking for a Journeyman Data Analyst to support an important Army mission. In this role, you will turn complex data into clear reports, dashboards, and insights that support informed decisions. You will work with a collaborative team to improve data quality, develop reporting tools, and help users get the most out of their data.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate and analyze statistics and trends.
  • Uses various query software tools to produce finished reports, statistics, and/or graphic information reflective of the subject matter.
  • Analyze and evaluate data extracted for the purposes of quality assurance, quality control, and data integrity.
  • Prepare procedures manuals, user guides, and technical documentation, to include but not limited to, report development documentation.
  • Prepare written analyses and recommendations.
  • Develop new reporting tools, views, and interfaces.
  • Train users in new applications, reporting tools or system features.
  • Maintain daily work reports.

Education And Experience

  • Must have an undergraduate degree, preferably in computer science or information management, and 4 years of progressively more responsible experience in a professional analytical occupation working with relational databases for the purposes of data extraction.

Required Skills

  • Have experience with Power Query and Power BI. Experience with Army Vantage or Palantir preferred.
  • Be proficient in extracting data from relational databases using various query software tools, graphic displays for data presentation, database tools, and spreadsheet software.
  • Be proficient in creating data visualizations, data cleaning and preparation.
  • Be proficient and experienced using SQL, T-SQL, and Microsoft Access.
  • Experience using HTML, ASP, and Visual Basic.
  • Able to produce finished reports containing analyses, graphics, and recommendations.
  • Have excellent data analysis skills.
  • Able to work independently.
  • Have excellent written and effective oral communication skills.

Security Clearance

  • Must have an active Secret security clearance.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of this position, with or without accommodation.
  • Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
  • Frequently operate standard office equipment, including computers and telephones.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, video conference, and email.
  • Occasionally move about the office and lift up to 20 pounds.
  • Ability to work the assigned schedule with regular and reliable attendance.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% as required.

More About B&A

B&A delivers secure, innovative, and mission-critical IT solutions to support the United States Government across all three branches—Executive, Legislative, and Judicial—focused on National Security, Defense, and Intelligence. Our team of cleared professionals specializes in Agile DevSecOps, Cloud Migration and Modernization, Data Science and Analytics, Human Capital Management, Operations and Enablement, Application Transformation, All-Source Intelligence, Geospatial Production, Engineering and Integrated Services, and Cybersecurity.

Notable Clients

B&A has grown to be a company that is trusted by our clients for exceptional service, innovative solutions, and inspired employees. Our service extends through federal, state, and local Government, the private sector, and higher education. Some of our notable clients include Department of Homeland Security, U.S. Customs and Border Protection, U.S. Senate, U.S. Courts, U.S. Census Bureau, U.S. Navy, and more.

Benefits And Programs

B&A is proud to offer three robust individual and family medical plans to full time employees, including a Health Savings Account (HSA) option as well as two tiers of dental coverage, vision, life & AD&D, disability, accident, hospital indemnity, and critical illness insurance. In addition to these benefits, B&A employees enjoy paid time off,B&A sponsored trainings and certifications, pet insurance benefits, commuter transit benefits and a free subscription to a virtual exercise platform (NEOU). B&A’s 401(k) plan is available to all employees and includes a company matching contribution.

B&A has launched several programs to focus on employee engagement, wellness, and assistance. These include:

  • The B&A Cares program: 30/60/90-day wellness check ins, personal development, financial management, and stress management seminars, and more
  • A formal mentorship program
  • Job shadowing and cross training opportunities
  • Brand Ambassador program
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - Access to various support resources to include counseling, legal guidance, financial planning, and more
  • Monthly teambuilding events
  • B&A Annual Wellness Challenges: #StepWithB&A, #WalkDuringLunchWithB&A, #VolunteeringWithB&A, #ExerciseDuringLunchWithB&A, and more

At B&A, we place significant importance on improving the communities and lives of citizens across the nation through our involvement, technology expertise, and employees. B&A puts an emphasis on charitable efforts in the Northern Virginia area, including Capital Area Food Bank pantry drives, book donations, Hope for Henry Foundation events, and many more. In recognition of all these efforts, B&A has been named a Companies as Responsive Employers (CARE) award recipient by Northern Virginia Family Services and nominated by the Northern Virginia Chamber of Commerce for Outstanding Corporate Citizenship Award.

EEO

B&A provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. B&A complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy covers conduct occurring at B&A’s offices, and other workplaces (including client sites) and all other locations where B&A is providing services, and to all work-related activities.

EEO is the Law: https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2022-10/EEOC_KnowYourRights_screen_reader_10_20.pdf

E-Verify

B&A participates in e-Verify. We provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s I-9 Form to confirm work authorization.

B&A is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans Disabilities Act and applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact HR@bna-inc.com
