descriptionHtml:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

  • Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
  • What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
  • It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

  • Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
  • Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
  • Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
  • And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
  • Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.
  • Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Data Analyst to help us turn data into useful insights and make better business decisions while contributing to the continued development of our data infrastructure. In this role, you’ll independently partner with stakeholders across the organization to explore data, improve reporting, answer business questions, define meaningful metrics, and develop practical, reusable solutions. You’ll also help test, validate, and execute new data models, processes, and tools as we build a more scalable data foundation. This is an opportunity for someone who brings strong analytical fundamentals, sound judgment, and a practical approach to solving complex problems while helping establish sustainable analytics practices across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Independently partner with stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into reliable analyses, reports, dashboards, metrics, and data solutions.
  • Explore, clean, reconcile, and validate data from operational systems and emerging data infrastructure to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities.
  • Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, recurring reports, SQL queries, analytical datasets, and ad hoc analyses that support business decision-making.
  • Test and execute new data models, reporting processes, and analytical workflows; identify issues, document findings, and provide feedback to improve scalability and usability.
  • Help establish consistent metrics, data definitions, documentation, quality checks, and reporting practices as our data capabilities scale.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, operations analysis, finance, product analytics, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own analytical projects from requirements gathering through analysis, validation, communication, and delivery.
  • Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations, CTEs, window functions, and the ability to investigate and validate query results.
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards, reports, datasets, or analytical tools used by business stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, organization, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to exercise sound judgment when working with complex or imperfect data.

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Experience with a BI or visualization tool such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or a similar platform.
  • Experience validating data models, reporting pipelines, data transformations, or analytical workflows across multiple systems.
  • Familiarity with data modeling concepts such as tables, dimensions, measures, data grain, reusable reporting datasets, and metric definitions.
  • Exposure to Python, R, APIs, data warehouses, ETL/ELT, dbt, lakehouse concepts, Git, or other data development practices.
  • Experience improving data quality, automating manual reporting, documenting data processes, or helping establish analytics standards.

Compensation

  • Base Salary: $80,000 - $150,000
  • Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

Additional Requirements

  • Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Long Beach, CA. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

To protect candidates and our company from application fraud and impersonation, we use third-party tools to verify applicant identity and detect fraudulent applications. Learn more in our Privacy Notice.

Job Description

The Senior Strategic Data Analyst drives institutional success by transforming raw data into actionable strategic insights. This role designs complex data architecture, develops predictive analytics, and builds enterprise-level dashboards. The primary focus is providing the Muma College of Business with necessary data and monitoring and forecasting key performance indicators (KPIs) related to student success and Florida State University System performance metrics.

Responsibilities

Strategic Plan KPI Dashboards and Analytics Development

  • Build, publish, and maintain interactive enterprise-level visualization dashboards.
  • Translate complex institutional data into clean, understandable visual narratives.
  • Provide leadership and stakeholders with real-time access to strategic data.
  • Establish automated workflows for continuous dashboard data updates.


Advanced Data Extraction and Querying

  • Write, optimize, and maintain complex, end-to-end SQL queries.
  • Extract data from student, human resources, and financial information systems.
  • Blend cross-functional data to uncover institutional correlations and efficiencies.
  • Ensure data integrity, consistency, and security across all query models.


Predictive Modeling and Strategic Forecasting

  • Develop predictive models to anticipate performance outcomes and trends.
  • Identify potential shortfalls in state and institutional metrics well in advance.
  • Recommend data-driven, proactive interventions to ensure college success.
  • Conduct scenario modeling to assess the impact of proposed policy changes.
  • Maintain expert knowledge of the Florida State University System Performance-Based Funding (PBF) model and Preeminent metrics.
  • Monitor critical undergraduate and graduate student success and retention metrics.
  • Present complex analytical findings clearly to executive leadership and board members.
  • Document data definitions, query logic, and dashboard methodologies thoroughly.


Cross-Level University and MCOB Constituent Engagement and Collaboration

  • Partner with institutional constituents at all levels, including executive leadership, faculty, and administrative staff.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions with diverse stakeholders to capture business requirements.
  • Adapt communication style to effectively collaborate with both highly technical IT staff and non-technical academic leaders.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor across departments to promote a culture of data-informed decision-making.


Qualifications

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Five (5) years of experience in data management, business intelligence, or institutional research.
  • Expert-level proficiency in writing complete, advanced SQL queries from scratch.
  • Proven experience building production-level dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools.
  • Demonstrated experience successfully collaborating with multi-level institutional stakeholders.
  • Experience utilizing predictive analytics tools or statistical programming (Python, R).


Preferred Experience

  • Master's Degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Three (3) years of experience in data management, business intelligence, or institutional research.
  • Prior experience working within the Florida State University System.
  • Deep familiarity with Banner and OracleHR, or equivalent higher education ERP systems.


This is not a visa supporting position.

Degree Equivalency Clause: Four years of direct experience for a bachelor’s degree.

  • Senate Bill 1310- The Florida Senate (https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2023/1310) is conditional upon meeting all employment eligibility requirements in the U.S.
  • SB 1310: Substitution of Work Experience for Postsecondary Education Requirements
  • A public employer may include a postsecondary degree as a baseline requirement only as an alternative to the number of years of direct experience required, not to exceed:
  • (a) Two years of direct experience for an associate degree;
  • (b) Four years of direct experience for a bachelor’s degree;
  • (c) Six years of direct experience for a master’s degree;
  • (d) Seven years of direct experience for a professional degree; or
  • (e) Nine years of direct experience for a doctoral degree
  • Related work experience may not substitute for any required licensure, certification, or registration required for the position of employment as established by the public employer and indicated in the advertised description of the position of employment.
  • Minimum Qualifications that require a high school diploma are exempt from SB 1310.

descriptionHtml:
Location: METROHEALTH MEDICAL CENTER

Biweekly Hours: 80.00

Shift: 8:30am - 5:00pm

The MetroHealth System is redefining health care by going beyond medical treatment to improve the foundations of community health and well-being: affordable housing, a cleaner environment, economic opportunity and access to fresh food, convenient transportation, legal help and other services. The system strives to become as good at preventing disease as it is at treating it. Founded in 1837, Cuyahoga County’s safety-net health system operates four hospitals, four emergency departments and more than 20 health centers.

Job Summary

Supports the evolving need of managing the outcomes for Care Innovation and community Improvement Program (CICIP) population health initiatives with respect to social determinants of health to include managing the metrics and outcomes. The outcomes can be related to any of the quadruple aim expectations including financial, patient experience, clinical quality, and provider experience outcomes. The work involves connecting the outcomes and processes to the CICIP work. Upholds the mission, vision, values, and customer service standards of The MetroHealth System.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance or Health-focused major or any equivalent combination of education, training, and experience in addition to the experience stated below.
  • One to five years of progressive financial analytical experience in healthcare.
  • Highly proficient in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word.
  • Foundational knowledge of relational database structures.
  • Experience with SAS/SQL or similar programming languages.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, forecasting, communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Working knowledge of healthcare data and inter-related nature of coding nomenclatures (e.g., DRG’s, CPT’s, etc.).
  • Experience requesting and extracting data from healthcare information systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to manipulate and analyze data derived from disparate sources.
  • Beginner to intermediate knowledge of healthcare utilization review, revenue cycle, cost allocating and their impacts on financial and strategic performance.
  • Ability to take abstract thoughts or ideas, hone them into an analytical plan, and support leadership-ready reports.

Preferred

  • Experienced in project valuation, statistical significance testing, business case analysis and development.
  • Prior Epic experience.
  • Experience with data visualization programs like Tableau.
  • Experience with social determinant and community resource referral software like Unite Us and Pathway HUB.
  • Knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or deep learning methods.
  • Experience with statistical modeling/testing and regression analysis.
  • Experience with a large healthcare hospital system (public system highly desirable).

Physical Demands

  • May need to move around intermittently during the day, including sitting, standing, stooping, bending, and ambulating.
  • May need to remain still for extended periods, including sitting and standing.
  • Ability to communicate in face-to-face, phone, email, and other communications.
  • Ability to read policies, financial statements, statistical reports, etc.
  • Ability to use computer.

descriptionHtml:
Hybrid role (3 days/week in office) at our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo, Portland, Vancouver, Renton, Medford, Burlington, Lewiston, Little Rock, and Springdale offices. Preference will be given to current employees and candidates who reside within a commutable distance from our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo, Lewiston, Little Rock, and Springdale offices, or who are willing to relocate.

Build a career with purpose. Join our Cause to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.

Who We Are Looking For

Every day, Cambia’s dedicated team of Pharmacy Data Analysts is living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a Pharmacy Data Analyst, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping strategic decisions by developing sophisticated reporting solutions and conducting complex analyses that directly impact our corporate initiatives. We're seeking a highly skilled technical professional with pharmacy data experience who excels at managing multifaceted projects and solving high-stakes challenges with significant financial implications. Your analytical prowess will be instrumental in supporting pharmacy management decisions and developing innovative long-term solutions. This role offers an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of healthcare evolution, where your expertise in data analytics will directly contribute to optimizing pharmacy services and advancing our mission of transforming healthcare delivery.

Do you thrive when problem-solving or performing analysis in a fast-paced environment? Are you able to work both independently and together as team? Then this role may be the perfect fit.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Cambia:

  • Pharmacy Data Analyst I would have a Bachelor's degree in business, health information administration, mathematics, statistics, computer science or related field and 2 years' relevant work experience in data analysis or supporting relational database development, maintenance or utilization in healthcare systems or business systems or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Pharmacy Data Analyst II would have a Bachelor's degree in business, health information administration, mathematics, statistics, computer science or related field and 5 years' relevant work experience in data analysis or supporting relational database development, maintenance or utilization in healthcare systems or business systems or equivalent combination of education and experience. STARS and MES experience strongly preferred.
  • Pharmacy Data Analyst III would have a Bachelor's degree in business, health information administration, mathematics, statistics, computer science or related field and 8 years’ relevant work experience in data analysis or supporting relational database development, maintenance or utilization in healthcare systems or business systems or equivalent combination of education and experience. STARS and MES experience strongly preferred.

Skills And Attributes

Level I

  • Advanced SQL and report-writing skills, with proficiency in Oracle tools, SQL, and SNOWFLAKE.
  • Proficiency in MS Word and Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs/XLOOKUPs, macros, and VBA.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and implement solutions.
  • Strong business acumen (finance, accounting, statistics, risk management, project management).
  • Ability to apply data creatively to support planning and develop methodologies for new projects.
  • Ability to create desk procedures and lead interdepartmental training.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with internal and external customers.
  • Strong understanding of claims, membership, pricing, and provider data systems.
  • Knowledge of provider reimbursement, managed care, underwriting, actuarial principles, medical terminology, and coding is helpful.
  • Experience with AI tools to enhance productivity and decision-making is highly desired.

Level II

  • All level I requirements, plus:
  • Must have advanced/complex SQL knowledge and report-writing capabilities. Seen as department expert.
  • Proficient using data access tools, specifically Oracle suite of tools, SQL Navigator, SQL, VBA, ODBC, report development, form development, imports specs and case selects, etc.
  • Advanced skills with word processing (MS Word) and spreadsheet (MS Excel) programs.
  • Highly advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills. Ability to effectively present to all levels of management.
  • Proven ability to work independently with complex projects with large financial impact and/or risk to the corporation.
  • Proficient understanding of all relevant corporate data systems including claims, membership, pricing and provider data systems.

Level III

  • All level I and II requirements, plus:
  • Ability to work well independently or with a team. Mentors/coaches others. May direct or lead Analyst I or II on projects.

What You Will Do At Cambia

Level I

  • Create complex reports and modify underlying SQL; thoroughly validate own work and that of other team members, and be relied on for accuracy with complex reporting
  • Analyze data and prepare reports on health care services, utilization, costs, trends, enrollment, incentives, and revenue by provider, member, network, group, product, and line of business
  • Perform statistical analysis and data modeling per user requests, and communicate results and recommendations verbally and in writing
  • Maintain existing and develop new information reporting systems to meet the needs of internal and external users, gathering reporting requirements directly from information users
  • Evaluate the impact of new products, systems, and work processes on data and reporting systems, and work with transaction system departments to maintain data integrity and reliability
  • Develop and execute balancing and data validation routines to ensure data warehouse updates are complete, accurate, and reliable
  • Assist and train business analysts in other departments on data interpretation, appropriate use of data tools, and query and report preparation to improve reporting consistency across the plan and Regence
  • Make sound decisions on issues with significant corporate risk impact, proactively raise issues and concerns to management, and contribute as needed to meet departmental deadlines

Level II

  • All level I requirements, including:
  • Creates enterprise universes. Automation of enterprise published reports (dashboards). Identifies needed reporting and assembles or directs the assembly.
  • Validates complex reporting produced within and outside the department. Responsible for proving final sign-off.
  • Defines and implements procedures/processes/tools to automate validation.
  • Trusted ability to make decisions with large financial impact and/or risk to the corporation.

Level III

  • All level I and II requirements, including:
  • Seen as the technical expert on pharmacy data analytics issues.
  • May Mentor/coach others. May direct or lead Analyst I or II on projects.

Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure / certifications; and performance history.

Level I

  • National pay structure — applies to the Boise, Portland, Salem, Seattle/Renton/Tacoma, Burlington, Vancouver, Lewiston, Minneapolis, St. Paul, and Salt Lake City metro areas: The full salary range is $55,000 - $90,000, and the bonus target is 6%.
  • Regional pay structure — applies to Arkansas, North Dakota, Minnesota, Idaho, Oregon, Washington, and Utah locations outside the metro areas listed above: The full salary range is $49,000 - $81,000, and the bonus target is 6%.

Level II

  • National pay structure — applies to the Boise, Portland, Salem, Seattle/Renton/Tacoma, Burlington, Vancouver, Lewiston, Minneapolis, St. Paul, and Salt Lake City metro areas: The full salary range is $72,000 - $119,000, and the bonus target is 10%.
  • Regional pay structure — applies to Arkansas, North Dakota, Minnesota, Idaho, Oregon, Washington, and Utah locations outside the metro areas listed above: The full salary range is $65,000 - $107,000, and the bonus target is 10%.

Level III

  • National pay structure — applies to the Boise, Portland, Salem, Seattle/Renton/Tacoma, Burlington, Vancouver, Lewiston, Minneapolis, St. Paul, and Salt Lake City metro areas: The full salary range is $88,000 - $143,000, and the bonus target is 15%.
  • Regional pay structure — applies to Arkansas, North Dakota, Minnesota, Idaho, Oregon, Washington, and Utah locations outside the metro areas listed above: The full salary range is $79,000 - $129,000, and the bonus target is 15%.

About Cambia

Working at Cambia means being part of a purpose-driven, award-winning culture built on trust and innovation anchored in our 100+ year history. Our caring and supportive colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry, innovating together toward sustainable, person-focused health care. Whether we're helping members, lending a hand to a colleague or volunteering in our communities, our compassion, empathy and team spirit always shine through.

Why Join the Cambia Team?

At Cambia, You Can

  • Work alongside diverse teams building cutting-edge solutions to transform health care.
  • Earn a competitive salary and enjoy generous benefits while doing work that changes lives.
  • Grow your career with a company committed to helping you succeed.
  • Give back to your community by participating in Cambia-supported outreach programs.
  • Connect with colleagues who share similar interests and backgrounds through our employee resource groups.

We believe a career at Cambia is more than just a paycheck – and your compensation should be too. Our compensation package includes competitive base pay as well as a market-leading 401(k) with a significant company match, bonus opportunities and more.

Benefits

In exchange for helping members live healthy lives, we offer benefits that empower you to do the same. Just a few highlights include:

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members, including mental health benefits.
  • Annual employer contribution to a health savings account.
  • Generous paid time off varying by role and tenure in addition to 10 company-paid holidays.
  • Market-leading retirement plan including a company match on employee 401(k) contributions, with a potential discretionary contribution based on company performance (no vesting period).
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid parental time off (eligibility requires 12 months of continuous service with Cambia immediately preceding leave).
  • Award-winning wellness programs that reward you for participation.
  • Employee Assistance Fund for those in need.
  • Commute and parking benefits.

Learn More About Our Benefits.

We are happy to offer work from home options for most of our roles. To take advantage of this flexible option, we require employees to have a wired internet connection that is not satellite or cellular and internet service with a minimum upload speed of 5Mb and a minimum download speed of 10 Mb.

As part of our security requirements, new hires will need access to a personal mobile device to set up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) upon joining the company. MFA is an important layer of protection for accessing Cambia systems and is required for all employees.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer dedicated to a drug and tobacco-free workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by law. A background check is required.

If you need accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please email CambiaCareers@cambiahealth.com. Information about how Cambia Health Solutions collects, uses, and discloses information is available in our Privacy Policy.

descriptionHtml:
The Medpace Analytics and Business Intelligence team is growing rapidly and is focused on building a data driven culture across the enterprise. The BI team uses data and insights to drive increased strategic and operational efficiencies across the organization. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will hold a highly visible analytical role that requires interaction and partnership with leadership across the Medpace organization.

What’s in this for you?

  • Work in a collaborative, fast paced, entrepreneurial, and innovative workplace;
  • Gain experience and exposure to advanced BI concepts from visualization to data warehousing;
  • Grow business knowledge by working with leadership across all aspects of Medpace’s business.

Responsibilities

What’s involved?

We are looking for a Junior Business Intelligence Analyst to add additional depth to our growing Analytical team in a variety of areas – from Visualization and Storytelling to SQL, Data Modeling, and Data Warehousing. This role will work in close partnership with leadership, product management, operations, finance, and other technical teams to find opportunities to improve and expand our business.

An ideal candidate in this role will apply great analytical skills, communication skills, and problem-solving skills to continue developing our analytics & BI capabilities. We are looking for team members who thrive in working with complex data sets, conducting deep data analysis, are intensely curious, and enjoy designing and developing long-term solutions.

What you bring to the table – and why we need you!

  • Data Visualization skills - Designing and developing key metrics, reports, and dashboards to drive insights and business decisions to improve performance and reduce costs;
  • Technical Skills – either experience in, or strong desire to learn fundamental technical skills needed to drive BI initiatives (SQL, DAX, Data Modeling, etc.);
  • Communication Skills - Partner with leadership and collaborate with software engineers to implement data architecture and design, to support complex analysis;
  • Analytical Skills - Conduct complex analysis and proactively identify key business insights to assist departmental decision making.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Life Science, Computer Science, or Related Degree;
  • 0-3 years of experience in business intelligence or analytics – Power BI and advanced SQL preferred;
  • Strong analytical and communication skills;
  • Excellent organization skills and the ability to multitask while efficiently completing high quality work.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO). We provide Phase I-IV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through its scientific and disciplined approach. We leverage local regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic disease, endocrinology, central nervous system, anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, employing more than 5,000 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence
Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable
Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development

Schedule Full time

Days/Hours Monday - Friday; 830 AM - 5 PM

Salary Range $120,135 - $135,120 (pay will be determined based on experience, preferred qualifications, and education)

Our compensation philosophy aims to provide marketable compensation programs and to compensate employees based on relevant experience and education. Individual compensation discussions begin during the hiring process and may occur during job review and promotional opportunities. Salaries vary depending on experience, education and current market for the position. Human Resources determines the external and internal equitable salary for each employee.

The above salary range (or hiring range) represents Stony Brook CPMP’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting

SUMMARY

The Data Analyst will be a member of the SB CIN Population Health IT Team. This individual will work in a fast-paced environment as part of a multi-disciplinary project team acquiring data from multiple participants of the CIN Program assisting with data ingestion, validation and mapping into the Population Health Platform. The Analyst will be responsible for developing SQL queries used to generate reports, create data marts and perform analytics against the data that has been successfully loaded into the platform.

The successful candidate will bring a balance of creative problem solving, hands-on data analytics, manipulation and practical software integration skills. The candidate will also be responsible for helping provide technical support for Cerner’s Population Health Management suite of products, HealtheRegistries, HealtheAnalytics, HealtheEDW and HealtheCare.

The Data Analyst will be responsible to maintain up to date knowledge and understanding of Managed Care and ACO program measure specifications and compliance requirements.

This team member will participate and contribute to all CIN software development project lifecycle tasks including requirements, analysis, solution design, development, testing, training, implementation and support.

The Analyst will provide support in making strategic data-related decisions by analyzing data, finding actionable insights, and working with leaders and stakeholders to drive change.

Job Duties & Essential Functions

Analyst responsible for maintaining and processing all CIN Data used for Reporting.

    • Support the CIN data acquisition and EMR integration projects. Assist the team with technical on-boarding projects, integrating disparate EMR data sources from various practice sites and billing vendors into the Population Health Platform.
    • Design, code and maintain SQL queries used within Cerner’s Hosted platform for reporting.
    • Run attribution algorithms, maintain and execute scripts used to generate reports.
    • Upload required report files to the Population Health platform.
  • Design, code and operationalize reports as requested by the end user for the purpose of quality, process monitoring or regulatory requirements. This data will be extracted from multiple source systems, normalized and ultimately provided in the format requested by the CIN business team.
  • Design and develop custom data marts using SQL server to be used as input for dashboards and reporting requirements.
  • Assist in the creation and maintenance of the CIN report catalog.
  • Improve performance and accuracy of existing reports by optimizing existing SQL statements as necessary and establishing best practices.
  • Author technical requirements and design specifications as needed.
  • Communicate results of data analyses in a clear and effective manner to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Test and validate all report outputs and visualization dashboards using various queries and tools.
  • Work in a high paced team environment with the ability to multitask when required based on project plan and business priorities.
  • Other duties as assigned by management.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, other applied science field.
  • Minimum of 5 years professional experience in a technical/data analyst role in a data driven environment.Proficient knowledge of SQL -
  • Working with SQL server and Oracle; able to write sound, efficient, and prop
    • SQL statements ensuring stability, reliability, and performance of databases.
    • Experience with stored procedures and able to query complex datasets and derive conclusions, including using all types of joins between multiple tables
    • Skilled at optimizing large complicated SQL statements and knowledge of best practices
  • 3+ years’ experience in data mining, large scale data acquisition, transformation, and cleaning, both structured and unstructured data.
  • Experience with data modelling, data structure principles and designing database tables that facilitate efficient information retrieval.
  • Competency in data manipulation and analysis; accessing raw data in varied formats with different methods and analyzing and processing data.
  • The Data Analyst must have programming proficiency with analytical platform software and BI systems expertise including but not limited to Business Objects, SQL and Tableau.
  • Considerable experience with statistical tools and methods to incorporate statistical results into analyses.
  • Ability to turn vague concepts and asks into well-documented and effective business metrics and insights.
  • Strong knowledge and comfort level with Excel.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Python and SSIS a plus.
  • Experience with the Cerner Electronic Medical Record and Population Health applications.
  • Mentor/direct junior programmer analyst team member(s).
  • Knowledge of HL7 transactions, Health Care Claims (837), and/or CCDA a plus.
  • Knowledge of, and exposure to, established standards of care presented by CMS, NCQA, AHRQ, IOM, The Join.
  • Experience with Tableau or other data statistical, visualization, and predictive modeling software.
  • Electronic health record review and abstraction ability and experience.


Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to communicate with patients, staff and medical providers. The employee must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. This position is largely sedentary and requires the employee to remain stationary for a majority of the day. Any additional physical demands will be outlined and provided by management.

The responsibilities and tasks outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and may change as determined by the needs of CPMP.

The Office of the District Attorney, Bronx County (“BXDA”) is charged with the twin goals of ensuring public safety and striving for equal justice for the over 1.4 million members of the Bronx County community. By “Pursuing Justice with Integrity,” the BXDA places a focus on assistance for crime victims while simultaneously ensuring fairness to defendants. Moreover, the BXDA aims to balance the need to seek appropriate punishment for certain crimes while recognizing when punitive measures do not adequately advance justice. By recognizing these significant distinctions and acting accordingly, BXDA has established a standard of excellence in the representation of the Bronx community at large, which continues to grow stronger every day.

In furtherance of this mission, the BXDA seeks an experienced and enthusiastic Data Visualization Analyst Level to join the Strategic Planning & Analytics Bureau.

Strategic Planning & Analytics uses data, research, and analytics to support evidence-based decision-making, measure performance, evaluate policies and initiatives, and promote transparency.

The Data Visualization Analyst will develop and maintain dashboards, automated reports, and other data products that translate complex criminal justice data into clear, actionable information for Office leadership, staff, policymakers, and external audiences. The ideal candidate combines strong communication and technical skills, including querying, analyzing, and preparing data for analysis and presentation.

Job Responsibilities

Specific duties includes but not limited to the following:

  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and other data visualization products.
  • Translate complex data and analytic findings into clear dashboards, charts, tables, reports, and presentations for non-technical audiences.
  • Apply data visualization and storytelling principles to communicate trends, performance measures, and policy-relevant findings.
  • Work with analysts, data engineers, and Office stakeholders to identify reporting needs, define measures, and develop useful data products.
  • Query, clean, transform, validate, and analyze data using SQL, R, Stata, and related tools.
  • Develop and maintain automated and reproducible processes for dashboards, recurring reports, and data extracts.
  • Assess data quality and suitability for analysis and reporting.
  • Support ad hoc analyses and recurring reporting on Office performance, caseloads, case processing, programs, and strategic priorities.
  • Perform other related analytic and data visualization projects as assigned.

Please Note

  • This is a hybrid position: 4 days in the office, 1 remote day after 2 years of service.
  • BXDA does not support H1B Visas.
  • Must reside in NYC and surrounding counties.

COMMUNITY COORDINATOR - 56058

Minimum Qualifications

  • A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or
  • High school graduation or equivalent and six years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or
  • Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above. However, all candidates must have at least one year of experience as described in "1" above.

Preferred Skills

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data analytics, data science, statistics, economics, public policy, social sciences, information systems, data visualization, or a related field. - At least two years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, data visualization, research, or a related field public-sector or criminal justice experience. - Demonstrated experience developing interactive dashboards in Power BI is strongly preferred. - Experience using SQL to query relational databases. - Experience using R and/or Stata for data cleaning, analysis, automation, or reporting. - Experience developing automated or reproducible reporting processes. - Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. - Familiarity with research methods, descriptive statistics, performance measurement, and quantitative analysis. - Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality. - Ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively with technical, legal, operational, and senior staff. - Experience with Microsoft Power BI and data analysis software is highly preferred.

  • 1+ years industry experience as Data Analyst
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python or equivalent
  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets

Primary Function

The Sr Data Analyst is responsible for leading projects designed to improve operational performance and deliver excellent client service while assisting our internal operations units. The individual will leverage creative talents, excellent communication, analytic and project management skills.

Principal Duties

  • Be accountable for a designated group of operational departments or 3rd party clients by identifying and implementing new operational or client-based business strategies.

  • Maintain a working knowledge of existing business processes and reporting.
  • Retrieve data from the data warehouse structure.
  • Perform query optimization and performance tuning.
  • Mentor team members in SQL programming.
  • Be able to clearly articulate and present ideas and findings to a varied audience including the operations staff and senior management.
  • Performs related duties as assigned by management.

Education And Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in an analytical or quantitative discipline, or related STEM field.
  • Graduate degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of related experience as a data analyst in a financial setting.

Knowledge, Skill, and Ability Requirements

  • Strong business communication skills with an ability to work well in a collaborative environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and an ability to multi-task, respond well to pressure and deadlines, and work well individually and in a collaborative environment.
  • Strong skills in Excel (graphs, pivot tables, formulas).
  • Experience visualizing data in Tableau/PowerBI/R/Python.
  • Expertise in SQL programming and optimization.
  • Fast learner – able to assimilate new ideas and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Prior work experience performing business, data, and/or statistical analysis is a plus.
  • Experience with PowerPoint and Visio a plus.
  • Natural entrepreneurial interest is a plus.

All employees are required to have smart phones that meet Company security standards with the ability to install apps such as Microsoft Authenticator. Employment will be contingent on this requirement.

We’re a great place to work because we invest in what matters: your career, your community, your wellbeing, and your future. Our total rewards package is designed to support your whole self.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Please note that this position is contingent upon the successful award of a contract currently under bid.

Goldbelt Apex, a part of the Healthcare Technology Transformation Group, is a data-focused company dedicated to process and quality in every aspect. As experts in healthcare IT experts, Apex is committed to building systems for healthcare organizations to seamlessly communicate and exchange data across different systems and devices.

Summary:

The Mid-level Data Analyst will support survey and program data analysis, recurring/ad hoc reporting, data quality, system data support, charts/graphs/tables, and analysis of DES and SCAADL program performance.

Personnel are assigned in support of DHHQ in Falls Church, VA, but may work from the contractor facility or remotely when authorized.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Develop, refine, and generate recurring and ad hoc reports using approved data analysis and reporting software to analyze large datasets from multiple sources.
  • Analyze DES and SCAADL program data to identify performance trends, population changes, timeliness, process outcomes, quality measures, and other program metrics.
  • Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad hoc reports in accordance with established program requirements and deadlines.
  • Develop clear and accurate charts, graphs, tables, and statistical visualizations appropriate to the type and complexity of the data, including scatter plots and other advanced visualizations when appropriate.
  • Prepare draft DES performance reports addressing population changes, phase and stage timeliness, process outcomes, special interest metrics, and other required measures.
  • Prepare draft SCAADL performance reports and analyze historical enrollment and participation data to identify trends and support program reporting.
  • Maintain and update the SCAADL Microsoft Access database and compile data received from Military Departments for analysis and reporting.
  • Analyze program data and reporting results and provide recommendations for process improvements based on identified trends and findings.
  • Support IDES satisfaction survey activities by gathering survey outcomes, analyzing results, and preparing reports, graphs, and recommendations for corrective actions.
  • Assist with the development and modification of MEB, PEB, and Personnel survey instruments and related survey documentation.
  • Pull MEB and PEB cohorts from the Veteran’s Tracking Application (VTA) and review data for accuracy, completeness, and survey eligibility.
  • Monitor data quality in program-related systems, identify data errors, and assist with tracking and resolving data quality issues.
  • Assist with system data support activities, including drafting system change requests, supporting user acceptance testing, and identifying opportunities to improve system capabilities and performance.
  • Assist with developing and maintaining business process documentation, reporting procedures, and user guidance for program-related systems and processes.
  • Coordinate with Government personnel and other stakeholders to obtain, validate, and clarify data and reporting requirements.
  • Provide other support as needed.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and one or more analytical/reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Access, R, Python, or similar
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and written communication skills

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, information systems, business analytics, computer science, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis, statistical analysis, or reporting
  • Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources
  • Experience developing reports, charts, graphs, tables, and data visualizations
  • Experience performing data validation and identifying data-quality issues
  • Tier 1/non-sensitive, with the applicable DHA background investigation and suitability requirements.

Preferred Qualifications (Education, Experience, Skills):

  • Federal, DoD, DHA, healthcare, or military personnel data experience preferred

Pay And Benefits

The salary range for this position is $75,000.00 to $100,000.00 annually.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

For the past 25 years, we’ve been building a national network of low-cost veterinary clinics that provide low-cost, high-quality, and compassionate care in underserved communities. Our clinics have the power to transform communities into places where no one has to forego veterinary care for their pets because the cost is out of reach. You are invited to join the movement!

We are dedicated to building and supporting a diverse workforce. Emancipet is committed to applying a social justice lens to our work by evaluating and ensuring that our systems, policies, practices, language, and programs create equitable access, opportunities, engagement, and inclusivity for all people, and people from historically marginalized groups in particular. We strive to live by our values and be an organization where the culture created by our diverse staff and board advances our mission and vision, and supports organizational excellence and sustainability.

The Team: Who is Research, Data, and Analytics?

It’s not just what we do, but how we do it that makes the difference. Emancipet’s Research, Data, and Analytics (RDA) team turns the information our clinics and shared services teams capture every day into data people can trust and use. We partner closely with our Information Technology team so that data stays accurate and usable as our systems change and we grow.

We support Emancipet in achieving its three bottom lines—Quality Medicine, Transformative Service, and Financial Sustainability—by providing timely, approachable access to data and insights. That means dashboards clinic leaders can rely on, analysis that shapes strategic decisions, and evaluation grounded in equity.

The Data Analyst reports to the Chief Finance and Data Officer and works across departments to answer the questions that help us serve more families and pets.

The Opportunity: Tell me more about the Data Analyst position

At Emancipet, we serve over 100,000 families a year. Behind every decision about where to open a clinic, how to match appointment capacity to client demand, or whether we’re reaching the families who need us most is a question that data can help answer. We are seeking a Data Analyst who wants their work to be used, not just admired.

This is a role for a curious, careful analyst who’s comfortable owning the work from start to finish. You’ll build and maintain the datasets, reports, and dashboards that keep our operations running, and you’ll help us understand what’s behind the numbers—spotting trends, measuring whether decisions paid off, and sharing what you find in a way non-technical colleagues can act on. When someone comes to you with a request, you’ll take the time to understand what they’re trying to do, so you can give them what they need, not just what they asked for.

You’ll thrive here if you like both the puzzle and the people. You know your way around SQL and Power BI, you double-check your joins, and people leave a conversation with you understanding their data a little better than before. You care about data integrity and equity because you know the data represents real families and their pets.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following:

Reporting, Dashboards & Data Delivery (50%)

  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot the datasets, reports, and dashboards that support day-to-day operations and strategic projects, including external reporting for grants and municipal partners.
  • Query, extract, join, validate, convert, and summarize data from large datasets (100k+ rows).
  • Work with requesters to understand what they need, and deliver accurate, finished work on time.
  • Manage our client NPS surveys so results flow reliably into our reporting.

Analysis & Insights (20%)

  • Help answer questions from teams across the organization, from quick trend checks in our internal data to figuring out whether a change made a difference.
  • Contribute to larger analyses that bring in outside sources, like public data on the communities we serve, to help us better understand our operations, markets, and clients.
  • Share what you find with the people who need it, and be ready to talk through what the data is telling us.

Data Integrity & Measurement (20%)

  • Uphold and help improve data collection processes that protect data integrity and quality, meet organizational needs, and follow the principles of equitable evaluation.
  • Monitor the data flowing between our core systems, and troubleshoot issues when they come up, with support from our ETL specialist.
  • Work cross-functionally to help define the metrics and KPIs we use for timely, regular monitoring.
  • Help keep our documentation current when systems and processes change.

Collaboration & Communication (10%)

  • Be a dependable partner to clinic and shared services teams, helping build trust in our team and the data we provide.
  • Keep people informed about timelines, progress, and any data issues that affect their work.
  • Support the team in meeting and exceeding individual and team goals.

What You Bring (and We Know No One Has It All!)

  • Mission-driven and aligned with Emancipet’s values of compassionate service, excellence, teaching & learning, and optimism.
  • Strong communication and a service mindset: you’re responsive, approachable, and able to explain technical problems to people who aren’t data people.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in an analytical role.
  • Skills in SQL, Excel (including Power Query), and Power BI (including DAX), and a knack for choosing the right visual for the audience.
  • Foundational statistics and working knowledge of R or Python, with the curiosity to keep building your analytical toolkit.
  • Strong fundamentals in data cleaning, data integrity, and data quality, including handling private or sensitive data.
  • Comfortable troubleshooting data issues, including ETL processes or data pipelines, and figuring things out when the answer isn’t obvious.

Bonus Points If You Have Experience With

  • Mapping tools like ArcGIS
  • Qualitative data, including survey tools like Forsta or Qualtrics and analysis tools like NVivo
  • Equitable evaluation practices
  • Working in a non-profit

You Don’t Have to Check Every Box! We recognize that candidates bring diverse skills and experiences, and you may be a great fit even if you don’t check every box. If you’re passionate about our mission and confident in your ability to succeed in this role, we encourage you to apply.

Compensation & Benefits

The Data Analyst position is full-time, with a salary range of $70,000–85,000, depending on experience and qualifications. Candidates with more extensive experience may be considered for a Senior Data Analyst title.

Emancipet Offers a Comprehensive Benefits Package, Including

  • Generous Paid Time Off – 9 paid holidays and 120 hours of PTO, increasing with tenure, with the ability to roll over 40 hours each year.
  • 401(k) Plan – Emancipet match of 50% of your contribution, up to 5% of your annual pay.
  • Health Insurance – 100% Emancipet-paid coverage for employees and their children, with zero co-pays, zero out-of-pocket expenses, and most common prescriptions at $0.
  • Dental & Vision Insurance – 100% Emancipet-paid coverage for employees and their children.
  • Telehealth – 100% Emancipet-paid telehealth for your entire household, partner/spouse, and all children under 26, regardless of insurance status. This provides $0 visits for urgent care, mental and behavioral health care, pharmacy, and health advocacy services.
  • Life AD&D Insurance – 100% Emancipet-paid employee coverage, including estate planning service, travel assistance, and identity theft protection.
  • Voluntary Benefits – Additional coverage options, including accident, cancer, supplemental life, short- and long-term disability, and more.
  • Support for Your Pets – $324 per year in free services or products through Emancipet.

Location

This position can be based in Austin, TX (hybrid, with time in our central office), Houston, TX, or Philadelphia, PA. The role requires up to 5% travel to our central offices, clinic locations, or offsite locations for research and evaluation activities.

Deadline And How To Apply

This position will remain open until filled. We encourage early applications, as interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis beginning November 23.

To apply, submit your resume and a cover letter detailing why you’re a great fit for Emancipet via our website: https://emancipet.org/careers/

Want to learn more about our work? Watch our short documentary: https://www.emancipet.org/documentary

Emancipet is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Emancipet is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status, or any other status protected by law.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone belongs. We actively seek team members who share our values and bring unique perspectives to our mission.

All candidates eligible to work in the United States are encouraged to apply. However, we are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas at this time.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

Nisga’a CIOPS delivers cleared professionals to support civilian and DoD customers worldwide across intelligence support, cyber/defensive cyber operations, IT O&M, infrastructure modernization, training, and logistics.

Summary:

We are looking for a Mission Relevant Terrain - Cyber (MRT-C) Data Analyst in the Colorado Springs, CO area.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Leverage your technical IT abilities to analyze Space Force missions, systems, assets, and capabilities, then translate that knowledge into actionable content to support the cyber portion of mission assurance.
  • Perform data normalization, cleaning, manipulation, transformation, and analysis of complex systems, assets, networks, and operational processes.
  • Manually enter cross-functional cyber security data into the customer’s database and visualization tools such as Mission Assurance Decision Support System (MADSS) or Power BI.
  • Design, enhance, and optimize dashboards or visualization tools provided by the customer.
  • Upload the cyber security reports and references used for data input, visualization, or modeling to the customer’s database.
  • Provide quality assurance review for all data to be input into MADSS or similar data repositories.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations to the Lead and/or stakeholders to enhance the program or leadership’s decision-making.
  • Collaborate with Mission Analyst teammates on data initiatives, integrations, and other system-focused needs to enhance the customer’s cyber security posture.
  • Submit updates for relevant technical documentation, standards, guides, and training.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

  • Able to understand and differentiate between critical and non-critical systems, assets, networks, and operational processes.
  • Stay updated on emerging data analysis technologies and trends that would affect the customer’s cyber security initiatives or decision-making.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Excellent communication skills both verbal and written.
  • Good time management, prioritization, and multitasking abilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to build strong relationships with colleagues.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum 2 years of cyber analysis, data analysis, cyber security, mission assurance, or operational analysis experience.
  • Must possess a DoD 8140.01 qualifying certification such as CISSP, Security+, or equivalent.
  • TS/SCI Required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Systems, Data Science, or similar.

#CJ

Pay And Benefits

The salary range for this position is $80,000 to $100,000 annually.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Exempt or Non-Exempt

Job Summary

  • Hybrid Work Environment - Must reside in Hawaii**


Pay Range: $68,000 - $133,000

Note: Individuals typically begin between the minimum to middle of the pay range

Serves as a Medicare business data analyst, leveraging data, performance metrics, and effective reporting to inform performance initiatives and strategy for Medicare Stars and Risk Adjustment team and cross-functional collaborating teams. Supports efforts with internal and external partners by providing relevant and actionable data. Works independently to support the team with data-driven performance management including: data management and synthesis of disparate sources, data analysis, reporting and data visualization. Designs and develops data automation and streamling that create workflow efficiencies by interfacing disparate IT systems through APIs, ETLs, or other technological solutions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in information systems, data analytics, mathematics or statistics and four (4) years of related work experience; or equivalent combination of education and related work experience.
  • Demonstrated knowledge in identifying issues, collecting data, and analyzing and interpreting data.
  • Knowledge of managed care/health care business processes, systems and applications for delivered services such as claims, encounters, provider data, and/or patient/member data.
  • Intermediate working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications including Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
  • Intermediate working knowledge of MicroStrategy, SQL, SAS, Access, R or other business intelligence language/tools.
  • Intermediate working knowledge of Tableau or other data visualization tools.


Duties And Responsibilities

  • Report Development, Research and Analysis:
    • Develop and present reports that provide organizational awareness, insights and action plans to internal and external partners supporting Stars and Risk Adjustment performance improvement initiatives.
    • Integrates data and uses advanced analytical methods/tools to identify trends, issues, root causes and focused population segments, translating data into actionable visualizations using tables, graphs, charts, written reports and presentations.
    • Develops, implements and/or enhances methods to extract complex data sets from available sources (e.g., HMSA data repositories, HEDIS software, external party extracts, etc.).
    • Applies understanding of standard quality measures (e.g., HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS) to identify strategic improvement levers (e.g., supplemental data, benefit alignment) to impact Stars performance.
    • Applies understanding of Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) and Hierarchial Care Conditions (HCC) to identify strategic improvement levers to improve Risk Adjustment
    • Ensures Stars measure data and Risk Adjustment data is complete and accurate by implementing effective controls and validation activities.
    • Work as part of an agile quality team supporting quality improvement initiatives, Medicare quality pilots programs and member incentive programs.
    • Ensure compliance to regulatory standards and requirements
  • Stars and Risk Adjustment Performance Monitoring
    • Maintains a thorough understanding of the Medicare Part C & D Star Ratings Technical Notes, Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) and Hierarchical Care Conditions (HCC). Monitor proposed changes, proactively identify potential risks to performance, as well as associated mitigation strategies.
    • Gathers data to create and publish Stars and Risk Adjustment dashboards and related metrics on a monthly basis. Proactively identifies and supports acquisition of new data sources.
    • Create and update reports for committees and other program-related teams, distributes actionable data to facilitate performance monitoring against current targets and year-end projections.
    • Works with internal and external teams to proactively identify and implement Stars and Risk Adjustement dashboard enhancements.
    • Validates CMS Stars plan performance reports (e.g., First Plan Preview, Westat MCAHPS reports) against internal data.
    • Suports ad hoc reporting requests for Stars and Risk Adjustment
  • Data Automation and Streamlining
    • Reasearch, design and develop data automation between disparate data systems through interfacing, APIs, ETLs, or other technological solutions.
    • Work collaboratively as part of project teams to understand, research and document requirements for data, workflows, and business needs.
    • Works independently to progress assigned work according to timeline and deadlines, work collaboratively to ensure that projects are meeting defined requirements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Participates in projects and cross-departmental teams that support the Stars program and Risk Adjustment.
    • Serves as the Stars and Risk Adjustment performance data subject matter expert in various workgroups and efforts (e.g., data strategies, HEDIS performance, provider performance platforms such as Cozeva, Cotiviti etc.).
    • Coordinates Stars performance data activities with related quality team activities (e.g., HEDIS data team, Primary Care Payment Model quality team, FQHC/RHC quality team). Coordinates Stars improvement activities with the HCC risk adjustment team to ensure integration and alignment of quality goals with HCC risk adjustment objectives.
    • Represents HMSA in Blues plan and/or other industry work groups to compare best practices for improving Stars performance data.
  • Performs all other miscellaneous responsibilities and duties as assigned or directed.

REPORTS TO: Senior Director, ChimeData Solutions


Position is hybrid, requiring onsite work in Wallingford, CT.


JOB SUMMARY:


The Connecticut Hospital Association (CHA) is the leading voice for Connecticut hospitals and healthcare providers, advancing community health through public policy and advocacy, research and education, innovative healthcare services, and collaboration with healthcare and community partners. ChimeData is CHA’s data and analytics organization, providing healthcare data, analytics, benchmarking, and insights to support hospitals, healthcare organizations, policymakers, and CHA’s internal teams.


CHA seeks a Data and Business Intelligence Analyst to expand the use of data to inform strategy, advocacy, decision-making, and member services. This position combines business intelligence, healthcare analytics, and applied data science, using SQL and/or Python, alongside Tableau or Power BI, to explore data, develop analytical products, and translate complex information into actionable insights. The analyst will support a broad range of CHA functions, including advocacy and public policy, finance, community health, quality and patient safety, and member services, providing data and analytical support to help teams understand challenges, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions.


The ideal candidate is an intellectually curious, self-directed problem solver with a foundational understanding of healthcare who enjoys solving complex problems or working through ambiguity and thinking outside the box. Working with colleagues at all levels of data expertise, this person will translate business needs into meaningful analytical solutions. The ability to move fluidly between data, healthcare, and people is just as important as technical skill.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


The analyst will support CHA’s cross-functional analytical needs, while proactively identifying opportunities to use data in new and meaningful ways.


  • Analyze healthcare, operational, financial, quality, utilization, and other data to answer strategic and business questions
  • Use SQL and/or Python to query, transform, validate, explore, and analyze data and develop repeatable analytical processes
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Tableau or Power BI
  • Translate ambiguous business questions into clearly defined analytical problems and develop practical, data-driven solutions
  • Partner with teams across CHA to understand their goals and identify how data and analytics can support decision-making
  • Communicate analytical findings, trends, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Explore new data sources and identify opportunities to combine, transform, or analyze data in ways that generate new insights
  • Perform data validation and quality checks and document data definitions, methodologies, and analytical processes
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting and analytical processes and improve the efficiency and usability of existing tools
  • Manage assigned analytical projects from problem definition through analysis, validation, and delivery
  • Build strong relationships across CHA and serve as a trusted analytical resource for colleagues and stakeholders
  • Stay current with emerging analytical methods, data technologies, visualization approaches, and responsible applications of AI and data science


QUALIFICATIONS:


Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, analytics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, information systems, business, healthcare administration, public health, or a related field; equivalent education and experience may be considered
  • Approximately 1–3 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, healthcare analytics, or a related analytical role
  • Experience working with healthcare data within a healthcare organization or in a healthcare-related environment
  • Demonstrated experience using SQL and/or Python for data querying, analysis, manipulation, automation, or related analytical applications
  • Experience with Tableau or Power BI and an understanding of effective data visualization principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work through ambiguous or complex questions
  • Ability to work with large or complex datasets and identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, and limitations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical concepts and findings to non-technical audiences
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders


Preferred:

  • Experience with statistical analysis or applied data science
  • Experience developing automated reporting or analytical workflows
  • Graduate degree in data science, analytics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, information systems, business, healthcare administration, public health, or a related field


Anticipated hiring range - $90,000-$110,000 annually


The hiring range reflects a good faith estimate of pay for this position as of the posting date. Actual pay will be determined based on qualifications, internal equity, and other factors. 


CHA offers participation in the following benefit programs: Medical, Vision, Paid Time Off, 401(k), Health Savings Account with employer contribution, Flexible Spending Account options, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, and additional supplemental benefits.
