If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider Craft Education as the next step in your career.

Craft Education is on a mission to solve skilled labor shortages by powering work-based learning pathways for all.

At Craft, we’re revolutionizing the apprenticeship degree, combining on-the-job learning with accredited instruction to create innovative educational pathways that accommodate working professionals and meet employer needs. Our flagship product - Craft Connect - helps organizations administer apprentice degree programs and address mission-critical data and reporting needs. Through the same platform, Craft is also transforming how on-the-job learning converts into academic credits.

Our team of technology, education and workforce professionals also provides technical assistance to organizations looking to launch and manage apprenticeship degree programs. We are working tirelessly to accelerate the expansion of these programs along with the data infrastructure that underpins them.

If you’re looking to join the work-based learning revolution, we’d love to talk with you. At Craft, you’ll have the opportunity to solve hard problems in a high-growth startup environment and make a lasting impact on the future of education and workforce development. We couldn’t be more excited to advance this work as a team of innovative, collaborative and mission-oriented professionals - we hope you’ll consider joining us.

The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

At WGU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is:

Grade: Professional 310

Pay Range: $91,000.00 - $136,400.00

Job Description

The Lead Data Analyst for Craft (https://www.crafteducation.com/) is responsible for extracting, processing, analyzing, and reporting on data to produce rigorous, actionable insights and research. They establish and maintain strong relationships with peers and leaders across IAR, Data Engineering, Product Management, Finance, EdTech, and Faculty staff. They perform ad hoc analyses, build standard reports and data visualizations, and deliver information and insights through various methods and media that privilege data storytelling and compress time-to-action.

  • This position will be expected to work in the Craft office located in Downtown Nashville..

Primary Responsibilities

  • Drives the documentation of data, analytics, and research needs in projects of high complexity with a student and equity-centered lens, collaborating with peers, cross-functional partners, faculty staff, and leaders.
  • Leads the translation of user stories into technical requirements.
  • Establishes trust and builds strong relationships with cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.
  • Answers complex business questions requiring extensive knowledge of the university’s data assets across several domains and departments.
  • Identifies adequate data sources and data sets to evaluate hypotheses and produce forecasts.
  • Collaborates with Data Engineering in the development of complex ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines.
  • Identifies, investigates, and solves complex data issues, contributing to the accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and validity of the university’s data.
  • Collaborates with Data Engineering and other data & analytics partners to define standards and best practices that increase data quality across the university.
  • Combines data analysis, visualization, and narrative structures to convey information in compelling ways that instigate deliberate action.
  • Participates in the definition of data visualization standards and best practices and promotes their adoption across the university.
  • Conveys information effectively to peers, partners, and senior leaders, using a variety of resources and formats (synchronous and asynchronous, verbal and written) such as e-mails, presentations, meetings, and workshops.
  • Creates and organizes information about processes, projects, operations, data assets, and insights from analyses and research, making it accessible in ways that increase the university’s knowledge and efficiency.
  • Writes and interprets technical documentation (e.g., Entity-Relationship, Conceptual, Logical, and Physical data models).
  • Contributes actively to the development of the university’s data management platforms (e.g., data dictionaries, catalogs, etc.).
  • Plays a prominent role in other team members’ development through constructive feedback and sharing of technical and institutional knowledge.
  • Drives tasks, activities, and medium-scale projects with high levels of autonomy, confidence, and collaboration with peers and partners.
  • Tracks and reports own progress, dependencies, and challenges diligently. Breaks down complex goals into concrete tasks and activities, and actively supports leaders in project planning.
  • Works actively to improve own skills and knowledge through internal and external, formal and informal, structured and unstructured learning. Is a lifelong learner and embodies a growth mindset. Stays abreast of innovative developments in their area of work and plays an active role in deploying them at the university.
  • Supports leadership in strategic planning and contributes to operational excellence across the department.
  • Understands and abides by the relevant policies and methods to access, use, transform, store, and delete data in responsible, secure, and compliant ways.
  • Identifies data security risks when dealing with concrete data sets and takes adequate mitigation actions.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

This job description includes a general representation of job requirements rather than a comprehensive inventory of all required responsibilities or work activities. The contents of this document or related job requirements may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Advanced SQL proficiency, with experience writing queries and subqueries, modifying, creating views, and knowledge of different join types, filtering, sorting, aggregation, window functions, common table expressions (CTE), and performance tuning.
  • Highly proficient and experienced in using tools like Tableau and Power BI to present data and information utilizing charts, graphs, and maps in ways that make it easy to understand trends, patterns, and outliers.
  • Ability to interpret and design models that describe how data relate to one another, and to the properties of the real-world entities they represent. Highly experienced in conceptual and logical data modeling, dimensional models, star schema, snowflake schema, and advanced concepts like slowly changing dimensions.
  • Comfortable with common project management methodologies and frameworks (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, SDLC).
  • Proficient in the MS Office suite, including advanced Excel knowledge.
  • Proficient in flowchart and diagramming tools like Miro, Visio, Lucidchart, and similar applications.
  • Familiarized with the university’s most relevant KPIs, the drivers that affect them, and plays an active role in their definition and tracking.
  • Ability to apply sound judgment, systems-thinking, and analytical skills to assess risks, perform root-cause analyses, make recommendations, and drive cross-functional decisions that contribute to the achievement of the university’s objectives.
  • Ability to perform with very high levels of autonomy, reliability, self-direction, and with a bias for action. Manages conflicting and concurrent activities with minimal need for supervision.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline

Experience

  • 7 years of related experience in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Decision Intelligence, Research, Learning Science, or Behavioral/Cognitive Psychology.

Experience In Lieu Of Education

An equivalent combination of training, experience, credentials, or accomplishments demonstrating the ability to perform the essential functions of this job may substitute for education degree requirements.

Travel

This position requires occasional travel of up to 20%, including required attendance at designated company summits (typically one to two per year). Additional travel may include conferences, visits to company locations, and other business-related events as needed. Additional travel may be assigned as needed to support business requirements.

If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider Craft Education as the next step in your career.

Craft Education is on a mission to solve skilled labor shortages by powering work-based learning pathways for all.

At Craft, we’re revolutionizing the apprenticeship degree, combining on-the-job learning with accredited instruction to create innovative educational pathways that accommodate working professionals and meet employer needs. Our flagship product - Craft Connect - helps organizations administer apprentice degree programs and address mission-critical data and reporting needs. Through the same platform, Craft is also transforming how on-the-job learning converts into academic credits.

Our team of technology, education and workforce professionals also provides technical assistance to organizations looking to launch and manage apprenticeship degree programs. We are working tirelessly to accelerate the expansion of these programs along with the data infrastructure that underpins them.

If you’re looking to join the work-based learning revolution, we’d love to talk with you. At Craft, you’ll have the opportunity to solve hard problems in a high-growth startup environment and make a lasting impact on the future of education and workforce development. We couldn’t be more excited to advance this work as a team of innovative, collaborative and mission-oriented professionals - we hope you’ll consider joining us.

The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

At WGU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is:

Job Description

The Lead Data Analyst for Craft (https://www.crafteducation.com/) is responsible for extracting, processing, analyzing, and reporting on data to produce rigorous, actionable insights and research. They establish and maintain strong relationships with peers and leaders across IAR, Data Engineering, Product Management, Finance, EdTech, and Faculty staff. They perform ad hoc analyses, build standard reports and data visualizations, and deliver information and insights through various methods and media that privilege data storytelling and compress time-to-action.



-  This position will be expected to work in the Craft office located in Downtown Nashville..

Primary Responsibilities



- Drives the documentation of data, analytics, and research needs in projects of high complexity with a student and equity-centered lens, collaborating with peers, cross-functional partners, faculty staff, and leaders. 
- Leads the translation of user stories into technical requirements.
- Establishes trust and builds strong relationships with cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.
- Answers complex business questions requiring extensive knowledge of the university’s data assets across several domains and departments.
- Identifies adequate data sources and data sets to evaluate hypotheses and produce forecasts.
- Collaborates with Data Engineering in the development of complex ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines.
- Identifies, investigates, and solves complex data issues, contributing to the accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and validity of the university’s data.
- Collaborates with Data Engineering and other data & analytics partners to define standards and best practices that increase data quality across the university.
- Combines data analysis, visualization, and narrative structures to convey information in compelling ways that instigate deliberate action.
- Participates in the definition of data visualization standards and best practices and promotes their adoption across the university.
- Conveys information effectively to peers, partners, and senior leaders, using a variety of resources and formats (synchronous and asynchronous, verbal and written) such as e-mails, presentations, meetings, and workshops.
- Creates and organizes information about processes, projects, operations, data assets, and insights from analyses and research, making it accessible in ways that increase the university’s knowledge and efficiency.
- Writes and interprets technical documentation (e.g., Entity-Relationship, Conceptual, Logical, and Physical data models).
- Contributes actively to the development of the university’s data management platforms (e.g., data dictionaries, catalogs, etc.).
- Plays a prominent role in other team members’ development through constructive feedback and sharing of technical and institutional knowledge.
- Drives tasks, activities, and medium-scale projects with high levels of autonomy, confidence, and collaboration with peers and partners.
- Tracks and reports own progress, dependencies, and challenges diligently. Breaks down complex goals into concrete tasks and activities, and actively supports leaders in project planning.
- Works actively to improve own skills and knowledge through internal and external, formal and informal, structured and unstructured learning. Is a lifelong learner and embodies a growth mindset. Stays abreast of innovative developments in their area of work and plays an active role in deploying them at the university.
- Supports leadership in strategic planning and contributes to operational excellence across the department.
- Understands and abides by the relevant policies and methods to access, use, transform, store, and delete data in responsible, secure, and compliant ways.
- Identifies data security risks when dealing with concrete data sets and takes adequate mitigation actions.
- Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

This job description includes a general representation of job requirements rather than a comprehensive inventory of all required responsibilities or work activities. The contents of this document or related job requirements may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities



- Advanced SQL proficiency, with experience writing queries and subqueries, modifying, creating views, and knowledge of different join types, filtering, sorting, aggregation, window functions, common table expressions (CTE), and performance tuning.
- Highly proficient and experienced in using tools like Tableau and Power BI to present data and information utilizing charts, graphs, and maps in ways that make it easy to understand trends, patterns, and outliers.
- Ability to interpret and design models that describe how data relate to one another, and to the properties of the real-world entities they represent. Highly experienced in conceptual and logical data modeling, dimensional models, star schema, snowflake schema, and advanced concepts like slowly changing dimensions.
- Comfortable with common project management methodologies and frameworks (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, SDLC).
- Proficient in the MS Office suite, including advanced Excel knowledge.
- Proficient in flowchart and diagramming tools like Miro, Visio, Lucidchart, and similar applications.
- Familiarized with the university’s most relevant KPIs, the drivers that affect them, and plays an active role in their definition and tracking.
- Ability to apply sound judgment, systems-thinking, and analytical skills to assess risks, perform root-cause analyses, make recommendations, and drive cross-functional decisions that contribute to the achievement of the university’s objectives.
- Ability to perform with very high levels of autonomy, reliability, self-direction, and with a bias for action. Manages conflicting and concurrent activities with minimal need for supervision.

Education 



- Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline

Experience



- 7 years of related experience in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, Data Science, Statistics, Decision Intelligence, Research, Learning Science, or Behavioral/Cognitive Psychology.

Experience In Lieu Of Education

An equivalent combination of training, experience, credentials, or accomplishments demonstrating the ability to perform the essential functions of this job may substitute for education degree requirements.

Travel

This position requires occasional travel of up to 20%, including required attendance at designated company summits (typically one to two per year). Additional travel may include conferences, visits to company locations, and other business-related events as needed. Additional travel may be assigned as needed to support business requirements.

Position & Application Details

Full-Time Regular Positions (classified as regular and working 40 standard weekly hours): This is a full-time, regular position (classified for 40 standard weekly hours) that is eligible for bonuses; medical, dental, vision, telehealth and mental healthcare; health savings account and flexible spending account; basic and voluntary life insurance; disability coverage; accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity supplemental coverages; legal and identity theft coverage; retirement savings plan; wellbeing program; discounted WGU tuition; and flexible paid time off for rest and relaxation with no need for accrual, flexible paid sick time with no need for accrual, 11 paid holidays, and other paid leaves, including up to 12 weeks of parental leave.

How to Apply: If interested, an application will need to be submitted online. Internal WGU employees will need to apply through the internal job board in Workday.

Additional Information

Disclaimer: The job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job. It’s not all-inclusive.

At Stout, we’re dedicated to exceeding expectations in all we do – we call it Relentless Excellence ®. Both our client service and culture are second to none, stemming from our firmwide embrace of our core values: Positive and Team-Oriented, Accountable, Committed, Relationship-Focused, Super-Responsive, and being Great communicators. Sound like a place you can grow and succeed? Read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity to join our team.

Stout's Transformative Change practice combines data analysis, research, strategy, and operational experience to help clients achieve sustainable change in complex environments. The practice helps clients meet financial objectives, implement strategic initiatives, address compliance requirements, and evaluate impact.

Engagements may focus on designing, implementing, and improving programs, policies, and operational processes for clients, including government entities and nonprofit organizations. We work with nonprofit legal organizations, pro bono counsel, government entities, and court-appointed monitors on matters involving housing, education, disability rights, public benefits, immigration, family and child rights, and related civil rights and system reform issues.

Impact You’ll Make

As a Data Analyst in Stout’s Transformative Change practice, you’ll turn complex structured and unstructured information into clear, accurate analyses and accessible visualizations. Your work will help teams and clients understand data quality, identify relationships across information sources, and make informed decisions in support of transformative change initiatives.

  • Translate complex data into understandable visualizations and client-ready findings.
  • Support data collection, monitoring, and visualization for collaborative, multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Contribute analytical insights to data-driven strategy planning, financial and fiscal impact assessments, and implementation milestones.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify, normalize, and analyze large structured and unstructured datasets, including data limitations and quality issues.
  • Assess relationships among multiple data sources and organize information for effective analysis.
  • Design and implement database models; download, store, and import raw data; and maintain SQL database tables.
  • Use business intelligence tools, including Tableau, to build robust visualizations and practical client-facing tools.
  • Apply complex extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes and SQL querying to prepare and analyze data.
  • Maintain detailed workpapers documenting assumptions, methodologies, and information sources.
  • Translate key findings from technical analyses in clear, simple terms for non-technical audiences.
  • Conduct industry and technical research; prepare analyses, reports, and presentations.
  • Coordinate day-to-day project activities with clients, internal teams, and other engagement professionals.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, information technology, mathematics, accounting, economics, finance, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in data analytics, problem-solving, coding, or related work.
  • Proficiency with Tableau; Tableau Desktop Specialist or Tableau Certified Data Analyst credential preferred, not required.
  • Proficiency in SQL and database management, including table creation, data imports and transformation, coding, and querying.
  • Experience with ETL processes and working in a team-oriented environment.
  • Python programming experience preferred, not required.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot data quality issues, reconcile discrepancies, and ensure data accuracy and completeness.
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative research skills, with the ability to analyze complex data and financial or operational documents.

How You’ll Thrive

  • Communicate clearly and regularly with internal and external stakeholders about project status, timelines, and findings.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, manage multiple workstreams independently, ask timely questions, and adapt to evolving priorities and deadlines.
  • Deliver accurate, high-quality work under tight deadlines and review others’ work for quality assurance.
  • Combine sound analytical judgment with thoughtful visual presentation, including color, spatial relationships, and appropriate data density.
  • Collaborate effectively, demonstrate initiative, and use technology to solve complex problems.
  • Demonstrate Stout’s values: Positive and Team-Oriented, Accountable, Committed, Relationship-Focused, Super-Responsive, and Great Communicators.
  • Deliver Relentless Excellence® through careful documentation, collaboration, and responsive client service.

Why Stout?

At Stout, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards program with competitive compensation, benefits, and wellness options tailored to support employees at every stage of life.

We foster a culture of inclusion and respect, embracing diverse perspectives and experiences to drive innovation and success. Our leadership is committed to inclusion and belonging across the organization and in the communities we serve.

We invest in professional growth through ongoing training, mentorship, employee resource groups, and clear performance feedback, ensuring our employees are supported in achieving their career goals.

Stout provides flexible work schedules and a discretionary time off policy to promote work-life balance and help employees lead fulfilling lives.

Learn more about our benefits and commitment to your success.

We are partnering with a highly quantitative, data-driven organization seeking a Data Analyst to support reporting, analytics, and data management initiatives across a complex business environment. This role sits at the intersection of data, operations, and business stakeholders, helping answer critical questions, deliver trusted reporting, and improve access to information across the organization.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze large and complex datasets to answer business questions and support decision-making
  • Develop and run SQL-based data extracts from multiple databases and systems
  • Deliver reporting and analytical support for operational, compliance, finance, and business functions
  • Handle ad hoc requests and time-sensitive reporting deliverables
  • Validate data accuracy through reconciliations, cross-checks, and quality control processes
  • Investigate discrepancies and work with stakeholders to ensure reporting integrity
  • Document reporting methodologies, business rules, and data definitions
  • Identify recurring reporting needs and partner with technical teams to develop scalable solutions
  • Help define requirements, business logic, edge cases, and testing criteria for new reporting tools and dashboards
  • Contribute to the development of self-service reporting and business intelligence capabilities


Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, analytics engineering, or a related field
  • Advanced SQL skills with experience writing complex queries, joins, aggregations, and CTEs
  • Python experience for data analysis, automation, and repeatable reporting workflows
  • Experience working with large-scale transactional, operational, or financial datasets
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Ability to communicate methodologies and findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience gathering requirements and working with engineering or development teams
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, technical, or related discipline


Preferred Experience

  • Exposure to regulatory, compliance, audit, tax, or financial reporting processes
  • Experience creating scalable reporting frameworks and self-service analytics solutions
  • Familiarity with data governance, controls, and reporting best practices

Job Description

We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About The Role

Job description

Summary

This role supports the organization's strategic decision-making process by providing timely, accurate data analysis and visualizations to the leadership team. The analyst leads end-to-end ETL processes and builds dashboards using tools such as Microsoft Power BI, SQL, and BigQuery, curating a reporting suite that evolves with the changing needs of the business. The role combines technical expertise in data management and visualization with strong business acumen and communication skills to translate complex insights for stakeholders at every level. As a liaison between technical data operations and executive decision-making, the Senior Business Intelligence Analyst plays a pivotal part in driving the organization's strategic initiatives and growth.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead end to end ETL processes, including data extraction, transformation, and loading, to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and security of data used for analysis.
  • Develop and maintain interactive dashboards in Microsoft Power BI that give the leadership team clear, data driven visualizations to support decision-making.
  • Use SQL and BigQuery to run complex data queries and analyses, identifying trends, patterns, and opportunities for operational and business improvements.
  • Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand requirements, share insights, and support data driven decision-making and continuous improvement.
  • Communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly, adjusting the message for different audiences, including executives and team members.
  • Coach and mentor team members on best practices in data analysis, ETL processes, and dashboard development to build a strong, collaborative team.

Essential

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field.
  • Four or more years of relevant experience in a business intelligence or data analytics role.
  • Working proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and ETL processes.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn data into a business story.

Desirable (recruiter may evaluate whether to retain)

  • Additional certifications in business intelligence tools and systems.
  • Direct experience with BigQuery or a comparable cloud data warehouse.
  • Prior experience training or mentoring other analysts.
  • Experience leading or overseeing business intelligence projects.

We power infinite possibilities.

For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.

We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.

Description

The Finance Data Analyst will play a critical role in supporting finance, executive, and operational teams by ensuring data integrity, delivering actionable insights, and driving financial reporting and operational excellence. This position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across departments to build business intelligence dashboards and enhance reporting capabilities. The Finance Data Analyst will also interpret data, identify trends, and visualize findings to communicate insights effectively.

This is a full-time, in-office position based at our Westfield, Indiana location. The successful candidate will be expected to work on-site in the Westfield office.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Extract and process data from various sources, including databases, APIs, and reports generated from a variety of internal programs, external sources and software providers
  • Design and optimize enterprise-level reporting data workflows to improve efficiency and scalability
  • Ensure data integrity and consistency by cleaning data, identifying and correcting any errors, troubleshooting missing values and understanding the business to ensure data aligns with and validates business results & KPI’s
  • Analyze and interpret datasets using statistical analysis, focusing on trends and patterns
  • Develop and create reports and dashboards to present findings to stakeholders
  • Communicate visual representations of data using tools such as Tableau or Power BI to make insights understandable
  • Write and optimize SQL queries against large-scale datasets
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data needs and provide support for consolidated reporting and data driven decision-making.
  • Develop and deliver ad hoc analysis projects to address urgent business concerns as they develop utilizing data in real time
  • Support strategic objectives by establishing KPIs, refining key performance indicators and other quantifiable business objectives to measure the effectiveness of business initiatives
  • Partner with leadership and act as a business intelligence consultant to executives and other functional leaders to identify improvement opportunities and guide strategic planning

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field (Statistics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related)
  • 3+ years of data analysis / business intelligence experience
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL, Python, R, and Excel
  • Experience in machine learning, predictive modeling, or statistical analysis
  • Experience with NetSuite ERP, Power BI, Tableau or other visualization tools
  • Demonstrated ability to understand manufacturing business needs and speak to technical and non-technical operational business groups
  • Strong communication skills, with demonstrated ability to present and explain the significance of data to business stakeholders
  • Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Visio, etc.); NetSuite experience; Web proficiency.

Working Conditions

  • Primarily works in an office environment in Westfield, IN with frequent interaction on the manufacturing floor.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit and work at a desk for long periods of time
  • Ability to perform close visual work for prolonged periods of time

descriptionHtml:
Integration meets Innovation

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we’re on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

As a Product Data Analyst  you will play a critical role in Celigo’s success and help execute quantitative research tasks throughout the product development lifecycle to ensure that we’re solving the right problems and providing the right solutions for our target audiences and users. The Product Data Analyst  works strategically, proactively, and collaboratively to inform and influence product roadmaps and business goals.

We are seeking a Product Data Analyst to partner closely with UX Research, Product Management, Design, Content, Engineering, and Customer-facing teams to uncover actionable insights from behavioral and product usage data.

This role sits within the UX Research team in the Product organization and will partner closely with  product managers and designers to uncover actionable insights from behavioral and product usage data.

This is not a reporting-only role. It is a strategic position focused on uncovering, identifying, and transforming complex data into clear recommendations that drive measurable improvements in user experience, adoption, retention, and business impact.

What would you do if hired?
  • Partner with members of the Design, Content, and Product Management teams to uncover what they need to learn from quantitative data sources (and why) and then identify, pull, and analyze the necessary data to provide them with actionable insights rather than tables of raw data.
  • Collaborate closely with designers to define, track, and report on metrics that demonstrate the business and user impact of their work as well as craft measurable hypotheses for new and existing features.
  • Be curious, proactively analyze data, and surface insights that influence product strategy, roadmap decisions, and customer experience improvements.
  • Help train peers to effectively utilize user research findings and usage metrics to guide and improve design decisions.
  • Support research operations tasks such as pulling recruitment lists and answering ad-hoc data questions.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting frameworks that empower cross-functional teams.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
  • Identify leading indicators of engagement, activation, retention, and expansion.
  • Collaborate with Product Operations, Engineering, and Data teams to ensure clean, reliable event tracking and instrumentation.
  • Influence stakeholders across functions to gain support for research-based, user-centric solutions.

Who are we looking for?Skills & Abilities
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills, along with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask and operate as a consultant across multiple product areas.
  • Ability to analyze and synthesize data, and guide product managers, designers, and engineers on how to act on the findings.
  • Aptitude for learning complex technological concepts.
  • Actively seeks and offers candid, constructive feedback with curiosity, humility, and openness.

Education & Experience  

  • 4–6+ years of experience in Product Analytics or a similar role supporting B2B SaaS or enterprise software products.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience querying large datasets from multiple applications in a data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake).
  • Experience working with product analytics tools (e.g., Pendo, Google Analytics) and BI tools (e.g., Sigma).
  • Experience in defining and measuring KPIs such as activation, engagement, retention, churn, and feature adoption.
  • Work samples (case studies, portfolio, website, or similar) demonstrating the depth and breadth of your abilities, and their impact on the business.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS, enterprise, or technically complex platforms.
  • Proven experience working with multi-disciplinary teams (Design, Engineering, Business, R&D, and others) to ideate, iterate, launch, and refine new product designs.
  • Experience with statistical tools (e.g., R, Python). Experience with methods such as cluster analysis, multivariate regressions, and two-proportion Z-tests is a plus.
  • Degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field (or equivalent experience).

Celigo reasonably expects to pay a base salary between $140,0000 and $175,000 per year for this position. Actual starting base pay will be determined by skills, experience, geographic location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, benefits, or other perks as outlined in any formal employment offer made.

Celigo is proud to be

  • A 2025 Gartner Customers’ Choice for iPaaS. The only vendor to receive this award.
  • Celigo is a Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for iPaaS for the second consecutive year
  • Celigo is ranked #1 iPaaS on G2 for multiple quarters and named a Leader in both B2B/EDI and API Management.
  • Celigo is a leading intelligent automation platform that puts the power of automation in the hands of every team, unifying workflows from the predictable to the fully agentic in a single platform.

Here you'll experience

  • Remote-first culture, built on trust, collaboration, and transparency
  • A high-growth, inclusive work environment where innovation thrives and ideas are implemented
  • Lightspeed learning opportunities to keep you at the leading edge of your field
  • Exceptional coworkers who challenge and inspire you daily
  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including:
    • Three weeks of vacation (starting year one)
    • Wellness days and holidays to recharge
    • Parental leave and a generous benefits package
    • Monthly tech stipend
    • Recognition and career development opportunities

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility

As a company, one of the values we hold most dear is fostering a safe, collaborative environment to bring out the best in us, so we created our Taking a Stand Initiative. Our TAS initiative is a volunteer committee open to all Celigans, with representation from underrepresented voices within our company. We believe, unequivocally, that everyone deserves to be in a place where they feel welcome as they are. Learn more about Taking a Stand.

Celigo is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, disability, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. descriptionHtml:
Overview

FTI is seeking a Data Analyst to support equipment readiness and integration on its Navy Expeditionary Combat Command (NECC) project in Norfolk, VA. The analyst will work hand-in-hand with the NECC CDM/ILS Program Manager to act as a subject matter expert for enterprise equipment Configuration Data Management Systems (Enterprise Resource Planning, Configuration Data Management Database – Open Architecture, and other associated Department of Defense systems, as required). This job requires at least a DoD Secret clearance and will require candidates to be onsite at the Joint Expeditionary Base in Little Creek, VA.

Responsibilities

  • Utilize Jupiter within the Advana platform to integrate and utilize naval data across readiness pillars.
  • Ability to create reports, dashboards, and data sets for collaboration internally and externally of the organization.
  • Ability to bring multiple data sources together, perform data cleanup, shaping, and modeling to produce visualizations and reports that support and enable actionable insights.
  • Assist in the collection of data, conduct analytical reviews, and make recommendations for improving Equipment Readiness policies.
  • Assist in the promulgation of software development requirements for Readiness Reporting and cost models for NECC and OPNAV on NECC’s behalf.
  • Perform analysis of raw data and provide decision-supporting products such as historical trends, reports, graphical data presentations, and recommendations.
  • Assist with and/or independently perform quantitative analysis of financial, materiel inventory and materiel assessments data against risk management problem set.
  • Utilize mathematical and statistical methods to provide the value of materiel solutions required to increase combat power and readiness from the force down to the individual unit level.
  • Assist with and/or independently prepares economic analysis of NECC force wide materiel asset requirements, commonly referred to as Table of Allowance (TOA) and TOA inventory, including conducting research of historical cost data of TOA maintenance, replacement and technical refresh for NECC units (Tables of Allowance).
  • Analysis of current resource utilization and projection of future resource requirements for segments (sections) of materiel; and research and completion of routine and/or continuing cost studies.
  • Participate in the development of procurement plans and program objectives by evaluating cost/readiness tradeoffs, budget requirements/constraints, etc.
  • Assist with and/or independently perform special assignments in keeping with the Materiel Readiness strategic objectives, such as cross-functional team initiatives and force readiness improvement initiatives. Includes administrative assignments to develop knowledge of the mission and organization of the force material readiness community.

Education/Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or equivalent graduate degree, or 4 full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and possess and active Secret DoD Clearance.

descriptionHtml:
The IoT Data Analyst will leverage connected-device data from DEXIS equipment globally to develop actionable insights that improve customer experience, increase commercial effectiveness, and drive revenue growth. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product Management, Commercial Operations, Sales Leadership, and Customer Support teams to transform complex IoT data into automated reporting, dashboards, and predictive insights. The analyst will serve as a key contributor in identifying trends, developing KPIs, and enabling data-driven business decisions across the organization.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • Leverage IoT equipment data to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable insights that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and revenue growth.
  • Demonstrate ability to leverage AI, machine learning and advanced analytics tools to accelerate experience managing, querying, and analyzing large-scale datasets within cloud-based data platforms such as AWS, Snowflake, Databricks or similar enterprise data environments.
  • Proficiency in data engineering and analytics programming languages to translate complex data into measurable business outcomes and influence commercial decisions.
  • Experience transforming large-scale IoT, device telemetry and customer usage data into actionable insights thorough ETL/ELT processes, collaborating with subject matter experts to identify trends, improved customer outcomes, optimize support operations and uncover revenue growth opportunities.
  • Demonstrate ability to leverage AI, machine learning and advanced analytic tools to accelerate insight generation, automate workflows and improve business decision-making.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product Management, Sales, Commercial Operations, and Customer Support teams to translate business needs into data-driven solutions and recommendations.
  • Integrate and analyze data from multiple sources, including IoT, CRM, ERP, and business intelligence platforms, to improve decision-making and reporting capabilities.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and identify opportunities for process improvements, customer engagement, and commercial growth.
  • Monitor and improve data quality through validation, anomaly detection, and ongoing governance practices.
  • Define, track, and communicate project and business performance metrics to measure the impact of IoT-driven initiatives.
  • Manage ad hoc analytical requests and present findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the global organization.
  • Support the development of predictive and proactive insights that help identify customer needs and potential revenue opportunities.
  • Travel up to 10% as business needs require.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience considered.
  • 3-5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or commercial operations.
  • Experience with BI platforms such as, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
  • Experience analyzing large datasets.
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience working with CRM systems.
  • Experience supporting global stakeholders and cross-functional teams within Sales, Marketing, Operations, Engineering, and Customer Support functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • IoT/connected-device data experience.
  • Medical device or dental industry experience.
  • Commercial analytics and revenue-growth insights.
  • Predictive analytics/AI experience.
  • Experience with SQL, Python, Scala and/or other related technologies. used for data processing, automation and advanced analytics.

This opportunity is in the Business Intelligence & Planning department.

The Business Intelligence & Planning Department is dedicated to empowering informed decision-making and driving strategic growth through comprehensive financial planning, data-driven insights, and governance excellence. Our mission is to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable intelligence to all stakeholders around the company by leveraging the strengths of our integrated teams, including Planning & Reserving, Portfolio Management, BI Analysis, BI Data Analysis, Data Quality and Data Governance. Together, we support a culture of data excellence and financial foresight.

Role Description:

As a Business Intelligence Data Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming data into meaningful insights that drive business decisions across the organization. You will work closely with business partners to understand reporting needs and translate them into technical solutions, building and maintaining reports and dashboards using tools like Power BI and SSRS.

In this role, you will leverage your SQL expertise to query and manage data across multiple systems, ensuring accuracy and consistency in reporting outputs. You will also support data validation, assist in refining reporting processes, and contribute to documentation that enhances transparency and usability.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, solving business problems, and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver impactful analytics solutions in a dynamic and growing environment.

Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, information systems, computer science, or a related field is preferred

Required Qualifications:

  • 1 or more years of experience in reporting, data analysis, or analytics within a business environment
  • Prior experience interpreting business requirements and translating to technical requirements
  • Ability to read, write, and modify moderately complex SQL queries
  • Prior experience managing data tables and strong knowledge of common data structures and table joins
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills including proficiency in vlookups, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and writing moderately complex formulas
  • Prior hands-on experience providing reporting and/or data visualization using Power BI or SSRS / Visual Studio
  • Must be presently authorized to work in the U.S. without a requirement for work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future
  • This position allows for a hybrid work schedule which includes a minimum of 3 days per week in our St. Louis Corporate Office, located at 1832 Schuetz Rd. Saint Louis, MO. All employees are required to submit work from home requests and follow our Work From Home policy, which will be provided to all candidates selected to interview.

  • Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, information systems, computer science, or a related field
  • Prior experience with Snowflake data cloud

We are seeking a Data Analyst to support reporting, data quality processes, analytical projects, and data-driven decision making across the organization. This role will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, develop actionable insights, and support operational and strategic initiatives through analysis and reporting. The Data Analyst will also support quantitative analysis and data-informed planning to evaluate program effectiveness, monitor operational performance, and inform strategic decision-making across schools and organizational functions. This may include analyzing trends, assessing outcomes of organizational initiatives, supporting enrollment and operational planning, and supporting academic and operational reporting processes such as report cards and progress monitoring.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with large datasets. This position is well-suited for a professional with strong technical aptitude and an interest in data analytics, reporting, statistical analysis, and operational problem-solving in an education setting.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Reporting & Analytics

  • Create and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, and visualizations for operational and academic stakeholders.
  • Support report card, progress monitoring, enrollment, attendance, assessment, and other school-based reporting processes.
  • Conduct analyses to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support school and organizational goals.
  • Present findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Quantitative Analysis & Strategic Support

  • Support analytical projects using quantitative and statistical methods.
  • Conduct trend analysis and support forecasting and planning initiatives using historical and operational data.
  • Analyze program effectiveness and operational outcomes to support continuous improvement efforts.
  • Identify patterns, risk indicators, and opportunities for operational and academic improvement.


Data Quality & Data Management

  • Perform data validation, auditing, cleaning, and quality assurance checks across multiple systems and datasets.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve data inconsistencies, missing values, and reporting anomalies.
  • Support efforts to improve data accuracy, consistency, reliability, and documentation practices.
  • Maintain documentation related to reports, metrics, business rules, and data processes.


Data Systems Support

  • Support the maintenance and monitoring of data systems and data warehouse processes.
  • Assist with data integration, transformation, and validation activities.
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies, report issues, and address system-related data concerns.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support operational and reporting needs across schools and departments.


Collaboration & Operational Support

  • Work collaboratively with school-based and central teams to understand reporting and analytical needs.
  • Support users with dashboards, reports, data interpretation, and troubleshooting.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to analytics, reporting, and data governance.


Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, or a related field with at least 2 years of relevant analytics experience; or Master’s degree in a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with data analysis concepts and statistical methods.
  • Experience working with spreadsheets and datasets.
  • Basic proficiency in SQL for querying and manipulating data.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to communicate findings clearly and effectively.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI or similar).
  • Familiarity with Python or R for data analysis and data cleaning.
  • Understanding of relational databases and data warehouse concepts.
  • Knowledge of ETL processes and data transformation workflows.
  • Familiarity with statistical analysis techniques such as regression, forecasting, or trend analysis.
  • Ability to interpret data and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Experience working in K-12 education, nonprofit, healthcare, or mission-driven organizations is a plus.
  • Familiarity with student information systems, enrollment data, attendance data, assessment data, or report card processes is a plus.


Technical Skills

  • Python or R
  • Power BI
  • SQL
  • Excel
  • Data visualization tools
  • Statistical analysis
  • Data cleaning and validation
  • Reporting and dashboard development


Soft Skills

  • Problem-solving mindset
  • Detail-oriented mindset
  • Critical thinking and curiosity
  • Effective written and verbal communication
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively
  • Strong organizational skills


Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Interested in using data to support educational outcomes and organizational decision-making.
  • Curious and eager to learn new analytical tools and techniques.
  • Comfortable working with data and identifying patterns, trends, or operational challenges.
  • Able to balance technical tasks with communication and collaboration.
  • Interested in applying analytical and quantitative methods to solve operational and educational problems.


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Starting Salary $65,000. Salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.
  • Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement: 403(b) retirement plan – Employer Match
  • Leave: Paid time off, paid sick leave, parental leave, and FMLA.
  • Additional Benefits: Short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, and $5,000 annual tuition reimbursement.

Whether you're early in your career or bringing years of experience, you'll find opportunities to grow, take ownership, and make meaningful contributions from day one. We know every employee brings unique talents and perspectives that fuel our success, and we seek driven individuals who are excited to make an impact in a fun, fast-moving culture.

The responsibilities of this position are to assist the MBU data team with the collection, organizing, and analysis of Thorlabs' various data sets. The range of these data sets include manufacturing, engineering, marketing, sales, pricing, and ERP. The Data Analyst will be able to autonomously analyze qualitative data, trends, strategies, and markets aimed at increasing the company's competitiveness. Although the location of the position is in Newton, NJ, from time to time it may be required to undertake duties at other Thorlabs locations.

Essential Job Functions include the following, but are not limited to:

  • Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources to identify patterns, trends, and correlations using tools such as SQL, Python, or Power BI
  • Develop and implement data models, algorithms, and statistical techniques to extract insights and generate reports, dashboards, and visualizations that inform data-driven decision-making
  • Conduct thorough data validation and quality assurance checks to ensure accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data
  • Interpret data findings and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders, including business leaders and other relevant teams, to drive business performance and optimize operational processes
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and execute data-driven strategies that align with business objectives
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data analysis, and apply them to improve data-driven decision-making within the organization
  • Participate in data governance initiatives, including data documentation, data lineage, and data security, to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and data standards
  • Lead improvement initiatives where needed
  • Determine and clarify strategic and operational issues via consultation
  • Track success of key initiatives (Corporate Initiatives, Kaizens, Product Line Reviews)
  • Aid Managers/Supervisors in area performance capture and presentation
  • Compile and present information verbally, visually and in writing
  • Occasionally lead operational training initiatives

In addition to the essential functions and duties listed above, all positions are also responsible for:

  • Meeting company standards pertaining to quantity and quality of work performed on an ongoing basis, performing all work-related tasks in a manner that is compliant with all Company policies and procedures
  • Adhering to Company policies, procedures, and directives regarding standards of workplace behavior in completing job duties and assignments

The Company retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position.

Annual salary range for this position is $83,000 - $103,000 depending on experience

Requirements

Experience:

  • 2-to-5-year experience with data visualization best practices and the ability to create visually compelling reports, dashboards, and visualizations that effectively communicate complex data findings to non-technical stakeholders
  • Familiarity with data validation, data quality assurance, and data cleansing techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Computer Science or related fields

Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with data analysis techniques and tools, such as SQL, Python, Power BI, or Excel
  • Knowledge of data modeling, data warehousing, and data integration concepts
  • Ability to apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to analyze data, identify patterns, trends, and correlations, and provide actionable recommendations for business decision-making
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively communicate complex data findings to diverse audiences
  • Experience with machine learning, predictive analytics, or data mining techniques is a plus

descriptionHtml:
About Thrive Market

Thrive Market was founded in 2014 with a mission to make healthy and sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone. As an online, membership-based market, we deliver the highest quality healthy, and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need. Every day, we leverage innovative technology and member-first thinking to help our over 1,600,000+ members find better products, support better brands, and build a better world in the process. We are also a Certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation, and a Climate Neutral Certified company.

Join us as we bring healthy and sustainable living to millions of Americans in the years to come.

THE ROLE

At Thrive Market, data is core to how we operate, innovate, and grow. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst (Lifecycle Marketing) to play a critical role in turning data into strategic insight - guiding decisions for the Lifecycle Marketing team.

This role goes beyond building dashboards or pulling reports. Reporting into the Senior Manager, Data Analytics & Engineering, you'll help translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that shape business outcomes. Whether it's analyzing member behavior, optimizing campaigns, or supporting cross-functional initiatives, you'll bring rigor, curiosity, and clarity to every conversation.

You’ll be a trusted analytics partner to leaders across Thrive Market, connecting data to real-world outcomes, and helping teams make smarter, faster decisions every day.

Responsibilities

  • Lead high-impact, end-to-end analytics projects that inform key business and product strategies.
  • Partner cross-functionally with stakeholders to align on priorities and translate questions into analytical frameworks.
  • Deliver clear, data-driven insights that influence decision-making across the organization.
  • Design and maintain dashboards, models, and datasets that empower business teams to self-serve and track performance.
  • Identify data quality issues and help resolve inconsistencies across source systems.
  • Support lifecycle and engagement analytics to inform retention, LTV, and user journey improvements.
  • Collaborate with Finance to measure and forecast the financial impact of product and business decisions.
  • Respond to ad hoc analytical requests with accuracy, efficiency, and business context.
  • Bring thought leadership to Thrive Market’s data practices — recommending new ways to enhance our analytical toolkit and processes.

Support The Retention Marketing Team

  • Partner with the Retention Marketing team to evaluate customer journey touchpoints, measuring the effectiveness of email, SMS, and app engagement campaigns.
  • Build dashboards and models to monitor lifecycle KPIs (churn, reactivation, engagement rates), identifying opportunities to improve retention and loyalty.
  • Deliver insights that inform personalization strategies and CRM segmentation, enabling more relevant, data-driven communications that enhance customer lifetime value.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in data analytics, with a strong track record of business impact.
  • MBA with a focus in analytics, strategy, or a related quantitative field.
  • Ability to translate business questions into analytical frameworks and provide actionable, prescriptive insights to stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Domo, Looker, Tableau) with a focus on self-serve dashboard governance.
  • Advanced SQL skills with experience in cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery).
  • Experience using DBT and Python for data manipulation, transformation, and processing.
  • Strong foundation in statistics and multivariate regression.
  • Expertise in building and interpreting member segmentation models to drive personalized lifecycle campaigns.
  • Proven track record of designing, executing, and analyzing complex A/B and multivariate tests across channels (email, SMS, push, onsite).
  • Strong ability to connect CRM metrics (e.g., retention, LTV, churn, reactivation, ROAS) to overall business impact
  • Ability to clearly communicate insights to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.
  • Experience collaborating with CRM, product, and data engineering teams to influence experimentation design, campaign strategy, and measurement frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of data quality, attribution, and causal inference techniques in the context of CRM performance measurement.
  • Curious, collaborative, and highly self-motivated — with a bias for action and a business-first mindset.

Position Title: Data Analyst (AI)

Company: Reef Capital

Salary: $80,000-$110,000

Location: Lehi, UT; On-site

  • Please note that we cannot offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this position

About Reef

Reef is a Utah-based vertically integrated investment and development firm founded in 2005. Reef's team is currently involved in some of the most prominent development transactions in Utah and other targeted geographies across the United States.

Built on two decades of success, our investment approach combines proven expertise with purposeful innovation. Reef's team has completed more than 500 transactions across all lines of business. In addition to our real estate investment strategy, Reef and/or affiliates own and operate various businesses that add significant long-term value to its projects. We have grown rapidly, growing from about 25 employees to well over 400, with managed assets on behalf of over 750 institutional and individual partners worldwide.

With the motto "Expect the Best," Reef's most prominent developments include Black Desert Resort, a $2 billion luxury resort in Ivins, Utah; Marcella, a luxury private golf community in Park City, Utah; Tributer Resort, Virginia's newest premier private lakeside golf destination; Cornerstone Club, a 5,000-acre residential community, private club, and resort in Telluride, Colorado; Sweetens Cove, a renowned and evolving golf destination nestled in the Tennessee Valley; and the restoration of the historic Coco Palms Resort in Wailua, on the island of Kauai, Hawaii.

Our culture is defined by a shared set of principles that guide how we think, collaborate, make decisions, and pursue success together. This mindset serves as the foundation for the five principles that define how we work together: first, we are One Reef, always prioritizing the success of the whole over individual agendas; we speak candidly and respond collaboratively; we move in solidarity once a decision is made; we take full accountability for outcomes in our domain; and we refuse to settle for anything less than extraordinary. These aren't aspirational values posted on a wall. They are the behaviors we hire for, develop, reward, and exhibit each day. Candidates who thrive at Reef bring energy, ownership, and a genuine commitment to raising the bar on everything they touch.

Position Summary

Reef is looking for an AI-forward analytics professional who turns business questions into answers people trust. You will work with leaders across real estate, hospitality, investments, and membership to define the metrics that matter, then build the dashboards and analysis yourself in Reef Analytics, our internal analytics application.

At Reef, AI isn't a side project, but instead, it's how we build. You'll drive your work from the first question to the finished dashboard, using AI agents and coding tools like Claude to get there faster than you thought possible. Work that used to take an analyst weeks takes hours here. We're looking for someone who hands work off to AI without hesitation, takes on projects bigger than anything they've tried before, and owns the result.

If you've been building with Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools, great. If you haven't yet but you're eager to work this way, and you bring strong SQL and data visualization instincts, you'll thrive here. We hold this team to a white-glove standard and you'll own the complexity and ambiguity of every request, so stakeholders, including executives, get a polished, effortless experience.

Responsibilities

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with stakeholders, including executives, to gather, clarify, and translate business questions into defined metrics and analytical solutions.
  • Own the complexity and ambiguity of data requests: ask the right questions, fill in the gaps, and deliver a finished solution rather than handing the problem back.
  • Deliver white-glove work: polished and easy to use, with clear communication from request to delivery and follow-through after launch.
  • Analyze business processes to identify key metrics, KPIs, and opportunities for data-driven improvements.

Data Definition, Modeling, and Quality

  • Define data elements, create and maintain data dictionaries, glossaries, and metadata to ensure consistent understanding and usage across the organization.
  • Design logical and conceptual data models to support reporting, analytics, and dashboard requirements.
  • Make sure the data behind every dashboard is accurate and consistent, validating and testing it before it ships.
  • Work with the Data Engineer to resolve data discrepancies and fix problems at the source.

Dashboard and Report Development

  • Build and maintain dashboards in Reef Analytics, our internal analytics application, using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as your primary development partner.
  • Work with AI as a coding partner: review AI-generated code and queries critically, fix what does not work, and handle the parts AI cannot do alone.
  • Apply data visualization and dashboard design best practices so executives can read and trust what they see.
  • Ship through Git and GitHub pull requests with code review.
  • Create self-service reporting solutions that enable employees to explore data independently while adhering to governance standards.
  • Develop ad-hoc reports and automated recurring reports to support operational and executive decision-making.

Analytics and Insights

  • Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover insights, trends, patterns, and anomalies.
  • Provide actionable recommendations based on data findings to support business objectives.
  • Monitor dashboard usage and performance, iterating based on user feedback.

Data Governance and Collaboration

  • Support data governance initiatives, including documentation of data lineage, security classifications, and best practices.
  • Partner with the Data Engineer on integration projects and pipeline enhancements to improve data availability for analysis.
  • Train and support end-users on dashboard tools and data interpretation.

Project Management and Delivery

  • Scope, break down, and track work in Jira: clear tickets, acceptance criteria, and priorities for both people and AI agents.
  • Manage a portfolio of stakeholder requests: set expectations, sequence the work, and keep stakeholders informed through delivery.
  • Turn ambiguous requests into well-defined specs that AI agents can build against, then verify the result.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, or related fields.
  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a similar role (experience in data engineering tasks is a plus).
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a similar BI tool, with a strong grasp of data visualization and dashboard design.
  • Solid knowledge of SQL for querying and manipulating data; experience with Snowflake SQL is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Microsoft 365, HubSpot, and data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS S3, data lakes like Microsoft Fabric).
  • Experience in data modeling, creating data dictionaries, and defining business metrics.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to both technical and business audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively in a cross-functional environment.
  • Familiarity with project management basics (e.g., Kanban, Agile/Scrum, Waterfall) and tools like Jira.
  • Experience with FinOps or spend analysis (cloud, software, or AI usage costs), directly supporting an executive, and hands-on experience with ETL processes and tools (e.g., Power Query, SQL-based transformations, or integration platforms) are all considered nice to have

Company Benefits

  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match
  • Generous Health Plan with HSA Match
  • Flexible Paid Time-off
  • Daily Company Lunches
  • Cell Phone Service Allowance
  • Discounts at Company-owned Resorts and Golf Courses

Salary: $80000 - $110000 per year

Established in 2021, Independence Pet Holdings is a corporate holding company that manages a diverse and broad portfolio of modern pet health brands and services, including insurance, pet education, lost recovery services, and more throughout North America.

We believe pet insurance is more than a financial product and build solutions to simplify the pet parenting journey and help improve the well-being of pets. As a leading authority in the pet category, we operate with a full stack of resources, capital, and services to support pet parents. Our multi-brand and omni-channel approach include our own insurance carrier, insurance brands and partner brands.

Position Overview

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a critical role in transforming data into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions across the organization. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs, develop robust reporting solutions, and ensure data integrity across multiple sources—primarily using Power BI and SQL.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data-driven solutions
  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI (or similar tools)
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources
  • Perform ad-hoc analyses to support strategic decision-making and operational improvements
  • Ensure data accuracy and integrity through validation, cleansing, and reconciliation processes
  • Automate data collection and reporting workflows to improve efficiency and scalability
  • Identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform business strategy and performance
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop alerts or visualizations to track them
  • Document data definitions, processes, and reporting standards for consistency and transparency
  • Partner with data engineering and IT teams to enhance data infrastructure and reporting capabilities
  • Stay current with BI tools, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve analytics maturity

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Operations Research, or a related analytical field
  • 5+ years of experience with SQL (SQL Server Management Studio preferred)
  • 5+ years of experience with Power BI or Tableau
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing and data wrangling techniques
  • Excellent analytical, conceptual thinking, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to communicate complex data insights clearly and effectively
  • Self-starter with strong organizational and time management skills
  • Passion for data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement
  • Proven ability to work with cross-functional teams to deliver data-driven solutions that support shared business goals.

Why Join Embrace?

  • Award-winning workplace culture
  • Emphasis on work-life balance and professional development
  • Opportunities to make a real impact with data
  • Collaborative, pet-loving team environment
