Summary Statement

The City of Boise is seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst I to support Facilities Services and Operations (FSO). This role collects, maintains and analyzes facility, asset, maintenance, work order and utility data while developing reports, dashboards and other tools that help teams make informed decisions and deliver reliable services.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career analyst who wants to build practical experience while contributing to the facilities and systems that support City operations. You’ll collaborate with operational, analytical and technical staff, help improve data quality and business processes and provide basic system support and training.

To ensure internal equity and alignment with the approved budget for this position, offers are made within the posted hiring range. Although the hiring range is fixed, employees receive an exceptional benefits and total rewards package that enhances the overall value of employment with the City of Boise.

Required Knowledge, Experience, And Training

  • Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, public administration, information systems, business, environmental science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • General office practices, procedures and essential equipment
  • Basic data collection, research, validation, and reporting methods
  • Computer usage including related software, database, spreadsheet, reporting, and data visualization applications
  • Basic reporting and data visualization principal
  • Records management and process documentation practices

Essential Functions

Performs routine or repetitive tasks with specific instructions and set procedures. Handles basic issues and problems and refers more complex issues to higher-level staff.

Collects, organizes, validates, and analyzes information from operational systems, databases, spreadsheets, and other sources. Develops and maintains standard reports, dashboards, and datasets; identifies trends, discrepancies, and data-quality issues; and communicates findings to appropriate staff.

Maintains accurate and current facility, location, building-system, equipment, preventive maintenance, work order, utility, and related asset data in database. Processes documented asset additions, replacements, relocations, updates, and deactivations; monitors established data-quality controls; corrects routine discrepancies; and coordinates issues requiring operational or technical review.

Works with FSO staff and other assigned users to understand routine reporting, data, and system needs. Documents business processes and user requirements and maintains data dictionaries, procedures, report documentation, user guides, and training resources. Provides first-line assistance and basic training on approved system processes, data entry, reports, and dashboards, and coordinates assigned technical issues with Information Technology, vendors, consultants, and internal subject-matter experts.

Supports assigned projects and process-improvement efforts through data collection, validation, testing, analysis, reporting, and documentation. Work may include asset inventories, preventive maintenance data analysis and reporting, work order reporting improvements, utility and performance reporting, facility condition assessment data, customer surveys, and operational system implementations. Recommends improvements and implements approved changes within established procedures and assigned authority.

Collaborates with other department data analysts to apply shared reporting, documentation, data-quality, and analytical practices. Participates in peer review and knowledge sharing and provides analytical or system support for special projects and short-term departmental priorities. Primarily supports FSO and may assist fleet services or other department programs as assigned.

Performs other duties as assigned. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this position at any time.

Requirements

Additional Required Knowledge, Experience, And Training

Ability To

  • Gather, organize, analyze, interpret, and report operational and project data using established methods and procedures
  • Develop and maintain routine reports, dashboards, datasets, documentation, and written procedures
  • Identify and investigate data-quality, reporting, and system issues and refer complex or unresolved issues for additional review
  • Apply logical problem-solving methods, distinguish findings from assumptions, and exercise sound judgment within assigned responsibilities
  • Produce accurate, organized work while maintaining attention to detail
  • Consistently apply established data, information security, privacy, and data-handling standards and procedures
  • Communicate analytical results and technical information effectively to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge
  • Work collaboratively with operational, analytical, and technical staff
  • Communicate effectively in the English language at a level necessary for efficient job performance
  • Perform all essential functions as assigned by an authorized employee, supervisor and/or manager with or without reasonable accommodation

Preferred Knowledge, Experience, And Training

Two years of experience providing data collection, validation, reporting, analysis, system support, or related services.

Experience with Excel, Power BI, SQL, databases, or operational information systems.

Familiarity with computerized maintenance or enterprise asset management systems, including VueWorks or a comparable platform, and with facilities, fleet, public works, utility, work order, maintenance, or asset data.

Special Requirements

Applicants must be able to pass:

City of Boise background check processes which includes a criminal history check and reference checks in accordance with the City of Boise Hiring Process Regulation

Hybrid Work Eligible

Working Conditions

The physical effort characteristics and working environment described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Efforts

While performing the duties of this job the employee is occasionally lifting/carrying up to 10 pounds and rarely lifting/carrying up to 35 pounds. Also, the employee is rarely pushing/pulling up to 35 pounds. Work includes sensory ability to talk, hear and touch. Work in this position also includes close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision and depth perception. Employees will sit, stand and walk.

Working Environment

The work environment will include inside conditions.

Standard Job Description

The Infrastructure Technology Experience and Enablement (ITxN) team is hiring an experienced Data Analyst Sr. This role is part of a small, motivated team of architects, engineers, and developers who are focused on the design, development, and deployment of infrastructure and supporting automation capabilities across both the Enterprise and Business Area ecosystems.

What You Will Be Doing

In this role, you will working with the automations and network operations team and supporting various important databases. Your responsibilities will include (but not be limited to) the following:

  • Working with all business areas to clean and represent appropriate data
  • Timely updating critical information
  • Working with change management teams across the enterprise to properly document and update site and device specific data

This role will require close attention to detail, collaboration with leadership, and experience manipulating Service Central forms and applications.

Further Information About This Opportunity

This role is fully remote. US Citizenship is required due to system access.

Responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to develop immersive stories that answer business questions. Using proven and sound statistical methods, the analyst draws insights from data, and translates those insights into action that drive business results. Data Analysts are extremely resourceful and able to find novel new data sources to enrich their analysis. They apply mathematical and statistical methods to business and risk management problems.Mine, process, and summarize data; Manage the quality assurance of data scraping, query databases for stakeholder requests, and triage data issues for timely resolutions; Analyze large datasets, draw valid inferences and prepare insights in narrative or visual forms, including dashboards; Set up and maintain data processes and new analytics capabilities; Produce and track key performance indicators; Ability to formulate functional and technical requirements from business problems; Program management of key tasks and resources to achieve cost and schedule

Basic Qualifications

  • Hands‑on experience with ServiceNow (or ServiceCentral) – daily usage and administration.
  • Documented experience in ServiceNow, integrating with JavaScript and databases.
  • Strong understanding of configuration management databases (CMDB’s) and IT Service Management (ITSM) databases.
  • Proven ability to build and script catalog items (UI policies, client scripts, flow, etc.)
  • Testing experience and intake requirements.
  • Continuous process improvement amongst the various BA’s using the approved services.
  • Data analysis- identifying, parsing, understanding, and documenting data important to both ServiceNow and the associated application.
  • Communicating with wide audiences on a regular basis about CMDB and data governance.

Desired Skills

  • Ability to receive requirements for, design, deploy and maintain new applications using Python and GIT as a repository.
  • Experience with governance review panels
  • Excellent written and verbal abilities for interfacing with network and systems engineers, cyber security, senior leadership, and program leadership across all Business Areas.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification.
  • Experience integrating ServiceNow with external systems (APIs, middleware, etc.).
  • Dashboard and report creation and maintenance through ServiceNow and other applications.
  • Cisco Networking Experience (Foundational)
  • Strong sense of self-management while being able to support the team and autonomously support multiple projects.

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $106600.00 - $198000.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $95900.00 - $178100.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $85300.00 - $158300.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $76700.00 - $142500.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Ocala, FL; Lufkin, TX; etc.

Work Model: You’ll work in a hybrid model, onsite at your designated Regal Rexnord location at least 3 days per week (Monday–Thursday), with flexibility to work remotely up to 2 days, including Friday.

Position Summary

The Logistics Business Analyst II will support all aspects of data analytics for the Logistics & Fulfillment organization, providing expertise in data analytics and data mining to help create solutions across the Regal Rexnord network. This role will support our strategy for business intelligence solutions and reporting tools with a focus on data mining and analysis. Working as part of the Data & Analytics team, you will create standardized approaches to data mining, reporting, and visualization, providing leaders with the business insights needed to make informed decisions in a fast-paced environment. Your engagement and insights will support all tactical and strategic needs, ensuring expectations across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Growth (SQDCG) are met. At Regal Rexnord, you are expected to model our company values and be a brand ambassador. This role will report directly to the Senior Manager, Data & Analytics.

Major Responsibilities

  • Conducts analysis for Logistics & Fulfillment to create accurate and timely decisions for business results.
  • Utilize structured and unstructured data sets to create reporting that is descriptive, diagnostic, predictive and / or prescriptive to drive improvements across the business.
  • Maintain and analyze metrics to assess performance and identify improvements across the areas of Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Growth (SQDCG).
  • Develop and maintain standardization related to data visualization. Conduct training when needed to ensure end users can fully leverage reporting tools.
  • Provide effective and actionable scenario analysis and communication of trade-offs to support business needs.
  • Understand organizational priorities to assist with the design and identification of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that align with the business.
  • Creates, identifies and implements effective dashboards for tracking and KPI Metrics to improve SQDCG performance.
  • Ensures that daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly KPIs are prepared and published as appropriate.
  • Balance competing priorities while ensuring initiatives maintain momentum delivering against expected ROI.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Required Education / Experience / Skills

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or Operations is preferred
  • 3+ Years of experience in a logistics operations or analytics related position
  • Understanding of basic programming concepts and languages (SQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, Java, C+, etc.)
  • General knowledge of Logistics and Fulfillment operations
  • Knowledgeable in all modes of Transportation: TL, LTL, Ocean, Air, Small Package
  • Proficient with Microsoft office products
  • Proven ability to take on tasks and drive continuous improvement
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Power BI with demonstrated ability to create intuitive dashboards
  • Experience using data and analytics to measure, track, and action KPIs
  • Intellectual curiosity with a desire to take initiative and find new opportunities for improvement

This role may require up to 5% travel.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without requiring company sponsorship to obtain or keep U.S. work authorization.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription Drug Coverage
  • Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
  • Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • 401k Retirement Plan with Matching Employer Contributions
  • Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
  • Paid Leaves
  • Tuition Assistance

About Regal Rexnord

Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.

The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.

Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Position Summary...

What you'll do...Role summary:

The Senior Data Analyst will leverage advanced data management, analysis, and visualization techniques to support business decision-making across multiple domains. This role requires expertise in identifying appropriate data sources, ensuring data quality, and applying analytical methods to solve complex business challenges. The position involves collaborating with stakeholders to translate requirements into actionable insights, developing data-driven strategies, and communicating findings effectively. Proficiency in SQL, Python, and data visualization tools (primarily PowerBI) is essential to deliver impactful results that align with organizational goals and drive continuous improvement.

About the team:

The Inbound Operational Analytics team serves as Walmart Transportation’s intelligence engine for inbound operations. Combining operational expertise, advanced analytics, data engineering, continuous improvement, and AI, the team transforms transportation data into actionable insights. Their mission is to enhance service, reduce costs, increase visibility, and enable faster, data-driven decisions across Walmart’s inbound supply chain. Success on this team requires strong business understanding, stakeholder collaboration, and curiosity to identify opportunities beyond standard reporting. The team develops innovative tools and insights that address operational challenges and support proactive problem-solving for the business.

What you'll do:

  • Identify and source relevant data from multiple business domains to support analytical needs and decision-making.
  • Conduct initial data quality assessments and lead data cleansing efforts to ensure accuracy and reliability.
  • Translate complex business requirements into actionable data projects aligned with strategic objectives.
  • Develop and apply advanced analytical methods and visualization techniques to generate insightful reports.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to communicate findings clearly and influence data-driven business solutions.
  • Mentor junior analysts on best practices in data analysis, visualization, and quality management.
  • Monitor and maintain data governance standards to uphold compliance and data integrity.

What you'll bring:

  • Proven expertise in data analysis, data management, and data cleansing with strong proficiency in SQL and Python programming languages.
  • Experience in identifying and sourcing data from multiple business domains, ensuring data quality and relevance for decision-making.
  • Knowledge of data visualization tools and techniques to effectively communicate complex insights to stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into data-driven solutions aligned with organizational strategy.
  • Familiarity with data quality management frameworks, data governance, and enterprise data architecture principles.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills to support cross-functional collaboration and project success.
  • Experience with exploratory data analysis and statistical techniques to uncover trends and inform business recommendations.

It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see https://one.walmart.com/notices. Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.

For Information About Benefits And Eligibility, See One.Walmart.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About The Role

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will design, build, and own the analytics that ShipStation Global’s business teams use to make decisions. This role sits between the data platform built by data engineering and the business and is responsible for performing data discovery, defining and governing metrics, and analysis activities to identify specific information required to support client decisions and then present these results in a meaningful and intuitive format, using a variety of BI tools and techniques.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, genuinely curious about how the business operates, and comfortable working through ambiguity — able to sit down with a stakeholder, ask the questions that surface the real decision behind the request, define the problem, and then engineer a durable solution. Equally important is the judgment to push back when what was asked for is not what is actually needed, and the communication skills to explain why.

This position is hybrid (3 days per week in office) and is located in Austin or Dallas, Texas.

About The Team

The Senior Data Analyst designs, builds, and owns the analytics that ShipStation Global’s business teams use to make decisions. This role sits between the data platform built by data engineering and the business and is responsible for performing data discovery, defining and governing metrics, and analysis activities to identify specific information required to support client decisions and then present these results in a meaningful and intuitive format, using a variety of BI tools and techniques.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, genuinely curious about how the business operates, and comfortable working through ambiguity — able to sit down with a stakeholder, ask the questions that surface the real decision behind the request, define the problem, and then engineer a durable solution. Equally important is the judgment to push back when what was asked for is not what is actually needed, and the communication skills to explain why.

What will you be doing?

  • Partner directly with business stakeholders to turn ambiguous requests into well-defined analytics deliverables.
    • Lead discovery conversations with Finance, Accounting, Sales, Marketing, and Product to uncover the underlying decision or business problem behind each request.
    • Translate open-ended asks into documented requirements: metric definitions, grain, dimensionality, filters, refresh cadence, and clear acceptance criteria.
    • Challenge assumptions and propose better framing when the requested output would not actually answer the question being asked.
  • Design, build, and maintain analytics data models.
    • Develop modular, tested, version-controlled transformation models in dbt on BigQuery — and on Databricks as the ShipStation Global platform expands — following layered staging, intermediate, and mart patterns.
    • Write advanced SQL: window functions, incremental logic, complex joins, and query tuning through partitioning, clustering, and cost-aware design.
    • Implement data quality controls such as dbt tests, source freshness checks, and anomaly monitoring so that breakages are caught before stakeholders find them.
    • Work in Git with pull-request review and CI/CD, treating analytics code as production software.
  • Own the semantic layer and BI delivery.
    • Develop and maintain LookML views, explores, derived tables, and reusable measures so that each metric is defined once and reported consistently everywhere.
    • Build and maintain Looker dashboards, Looks, schedules, and alerts; develop Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, and reports as the ShipStation Global reporting stack consolidates between data & reporting platforms.
    • Optimize dashboard performance and query cost; manage content organization, folder structure, and row-level access controls.
    • Enable self-service by documenting metric definitions, training stakeholders, and building durable assets that reduce recurring ad hoc requests.

    • Reconcile analytics output against source systems and finance reporting, investigating discrepancies and explaining them clearly.
    • Write up findings, caveats, and recommendations in plain language for a non-technical executive audience.
  • Support platform modernization and post-merger integration.
    • Contribute to migrating, rationalizing, and consolidating reporting assets as ShipStation Global standardizes its data and BI stack across GCP and BigQuery, Databricks, Looker, and Power BI.
    • Automate recurring manual reporting using Python and scheduled orchestration.
  • Maintain documentation, standards, and data governance.
    • Document models, metric definitions, and data lineage in dbt docs and Confluence so that institutional knowledge does not live in a single person’s head.
    • Follow and help improve team standards for naming, testing, code review, and release management.
    • Handle sensitive customer, financial, and employee data in accordance with company security and privacy policy.
The ideal candidate is highly analytical, genuinely curious about how the business operates, and comfortable working through ambiguity — able to sit down with a stakeholder, ask the questions that surface the real decision behind the request, define the problem, and then engineer a durable solution. Equally important is the judgment to push back when what was asked for is not what is actually needed, and the communication skills to explain why.

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field; equivalent hands-on experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 5+ years of experience building business intelligence and analytics solutions on a cloud data platform.
  • 3+ years of advanced SQL in a production analytics environment.
  • 3+ years of hands-on dbt experience building and maintaining production models.
  • 3+ years of dashboard and report development in a modern BI tool; Looker and LookML strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience gathering requirements directly from business stakeholders with limited direction or supervision.
  • Working experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery.
  • Proficiency with Python and with Git-based development workflows.

What will make you stand out?

  • Advanced SQL, including complex analytical queries, window functions, and performance and cost optimization against columnar cloud warehouses.
  • Hands-on analytics engineering with dbt: modular models, tests, macros, snapshots, documentation, and deployment through CI/CD.
  • Working depth in at least one modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse — BigQuery, Databricks, or equivalent — including partitioning, clustering, incremental strategies, and cost management.
  • Semantic layer development in LookML or an equivalent metrics modeling layer.
  • Dashboard and report development in a modern BI platform such as Looker, Power BI, or Tableau, with a strong grasp of visualization and information design principles.

descriptionHtml:
About Onos Health

Onos Health’s mission is simple but ambitious: ensure every healthcare dollar goes toward delivering the highest quality care. Today, nearly 30% of U.S. healthcare spending is wasted due to ineffective care and administrative burden caused by misalignment between providers and payers.

Onos is addressing this by building the AI platform that enables health plans to understand clinical care at scale. By transforming unstructured clinical documentation into actionable insights, we help payers make faster, more informed decisions, identify opportunities to improve quality and reduce waste, and ensure more healthcare dollars are directed toward delivering better outcomes.

Come join a category-defining company and transform how healthcare is managed in the U.S.

Why Onos?

Meaningful impact: Help solve one of healthcare’s biggest challenges by improving quality while reducing waste.

Ownership: Take on significant responsibility from day one and shape a rapidly growing company.

Direct collaboration: Work alongside experienced founders with deep expertise in healthcare, AI, and product development.

High-performing team: Join a transparent, collaborative, and execution-focused culture.

Build something new: Help define the next generation of AI-powered healthcare analytics.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to turn health plan data into the reporting, analyses, and insights our customers rely on.

You’ll work hands-on with claims, authorization, eligibility, and clinical review data from our health plan customers. You’ll build and maintain the analyses and dashboards that show customers what’s happening in their populations: utilization trends, provider variation, cost, and the impact of programs running on the Onos platform.

This role works closely with our data science, product, and customer teams. This role is tightly focused on core analytics – tackling complex analytical questions independently. You’ll own analyses end to end, from digging into data to presenting results to customer stakeholders, and you’ll help make repeatable analyses into standard reporting in the product.

What You’ll Be Doing

Customer Analytics & Reporting

  • Build and maintain customer-facing reports and dashboards covering utilization, cost, provider performance, and program outcomes.
  • Run analyses that answer specific customer questions, such as where spend is concentrated, which providers are outliers, and how a program is affecting utilization.
  • Support ROI and impact analyses by preparing data, running calculations, and checking results against agreed methodologies.
  • Prepare findings for customer meetings and present results to analytics and operational teams at health plans.

Data Onboarding & Quality

  • Explore and analyze structured, analysis-ready customer data feeds (including claims, authorizations, eligibility, and clinical documentation) to extract key insights.
  • Investigate data quality issues, anomalies, and inconsistencies, collaborating closely with Engineering and customer teams to ensure accurate reporting.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to define business logic and data requirements needed for downstream analytical workflows.
  • Build checks that catch data issues before they reach customer reporting.

Product Support

  • Turn recurring customer analyses into standard metrics and reports that can be built into the platform.
  • Help define metric logic and business rules so numbers are consistent across customers and reports.
  • Give Product, Engineering, and Data Science feedback on what customers ask for and where current reporting falls short.

Collaborate Across The Company

  • Work with Data Science, Product, Engineering, Clinical Operations, and Customer Success on customer engagements and internal projects.
  • Be a go-to resource on how our customers’ data is structured and what it can and can’t support.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in healthcare analytics or a related analytical role.
  • Hands-on experience with healthcare claims data; experience with authorization, eligibility, or clinical data is a plus.
  • Strong SQL skills, working proficiency in Python for data analysis, and proven ability to independently answer complex, ambiguous analytical questions.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports in a BI or notebook tool.
  • Solid understanding of descriptive statistics and common healthcare metrics (e.g., PMPM, utilization per 1,000, cost per member).
  • Careful about data quality, with a habit of checking results before sharing them.
  • Ability to explain analytical findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Proven experience working directly with customers or external stakeholders is required.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and building processes from the ground up.
  • Healthcare payer, provider, or health technology experience strongly preferred. Behavioral health experience is a plus.
  • Exceptional references from colleagues and former managers.

Why This Role Is Unique

At Onos, Analysts aren’t a back-office reporting function.

You’ll work directly with health plan customers, see how your analyses inform their decisions, and help shape the reporting built into the Onos platform.

If you like digging into messy healthcare data, getting the numbers right, and seeing your work used by customers, we’d love to talk.

Benefits & Perks

  • 3x per week in office (Mon/Tues/Thurs) in San Francisco, Financial District
  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • Paid parental leave
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • 401(k)
  • Significant equity as an early employee
  • Direct mentorship from experienced founders
  • Ground-floor opportunity to help build both the product and company
  • Regular team events and off-sites
  • Company-provided equipment and home office setup
  • In-office lunches and snacks provided

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Onos. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other protected characteristic.

Compensation Range: $170K - $200K

descriptionHtml:
POSITION: Business Intelligence Analyst

FULL-TIME/PART-TIME: Full Time

LOCATION: Bothell, WA - Hybrid

React Health is a fast-paced, growth-driven manufacturer and distributor of medical equipment, dedicated to supporting patients, caregivers, physicians, and healthcare providers. With a focus on respiratory and sleep health sectors, we offer a comprehensive range of products and services across acute care, non-acute care, and home medical equipment. By integrating manufacturing and distribution, React Health addresses the needs of both undiagnosed individuals and those requiring therapy after diagnosis, particularly within the sleep and respiratory care sectors.

General Summary

The Business Intelligence Analyst will play a pivotal role in supporting data-informed decision-making across our organization. This position will encompass both analytical and development responsibilities - gathering, analyzing, and interpreting business operations data to generate actionable insights, while also designing and maintaining the data infrastructure, pipelines, and BI solutions that enable reporting and analytics at scale.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in the same or similar role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with business intelligence/data analytics tools (Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, etc.)and proficiency in SQL including complex queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
  • Experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and familiarity with data warehouse concepts and tools (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, or similar).

Preferred Education

  • Master’s degree in related field

Preferred Experience

  • Medical / health industry experience
  • Experience with NetSuite
  • Working proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation, automation, and analysis (e.g., pandas, numpy, or equivalent libraries).
  • Excellent attention to detail and project management skills.
  • Excellent written/oral communication skills required. Must be able to work effectively with diverse groups of people.

Physical Demands

  • Requires normal visual acuity and hearing.
  • Typically, employees sit comfortably to do their work, interspersed by brief periods of standing, walking, bending, carrying papers and books, and extensive periods requiring the use of computer terminals to accomplish work objectives.
  • Required to sit and use their hands and fingers to handle or feel and manipulate keys on a keyboard.
  • Additional skills may be required to perform additional task(s) specific to work location, department or line of business.

Working Conditions

  • Predominantly operates in an office environment. Some work (less than 5%) requires moving and lifting of computer or networking equipment.

Duties And Essential Functions

Each Employee consistently demonstrates the following essential functions:

  • Perform data analysis to gain insights into various aspects of business performance, including revenue generation, customer behavior, market trends, and operational excellence.
  • Support the assessment of the effectiveness of business strategies and initiatives by providing data-driven insights and recommendations for optimization.
  • Analyze metrics related to business growth and customer retention, identifying patterns and opportunities for improvement.
  • Conduct analyses to identify root causes behind business challenges and contribute to proposing actionable solutions for improvement.
  • Development of visually appealing dashboards and data visualizations using industry-standard tools to present key business metrics and insights.
  • Assist in creating interactive visualizations that enable stakeholders to explore data and gain actionable insights to inform decision-making.
  • Support the design and maintenance of dashboards and reports to monitor performance across various business functions, such as sales, finance, and operations.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and data models to extract, transform, and prepare data from multiple source systems.
  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT data pipelines to ensure reliable, timely, and accurate data delivery from source systems to the data warehouse or reporting layer.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and assist in translating them into meaningful data insights and visualization solutions.
  • Support documentation efforts by capturing methodologies, data sources, and key findings to establish a comprehensive knowledge base for business intelligence.
  • Participate in knowledge-sharing sessions with stakeholders to enhance their understanding of data insights and contribute to fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.
  • Attends and participates in departmental meetings. Attends seminars and training sessions necessary to maintain appropriate level of professional competence. Ensures all department compliance guidelines are met.
  • Attends all meetings, in-services training, or continuing education as delegated by the supervisor.
  • Provides customer focused interactions.
  • Performs all duties necessary for the department as per department policies and procedures.
  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as delegated by the supervisor within the scope of practice and the responsibilities in the department.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to accommodate individuals with disabilities to perform the basic functions of the position without compromising client care. React Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to providing a drug-free workplace. We are an Equal-Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

Grow was born to tackle a critical challenge: making mental health care more effective and accessible for everyone. Since launching in 2020, 15 million sessions have started on Grow, and we've barely scratched the surface. We do it through a three-sided marketplace that empowers providers, augments insurance payors, and serves patients. Every solution we build reveals ten more waiting to be delivered, and that's just what gets us going. We've backed that ambition with more than $328M in funding, including our Series D at a $3B valuation from Sequoia Capital, Transformation Capital, TCV, SignalFire, Menlo Ventures, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, and others.

Your Impact At Grow

At Grow, the work you do can literally change someone's life. Your work here doesn't stay on a screen; it impacts whether someone can find, afford, and access quality care. That ambition sets us apart, and offers you an endless runway to impact one of the world's most urgent issues. We don’t have passenger seats here. Everyone is driving something that matters.

This work deserves real commitment. So if you thrive on meeting problems head on, untangling serious complexity, and working at pace with the sharpest yet kindest people around, you've come to the right place.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to drive data-driven insights and reporting in Product at Grow Therapy, working on a mix of reporting, analytics, and experimentation projects. You’ll join our broader data organization of analysts, data scientists, and data engineers as part of an Analytics team that reports into an Analytics Manager, and you’ll support our Lives Covered product group, which focuses on Billing & Payments features. Do more than move the needle: help move a person.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Partner with Product and other technical stakeholders to prioritize analytical needs and support product launches, decisions, and ad hoc requests with clear insights.
  • Develop, maintain, and evolve core product and performance reporting, including business-critical dashboards built on scalable, reliable datasets.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing through thoughtful design, execution, analysis, and clear, actionable conclusions.
  • Create compelling data visualizations and storytelling assets that communicate insights to diverse audiences.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on complex, high-impact analytical projects, including data modeling and OKR development.
  • Work with data scientists and data engineers to improve data availability, integrity, accuracy, reliability, and logging and pipeline quality.
  • Identify business-critical opportunities to improve claims collection and reduce billing friction.

What You’ll Bring

  • You have 5+ years of proven experience using analytics to tackle business problems that cross multiple product or project areas and teams, ideally in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • You have strong SQL skills and an intermediate understanding of experimental design, such as A/B experiments.
  • You build business-critical dashboards and data visualizations, ideally in Hex.
  • You have experience with data modeling (dbt) or are eager to learn.
  • You love data storytelling: creating a compelling narrative from insights and summarizing takeaways for executives.
  • You have prior experience analyzing healthcare data, particularly across the claims lifecycle and patient billing processes.
  • You communicate effectively and build relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You deeply value expanding access to mental health care.

Exemption Status: Exempt

The base compensation for this role will vary depending on several factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, and the candidate’s working location.

General Information About Working At Grow

The information below provides an overview of work arrangements and full-time employee benefits at Grow. Applicability varies by role, employment type, and location; please refer to the job description above for this role’s work arrangement.

Work Location & Travel:

Hybrid Roles are onsite from a listed Hub location three days per week ( Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday), unless otherwise specified in the above job description. The hybrid arrangement will include travel 2–3 times per year (e.g., company and department offsites).

Remote roles are fully remote within the United States. The remote arrangement will include travel 2–3 times per year (e.g., company and department offsites).

Full Time Employee Benefits

  • Health Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage.
  • Grow for Grow: No cost access to therapy through the Grow platform (available to US employees)
  • Financial Wellness: Retirement savings programs and equity opportunities to help you invest in your future.
  • Flexible Time Off, Paid Holidays & Winter Break: Flexible time off, company paid holidays (which vary by country), and a full company wide Winter Break to rest and recharge
  • Parental Leave: Up to 18 weeks of paid parental leave to support you and your growing family and a new child stipend.
  • Mental Health Mornings/Afternoons: Dedicated weekly flexible time for self care, whether that's therapy, exercise, journaling, time with family, or simply taking a break.
  • Wellness & Development Stipend: Annual stipend to support your personal wellbeing and professional growth, from fitness and education to books and learning resources.
  • Commuter Benefits: Pre tax commuter benefits to support teammates working from one of our hub locations.
  • Home Office & Meals: Support for your home workspace plus meal benefits, with offerings tailored to both remote and hub based employees.
  • Additional Perks: A variety of wellbeing benefits, including wellness memberships, virtual care, pet insurance discounts (where available), and global travel assistance.

Research shows that some groups hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. If you’re excited about this role but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply. At Grow, we value diverse experiences, transferable skills, and the unique strengths each person brings.

Grow Therapy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Use of AI Tools: We use certain AI and automated tools to support recruitment. These tools help our team review applications, organize interviews, detect potential application integrity issues, and maintain interview records; they do not make final hiring decisions.

Application Review: Ashby's AI-Assisted Application Review helps review application materials against role-specific criteria and may flag potential fraud or integrity issues for recruiter review. All advancement decisions are made by our human recruiting team after independent review. See Ashby's AI Bias Audit Report.

Interview Recording: We use BrightHire to record interviews, supporting note-taking and consistency across candidates. Learn more. Interviews are confidential; you may ask your interviewer to stop recording anytime, or opt out in advance. Choosing not to be recorded will not, by itself, affect your candidacy.

AI-Assisted Recruiter Screen: For select roles, BrightHire's AI features may help structure initial recruiter screens and organize interview notes. All responses are reviewed by our recruiting team; no hiring decisions are made by AI alone.

State-specific notices: Depending on your location, you may have additional rights. Illinois: If AI analyzes a video interview, we'll provide notice, explain how it works and what it evaluates, and obtain consent beforehand. New York City: Where required, we'll provide at least 10 business days’ notice before using an automated employment decision tool and explain how to request an alternative process. Maryland: We do not use facial recognition to create facial templates during interviews unless required notice and written consent are obtained.

Questions, accommodation requests, requests for an alternative selection process, objections to recording, or concerns about AI use? Contact talentops@growtherapy.com. We’re happy to help or offer an alternative way to participate.

descriptionHtml:
ABS Group is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Artificial Intelligence Practice in support of a major federal modernization program. In this role, you will use business intelligence and visualization tools to turn complex data into clear, decision-ready dashboards, reports, and analytical products.

You will work with stakeholders across technical and operational teams to provide reporting, insight, and performance visibility that supports better decision-making in a large-scale federal environment. The scope of responsibility, degree of technical leadership, and level of independence expected will reflect the level at which this position is filled.

What You Will Do
- Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, scorecards, and other business intelligence products
- Analyze, interpret, and visualize data to support operational, technical, and stakeholder decision-making
- Develop reproducible reports and analyses, including trend analysis, benchmarking, and performance reporting
- Translate stakeholder needs into effective reporting structures, visualizations, and dashboard requirements
- Integrate data from multiple sources to support accurate and consistent reporting outputs
- Present findings and business intelligence products to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and program stakeholders to improve reporting data structures and insight generation
- Support validation, refresh accuracy, usability, and quality of reporting products
- Produce presentation materials, reporting guidance, and supporting documentation as needed

Level and Compensation: This position may be filled at multiple career levels based on business need and the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and demonstrated capability. Typical leveling for this role is as follows:

- Junior (0 to 4 years)

- Mid-Level (5 to 9 years)

- Senior (10 to 14 years)

- Principal (15 or more years)


These ranges are guidelines only and are not the sole determining factor in level. The posted compensation range reflects the full range across all possible levels. Individual offers will be based on the level at which the candidate is hired, as well as factors such as skills, experience, internal equity, and geographic market considerations where applicable.

Education and Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Relevant professional experience in business intelligence, dashboard development, reporting, or analytical visualization roles; the depth and scope of experience required will vary based on the level at which this position is filled

- Experience delivering reporting and visualization products for operational, executive, or stakeholder audiences preferred

- Experience in a complex enterprise, consulting, or government environment a plus


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
- Familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI and dashboarding tools
- Working knowledge of SQL and experience with structured data sources
- Familiarity with data visualization, dashboard design, reporting concepts, and analytics
- Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and create clear, useful visual products
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Understanding of validation practices, reporting quality controls, and data governance considerations

Nice to Have
- Experience supporting executive or stakeholder reporting in a large program environment
- Familiarity with survey, demographic, statistical, or public sector reporting environments
- Experience with geospatial or map-based visualizations
- Knowledge of accessibility considerations for dashboards and reports

Location
This position is based in the Washington, D.C. metro area, with primary work performed in Suitland, Maryland. Remote or hybrid arrangements may be available for eligible work, subject to government approval.

Notice: This role has been opened for a future need expected within three months of the original posting date of this position. Potential candidates may not receive communication until the open headcount is confirmed.

- Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, scorecards, and other business intelligence products
- Analyze, interpret, and visualize data to support operational, technical, and stakeholder decision-making
- Develop reproducible reports and analyses, including trend analysis, benchmarking, and performance reporting
- Translate stakeholder needs into effective reporting structures, visualizations, and dashboard requirements
- Integrate data from multiple sources to support accurate and consistent reporting outputs
- Present findings and business intelligence products to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and program stakeholders to improve reporting data structures and insight generation
- Support validation, refresh accuracy, usability, and quality of reporting products
- Produce presentation materials, reporting guidance, and supporting documentation as needed

- Junior (0 to 4 years)

- Mid-Level (5 to 9 years)

- Senior (10 to 14 years)

- Principal (15 or more years)


These ranges are guidelines only and are not the sole determining factor in level. The posted compensation range reflects the full range across all possible levels. Individual offers will be based on the level at which the candidate is hired, as well as factors such as skills, experience, internal equity, and geographic market considerations where applicable.

Education and Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Relevant professional experience in business intelligence, dashboard development, reporting, or analytical visualization roles; the depth and scope of experience required will vary based on the level at which this position is filled

- Experience delivering reporting and visualization products for operational, executive, or stakeholder audiences preferred

- Experience in a complex enterprise, consulting, or government environment a plus


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
- Familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI and dashboarding tools
- Working knowledge of SQL and experience with structured data sources
- Familiarity with data visualization, dashboard design, reporting concepts, and analytics
- Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and create clear, useful visual products

  • $100 monthly technology stipend.
  • Up to $5,250 annually in educational reimbursement plus LinkedIn Learning.
  • Up to $5,000 annually in charitable donation matching.
  • Financial coaching and student loan support.
  • Family planning, mental health, and caregiving support.
  • Pet insurance, employee discounts and cash back offers.

Position Information

Banner Position Number R10938 Position Title Data Analyst (2 positions available) Classification Title MURC-Misc Other Technicians Department SOM - VP Health Science/Dean - RC5000 Job Description

Position Overview

The Data Analyst support clinical and research programs addressing chronic diseases including obesity and diabetes. The analyst manages program data, develops performance dashboards, and leads the preparation and coordination of required data reporting to support health interventions and continuous improvement.

Working with program leaders, clinical teams, and external partners, the analyst turns complex healthcare and program data into clear, actionable findings across initiatives such as telehealth and value-based care. The role requires strong analytical skills, and extensive familiarity with healthcare systems.

Core Responsibilities

Data Management and Quality

  • Manage and maintain data across several initiatives, integrating approved sources such as program records, electronic health records, claims, enrollment files, and partner submissions as available.
  • Develop repeatable processes to extract, clean, transform, link, and validate data. Investigate missing values, duplicates, inconsistencies, and reconciliation issues with data owners and program partners.
  • Maintain data dictionaries, measure specifications, source documentation, and version-controlled analytical code to support consistent definitions, reproducible results, and reliable reporting.

Dashboards and Performance Measurement

  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards using tools such as Power BI or Tableau to monitor key performance indicators, service utilization, access, quality, and program outcomes.
  • Collaborate with the intervention team to define measures, baselines, targets, denominators, and reporting periods. Establish dashboard refresh schedules appropriate to source availability and clearly display data currency and limitations.
  • Analyze trends and variation across initiatives, populations, providers, and geographic areas. Assess rural access barriers and disparities while applying appropriate safeguards for small populations.

Federal and State Reporting

  • Lead data collection, validation, analysis, and preparation of required federal and state reports. Coordinate internal review, approval, and timely submission according to terms, reporting specifications, and program deadlines.
  • Maintain reporting calendars, submission instructions, validation checks, and supporting documentation. Reconcile reported results to source data and retain an auditable record of submissions, revisions, and approvals.
  • Monitor changes to reporting requirements with program and compliance staff, translate them into data specifications, and help resolve reporting discrepancies and follow-up requests

Data Governance and Partner Collaboration

  • Support data-sharing agreements and exchange protocols in collaboration with legal, privacy, security, and information technology teams.
  • Follow approved data-use restrictions, access controls, secure transfer procedures, retention requirements, and applicable privacy policies. Escalate data access, quality, or security concerns through established channels.
  • Provide technical assistance and training on data submission specifications, dashboard use, measure interpretation, and basic data literacy. Work with partners to improve completeness and consistency of submissions.

Analysis and Program Improvement

  • Use appropriate statistical and analytical methods to identify trends, service gaps, and opportunities for improvement. Distinguish descriptive findings from causal conclusions and communicate limitations, including data lags and incomplete coverage.
  • Translate findings into concise reports, presentations, and recommendations tailored to clinical, operational, and executive audiences. Partner with program teams to evaluate changes and monitor progress toward established goals.

Location MURC - Marshall University Research Corporation Salary Range Salary is commensurate with education, experience, and internal equity

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, public health, economics, information systems, or a related quantitative field.

Experience

  • At least one year’s of professional experience in data analysis or business intelligence.
  • Understanding of rural healthcare delivery and the access barriers, provider capacity constraints, and community factors relevant to West Virginia.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Excel; demonstrated experience developing dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable visualization platform, and using R, Python, SAS, or a comparable tool for analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to validate complex datasets, document analytical methods, interpret statistical results, and manage multiple reporting deadlines with close attention to accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain findings to nontechnical audiences and collaborate with clinical, program, technical, and external partner teams.
  • Knowledge of healthcare data privacy, confidentiality, secure data handling, and data governance practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Education

  • Master’s degree in a relevant quantitative, public health, or health informatics field.

Experience

  • Experience in a U.S. healthcare organization and grant-funded programs.
  • Experience with West Virginia healthcare data or partners; telehealth, transportation, or value-based care evaluation; geographic analysis; or automated reporting and data integration.

As the Senior Data Analyst, you specialize in collecting, organizing and analyzing data from various sources with the purpose of turning numbers into context and recommendations. You integrate, transform and improve volumes of data at the project or company level for streamlined processes, greater efficiencies and more informed decision-making. As a Senior Data Analyst, you must demonstrate leadership among peers and extremely deep knowledge of your industry and business.

  • Stay informed of industry or business trends that pertain to data
  • Mentor teammates on any of the above responsibilities

  • Proficiency with industry-standard statistical analysis tools, such as SAS, R or Python
  • Experience training and mentoring peers
  • Experience creating data sets with advanced SQL or other querying languages and using them to develop business strategies
  • Experience researching data lineage

  • Experience data mining or using other exploratory techniques
  • Experience working with structured and unstructured data
  • Experience writing software functions to support data analysis
  • Experience contributing to standards and processes that increase efficiency and impact
  • Conceptual knowledge of logical and physical data models
  • Domain knowledge of multiple business areas

  • At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
  • At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The Analyst provides analytical support for all departments, including analysis, pricing, capitation, network and provider specific reporting. Analytical support includes creating and executing beginner and intermediate level reports and programs and programming modifications to previously written reports. The Analyst will collaborate with key stakeholders and determine the needed result including any special specifications. The Analyst will work with several databases to pull and integrate data, statistical analysis and data modeling.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute, write, test, validate, analyze and distribute reports. Determine appropriate approach and tools needed to complete project in an efficient and timely manner. Collaborate with key stakeholders and senior analysts.
  • Determine, write and present report results with key findings and trends to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Complete multiple concurrent ad-hoc analyses, provide corresponding reports based on customer specifications, determine and communicate analytical conclusions and recommendations.
  • Develop beginner to intermediate level reports and ad-hoc analysis based on specifications outlined by department management. Automate such reports and ensure that they are performed and delivered on schedule.
  • Perform tasks related to maintenance of Departmental Data Warehouse and its documentation.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Ability to apply advanced mathematical and statistical techniques and principles into the analysis of health-related data.
  • Possess strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate results in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to converse and write fluently in English.
  • Successful completion of Health Care Sanctions background check.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree Required. Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other quantitative discipline preferred.
  • Demonstrated use of analytical software. SAS or SQL preferred.
  • Experience in Power BI, Tableau or similar software preferred.1-2 years of related experience preferred.

CommunityCare is an equal opportunity at will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation or national origin

Job Description

Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond. We deliver personalized health care experiences and partner closely with providers to ensure members are genuinely cared for.

We're a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration — because success is a team sport. It's our mission to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm and every member feels valued.

The Healthcare Data Analyst performs intermediate-level analytical work to evaluate medical, financial, and operational data and support organizational decision-making. This role applies established analytical techniques to identify trends, assess performance, and produce reliable reports and insights. Operating with developing autonomy, the analyst interprets results, explains findings to partners, and resolves moderately complex analytical questions. The position contributes to team objectives by delivering accurate analyses, strengthening reporting consistency, and supporting improvement initiatives across healthcare programs. Performs other duties as assigned.

Key Accountabilities

  • Perform Analytical Studies & Foundational Modeling
  • Conduct quantitative analyses and basic modeling to assess medical cost, utilization, and operational performance
  • Apply established statistical methods and tools under defined guidelines
  • Interpret results, identify key drivers, and validate outputs for accuracy
  • Summarize findings in clear, structured formats for review and discussion
  • Support Metrics, Reporting, & Analytical Frameworks
  • Prepare and maintain standard reports, dashboards, and monitoring tools
  • Apply defined data requirements and metric definitions consistently
  • Perform data validation and reconciliation to ensure reporting integrity
  • Recommend incremental improvements to reports or analytic processes
  • Analyze Medical & Operational Data for Trends & Insights
  • Evaluate claims, utilization, pharmacy, or operational data to identify patterns
  • Compare actual experience to expectations and explain variances
  • Quantify preliminary financial or operational impacts of observed trends
  • Develop charts and summaries that highlight actionable insights
  • Provide Cross-Functional Analytical Support
  • Respond to questions from Finance, Operations, Clinical, or Product partners
  • Support cross-functional projects through data preparation and analysis
  • Explain methodologies and results with growing confidence and independence
  • Document assumptions, methods, and limitations for transparency
  • Build Analytical Skills & Team Effectiveness
  • Follow best practices in coding, data handling, and documentation
  • Incorporate feedback to improve analytical quality and efficiency
  • Share observations that support process or reporting enhancements
  • Continue developing technical and healthcare domain expertise

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a related field
  • 3+ years of experience beyond degree

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of work experience beyond degree in healthcare analytics or data roles within the healthcare or insurance industries with a focus on employer group or client stakeholders
  • 1+ years’ experience using SQL, SAS or Snowflake programming experience
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and visualization techniques/software (e.g. Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau)
  • John Hopkins ACG Grouper, Milliman HCG Grouper, Symmetry ETG Grouper

This position is an Office role, which requires an employee to work onsite, on average, 3 days per week. We are open to candidates located near one of the following office locations: Minnetonka, MN, or Madison, WI.

The full salary grade for this position is $62,700 - $107,500. While the full salary grade is provided, the typical hiring salary range for this role is expected to be between $62,700 - $94,080. Annual salary range placement will depend on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, education, work experience, applicable certifications and/or licensure, the position's scope and responsibility, internal pay equity and external market salary data. In addition to compensation, Medica offers a generous total rewards package that includes competitive medical, dental, vision, PTO, Holidays, paid volunteer time off, 401K contributions, caregiver services and many other benefits to support our employees.

The compensation and benefits information is provided as of the date of this posting. Medica’s compensation and benefits are subject to change at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

Eligibility to work in the US: Medica does not offer work visa sponsorship for this role. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. Employment is contingent on verification of identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer, where all qualified candidates receive consideration for employment indiscriminate of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

descriptionHtml:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems. The Enterprise Data team is focused on maximizing the value of our data ecosystem and enabling real-time, intelligent experiences built on a scalable, future ready foundation. We are a highly collaborative, cross-functional team working across Product, Technology, Design, Risk, and other partners to build a modern enterprise data ecosystem.

We are looking for an exceptional and innovative Senior Data Analyst to solve complex business and product challenges across our Enterprise Data Product teams. You will lead Product Analytics to measure and improve the performance and health of our Products and Platforms, transforming complex data into actionable, AI-enabled insights that shape product strategy and drive better decisions. If you are a strategic thinker who thrives on solving complex problems and using Data and AI to influence product development, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

  • Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
  • Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
  • Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

  • Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
  • Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

  • Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
  • Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
  • Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
  • Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
  • Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
  • Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services

Basic Qualifications:

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
  • At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
  • At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
  • At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
  • At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
  • At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
  • At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
  • At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

McLean, VA: $111,200 - $126,900 for Sr. Data Analyst

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries.

If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1-800-304-9102 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com

Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site.

Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp.
