Job Summary

Assure data accuracy, consistency and integrity within the primary Project Management computer systems. Provide data analytics expertise to assure execution of Quality Planning, Quality Assurance and Quality Control within AEP Project Management. This position is responsible for working on data analysis projects that gather and integrate large volumes of data by performing analysis, interpreting results, and developing actionable insights and recommendations for use across AEP Project Management. This includes data mining, data auditing, aggregation, validation, reconciliation, and visualization.

Job Description

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide framework for enforcing data integrity rules during data entry. Provide regular, scheduled reports and ad-hoc and other information to project management team and leadership so that corrective measures can be put in place.
  • Working with IT Support, provide framework for updating data for data correction activities. Monitors the progress and effectiveness of the project quality management system.
  • Recommend and implement improvements when required. Identify quality improvement measures and work with management to implement.
  • Work with project teams to put structure in place to monitor quality of process, documentation, scope adherence, etc., and to control influences that seek to change it.
  • Perform project process and procedure alignment review as well as data analytics to ensure departmental compliance for audits.
  • Monitor macro and micro performance metrics to measure process/productivity improvement effectiveness. Provide an objective view to ensure the metrics are driving correct behavior across the broader organization. Provides on-going continuous improvement support and training as required.
  • Collaborate with schedule and cost groups within the QA/QC department to ensure that cost and schedule processes are aligned.
  • Provide status reports to Project Support Manager. Facilitate the cultural desire within the organization to share and adopt best practices across AEP. Direct and guide the administration of the AEP project management organizational standards and assist in the management of projects to those standards.
  • Adhere to the guidance and standards put forth by the AEP Project Management Governance Committee.

What We’re Looking For:

Education requirements are listed below:

Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Operations Research, Applied Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or related quantitative discipline.

Experience Requirements Are Listed Below:

  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience with a demonstrated knowledge of analytics and statistical software such as SQL, R, Python, Excel, Hadoop, Tableau, SAS, SPSS and others to perform analysis and interpret data is attained. Two (2) years' experience as a Project Data Analyst (grade 006) is preferred but not required. Clear understanding of typical Project Control methods and procedures consistent with Project Management Institute's Project Management Book of Knowledge (PMBOK) methodologies is preferred. Experience with departmental computer systems is preferred but not required.
  • License/Certifications: Project Management Institute's (PMI) Project Management Professional (PMP) or AACE certification preferred. American Society for Quality (ASQ) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) certification preferred.

Other:

  • 10-15% Travel as needed to support AEP regions. Effective and compelling communication, including the use of effective listening, with all stakeholders including team members, sponsors, management and senior management.
  • Ability to apply strong analytical and complex problem solving and critical thinking skills. Provide training support as needed for Project Management as well as other departments impacted by departmental reporting, policies, and processes.
  • Identify quality improvement measures and work with management to implement. Safely and effectively perform light physical duties at various work sites including home and AEP locations in varying conditions.
  • Understand and support the policies, values, principles, structure and behavior of AEP. For nuclear positions, work performed at nuclear power sites may involve work in hazardous areas and possible radiation exposure within the limits prescribed by the NRC.

What You’ll Get:

In addition to competitive compensation, AEP offers a unique comprehensive benefits package that aims to support and enhance the overall well-being of our employees.

descriptionHtml:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

  • Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
  • Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
  • Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

  • Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
  • Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

  • Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
  • Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
  • Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
  • Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
  • Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
  • Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree plus at least 5 years of experience in data analytics, or Master’s Degree plus at least 3 years in data analytics, or PhD
  • At least 3 years of experience in at least one scripting language
  • At least 1 year of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
  • At least 3 years of experience in querying and analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
  • At least 4 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
  • At least 4 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
  • At least 2 years of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
  • At least 2 years of experience delivering Data Governance and Data Quality Management concepts and practices within the financial services industry

We are seeking a highly analytical Data Analyst with 4-6 years of experience transforming complex data into actionable business insights. The Data Analyst will extract and validate data from Excel files, PDFs, and internal systems, leverage technologies such as SQL and Snowflake to clean and structure data and utilize AI tools like Claude Code to accelerate data preparation, analysis, and reporting. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable writing complex queries, automating processes, and partnering with business stakeholders to solve problems through data.

Worksite Location: Minneapolis, 5 days onsite (business casual)

Salary: $95,000 - 125,000 + bonus

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, Paid Parking, Onsite Gym

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Extract, organize, and validate data from Excel spreadsheets, PDF documents, databases, and third-party systems.
  • Clean, standardize, transform, and aggregate complex datasets from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries, data models, and datasets within related data platforms.
  • Leverage Claude Code and other AI-enabled tools to streamline data ingestion, transformation, documentation, and reporting workflows.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, exceptions, risks, and opportunities that support business decision-making.
  • Create and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, and visualizations for operational and executive stakeholders.
  • Partner with business teams to gather requirements, define metrics, and deliver meaningful analytical solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and data preparation processes.
  • Support data quality, governance, and documentation efforts to improve trust and usability of business data.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4-6 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related field.
  • Advanced Excel skills including complex formulas, lookups, PivotTables, and large dataset management.
  • Strong SQL skills with experience developing queries, transformations, and analytical datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake or similar cloud-based data platforms.
  • Proven ability to clean, integrate, and analyze data from disparate sources, including Excel files, PDFs, and structured databases.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools such as Claude Code, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar technologies to improve productivity and automate data-related tasks.
  • Experience creating dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who enjoys digging into messy data, can efficiently move information from spreadsheets and PDFs into structured datasets, is comfortable writing SQL, and embraces AI tools to improve accuracy, speed, and productivity.

descriptionHtml:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as "absolutely excellent" and our people as "instrumental to organization's success." Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair's Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will turn a federal program's operational data into figures its people can rely on. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your first project will likely have you building the reporting a federal program runs on. Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Work with the people who own each process to define its measures, and document the business rules behind every figure
  • Write the Structured Query Language (SQL) that turns platform data on Amazon Aurora and related Amazon Web Services (AWS) data stores into clean, reconciled analytical datasets
  • Build the recurring reports, dashboards, and data visualizations the program actually uses, with documented measures, refresh schedules, and access controls, designed to answer the question, load fast, and never mislead with a scale or a label
  • Trace each discrepancy to its source, whether a definition, timing, a filter, or a source system, until the figure is explained
  • Produce the quality evidence behind the reporting: validation checks, reconciliation reports, and issue logs that hold up in an audit
  • Replace manual reporting with repeatable, tested workflows
  • Make AI-assisted analysis standard practice, using coding assistants and language models across the work with your own judgment on top

You help deliver figures a federal program can run on, each with the provenance to show where it came from, and clean datasets that give every later analysis solid ground.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of data analysis experience using SQL
  • Bachelor's degree
  • A strong working command of SQL
  • Experience building reports and dashboards in a business intelligence tool, such as Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable tool
  • Familiarity with Python or R for analysis scripting
  • The ability to own an analysis from the first question to a delivered, documented answer
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • Master's degree in a relevant field
  • Experience with cloud data platforms on AWS
  • Experience with federal program, financial, or performance data
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development and analysis tools

Who You Are

You are exact with numbers and wary of any you cannot explain: an anomaly is something to run down, not a footnote. You move easily between a stakeholder's question and the data that answers it, and you would rather hand a program one figure it can trust than ten it cannot. You adapt, and you pick up new concepts, systems, and tools fast enough to stay ahead of what the program needs as projects finish and priorities shift. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

  • A practical command of SQL and spreadsheets, with Python or R scripting where it makes the work faster or safer
  • The discipline of defined measures: rules written down, sources reconciled, and reports that refresh without surprises
  • The judgment to pick the chart that serves the reader, and the restraint to leave out the one that does not
  • The care to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $67,000 to $123,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

As a BI analyst, you will play a key role in creating effective reports and dashboards, recommending decisions based on detailed analysis, market forecasts and analysis internally as well as for our shipper and carrier partners.


Role & Responsibilities:

  • Leverage data to provide consultation to sales and operations to meet shipper and carrier requirements
  • Create dashboards and reports to measure performance, automate operational processes, and drive revenue and business decisions
  • Create detailed analysis, outlining problems, opportunities, and solutions for the business
  • Assist in effectively using and maintaining both internal and external data sources
  • Take ownership of organizational initiatives and projects
  • Partner with key internal stakeholders to ensure project success
  • Lead ad-hoc analysis to provide actionable insights to the business
  • Ensure that all departmental deadlines are met
  • Escalate known issues and highlight areas for process improvement


Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field of study, such as finance, accounting, engineering, operations research, math, or statistics
  • 1-2 years data analytics experience


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Solid understanding of data structures and SQL
  • Considerable experience with visualization tools such as Tableau, SSRS, or Power BI
  • Intermediate Excel skills
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and timelines simultaneously
  • Ability to collaborate and communicate with stakeholders
  • Strong time management skills

WORK ENVIRONMENT


Standard office environment, usually indoors away from the elements with moderate noise. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


PHYSICAL EFFORT


Maintain a stationary position for extended periods; move about the office, operate computers and files, as needed; and frequently communicate with others. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. Occasionally, the employee is required to lift boxes up to 20 pounds.


SCHEDULING

This is a full-time benefits-eligible position, working Monday through Friday; 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. An employee in this position must be available to work occasionally on weekends and evenings, during peak periods.


TRAVEL

Local travel is required. Out of state travel is limited, but may be required for special training/conferences.

Who is Fusion Technology?

Fusion Technology is a performance-driven HUBZone Small Business concern residing in the heart of the beautiful mountainsides of West Virginia, steps away from the Federal Bureau of Investigation's Criminal Justice Information Services Division's Headquarters. descriptionHtml:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

At KAYAK, data is how we make better decisions for travelers and partners alike — and the Commercial Analytics team is at the center of that work. As an Analyst on this globally distributed team, you'll help turn commercial data into clear, actionable insights that directly support revenue decisions across flights, hotels, cars, and advertising, working closely with colleagues across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific.

This role will be required to work from our Cambridge, MA office at least 3 days per week.

In This Role, You Will

  • Analyze commercial datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and performance drivers across travel verticals including flights, hotels, cars, and advertising
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports using data visualization and reporting tools to give commercial teams timely visibility into business performance
  • Respond to ad-hoc data and analysis requests from commercial teams
  • Monitor data accuracy, troubleshoot discrepancies, and maintain reporting reliability across existing data sources
  • Define and document key performance indicators (KPIs) in collaboration with commercial teams, and build models to support forecasting and goal-setting
  • Collaborate with data engineering and business intelligence colleagues to ensure data quality and translate commercial reporting needs into technical requirements
  • Contribute to global analytics projects such as inventory forecasting, partner-facing reporting tools, and the development of AI-assisted analytics solutions
  • Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior commercial leaders.

Please Apply If You Have

  • At least 2 years of experience working with data in an analytical, business intelligence, operations, or similar role — we value demonstrated ability and transferable skills; equivalent experience, training, or self-directed learning is considered
  • At least 2 years of hands-on SQL experience, writing queries to explore and manipulate large datasets
  • Hands-on experience with at least one data visualization or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Superset, Power BI, or a comparable platform)
  • The ability to communicate data findings clearly to people with varying levels of technical background, including in written summaries and presentations
  • Curiosity, attention to detail, and an enjoyment of working through ambiguous problems using data
  • Comfort working in a global, cross-functional environment with colleagues across multiple time zones

To Stand Out, You Also Have

  • Experience with Python or R for data manipulation, automation, or modeling
  • Familiarity with the travel, e-commerce, or digital advertising industry
  • Experience working with AI or agentic analytics tools
  • Exposure to large-scale data warehouse environments (e.g., Trino, Vertica, or similar).

Benefits And Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
    • No meeting Fridays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans
  • Free lunch 2 days per week
  • Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday socials, and more
There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts-based role is $90,000-$105,000.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need an accommodation for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

descriptionHtml:
General Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Data Analyst to support a large, 30-shareholder urology practice with integrated medical oncology, radiation oncology, and multiple ancillary service lines. This role is responsible for transforming data from clinical, operational, and financial systems into actionable insights that drive performance, efficiency, and strategic decision-making.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with healthcare data ecosystems, including practice management, EHR, and oncology-specific systems.

Key Responsibilities

Data Management & Integration

  • Extract, validate, and integrate data from multiple systems, including:
  • Allscripts (Practice Management)
  • Veradigm (EHR)
  • ARIA Oncology Information System (Radiation Oncology)
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines and standardized datasets for reporting and analytics
  • Ensure data integrity, consistency, and compliance with healthcare regulations (e.g., HIPAA)


Reporting & Analytics

  • Design and maintain dashboards and reports for:
  • Provider productivity (wRVUs, encounters, procedures)
  • Financial performance (collections, charges, payer mix, denials)
  • Radiation oncology utilization and throughput
  • Medical oncology infusion metrics
  • Ancillary service line performance (imaging, lab, pharmacy, etc.)
  • Deliver recurring and ad hoc reports to physicians, executives, and operational leaders
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement


Operational & Financial Insights

  • Analyze revenue cycle performance including:
  • Charge capture
  • Coding patterns
  • Denial trends and reimbursement optimization
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning initiatives
  • Partner with leadership to evaluate service line profitability and expansion opportunities


Clinical & Quality Analytics

  • Support quality reporting and value-based care initiatives
  • Analyze clinical outcomes, treatment patterns, and patient flow
  • Assist with registry reporting and compliance metrics (as applicable)


Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with physicians, administrators, billing teams, and IT
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences
  • Serve as a liaison between clinical operations and technical systems


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Health Informatics, Business, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare data analytics (multi-specialty or oncology preferred)
  • Strong experience with:
  • SQL and relational databases
  • Excel (advanced)
  • Data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar)
  • Experience working with EHR and PM systems (preferably Allscripts/Veradigm environments)
  • Understanding of healthcare financial and operational metrics (wRVUs, CPT/ICD coding, revenue cycle)


Key Competencies

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving
  • Attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Ability to manage large, complex datasets
  • Strong communication and data storytelling skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, physician-driven environment


Why This Role Matters

This position plays a critical role in helping a complex, high-volume specialty practice optimize performance across urology, medical oncology, and radiation oncology. The Data Analyst will directly influence financial outcomes, operational efficiency, and patient care quality through data-driven insights.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Health Informatics, Business, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare data analytics (multi-specialty or oncology preferred)
  • Strong experience with:
  • SQL and relational databases
  • Excel (advanced)
  • Data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar)
  • Experience working with EHR and PM systems (preferably Allscripts/Veradigm environments)
  • Understanding of healthcare financial and operational metrics (wRVUs, CPT/ICD coding, revenue cycle)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with oncology workflows (medical and/or radiation oncology)
  • Familiarity with radiation oncology data structures (e.g., ARIA)
  • Knowledge of ETL processes and data warehousing concepts
  • Experience with population health or value-based care analytics
  • Certification in healthcare analytics or data tools (e.g., CHDA, Power BI, Tableau)

Job Description - Data Analyst (Data & Analytics)

 

Mission of the Role:

 

Apex is looking for a Data Analyst who is passionate about helping build a world-class data and analytics organization. This individual would be responsible for (i) managing triaging reported data issues, (ii) supporting functions with ad-hoc data analysis, (iii) increasing the analytics posture of our data infrastructure, and (iv) being a thought partner on long-term strategic planning and data-driven growth initiatives with department leaders and other senior leaders within Apex.

This role is highly analytical, strategic, and data-oriented and is suited for someone who excels in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate will be able to technical and analytical capabilities, with a high level of emotional intelligence, to help grow the Company.

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Support Partner Services functions with ad-hoc data analysis capabilities such as data audit reports, producing curated data sets, and exploratory data analysis.
  • Take ownership of triaging reported data issues and identifying root cause.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics team to translate data analysis proof-of-concepts into Data Model enhancements.
  • Partner with Data & Analytics team to implement Data Quality checks within existing Data Pipelines.
  • Provide Data Analysis support for strategic initiatives.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align data strategies with organizational goals.

Experience:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or relevant field.
  • 3+ years of experience using Python & SQL in a Data Analysis role.
  • 3+ years of experience working with Python Data Science such as like Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn,
  • 3+ years using SQL functionality like CTEs, Pivots, Window Functions, etc.
  • Experienced with working with JSON data.
  • Experienced querying OLAP Data Models (Star Schema).
  • Experience with Snowflake & DBT is a plus.
  • Experience with AI, machine learning, or statistical analytics is a plus.

 

Personal Characteristics:

 

  • Proven adaptability in a fast-paced evolving technology landscape, with strong problem-solving ability and quick learning curve.
  • Analytical - finds meaning and action in numbers, and is a data-driven decision-maker

 

  • Exceptional formatting skills and attention to detail

 

  • Excellent communicator - written and oral

 

  • Stellar time management and organizational skills

 

  • Strong work ethic with a demonstrated history of outworking peers

 

  • Resourceful - figures out how to achieve results creatively with finite resources

 

  • Thrives in a nimble, lean, unstructured, fast-paced entrepreneurial environment

 

  • Works collaboratively and energetically

 

  • Impeccable integrity and ethical standards

 

  • Self-aware, accepting, honest, open, and respectful of others

 

  • An undying commitment to personal growth and development

 

Other:

 

Location: Tampa, FL/Dallas, TX

Compensation: Competitive

Other Benefits: medical, dental and vision coverage; unlimited PTO; 401(k) matching

Required Skills

  • Able to produce finished reports containing analyses, graphics, and recommendations.

  • Able to work independently.

B&A participates in e-Verify. We provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s I-9 Form to confirm work authorization.

B&A is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans Disabilities Act and applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact HR@bna-inc.com

If you have a positive can-do attitude and a drive for success, Solution One is looking for you! We are seeking a Data Analyst II for our client site in Fort Detrick, MD. For opportunities in your area, check out our Careers page at www.1soi.com/careers. About the position: The Data Analyst Level II provides advanced analytical, reporting, and information management support to the Army Medical Logistics Command (AMLC) Force Projection Directorate (FPD). The incumbent supports mission-critical medical logistics readiness programs by collecting, analyzing, validating, and reporting operational data that enables informed decision-making across Army Prepositioned Stocks (APS), Unit Deployment Packages (UDP), Medical Materiel Readiness Program (MMRP), Foreign Military Sales (FMS), and Medical Logistics Support Team (MLST) operations. The position serves as a key contributor in transforming complex logistics and readiness data into actionable information that improves operational effectiveness, supply chain performance, and mission readiness. Key Qualifications Essential Duties and Responsibilities Data Collection and Analysis

  • Collect, validate, analyze, and interpret data from multiple sources to support AMLC FPD operational, logistics, and readiness requirements.
  • Identify customer reporting requirements and determine technical, operational, and data-related issues affecting mission execution.
  • Analyze trends, performance indicators, inventory metrics, readiness data, and supply chain information to support leadership decision-making.
  • Perform quality assurance reviews to ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of data used for reporting and analysis. Reporting and Business Intelligence
  • Lead the development, design, and maintenance of recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical products.
  • Transform complex datasets into meaningful visualizations, metrics, and executive-level briefing materials.
  • Develop statistical reports, trend analyses, workload assessments, readiness reports, and operational performance metrics.
  • Support leadership with data-driven recommendations that improve resource allocation, mission planning, and operational execution. Information Systems Support
  • Analyze and troubleshoot information system requirements associated with logistics, supply, inventory, and readiness management programs.
  • Support data integration efforts between Government systems and organizational reporting tools.
  • Identify new data sources, reporting methodologies, and analytical techniques that improve data collection and reporting capabilities.
  • Assist with system testing, validation, and implementation activities related to data management solutions. Process Improvement and Mission Support
  • Evaluate existing business processes and recommend improvements that enhance efficiency, reporting accuracy, and operational visibility.
  • Assist in developing standard operating procedures (SOPs), data management guidance, user manuals, and training materials.
  • Support mission analysis efforts related to medical logistics readiness, force projection activities, and sustainment operations.
  • Collaborate with logistics analysts, procurement specialists, program managers, and Government personnel to address complex operational challenges. Strategic Decision Support
  • Prepare executive summaries, briefings, information papers, and management reports for AMLC leadership.
  • Support the development of performance measures and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) aligned with mission objectives.
  • Conduct research and analysis to support strategic planning initiatives, operational assessments, and readiness reviews.
  • Provide actionable insights that enhance medical materiel visibility, asset accountability, and supply chain responsiveness. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, information management, logistics analysis, or related analytical disciplines.
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, and analytical products using Microsoft Office applications and data visualization tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to collect, organize, analyze, and interpret large datasets.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Knowledge of data analytics principles, reporting methodologies, and performance measurement techniques.
  • Ability to identify trends, anomalies, and operational risks through quantitative and qualitative analysis.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Power BI, SharePoint, PowerPoint, and other reporting platforms.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of database concepts, data management practices, and data governance principles.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and reporting requirements in a dynamic operational environment.
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to data accuracy and integrity. Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting Army Medical Logistics Command (AMLC), Department of Defense (DoD), Defense Health Agency (DHA), or military logistics organizations.
  • Familiarity with Army medical logistics systems, supply chain management processes, and readiness reporting requirements.
  • Experience supporting Army Prepositioned Stocks (APS), Unit Deployment Packages (UDP), Medical Materiel Readiness Program (MMRP), Foreign Military Sales (FMS), or Medical Logistics Support Team (MLST) operations.
  • Experience developing Power BI dashboards, automated reporting solutions, and executive analytics products.
  • Knowledge of Army and DoD data management policies and business intelligence practices. Security Requirement
  • The individual selected for this position must possess or be able to obtain and maintain all required Government installation access credentials and security requirements necessary for contract performance. This may include a National Agency Check with Law and Credit (NACLC) / Tier 3 (T3) background investigation, as required by the Government. descriptionHtml:
The Senior Data Analyst will own end-to-end analytics for multiple key games, proactively identifying high-impact opportunities and translating complex or ambiguous product questions into clear, actionable strategies and experimentation plans.


In this role, you’ll partner cross-functionally with teams across Product Management, Ad Serving, Marketing, and Game Design, using data and insights to inform decision-making, evaluate performance, uncover opportunities, and help drive meaningful improvements across our games and the business.


Responsibilities:

  • Design, analyze, and interpret A/B tests for game features and monetization strategies, turning results into clear recommendations that improve retention, engagement, and ARPDAU.
  • Lead strategic analyses of player behavior and game systems to find growth opportunities and shape the product roadmap.
  • Build AI-powered self-serve agents and workflows that let game teams answer common data questions on their own and make the analytics team more efficient.
  • Define KPIs and build dashboards that track game performance across player types, game systems, and player experience.
  • Write tracking specs with designers and engineers so new features can be measured from day one.
  • Help prioritize data requests for supported games, balancing quick-turn asks with high-impact work.
  • Mentor junior analysts and product partners on experimental design, analysis, and interpreting data, and present findings and business impact to stakeholders and leadership.


Qualifications for Position:

  • BA/BS in Math, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.
  • 4+ years in product or data analytics, including 1+ years at a senior level, preferably in tech or gaming.
  • Advanced SQL skills for querying and analyzing large, complex datasets from multiple sources.
  • Experience with Python or R for analysis and modeling (e.g., regression, clustering, forecasting)
  • Strong grasp of experimental design and statistics.
  • Ability to connect analysis to business strategy and present clear, actionable recommendations to leadership.
  • Track record of proactively finding opportunities beyond assigned requests.
  • Experience using AI/LLM tools to automate analytics workflows or enable self-serve insights.
  • Experience mentoring junior analysts or teaching data best practices to non-technical partners.
  • Experience working with data engineering, product engineering, and marketing.
  • Nice to have – Experience in the gaming industry, particularly mobile gaming.

MobilityWare was recently named one of Built in LA’s Best Places to Work for the fifth year in a row and we’ve been recognized as one of the Best Places to Work in Orange County five times by the Orange County Business Journal and OC Register. While we’re proud to be the company behind some of mobile gaming’s most popular titles, our most important achievement is creating a work environment that encourages professional growth and prioritizes the wellness of all of our team members.


Do we have your attention yet? Here are just some of the perks of working with us:

  • We offer medical (100% paid option), dental (100% paid), vision (100% paid), unlimited PTO/Vacation, life insurance (100% paid), and a 401K with competitive contribution.

  • In the office we offer things like free lunch, free snacks, and free drinks.

descriptionHtml:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

As a key member of the Commercial Intelligence and Analytics team, you will take on a strategic role that combines advanced analytics, stakeholder partnership, and AI driven innovation. You will lead the development of scalable data products and analyses that directly support Circle’s Business and Marketing functions, while also identifying opportunities to incorporate AI tools and methodologies to enhance how insights are delivered across the business. This role sits at the intersection of data strategy and execution, helping the company make smarter decisions through high quality analysis, forward thinking automation, and technical leadership.

What You'll Work On

  • Delivering high impact analysis and reporting to support the Business and Marketing teams in understanding performance, risk, and opportunity
  • Designing and implementing scalable data models, dashboards, and pipelines that support accurate, self-service analytics
  • Identifying and leading the implementation of AI and ML tools to streamline data workflows and generate predictive insights
  • Partnering with senior leadership and the AI Engineering team to deliver insights and workflows that improve customer experience and maximize the value of strategic partnerships
  • Building and maintaining high quality documentation to support repeatable and transparent analysis
  • Driving operational excellence by applying strong data architecture and AI methods to enhance the effectiveness of business systems and workflows
  • Mentoring team members and contributing to best practices in analytics engineering and AI adoption

Core Requirements

What you’ll bring to Circle:

  • 7+ years of experience in sales analytics, business analytics, or a related field
  • Experience delivering advanced analytics to support strategic business decisions
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills to build scalable, reliable data products
  • Proficiency using APIs and Python to extract, transform, and analyze data across systems
  • Skill in developing prompts for AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar systems
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional projects that drive measurable impact
  • Ability to partner with senior stakeholders to align data initiatives with business goals
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Strong knowledge domain of blockchain ecosystem

Preferred Requirements

  • Familiarity with modern analytics tools such as Superset and Hex
  • Understanding of AI models, embeddings, and frameworks
  • Familiarity with advanced Marketing measurement models such as multi-touch attribution
  • Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS and GSuite.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

Base Pay Range: $157,500 - $190,833

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to accommodations@circle.com for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

descriptionHtml:
At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.co m to learn more about us.

As part of H1’s hiring process, all candidates are required to participate in an in-person final interview. Depending on your location, this may require travel.

As a Senior Data Analyst on the Client Delivery team, you will serve as the bridge between our Commercial stakeholders and data teams — translating business needs into technical data requirements, executing large-scale data extractions, and ensuring the quality and accuracy of every deliverable.

What You'll Do At H1

The Client Delivery team is responsible for delivering high-quality data insights and analytics that power Commercial and Sales decisions. Our objective is to enable fast, accurate, and scalable data extraction and reporting across large healthcare datasets — supporting strategic initiatives, client deliverables, and pre-sales activities.

As a Senior Data Analyst on the Client Delivery team, your day typically includes:

  • Partnering directly with Commercial, Sales, and Business stakeholders to gather, clarify, and translate business requirements into precise technical data specifications.
  • Writing and optimizing complex SQL queries — including joins, CTEs, subqueries, and window functions — to extract and transform large datasets from cloud environments including AWS Athena.
  • Using Python (pandas, NumPy) to automate data workflows, build reusable scripts, and perform data manipulation and validation at scale.
  • Performing rigorous QA and validation on all data deliverables — ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency before output reaches stakeholders.
  • Translating complex analytical findings into clear, concise insights and presentations that both technical and non-technical audiences can act on.
  • Managing multiple concurrent data requests and prioritizing competing business needs in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.
  • Supporting pre-sales and RFP activities by providing accurate, timely data outputs to the Commercial team.
  • Collaborating cross-functionally with Operations, Strategy, and Data Engineering to align on data availability, definitions, and methodology.
  • Taking full ownership of deliverables — proactively identifying data gaps, quality issues, or ambiguous requirements and resolving them with minimal supervision.
  • Contributing to analytics best practices, documentation, and self-service reporting capabilities across the team.

About You

You are a technically strong data analyst who thrives at the intersection of business and data. You take complex, ambiguous business questions and turn them into structured data requirements, then deliver clean, validated outputs that stakeholders can trust. You are fluent in SQL and Python, comfortable in cloud data environments, and bring the communication skills to make your findings land clearly with non-technical audiences. You manage your own workload, push for quality, and bring a solutions-first mindset to every request. You are equally at home in a stakeholder meeting as you are deep in a query.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role.
  • Expert-level SQL proficiency — complex joins, CTEs, window functions, subqueries, and performance optimization across large datasets.
  • Hands-on Python experience (pandas, NumPy) for data manipulation, automation, validation, and analytical scripting.
  • Proficiency with AWS Athena or comparable cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) for querying large-scale datasets.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into clear, executable technical data specifications.
  • Strong data quality instincts — experience performing end-to-end QA and validation on high-stakes analytical deliverables.
  • Excellent communication skills — proven ability to explain complex data findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent requests and prioritizing across competing business needs.
  • Good to have: experience with a BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, or Looker) for dashboard and report development.
  • Good to have: familiarity with healthcare data (medical claims, Clinical Trials,healthcare providers and organizations) or health insurance terminology.
  • Good to have: experience supporting pre-sales, RFP responses, or client-facing data deliverables.

Compensation

This rolepays $60,000 to $75,000 per year, based on experience, in addition to equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units.

Anticipated role close date: 12/15/2026

H1 OFFERS

  • Full suite of health insurance options, in addition to generous paid time off
  • Pre-planned company-wide wellness holidays
  • Retirement options
  • Health & charitable donation stipends
  • Impactful Business Resource Groups
  • The opportunity to work with leading biotech and life sciences companies in an innovative industry with a mission to improve healthcare around the globe

Job Description

Join a federally funded clinical and translational research laboratory whose active portfolio spans immune resilience, biological aging, military performance, infection, asthma, exercise physiology, heat stress, and trauma, with scientific output reaching multispecialty journals including Nature Communications and Aging Cell. The Data Analyst — Associate supports the research data management, reporting, and analytical workflows that underlie this portfolio.

This position may be filled at multiple education and training levels, including candidates with a bachelor’s degree in biology, biostatistics, biomedical informatics, or a related field (with relevant analytical experience), candidates with a master’s degree, and candidates with a doctoral (PhD) degree. The specific appointment will be calibrated to the candidate’s background and the laboratory’s active analytical needs.

Reporting to the Principal Investigator and senior analytical personnel, the Data Analyst — Associate contributes to the compilation, review, and submission of research data, reports, and documentation across the laboratory’s active studies. Core responsibilities include supporting data management for ongoing clinical and translational research, preparing study progress reports for federal sponsors and institutional stakeholders, developing ad hoc analytical reports as requested, maintaining documentation consistent with institutional and regulatory requirements, and ensuring that research reporting is accurate, timely, and audit-ready.

The role is positioned to support scientific decision-making across the laboratory’s active federally funded research. The successful candidate will work with the Principal Investigator, the laboratory biostatistician, postdoctoral fellows, and research coordinators, contributing to the analytical infrastructure that supports the laboratory’s publication record and sponsor reporting obligations. This position supports research operations and academic activities, including clinical and translational research, and is not focused on financial analysis, budgeting, accounting, or financial reporting.

Responsibilities

  • The lab is currently engaged in exciting, state-of-the-art, multidisciplinary projects focused on infection, aging, asthma, and exercise, and job duties are aligned with these research initiatives.
  • Compile and report data to support institutional compliance requirements.
  • Utilize basic programming techniques to extract, manipulate, analyze, and report data to internal and external constituencies.
  • Utilizes existing algorithms to merge complex data into new datasets.
  • Collaborates with team members across the institution to access data and articulate data requirements for various projects and initiatives.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining data repositories and databases.
  • Ensures compliance with deliverable reporting requirements by performing quality data audits and analysis.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and provide recommendations based on data insights.
  • Prepare reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate data effectively.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Experience in manipulating and analyzing data from varying sources to determine reporting needs and design specifications.
  • Familiarity of empirical research and answering questions with data.
  • Experience with statistical tools such as SPSS, SAS, or similar analytic tools.
  • Experience in dashboard sustainment using visualization tools such as but not limited to Tableau.
  • Proficient written and verbal skills, including the ability to convey information effectively.
  • Ability to work with a diverse group of colleagues as part of a diverse and dynamic team.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree degree in a related field is required.

Experience

  • Two (2) years of related experience is required.

Required Skills

Two (2) years of related experience is required.

About Us

The University of Texas at San Antonio (UT San Antonio) is a nationally recognized, top-tier public research university that unites the power of higher education, biomedical discovery and healthcare within one visionary institution. As the third-largest research university in Texas and a Carnegie R1-designated institution, UT San Antonio is a model of access and excellence — advancing knowledge, social mobility and public health across South Texas and beyond. UT San Antonio serves approximately 42,000 students in 320 academic programs spanning science, engineering, medicine, health, liberal arts, AI, cybersecurity, business, education and more. With 17,000 faculty and staff, UT San Antonio has been recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Employers for Company Culture .

Benefits Overview

UT Health San Antonio offers an excellent benefits package for its employees. Employees who work at least 20 hours a week, with an appointment of at least 4.5 months, are eligible for benefits.

Medical - UT SELECT Medical insurance is offered free for employees and administered by Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Texas. Family members can be added to the plan through payroll deduction. Employees and their dependents can also receive discounted copays and coinsurance when using UT Health Physicians, a network of 800 premier physicians including more than 100 specialists. Employees receive $50,000 of group term life insurance and $50,000 of basic accidental death and dismemberment insurance for free, with options to purchase additional employee and dependent coverage for both at group rates.

Dental - Three dental insurance plan options are available for employees and their families through Delta Dental Insurance Company, two PPOs and one dental HMO plan. Both PPO plans allow employees to choose any licensed dentist.

Vision - Fully insured Vision Care benefits are offered by Superior Vision Services. Two vision plan options that offer either standard or enhanced vision benefits.

Disability - Employees can enroll in the Disability Insurance which provides income if a non-work related illness or injury prevents you from working.

FSAs - Employees can enroll in flexible spending accounts (FSAs) to set aside money from earnings before taxes for qualifying dependent day care expenses or out-of-pocket health care expenses.

Retirement - Employees are eligible for either the Teacher Retirement System (TRS) or the Optional Retirement Plan (ORP). TRS is a defined benefit retirement plan which UT Health matches employee contributions. ORP is for eligible faculty staff employees. Voluntary retirement programs are also available to invest before- or after-tax dollars with the choice of five quality retirement plan providers.

Time Off - A generous leave program offers multiple paid leave options:

  • Front-loaded Paid Time Off: 128 to 208 hours (16 to 26 days) of Paid Time Off based on years of service, given at the start of each fiscal year. PTO may be prorated in year one based on date of hire.
  • Extended Illness Bank: 8 hours (1 day) accrued per month which can be used for illness or injury after one day of Paid Time Off is taken.
  • Paid Family Leave: Up to 240 hours (6 weeks) to care for a spouse, child, or parent after 6 months of consecutive employment.
  • Holidays: 12 set paid holidays each year.

Discounts - Employees enjoy a range of discounts on services, tickets, and gym membership.

EEO Statement

UT Health San Antonio is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. It is our policy to promote and ensure equal employment opportunity for all individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

Job Title: Junior Data Analyst

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Continental US

* * *

The Opportunity

This role supports the growing demand for standardized reporting, data automation, and site‑specific analytics across CACI Supply Chain. The junior analyst will help maintain and enhance Power BI reporting, perform data validation and ETL support, and engage directly with supply chain sites through both virtual and in‑person sessions. They will assist with data quality improvements, KPI development, and emerging analytics initiatives such as forecasting and EDW data ingestion. The position requires foundational skills in data analysis, communication, and supply‑chain data concepts, with desired capabilities in Python, SQL, API integration, and enterprise system familiarity. Overall, this role expands the team’s capacity to deliver consistent, accurate, and scalable analytics solutions across the organization.

Position will be onsite in either Florham Park, NJ or Saratoga, FL

Must be a US Citizen

Responsibilities

  • Support creation, maintenance, and enhancement of Power BI reports across Supply Chain functions.
  • Assist with ETL processes, data validation, and automation of recurring data tasks.
  • Conduct data quality checks and help resolve discrepancies across related systems.
  • Partner with site personnel to understand reporting gaps, usability issues, and opportunities for new analytics tools.
  • Participate in in‑person site visits to provide report training, gather requirements, and support local analytics challenges.
  • Support KPI generation and monitoring under direction from Supply Chain leadership.
  • Contribute to building and maintaining complex data models and forecasting tools.
  • Assist with API integrations, data ingestion processes, and early-stage EDW pipeline development.
  • Provide ongoing virtual support of report walkthroughs, and user guidance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent data usage, reporting standards, and documentation.

Qualifications

Required

  • Foundational experience with data analysis and reporting tools (Power BI, Excel, SQL).
  • Basic understanding of ETL concepts, data modeling, and data transformation workflows.
  • Ability to work with large datasets, perform data validation, and troubleshoot data quality issues.
  • Familiarity with supply chain concepts such as lead times, item master data, order quantities, and category structures.
  • Strong communication skills for engaging with stakeholders across multiple sites.
  • Ability to document processes, track requirements, and support recurring reporting operations.
  • Interest in developing automation skills using Power Query, Python, or similar tools.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast‑paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy, consistency, and data integrity.

Must be a US Citizen

Desired

  • Experience with API integration, Python scripting, or advanced SQL.
  • Exposure to enterprise systems such as Infor, or EDW architectures.
  • Prior involvement in supply chain analytics or operational reporting roles.
  • Experience conducting user feedback sessions, requirements gathering, or report usability analysis.
  • Demonstrated interest in forecasting, predictive analytics, or building advanced BI models.

What You Can Expect

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$53,100-$106,300

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

descriptionHtml:
Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brands include Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore, which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About The Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Sr Data Analyst – Store Analytics, to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. The Sr Data Analyst – Store Analytics serves as a strategic analytics partner to Stores leadership and enterprise leaders, driving deeper understanding of store performance through diagnostic and exploratory analysis. This role goes beyond reporting to identify root causes of business performance, uncover opportunities, develop actionable recommendations, and influence decisions that improve sales, productivity, customer experience, and operational effectiveness.

The Sr Analyst independently leads complex analyses, develops scalable analytical frameworks, partners closely with business leaders and Data Engineering, and helps shape the evolution of the Store Insights capability.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities

  • Lead complex diagnostic and ad hoc analyses that identify root causes of store performance, quantify business opportunities, and guide strategic decision-making across Stores.
  • Independently frame ambiguous business questions, formulate analytical approaches, synthesize multiple data sources, and translate findings into executive-ready recommendations.
  • Perform root cause analysis to explain sales trends, labor productivity, conversion, customer behavior, and operational performance, developing hypotheses and validating findings through quantitative analysis.
  • Proactively identify emerging risks and opportunities across the store fleet by monitoring leading performance indicators and conducting exploratory analyses.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards and analytical solutions that enable leaders to self-serve insights while ensuring metric governance and reporting consistency.
  • Serve as a key analytics partner in the migration from Tableau to Power BI by leading report validation, metric reconciliation, user acceptance testing, and adoption of standardized reporting.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and business stakeholders to validate semantic-layer logic, metric definitions, data quality, and reporting consistency.
  • Drive development of scalable Store Insights capabilities by identifying repeatable analytical opportunities, automating recurring analyses, and advancing self-service analytics.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior leaders, influencing business strategy through clear storytelling and data-driven insights.
  • Support store growth analytics initiatives through data preparation, exploratory analysis, performance tracking, and post-investment measurement for new stores, remodels, and market activations.
  • Develop repeatable analytics workflows that reduce manual reporting effort and improve the speed, quality, and consistency of insight delivery.
  • Create executive-ready charts, tables, dashboards, and written summaries that communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Apply advanced analytics tools and techniques, including SQL, Power BI, Python, and external data sources, to solve complex business problems and continuously improve analytical capabilities.
  • Recommend new metrics, analytical approaches, and measurement frameworks that improve how Stores evaluate performance and make decisions.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Business, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, business intelligence, consulting, retail analytics, or related quantitative disciplines, with demonstrated success solving complex business problems through data.
  • Demonstrated experience performing diagnostic, root cause, and exploratory analyses that influenced business decisions.
  • Proven ability to work independently with minimal direction, prioritize competing initiatives, and manage multiple high-impact analytical projects.
  • Experience presenting analytical findings to senior leadership and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency with experience optimizing complex queries and working with large enterprise datasets.
  • Strong experience with Power BI, semantic models, DAX, and modern BI best practices.
  • Working knowledge of Python, statistical analysis, and modern analytics workflows.
  • Experience applying statistical methods, experimentation, forecasting, or predictive techniques is preferred.
  • Experience in retail, multi-unit operations, consumer analytics, or store performance analytics strongly preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated experience with data validation, KPI governance, and metric consistency.
  • Ability to synthesize findings into clear written and verbal recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Experience working with cross-functional partners to translate business questions into analytical solutions.

Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

  • Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time
  • Ability to stoop, kneel, bend at the waist, and reach daily
  • Able to lift and move up to 25 pounds occasionally
  • Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment
  • Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location

Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go Tailoredbrands.com/working-here/people-culture.

Work-Life Balance

Responsibilities

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:

  • Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development
  • Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend
  • Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday

The starting salary for this position is $106,800 – $145,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, and qualifications. Over time, and subject to performance, tenure, and evolving responsibilities, total compensation for this role may grow to as much as $222,394. Other compensation may include a 10% Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) bonus paid out according to policy.
