descriptionText:
Tailored Brands is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brands include Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore, which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About The Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Sr Data Analyst – Store Analytics, to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. The Sr Data Analyst – Store Analytics serves as a strategic analytics partner to Stores leadership and enterprise leaders, driving deeper understanding of store performance through diagnostic and exploratory analysis. This role goes beyond reporting to identify root causes of business performance, uncover opportunities, develop actionable recommendations, and influence decisions that improve sales, productivity, customer experience, and operational effectiveness.

The Sr Analyst independently leads complex analyses, develops scalable analytical frameworks, partners closely with business leaders and Data Engineering, and helps shape the evolution of the Store Insights capability.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities 



-  Lead complex diagnostic and ad hoc analyses that identify root causes of store performance, quantify business opportunities, and guide strategic decision-making across Stores.
-  Independently frame ambiguous business questions, formulate analytical approaches, synthesize multiple data sources, and translate findings into executive-ready recommendations.
-  Perform root cause analysis to explain sales trends, labor productivity, conversion, customer behavior, and operational performance, developing hypotheses and validating findings through quantitative analysis.
-  Proactively identify emerging risks and opportunities across the store fleet by monitoring leading performance indicators and conducting exploratory analyses.
-  Develop and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards and analytical solutions that enable leaders to self-serve insights while ensuring metric governance and reporting consistency.
-  Serve as a key analytics partner in the migration from Tableau to Power BI by leading report validation, metric reconciliation, user acceptance testing, and adoption of standardized reporting.
-  Partner with Data Engineering and business stakeholders to validate semantic-layer logic, metric definitions, data quality, and reporting consistency.
-  Drive development of scalable Store Insights capabilities by identifying repeatable analytical opportunities, automating recurring analyses, and advancing self-service analytics.
-  Present findings and recommendations to senior leaders, influencing business strategy through clear storytelling and data-driven insights.
-  Support store growth analytics initiatives through data preparation, exploratory analysis, performance tracking, and post-investment measurement for new stores, remodels, and market activations.
-  Develop repeatable analytics workflows that reduce manual reporting effort and improve the speed, quality, and consistency of insight delivery.
-  Create executive-ready charts, tables, dashboards, and written summaries that communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
-  Apply advanced analytics tools and techniques, including SQL, Power BI, Python, and external data sources, to solve complex business problems and continuously improve analytical capabilities.
-  Recommend new metrics, analytical approaches, and measurement frameworks that improve how Stores evaluate performance and make decisions.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience



-  Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Business, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
-  8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, business intelligence, consulting, retail analytics, or related quantitative disciplines, with demonstrated success solving complex business problems through data.
-  Demonstrated experience performing diagnostic, root cause, and exploratory analyses that influenced business decisions.
-  Proven ability to work independently with minimal direction, prioritize competing initiatives, and manage multiple high-impact analytical projects.
-  Experience presenting analytical findings to senior leadership and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
-  Advanced SQL proficiency with experience optimizing complex queries and working with large enterprise datasets.
-  Strong experience with Power BI, semantic models, DAX, and modern BI best practices.
-  Working knowledge of Python, statistical analysis, and modern analytics workflows.
-  Experience applying statistical methods, experimentation, forecasting, or predictive techniques is preferred.
-  Experience in retail, multi-unit operations, consumer analytics, or store performance analytics strongly preferred.
-  Strong attention to detail and demonstrated experience with data validation, KPI governance, and metric consistency.
-  Ability to synthesize findings into clear written and verbal recommendations for business stakeholders.
-  Experience working with cross-functional partners to translate business questions into analytical solutions.

Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands



-  Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time
-  Ability to stoop, kneel, bend at the waist, and reach daily
-  Able to lift and move up to 25 pounds occasionally
-  Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment
-  Hours regularly 40 hours per week, as work dictates, from a remote office location

Benefits

This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go Tailoredbrands.com/working-here/people-culture.

Work-Life Balance

Responsibilities

We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:



-  Meeting-Free Fridays (encouraged) | so you can catch up on work and self-development
-  Summer Fridays | from Memorial Day to Labor Day so you can enjoy a head-start to the weekend
-  Holiday Early Departure | close out early the business day before a company observed holiday

The starting salary for this position is $106,800 – $145,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on factors such as skills, experience, and qualifications. Over time, and subject to performance, tenure, and evolving responsibilities, total compensation for this role may grow to as much as $222,394. Other compensation may include a 10% Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) bonus paid out according to policy. Base pay information is based on market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable.

The Program Data Analyst supports Aledade's Michigan Field Team by working on key programs and processes and collaborating across teams to improve market performance through novel, data-driven insights. This analyst develops the reporting and analytic tools the market relies on, including support for value-based contracts that are not covered by Aledade's central BI and analytics platforms, and works closely with divisions across the company including Executive Leadership, Product Development and Adoption, Business Development, ACO operations, and Technology. The ideal candidate has experience in healthcare analytics, population health, and value-based care, and a passion for having a direct impact on primary care practices and patient outcomes.

Primary Duties:

  • Reporting tools and outcome monitoring: Develop and maintain tools and dashboards that report on the processes supporting Michigan's growing provider network and that monitor key business outcomes.
  • Claims and market analysis: Use claims data to analyze Michigan market trends in cost and utilization, and produce novel insights that inform market strategy and identify cost-reduction opportunities for field operations and partner practices.
  • Field and practice partnership: Work with the field team and enterprise practice partners to identify key operational barriers and use data to help inform new interventions.
  • Board and leadership reporting: Produce reports and materials for ACO and IPA board of directors meetings and metrics report-outs, and provide key clinical insights to Medical Directors.
  • Project plans, metrics, and special projects: Develop and maintain project plans and key metrics that support Aledade Michigan's business operations, and work on a range of special projects to support business needs.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in business analytics, research, or health care.
  • Excellent quantitative analysis abilities, grounded in health informatics, healthcare analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical ability and proficiency with Excel/Sheets and PowerPoint/Slides, plus data management and data manipulation skills, including a foundation in SQL queries.
  • Experience with healthcare data sources such as claims, electronic health record, event notification, clinical, and patient-reported data.
  • Ability to source and analyze data, produce accurate and unbiased results, and present meaningful recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders in data visualizations, dashboards, and reports.
  • Familiar with Michigan healthcare landscape and payer programs (such as PGIP and Blueprint).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building data reports in Tableau (or other similar business intelligence software); Tableau experience strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of standard methods for measuring health care utilization, spending, quality, and outcomes; risk adjustment; provider profiling; and related analytical tasks.
  • Experience using qualitative inputs and quantitative data to drive decision-making.
  • Familiarity with value-based care.
  • Intense attention to detail and data quality assurance; detail-oriented and self-motivated to produce work that meets high standards.
  • Comfortable tackling ambiguous problems with a high level of autonomy; highly organized and proactive in raising questions about clarity, prioritization, and blockers to drive assigned tasks forward.
  • Strong writer and effective verbal communicator; collaborative team player with a roll-up-your-sleeves mentality.
  • Excited to join a fast-paced startup environment with significant opportunity for growth and to make a positive contribution to the healthcare field.

Physical Requirements:

  • Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% of the time, as needed.

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:

Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles

Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners

Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)

Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays

12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents

Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service

Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program

401(k) with up to 4% match

Stock options

And much more!

At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

We may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help organize and evaluate application materials. These tools support our recruiters and hiring managers by helping manage large applicant pools. Human judgment plays an essential role in our hiring process, including in the oversight and use of any automated tools. If you would like more information about our screening and hiring process, please contact us. Our Commitment to Authenticity. We use Endorsed, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Aledade PBC using Lever, a cloud services provider located in the United States. Lever is engaged by Aledade PBC to help manage its recruitment and hiring processes. For more information about how your personal data will be processed by Aledade PBC and any rights you may have, please review Aledade PBC’s Candidate Privacy Notice. By applying for this job, you agree to Aledade's Applicant Privacy Policy available at https://www.aledade.com/privacy-policy-applicants If you have any questions about our privacy practices, please contact [email protected] .

descriptionHtml:
Want to help pets live their best lives?

We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you

Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.

Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.

Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through district experiences, products, and services.

Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

Enterprise Analytics & Data Science Department

The Enterprise Analytics & Data Science department is responsible for leveraging strategic insights, customer analytics, data science, and market intel to understand customer behavior trends, product relationships, competitive positioning, and marketing opportunities to maximize financial performance and deliver exceptional customer experience.

The Business Intelligence team translates raw data into clear, actionable reporting and analytics. We develop efficient reporting solutions that help business leaders make timely, data-backed decisions with confidence.

About The Role

Are you an analytical problem-solver looking to accelerate your career in retail analytics and data visualization? In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex datasets and retail business partners, developing intuitive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that drive strategic decision-making across our retail operations.

The ideal candidate has a strong eye for data visualization, solid SQL skills, and a genuine curiosity for understanding retail performance. You will partner closely with business leaders to translate raw data into clear, compelling visual narratives using modern BI platforms, helping the team monitor key metrics and spot operational opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Dashboard Development, Data Preparation & Retail Analysis

Data Visualization & Reporting: Develop visually compelling, user-friendly, and high-performance dashboards. Our preferred BI platforms are MicroStrategy or Looker, though proficiency in Power BI or Tableau is highly valued.

UI/UX & Report Design: Apply clean visualization and design principles to ensure reporting layouts are intuitive, clear, and optimized for fast business decision-making.

Data Processing & SQL Queries: Write efficient SQL queries to profile, extract, filter, and structure raw data from cloud databases for seamless dashboard integration.

Quality Assurance & Credibility: Embed rigorous quality check standards into development workflows, ensuring high data accuracy and building total user trust in business reporting.

Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot and resolve basic performance issues in dashboards to guarantee a seamless, fast, and reliable end user experience.

Reporting Efficiencies: Maintain and optimize scheduled reporting cadences. Help streamline delivery processes using built-in BI tool scheduling or spreadsheet-based functions.

Legacy Report Optimization: Work to modernize legacy Excel spreadsheets or manual reporting processes, transitioning them into more sustainable, automated, or interactive dashboard solutions.

Ad-Hoc Analysis & Leadership Support: Support senior leadership and business stakeholders by conducting objective, data-driven analyses to answer key business questions. Assist in responding to high-priority inquiries by compiling accurate findings into clear, well-structured briefs and summary reports.

Insight Presentation: Translate data findings into clear, digestible summaries. Present trends and dashboard configurations to cross-functional stakeholders across the business.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with broader Analytics and Data Science teams to incorporate predictive metrics and model outputs into core operational dashboards.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience & Education

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related quantitative/business field.

Experience: 1–2+ years of hands-on experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a similar data-driven role

Industry Experience: Prior experience or a strong interest in retail operations, e-commerce, and key retail performance metrics.

Technical Skills

BI Platforms: Hands-on development experience or strong familiarity with modern BI tools (Looker and MicroStrategy preferred, Power BI or Tableau as alternatives).

SQL: Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, querying, profiling, and backend validation.

Spreadsheets: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for rapid data modeling and analysis.

Scripting (Beneficial): Familiarity with scripting languages (such as Python, JavaScript/Apps Script, or VBA) for task automation is a valuable advantage.

Analytical Mindset & Intellectual Curiosity: A genuine passion for exploring data, asking probing questions, and discovering underlying retail trends.

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to explain technical layouts to non-technical stakeholders and craft clear, executive-ready performance summaries.

Time Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver quality work in a fast-paced retail environment.

Actual pay rates will depend on factors such as position, location, level of experience, and applicable state or local minimum wage laws. Salary Range: $63,800.00 - $105,600.00

Hourly or Salary Range will be reflected above. For a more detailed overview of Petco Total Rewards, including health and financial benefits, 401K, incentives, and PTO - see https://careers.petco.com/us/en/key-benefits

About Petco

We’re proud to be “where the pets go” to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years – from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood – the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.

Petco Animal Supplies, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or any other protected classification. Please see our Privacy Policy here.

descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Data Analyst

Company: Clinisol Tech Inc.

Employment Type: Full-Time, W2 (deployed to client projects)

Experience: 2–3 years

Compensation: $60,000–$90,000 per year (Negotiable)

Work Mode: On-Site / Hybrid

Work Authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Why This Role?

Join Clinisol Tech Inc. to turn data into actionable business insights. Work on real-world client projects, build dashboards, analyze trends, and help organizations make data-driven decisions while developing your skills in SQL, Excel, and business intelligence tools.

Job Summary

Clinisol Tech Inc. is seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst with 2–3 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, and dashboard development. The ideal candidate will be comfortable extracting, cleaning, validating, and analyzing data to identify trends and provide meaningful insights to business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Extract, clean, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Write SQL queries to retrieve, join, aggregate, and validate data.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Use Microsoft Excel for data analysis, pivot tables, formulas, and reporting.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs), identify trends, and investigate discrepancies.
  • Automate recurring reports and improve reporting efficiency.
  • Translate business requirements into analytical reports and actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with business, operations, product, and technical teams.
  • Maintain data accuracy, documentation, and confidentiality.

Qualifications

  • 2–3 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Reporting, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Microsoft Excel.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, or another BI visualization tool.
  • Understanding of relational databases, data cleaning, and data-quality principles.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to present complex data clearly and work collaboratively with stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Python for data analysis is a plus.

Tools & Technologies

  • Querying: SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server
  • Spreadsheets: Microsoft Excel, PivotTables, Power Query
  • Visualization: Power BI, Tableau, Looker
  • Programming: Python, Pandas
  • Data Platforms: Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with interactive dashboards, KPI reporting, and data visualization.
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data warehousing.
  • Knowledge of basic statistics, trend analysis, and data modeling.
  • Experience automating reports and performing data-quality checks.

About Clinisol Tech Inc.

Clinisol Tech Inc. connects businesses with skilled professionals who drive results. We combine industry expertise with a personalized approach to deliver the right talent efficiently. Our mission is to connect exceptional technology talent with innovative organizations that value people.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman is seeking a Data Insight Analyst to join the Warner Robins Data Analytics team within the Engineering organization. This role reports to the Manager, Computer Systems Analysis and is an on-site position in Warner Robins, Georgia.

The selected candidate will support the day‑to‑day operation, maintenance, and user enablement of our business intelligence and data preparation platforms. You will work closely with analysts, data engineers, database administrators, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure our data tools are reliable, secure, and performant.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

  • Extract, transform, and validate large datasets from multiple sources (e.g., SQL databases, Excel) to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports using Tableau and Power BI to support operational decision‑making.
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear data models, KPIs, and visual storytelling solutions.
  • Perform advanced data analysis to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights that drive strategic initiatives.
  • Bridge operational technology (OT) with IT systems to enable high‑performance data visualization and logging.
  • Optimize report and dashboard performance, manage data refresh schedules, and implement governance standards for dashboard consistency and usability.

**This position may be filled at either Data Insight Analyst or Principal Data Insight Analyst role.**

Basic Qualifications

  • For a Level 2: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field and 3+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or business intelligence roles.
  • For a Level 3: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field and 5+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, or business intelligence roles.
  • **Will consider 4 additional years of related experience in lieu of Bachelor's Degree.
  • Minimum 2+ years of hands‑on experience developing interactive dashboards and reports using Tableau and/or Power BI in a professional environment.
  • Proficiency in SQL for complex data extraction and transformation, including joins, subqueries, CTEs, and performance tuning.
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing data models, including relationships, calculated fields, DAX measures, and data validation processes.
  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into KPIs, metrics, and visually compelling dashboards for operational and executive audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills, with the ability to clearly present insights to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Must currently hold or be able to obtain and maintain a U.S Government Secret level security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related discipline, with 3+ years of experience in enterprise‑level business intelligence environments.
  • Advanced expertise in Tableau (including Tableau Prep and advanced calculations) and/or Power BI (including complex DAX development and performance optimization) or
  • Experience implementing data governance standards, BI best practices, and scalable reporting frameworks across departments.
  • Holds a current U.S Government Secret level security clearance.

NGSkills

Primary Level Salary Range: $72,100.00 - $108,100.00

Secondary Level Salary Range: $89,400.00 - $134,200.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.

descriptionHtml:
The Business Data Analyst I role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home. The position also requires 10-15% local travel to other sites within Texas.

The Business Data Analyst I role has a national salary range of $70,000 - $115,000.

For roles within California the range is $70,304 - $115,000 and Washington is $80,169 - $115,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase, and a generous PTO policy.

Are you ready to turn data into decisions that drive real impact in the supply chain world? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Business Data Analyst I who thrives on solving complex problems, creating powerful visualizations, and delivering actionable insights. This is your chance to be at the heart of operations, influencing strategy and performance in a dynamic warehouse environment. If you're passionate about analytics, innovation, and making a difference, this role is for you. If you're a curious, self-driven problem solver with a passion for analytics, innovation, and impact—this role is for you!

Job Description

As a Business Data Analyst I, you will play a key role in transforming operational data into strategic insights that identify opportunities, improve performance, and reduce costs. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build reports, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. This role is ideal for someone with foundational analytics experience who is ready to take ownership of projects and grow into a trusted resource for data solutions.


  • Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
  • Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
  • Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
  • Collaborate with site and sector leadership to identify opportunities for efficiency and cost reduction
  • Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights through presentations and reports for internal and customer use
  • Ability to leverage data from various systems that support our operations (Warehouse Management System, Timekeeping systems, etc.)
  • Manage analytics projects independently, from concept to delivery
  • Serve as a point of contact for Power BI-related questions and support


Required Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience, required
  • 1+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, required
  • Hands-on experience using SQL or other scripting languages (such as Python or R) to query, clean, and transform data, required
  • Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards and reports from scratch, required
  • Experience writing DAX expressions to automate and enhance Power BI reports, required
  • Strong understanding of statistical concepts and data modeling techniques, preferred
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, preferred
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines, required
  • Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required


Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

descriptionHtml:
About Spot

Spot Pet Insurance is the fastest-growing pet insurance company in North America. Our commitment to an exceptional end-to-end customer experience and our data-driven approach have quickly established us as a leading pet insurance provider. We're dedicated to providing pet parents with peace of mind by offering accessible and comprehensive coverage so their furry companions can lead happier, healthier lives.


To demonstrate this commitment, we recently joined forces with MrBeast to help find homes for 100 homeless pets and committed to providing each of them with pet insurance for life. Along the way, we've created a company culture that allows our employees to thrive, with perks like daily free meals, a pet-friendly office, and fun company events every quarter. Our dedication to fostering a positive and rewarding work environment has even earned us a Great Place to Work certification.


About the Role


We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate is passionate about data, highly analytical, and eager to turn complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that drive business performance. This role will support both recurring and ad hoc analysis across the business, helping teams make faster, smarter decisions.

We are looking for someone who is high-energy, hands-on, collaborative, and willing to dive in and "run through walls" to get things done.


Responsibilities


• Partner directly with management to support strategy development and execution through data-driven insights and experimentation across sales and marketing channels.

• Design and build full-cycle experiments, dashboards, and reporting frameworks that improve decision-making and business outcomes.

• Gather stakeholder requirements, define key success metrics, and maintain regular reporting on performance indicators.

• Identify, integrate, and help automate new data sources and pipelines to improve data availability and reliability.

• Analyze datasets to identify trends, correlations, and relationships between key business metrics.

• Ensure data practices are aligned with privacy, compliance, and governance standards.

• Help establish and maintain a single source of truth across core datasets and reporting layers.

• Ensure ongoing data integrity, consistency, and observability across all reporting systems.


Qualifications

• 5-6 years of experience working as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Data Engineer.

• Strong experience using SQL to transform datasets into meaningful metrics and insights.

• Experience with ELT processes and methodologies.

• Experience managing databases, including relational database architecture, query optimization, and database schema design.

• Empathy and creativity to understand and solve stakeholder problems.

• Passion for data origins, integrity, accuracy, and storytelling.


Technologies

• SQL Databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL)

• Looker Studio and Tableau

• Google Analytics

• Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

• BigQuery

• Segment CDP

• Python

• R Studio


Nice to Have

• Experience with analytics and visualization tools such as Tableau and Power BI.

• Experience with data engineering tools such as BigQuery.

• Experience with machine learning, advanced modeling, or market mix modeling.

• Experience with advanced statistical analysis.


Compensation


Base pay range: $105,891 – $130,866 per year. This is the range we reasonably expect to pay at hire. Placement within the range depends on job-related factors such as experience, skills, and certifications. This position is not eligible for bonus or incentive pay. Base pay is one part of a total rewards package that includes benefits


Interview Technology Notice

Please note that phone and video interviews or screenings may be recorded and transcribed using interview technology to support our recruitment process.

By continuing with the interview, you consent to this use.


Text Messaging Notice

If you provide a mobile phone number, you may receive job-related communications via text message. Message and data rates may apply.

You may opt out of text communications at any time by replying "STOP."

descriptionHtml:
OnPoint is the largest community owned credit union in Oregon – and we’re growing! Our growth provides great opportunities for you to reach your personal and professional goals. We value enthusiasm, commitment to outstanding performance, and providing opportunities to truly make a difference. If you are looking to join a team of dedicated, collaborative, and passionate individuals, OnPoint is looking for our next Data Analyst Sr. – Fraud & Risk. We invite you to explore and grow your career with us!

Job Summary

The Data Analyst Senior – Fraud & Risk will be responsible for transforming fragmented fraud and risk data into trusted, actionable insights that accelerate fraud detection, investigation, recovery, risk mitigation, and audit readiness. This role operates in an ML‑enabled vendor environment, partnering closely with Fraud Operations, Risk, and Technology to extract maximum value from platforms like Verafin while laying the data foundation for future in‑house modeling. The analyst will also perform risk data analysis across fraud patterns, operational controls, exposure trends, and model performance to strengthen organizational decision‑making.

Essential Functions

  • Design and maintain fraud and risk analytics datasets in Databricks sourced from Verafin, Accelerant, Q2, Fed files, and other operational systems.
  • Build governed, repeatable pipelines and curated tables to replace manual Excel/macros processes.
  • Integrate cross‑channel fraud and risk views, such as member, account, product, transaction, case, exposure, or control effectiveness.
  • Perform risk data analysis to identify trends, gaps, typologies, control failures, and emerging threats.
  • Conduct quantitative assessments of fraud exposure, loss forecasting, and risk scenario analysis.
  • Partner with Fraud Operations to interpret and operationalize vendor ML outputs, such as risk scores, alerts, typologies.
  • Analyze model performance, false‑positive rates, thresholds, and operational impacts on fraud and risk controls.
  • Collaborate with first‑ and second‑line risk teams to ensure model outputs align with broader risk strategies.
  • Develop executive‑ready dashboards and investigator‑ready reporting with
  • Support audit, compliance, and regulatory requests with defensible evidence, through traceable, well‑documented metrics.
  • Contribute to fraud and risk data standards, definitions, metadata, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with Technology and Architecture on data ingestion and quality improvements.
  • Additional projects, responsibilities, or other duties assigned.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

  • Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex joins, window functions, data cleansing, performance tuning.
  • Strong proficiency with cloud data platforms, such as Databricks, Delta Lake, and distributed data processing.
  • Proven experience with trend analysis, loss/risk modeling, exposure calculations, scenario analysis.
  • Deep expertise in data quality and governance, such as data lineage, metric definitions, documentation, and standardization.
  • Expert-level knowledge in dashboard and visualization tools, executive reporting, investigator tools, KPI dashboards.
  • Knowledge of python/scripting, including data transformation, automation, and analytics (preferred but not required).
  • Working knowledge of data engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, pipeline development, ETL/ELT, and building curated datasets.
  • Ability to break down complex data issues, identify root causes, and propose actionable solutions.
  • Strong ability to convert data into meaningful operational and risk insights that influence decisions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to communicate complex technical issues to employees at all levels.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including senior leaders.
  • Working knowledge of fraud schemes, typologies, transaction flows, loss drivers, and enterprise risk frameworks.
  • Knowledge of ML‑based alerting systems, risk scoring, thresholding, and model performance concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy, traceability, and defensibility of analyses and reporting.

Min Qualifications

  • 5 years of experience in data analytics
  • Advanced SQL and experience working with large, messy datasets
  • Experience with Databricks or modern cloud data platforms
  • Proven ability to translate analytics into operational and executive insights

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8 years of experience in data analytics, preferably in financial services, risk, or fraud
  • Strong understanding of fraud concepts (alerts, cases, typologies, losses, recovery)
  • Experience working with vendor fraud platforms (e.g., Verafin)
  • Familiarity with model outputs, thresholds, and false‑positive tuning
  • Experience supporting audits or regulatory exams
  • Experience with Python or similar scripting for data transformation

OnPoint employees are rewarded, acknowledged and appreciated! We take care of our Members, and OnPoint takes care of us by offering employees a generous vacation package, incentives, competitive hourly pay, 100% - paid employee medical, dental and vision premiums, Tri-Met / parking passes, 401k matching, tuition reimbursement and more!

At OnPoint, we believe a workplace that reflects the richness of the world fosters a welcoming and empowering environment for everyone. We're committed to equity and inclusion, and consider all qualified applicants embracing every race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and your unique background.

We encourage you to apply if you're passionate about this opportunity and have the core qualifications. Your unique experiences and skills are what make you a strong candidate. If you need any accommodation(s) during the application or interview stage, please let us know. We're dedicated to providing what's necessary to ensure a fair and inclusive experience.

descriptionHtml:
Company Overview For Formosa Plastics Corporation, U.S.A.

Founded in 1978, Formosa Plastics Corporation, U.S.A. (Formosa Plastics) is a growing, vertically-integrated supplier of plastic resins and petrochemicals. With annual revenues of more than $5 billion, we employ over 2,800 people who operate 20 production units in six business divisions - Olefins, Polyolefins, Vinyl, Specialty Polyvinyl Chloride, Chlor-Alkali, and Oil & Gas.

Formosa Plastics offers a full line of polyvinyl chloride, polyethylene and polypropylene resins, caustic soda and other petrochemicals that deliver the consistency, performance and quality that customers demand. We market our polypropylene and polyethylene resins under the Formolene® tradename; we market our suspension PVC and specialty (dispersion) PVC resins under the Formolon® tradename. We also produce and sell caustic soda, ethylene dichloride, commercial bleach and hydrochloric acid.

We are committed to supplying the highest quality products and services to our customers, providing a safe and healthy workplace for our employees and contributing to the quality of life in the communities where we operate. This commitment is made possible through our dedicated people, consistent products, continued protection of the environment and ongoing investments in new product development, quality control systems and safe, modern and energy-efficient production facilities.

Formosa Plastics is a privately held company headquartered in Livingston, New Jersey. Our core business, producing plastic resins and petrochemicals, takes place at three wholly-owned chemical manufacturing subsidiaries located in Delaware City, Delaware, Baton Rouge, Louisiana and Point Comfort, Texas.

DATA ANALYST

POSITION OBJECTIVE

Serve as the division's Data Analyst, accountable for translating internal business data and external market data into reliable analytics, Power BI reporting, and internal application features that management and cross-functional stakeholders rely on to make decisions. The position interprets complex data from multiple internal and external sources, evaluates alternatives, and recommends solutions that improve reporting accuracy, operational efficiency, and business insight across the Sales, Marketing, and Technical Service functions. Application development is performed within the division's existing application environment — building and maintaining pages and features on the established stack.

The analyst independently owns analytics and reporting deliverables end-to-end, takes on complex data and reporting work, resolves non-routine data and integration problems with limited approval, and provides recommendations that management relies on for reporting and process decisions. Application development is limited to building and maintaining pages and features on the division's existing stack.

MAJOR AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY

Data Analytics & Reporting

  • Own the design, accuracy, and integrity of the division's Power BI data models and reporting layer — determining data model structure, authoring production DAX logic, and validating that reported figures are correct and decision-ready for management.
  • Own the development and accuracy of Power BI reporting on external market and trade data — sourced from industry and market-intelligence providers such as Plastics News, Datamyne, and similar services — integrating these sources into Power BI, interpreting pricing, import/export, and market trends, and presenting insights that inform commercial and business-development decisions.
  • Own the integrity and reliability of ETL/data-integration pipelines that consolidate data from multiple internal and external sources (Azure SQL, spreadsheets, and external market-data feeds such as Plastics News and Datamyne), investigating and resolving data-quality and reconciliation issues that are not governed by a standard procedure.
  • Independently own analytics and reporting deliverables end-to-end — from requirements analysis through build, validation, and stakeholder delivery — exercising discretion over scope, approach, and prioritization; sets own timeline and method for standard deliverables, and raises resourcing conflicts or scope changes affecting other functions to the Manager.
  • Recommend reporting design direction and delivery priorities in planning discussions, evaluating alternatives and advising on solutions that management and business partners rely on for analytics and reporting decisions.

Application Development

  • Build and maintain internal application pages and features within the division's existing application environment (React / TypeScript front end, consuming existing REST APIs), delivering well-defined features to meet business requirements with moderate supervision.
  • Follow the division's established application patterns, standards, and code-review process; test changes and apply feedback, working under the guidance of more senior developers on non-routine design decisions.

Qualifications

Previous Related Experience Required

  • Demonstrated experience independently designing and maintaining Power BI data models and reports used by business stakeholders for decision-making.
  • Experience building application pages and features and data integrations within an existing application environment (SQL databases, existing REST APIs, and multiple data sources) with moderate supervision.
  • Track record of investigating and resolving non-routine data-quality, reconciliation, or integration issues and recommending corrective actions.

Technical Skills Required To Perform This Job

  • Ability to independently analyze business requirements, evaluate alternative approaches, and determine an appropriate technical solution with limited supervision.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query); working proficiency in front-end development (React / TypeScript) sufficient to build pages and features within an existing application and consume existing REST APIs.
  • Ability to interpret complex, multi-source data — rather than only compile it — and to identify trends, variances, and root causes that inform recommendations to management.
  • Experience building ETL/data-integration pipelines across enterprise sources (Azure SQL, spreadsheets, and other systems) and resolving non-routine data-quality and reconciliation issues.
  • Familiarity with external market and trade-data sources (e.g., Plastics News, Datamyne) and the ability to acquire, integrate, and report on them in Power BI for market and competitive analysis.
  • Experience applying AI tools and workflow-automation solutions — including AI agents and integrations with CRM, ERP, databases, and APIs — to improve reporting and business processes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present analysis and recommendations to management and cross-functional stakeholders.

Education (Minimal Education Needed)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics,Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant analytics experience.

Health Coverage and Perks

Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance plans

Flexible spending accounts for health, dependent care

Short-term Disability

Long-term Disability

Group Term Life, Dependent and

Supplemental Life Insurance

Tuition Reimbursement

Work/Life Balance

10 Paid Holidays

Paid Time Off for a balanced life

(Vacation, Sick and Personal Time)

FlexTime Available

Competitive Compensation

Competitive salary, incentive/bonus, 401(k) plan with company match,

Cash Balance, Pension Plan

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Data Analyst II to join our Client Experience (CX) team in League City, TX. This position actively designs, integrates, and maintains client data systems and analytical deliverables within the Client Experience (CX) Analytics & Operations function. The Data Analyst II executes data ingestion, hygiene, and reporting activities; supports the operation of client data infrastructure and connected systems including the Voice of Client (VOC) platform; and contributes to test, brand, marketing, and client research analyses. The position works collaboratively with team members and stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and usability across CX initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Creates and executes plans for data ingestion, transformation, and quality tasks within client data systems and connected platforms.
  • Supports client identity resolution and unique client identifier maintenance, including monitoring of data hygiene rules and exception handling.
  • Develops and maintains data flows, inclcuing complex and new flows, between client data systems and downstream or upstream systems, including the VOC platform (Qualtrics) and reporting environments.
  • Builds a variety of reports, dashboards, and basic analytical models to support CX, brand, and marketing initiatives, demonstrating creativity and customization for the intended audience
  • Performs in-depth quality assurance and validation of data and analytical deliverables for completeness and accuracy.
  • Documents data flows, business rules, and analytical processes for ongoing reference.
  • Responds to a variety of ad-hoc data and reporting requests from CX team members and business partners.
  • Creates and conducts tests and studies, including data preparation, baseline analyses, and documentation of study assumptions and limitations.
  • Participates in research, brand, and marketing studies in a supporting analytical capacity.
  • Tracks work from inception through development, testing, and end-user communication.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Two to four years of experience.
  • Additional Qualifications:
    • Equivalent work experience in a business, analytical, or technical environment maybe considered in lieu of a Bachelor’s degree.
    • Experience working with data from multiple sources, building reports, and supporting analytical solutions.
    • Experience with data quality, data cleansing, and data transformation best practices.
    • Familiarity with structured testing and study methodologies, including hypothesis development and study documentation.
    • Advanced Excel knowledge.
    • Intermediate understanding of data modeling, testing, data visualization, and reporting concepts and tools.
    • Knowledge of basic business processes and the client experience lifecycle.
    • Familiarity with both on-premises and cloud-based data systems, tools, and services.
What Will Set You Apart

  • Exposure to client data platforms and connected systems, or comparable MDM/Client 360 platforms.
  • Familiarity with Voice of Client (VOC) and survey platforms such as Qualtrics.
  • Experience writing basic Structured Query Language (SQL) and/or Python for data analysis.
  • Intermediate understanding of business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong analytical, creative, and detail-oriented thinking skills.
  • Interest in evolving and improving client data and analytics capabilities over time.

Additional Information

Job titles may span multiple career levels. Base pay is determined by a variety of factors, including training, transferable skills, relevant experience, business needs, and market conditions. Compensation is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Job Description

  • Responds to ad-hoc query requests for information from internal and external entities.
  • Uses SQL tools to manipulate, analyze, clean, and transform data.
  • Develops and maintains portal and database reports.
  • Works directly with College personnel to support data gathering, analysis, visualizations, and summary feedback in a manner that is efficient, timely, and professional.
  • Creates visualizations of data for presentations.
  • Manages multiple projects, sets priorities, meets deadlines, and works independently.
  • Evaluates procedures to ensure validity, applicability, efficiency, and accuracy.
  • Disseminates information clearly and concisely in verbal and written form.
  • Presents ideas to individuals or groups to ensure that they understand the information.
  • Demonstrates commitment to continuous learning by completing all required training, compliance courses, and professional development activities promptly and within established deadlines.

In compliance with current state executive directives and the Texas Workforce Commission guidelines regarding foreign worker visa programs, Angelina College has implemented a freeze on the processing of new H-1B visa petitions. $55,000.00 per year in addition to excellent employee benefits. Proof of identify and eligibility to work in the United States must be verified for the successful candidate.

A completed application form, a cover letter, a resume, and college transcripts are required for an applicant to be considered. Please visit the Angelina College portal at https://myac.angelina.edu/ICS/AC_Employment/ to apply. Screening of qualified applicants will begin and continue until the position is filled. This is a security sensitive position and an appropriate background investigation will be made on applicants being strongly considered for the position.

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

The Senior Data Analyst, Clinical Programs will be an analytically driven team player, responsible for understanding business needs and objectives, eliciting requirements from stakeholders, and analyzing data and processes to identify opportunities for improvement. This role will support BHPS Clinical Programs, Utilization Management, Complex Case Management, and Population Health Management. In this role, you will be challenged to think creatively while developing actionable insights to inform client and program strategy.

  • This is a Remote role

Primary Responsibilities

  • Monitor Utilization Management and Case Management activities through the development of KPIs and benchmarks (i.e. member engagement rates, readmissions, preventable hospitalizations, ER utilization)
  • Develop statistical models that deliver meaningful insights on cost, utilization and clinical outcomes based on various data sources
  • Develop algorithms for stratifying populations and identifying high-risk members
  • Leverage Predictive Analytics to measure the performance (ROI) of Disease Management and other Medical Management programs
  • Conduct prospective savings analyses in support of clinical program initiatives
  • Build and maintain client-facing reports, dashboards, and analyses
  • Develop actionable data insights and advise on client strategy
  • Participate in program performance review presentations with clinical program managers, client account managers, and external clients, as needed
  • Manage internal and external client requests and timelines to ensure timely delivery
  • Collaborate with Medical Management to provide ongoing support

Essential Qualifications

  • Bachelors' degree required, preferably in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Actuarial Science, Data Science, or related field
  • 5-7 years of experience in healthcare analytics, preferably in a managed care setting
  • Proficiency in SQL and Microsoft SQL Server Suite of Products (SSMS) required
  • Proficiency in MS Excel required
  • Advanced data analysis, financial modeling, and predictive analytics skills
  • Experience with clinical program evaluation and outcomes reporting.
  • Experience with health plan performance reporting and cost and utilization analysis
  • Experience with developing client-facing reports
  • Experience with Business Intelligence applications and DAX functions (PowerPivot, Power BI, Tableau)
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to a non-technical audience
  • Ability to effectively manage and prioritize several concurrent projects
  • Excellent oral and written communications skills
  • Experience with Payer Care Management platforms (i.e. ZeOmega) a plus

About

At Brighton Health Plan Solutions, LLC, our people are committed to the improvement of how healthcare is accessed and delivered. When you join our team, you’ll become part of a diverse and welcoming culture focused on encouragement, respect and increasing diversity, inclusion and a sense of belonging at every level. Here, you’ll be encouraged to bring your authentic self to work with all of your unique abilities.

Brighton Health Plan Solutions partners with self-insured employers, Taft-Hartley Trusts, health systems, providers as well as other TPAs, and enables them to solve the problems facing today’s healthcare with our flexible and cutting-edge third-party administration services. Our unique perspective stems from decades of health plan management expertise, our proprietary provider networks, and innovative technology platform. As a healthcare enablement company, we unlock opportunities that provide clients with the customizable tools they need to enhance the member experience, improve health outcomes and achieve their healthcare goals and objectives. Together with our trusted partners, we are transforming the health plan experience with the promise of turning today’s challenges into tomorrow’s solutions.

Come be a part of the Brightest Ideas in Healthcare™.

Company Mission

Transform the health plan experience – how health care is accessed and delivered – by bringing outstanding products and services to our partners.

Company Vision

Redefine health care quality and value by aligning the incentives of our partners in powerful and unique ways.

JOB ALERT FRAUD: We have become aware of scams from individuals, organizations, and internet sites claiming to represent Brighton Health Plan Solutions in recruitment activities in return for disclosing financial information. Our hiring process does not include text-based conversations or interviews and never requires payment or fees from job applicants. All of our career opportunities are regularly published and updated brighonthps.com Careers section. If you have already provided your personal information, please report it to your local authorities. Any fraudulent activity should be reported to: recruiting@brightonhps.com

We are looking for you to join our team as a Data Analyst. This position focuses on data analysis for law enforcement support, requiring a combination of investigative data expertise, analytical skills, and the ability to work under high-pressure, mission-critical environments. This role will involve working with diverse data sets, ensuring accuracy and integrity while supporting ongoing criminal and civil investigations.

Our ideal candidate has a blend of technical acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to engage with law enforcement agencies. We are looking for more than just a "Data Analyst"—this role requires a technologist with excellent communication skills, customer service, and a passion for data and problem-solving.

Contributions

  • Data Analysis and Trend Recognition: Compile and analyze data from multiple sources, identifying trends across various data sets, locations, and targets.
  • Data Accuracy and Assessment: Monitor data for accuracy, integrity, authenticity, and relevancy. Identify intelligence gaps and assess data viability for investigative purposes.
  • Investigative Support: Collaborate with teams to examine data gathered from criminal and civil investigations, developing methodologies to exploit investigative information.

Job Description

POSITION IS ON SITE IN LAS VEGAS, NV

As a Data Analyst, you will deliver reports and analyses that look at historical and current views of the business to support key partners in decision making.   • Write SQL, Python, R, SSIS, etc. to extract, manipulate, and move data within the Boyd Gaming technology stack.

Other duties as assigned.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as business analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, or closely related field required.

  • Working knowledge of BI tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, or Power BI required.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office.
  • Inquisitive analytic thinking.
  • Organized and detail oriented with strong attention to accuracy.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain any necessary licenses and/or certifications.

descriptionHtml:
Range is creating AI-powered solutions to eliminate financial complexity for our members. We're transforming wealth management through the perfect blend of cutting-edge technology and human expertise. We're obsessed with member experience! We've built an integrated platform that tackles the full spectrum of financial needs–investments, taxes, retirement planning, and estate management–all unified in one intuitive system.

Backed by Google's Gradient Ventures, Cathay Innovations, and Scale Venture Partners, we're in hyper-growth mode and looking for exceptional talent to join our starting lineup. Every Ranger at this stage is shaping our culture and way of life—from former CEOs and startup founders to experts from leading hedge funds and tech companies.

If you're ready to build something that truly matters in financial services, bring your talent to Range. Here, you'll make a genuine impact on how people manage their financial lives while working alongside a team that celebrates wins, makes big decisions, and blazes new trails together.

About The Role

As a Senior Data Analyst at Range, you will be an analytical partner for teams across the business including member experience, planners, investments, finance and more. You’ll sit embedded with those teams to understand their work deeply and turn their hardest questions into answers, dashboards and analyses that drive decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys a mix of fast turnaround and deep data work. You will find yourself answering Slack questions with quick SQL pulls, building dashboards for new initiatives and deep diving into the best ways to understand churn trends or customer journeys.

We're excited to hire this role at Range's Headquarters in McLean, VA. All of our positions follow an in-office schedule Monday through Friday, allowing you to collaborate directly with your team. If you're not currently based in the area, but love what you see, let's discuss relocation as part of your journey to joining us.

What You'll Do With Us

  • Be the analytical partners that business units rely on. Embed with the teams you support, learn their work deeply and become the person they come to when they need to understand what’s happening or decide what to do next.
  • Deep dive the data that drives decisions. Investigate questions that don’t have easy answers: why churn is rising in a specific cohort, what is the next best action for a member, etc. You’ll frame the question, do the analysis and translate findings into actions.
  • Own the dashboards your business units run on. Build and maintain the dashboards the business units rely on for day-to-day decisions. Set the conventions for what's authoritative vs. exploratory within those teams, in line with the company-wide standards.
  • Handle ad hoc support and questions with judgment. Be the first point of contact when business teams need a quick answer, a pull, or a check on a number. Know which questions deserve a five-minute answer and which deserve a real investigation.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in a data-focused role (Data Analyst, Analytics, Data Science, or similar), including time embedded with business teams.
  • Advanced SQL. You can write a complex query without thinking about it and use it to answer the question that was asked, not just the question that was easy to query.
  • Comfort working in a modern data stack (dbt, a cloud warehouse, a BI tool like Sigma, Looker, or Tableau).
  • Strong analytical thinking. You can take an ambiguous business question, frame it, decide what data to look at, and turn the result into a recommendation.
  • A track record of communicating insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders. The best analysis doesn't matter if nobody acts on it.

What Will Set You Apart

  • You're comfortable with Python for analyses that go beyond SQL — statistical work, hypothesis testing, anything that requires more than aggregations.
  • You leverage AI as a force multiplier in your own work. You've developed real instincts for when to lean on it, when to verify, and where it actually accelerates analysis, dashboarding, and communication.

Compensation

Base salary range: $150,000 – $250,000

This is the base salary range we expect in good faith to pay for this role at the time of posting. Where an offer lands within the range depends on the scope and complexity of work the candidate can own independently and demonstrated depth at this level.

Other Compensation And Benefits

The range above reflects base salary only. Our offer packages also include equity in the form of stock options, so total compensation for this role will exceed the base salary range.

We do not ask for or consider salary history. You are welcome to ask questions about compensation at any point in the process.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: 100% employer-covered medical insurance for employees (75% for dependents), plus dental and vision coverage
  • 401(k): Retirement savings program to support your future
  • Paid Time Off: Dedicated time to reset and recharge plus most federal holidays
  • Parental Leave: Comprehensive leave policy for growing families
  • Meals: Select meals covered throughout the week
  • Fitness: Monthly movement stipend
  • Equity & Career Growth: Early exercise eligibility and a strong focus on professional development
  • Annual Compensation Reviews: Salary and equity refreshes based on performance
  • Boomerang Program: After two years at Range, you can take time away to start your own company. We’ll hold your spot for 6 months - and pause your equity vesting, which resumes if you return

Range is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. As a company, we are committed to designing products, building a culture, and supporting a team that reflects the diverse population we serve.

descriptionHtml:
Standard Job Description

THE WORK

Are you a data junkie? Do you enjoy developing, inspecting, mining, transforming, and modeling data to raise productivity, improve decision making, and gain competitive advantage in a production setting? Are data visualization applications your playground? If so, this is the perfect position for you!

Skills

In this role you will be part of an advanced data analytics team consisting of colleagues possessing varying skill sets including data science, front-end and back-end development, and other data/metric analyst skills. Our ideal candidate is someone who can:

  • Create interactive data analytics dashboards to measure & improve operations performance
  • Collect, analyze, and summarize data to communicate insightful information to key stakeholders
  • Work closely with leadership team, IT team, and other key stakeholders
  • Generate and document business processes and procedures
  • Present thorough and detailed reports to identify areas of opportunity to drive future decision making
  • Perform data validation and maintain integrity of dashboards & databases
  • Maintain and optimize current Tableau dashboards
  • Develop and automate data pipelines/structures
  • Complete Ad-hoc research request from senior leadership
  • Administer access control for various stakeholders
  • Generate and document Business processes and procedures

Who You Are

You are a dynamic and results-oriented professional with a passion for driving operational excellence and optimizing production processes. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are adept at managing complex projects while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Your strong analytical skills, coupled with your ability to communicate effectively and collaborate across departments, make you an invaluable asset to our team.

WHY JOIN US

Opportunity for Impact: Join a team that is at the forefront of innovation in the aerospace and defense industry and make a significant impact on the success of our organization.

Professional Development: Take advantage of unparalleled opportunities for growth and advancement within Lockheed Martin, with access to world-class training and development programs.

Collaborative Culture: Work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry who share your passion for excellence and who are committed to supporting each other's success.

Competitive Benefits: Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off, as well as competitive salary offerings.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience in the Aviation industry (Aviation Supply/Maintenance/Flight)
  • Experience in the Business Intelligence (BI) /Data Warehousing (DW) industry
  • Knowledge of Extract Transform and Load (ETL) concepts
  • Experience in developing Business Intelligence (BI) Visuals

Desired Skills

  • Experience in working with data integration and data warehousing solutions
  • Ability to interpret and convey technical details in a clear, concise manner for key decision-makers
  • Skilled in data analysis and facilitation, i.e. able to produce data designs using a variety of inputs such as requirements analysis, SME interviews, business process and data flow analysis, data profiling, etc.
  • Knowledgeable about Business Intelligence/analytics tools and their appropriate use in solutions for diverse business requirements with clarity in understanding business needs around ‘running the business vs managing the business’
  • Knowledge of Data software such as IBM Cloud Pak Services (IKC, Watson Studio, Data Stage, Watson Query, Cognos), Alteryx, Tableau, Tableau Prep
  • Ability to interact & communicate effectively with colleagues on requirements
  • Perform specialized data investigations to support analytics and custom reporting scenarios
  • Ability to work independently as well as with a team
  • Energetic & Self-Starting
  • Focused on results and able to work closely with others in collaborative environment
  • Strong attention to detail with proven problem-solving skills and results
